Each of these ten 10ml ampoules contains 0.9% sodium chloride for intravenous (IV), intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) injections. Used to restore depleted salt levels and rehydrating dehydrated tissues, and for mixing with other medications, this solution is generally well-tolerated by patients and has a variety of roles in the modern dental practice. Features & Benefits: Variety of ampoule sizes available, including 2ml, 5ml, and 10ml. Used for Tissue rehydration, irrigation, dilution of medicines and more. Generally well-tolerated by patients. What is Sodium Chloride used for? Some uses of Sodium Chloride include: Irrigation and cleaning of wounds, dilution of medicines, rehydration of dehydrated tissues, to maintain patency in IV sites. Generic GTN - Glyceryl Trinitrate Sublingual Spray AEN010 ( 0.4g (200 Dose) ) Generic code: 6327498 In Stock In Stock Restricted In Stock In Stock Restricted Sign In for Prices Product Overview A nitrate used to alleviate chest pain caused by angina. It dilates the blood vessels and is used to prevent and treat angina pectoris: left ventrical failure. This spray contains 200 metered doses of 400 micrograms per spray. This is sprayed under the tongue during application so as to ensure quick absorption, do not use more than two sprays during an attack. Features & Benefits: Alleviates chest pain caused by angina. Contains 200 metered doses of 400 micrograms per spray. Do not use more than 2 sprays during an attack. Product Details: 1 x bottle of GTN - Glyceryl Trinitrate Sublingual Spray FAQs: Who can't take GTN? According to the NHS at time of writing, the following patients cannot take GTN: Patients who have ever had an allergic reaction to GTN or any other medicine any recent brain or head injuries or problems, including bleeding in your brain and raised pressure in your head ever had a stroke any heart problems (other than angina), including a recent heart attack or heart failure low blood pressure (hypotension) anaemia Glaucoma Please check the manufacturer instructions alongside healthcare guidance. main_text: Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Strength: 50units Size: 1 x 50units Form: Vial QuickFind Code: 37981b Cold Chain View Special Offers SIGN IN FOR PRICE Product Description Letybo® Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo® contains the active substance botulinum toxin type A. It works by blocking nerve impulses to the muscles in which it has been injected. It prevents muscles from contracting, leading to a temporary paralysis. Letybo® is used in adults less than 75 years of age to temporarily improve moderate to severe vertical lines between the eyebrows, when their presence has a significant psychological impact on them. Letybo® is a white lyophilized powder for solution for injection provided in a clear glass vial with a rubber stopper and aluminium tamper-proof seal. Directions The recommended dose is 20 units divided into five injections of 0.1 mL (4 units). Each injection is given into the muscles above or between the eyebrows. Letybo® is for intramuscular use (IM use). After the solution is reconstituted, the vial must be used only for one session per patient. Any unused solution must be discarded, as explained after section 6 in the information for healthcare professionals. It is recommended to leave a minimum of 3 months between two treatments with Letybo®. Ingredients The active substance is botulinum toxin type A. One vial contains 50 units botulinum toxin type A produced by Clostridium botulinum. After reconstitution each 0.1 mL of the solution contains 4 units. The other excipients are human albumin and sodium chloride. description: Clinisept+ Plus Skin Cleansing Antimicrobial Skin Care (490ml) is the new look product from Clinisept replacing the original Prep and Procedure. Clinisept+ Skin applies the latest proprietary hypochlorous technology to ensure high levels of cleansing. Its antimicrobial properties deliver optimal hygiene and protection without stinging or irritation. Due to its oxidising method of action, Clinisept+ is not susceptible to antimicrobial resistance and is also an effective deodoriser. For use in a clinic before, during, and following an aesthetic procedure to provide optimum skin hygiene and protect against complications without causing irritation. Cleansing with Clinisept+ Skin provides a far more pleasant experience for your clients than traditional skin cleansers, which can themselves cause redness as well as dry the skin. Please note: The bottle size has changed so previous length triggers and pumps will no longer fit unless cut to fit. Directions For Use: Clinisept+ Skin is a ready-to-use aqueous solution. It should be decanted into a gallipot and then carefully wiped onto the skin using gauze or pad. The skin should be thoroughly damp. It can be used throughout a procedure to keep the skin clean and soothed. Once the procedure is complete, a damp gauze can be left to soak on the treated area to calm and cool. Clinisept+ Skin is non-sensitising to the respiratory system and doesn’t irritate the eyes. Suitable For: Clinisept+ Skin is recommended for use before, during and after all cosmetic and aesthetic procedures to ensure highly effective microbial control and protection against complications. It is suitable for use before procedures such as Injectables, Microneedling, Microblading, Micropigmentation, Laser Treatments, Peels, Electrocautery, Depilatory etc. Used after a procedure, it keeps the skin clean and provides the optimum conditions for natural healing to occur. Hypoallergenic and suitable for use on all types of skin including those prone to rosacea, eczema, psoriasis and dermatitis.

Radiesse also gets to work acting as a scaffold to encourage collagen growth and build up the structure of the skin, making its effects last longer than the initial boost of volume. Azzalure is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, also known as vertical lines between the eyebrows. Different clinical trials have validated the effectiveness of Azzalure for treating specific facial lines, involving numerous patients to ensure its efficacy and safety. In addition, frown lines, along with lateral canthal lines, are seen at maximum smile. Therefore, adult patients with visible signs of lines and wrinkles in these facial areas seeking a softening of the area of concern would be good candidates for Azzalure. Patients must be under 65 years old and not have any contraindications that would make them unsuitable for Azzalure treatment. How long does azzalure take to work? Clients should begin to notice a softening of the lines and wrinkles 2 to 6 days after treatment. After two weeks, the client should see the optimal level of results. What are the contraindications of Azzalure? The main contraindications for Azzalure include hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients, muscle weakness as a potential side effect, an existing infection at the injection site, and health conditions such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert Syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Individuals with an infection on the skin surface at the injection site should wait for the infection to fully resolve before undergoing treatment. Why buy products from ACRE? description: Aller-Tox Course for idiopathic and allergic rhinitis, plus treatment of hay fever Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description What is Aller-Tox™? Aller-Tox™ is an office based medical treatment for the symptomatic relief of allergic rhinitis and hayfever. It utilises the bilateral transition of botulinum toxin type A, via nasal aerosol therapy into the nostrils. Why choose Aller-Tox™ Training? It’s a simple procedure to follow and deliver. A video of how to administer the procedure is included in this course. Good profit, for a time-efficient treatment. It’s having significant merit, patients on average report 2 months of hayfever relief per treatment. Use of adjunctive therapies is allowed and safe, e.g.: use of oral antihistamines, eye drops and nasal sprays (not on the same day only). It avoids the use of injections, steroid use, and patients are unlikely to become resistant. It utilises botulinum toxin type A, a medicine that you are already aware has an outstanding safety profile. What is included in this course? What is Aller-Tox™ and how does it work? Why learn the Aller-Tox ™ method? Pharmacodynamics Literature Search Who is suitable? Contraindications, cautions & potential side-effects Hayfever Vs Rhinitis The 5 commercially available toxins (type A) Dosing Dilution & reconstitution Patient, practitioner, and product factors affecting results Non-prescription and prescription medication available for patients to purchase Insurance Charging, costs, and profit Before and aftercare advice References Consent form *Sent only following the submission of your assessment which is 10 questions related to the course. The emphasis is on practical experience so you are confident to carry out treatment on leaving. What qualifications do I need? The following professionals are covered in our insurance to be trained: Surgeon Doctor Dentist Nurse Midwife Pharmacist ODP Paramedic Podiatrist Dental Hygienist/Therapist Dental Nurse Physiotherapist Pharmacy Assistants *Please supply your full name, professional body and associated professional identity number to buy this course, once you have paid you will be screened as a candidate and the course will be sent to you as a PDF.

description: Alyval Ageless Intimate Care 50ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Alyval Ageless Intimate Cream is an innovative cream formulated to support the well-being of intimate areas, delivering the same anti-ageing and regenerating benefits usually sought in facial skincare routines and treatments. Particularly beneficial during perimenopause and menopause, it helps: Improve vaginal tissue elasticity and tone Deeply moisturises and restores suppleness Reduces the visible signs of ageing Evens skin tone and reduces hyperpigmentation Enhances comfort and natural lubrication by combating oxidative stress At the heart of this innovation is Alyval’s patented pealiquitech™ technology, featuring PEA (palmitoylethanolamide). PEA is a naturally occurring molecule produced by the body and known for its anti-inflammatory, soothing, antimicrobial, and neuroprotective properties. description: Clinisept+ Skin 100ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Description Clinisept+ Skin is a high-purity, professional-use cleansing solution formulated with advanced hypochlorous technology to support optimal skin hygiene before, during, and after cosmetic procedures. It delivers powerful, skin-compatible cleansing without stinging or irritation, making it a good alternative to traditional skin cleansers. Developed using a proprietary non-electrolytic method, its hypochlorous formulation ensures exceptional purity, stability, and surface compatibility, trusted in professional aesthetic and cosmetic protocols across the UK. Clinisept+ Skin provides cleansing antimicrobial support while remaining non-sensitising, non-irritating, and pH neutral. description: DEIRVE PDENS (10x DE|RIVE, 10x DAILY HAIR SUPPORT SERUM 60ML) Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description About DE|RIVE DE|RIVE is a patented 100% plant-based serum, designed to help improve hair and scalp health. With over 23 medical publications, the ingredients have been researched and are beneficial for all skin and hair types. Common Types of Hair Loss: Androgenetic Alopecia Alopecia Areata Effluvium Alopecia Universalis Post Covid Alopecia How does DE|RIVE work? The DE|RIVE serum helps remove dead skin cells from around the hair follicle. This promotes hydration and blood flow to the scalp. Giving the appearance of fuller and healthier hair, studies have shown that DE|RIVE may increase Cytokeratin15 protein levels. This is crucial for strengthening the hair bulb. How is DE|RIVE applied? DE|RIVE is topically applied in-clinic and can be boosted with AquaFirmeXS and ULTRA technology. Patients are sent home with a daily serum to apply morning and night after the in-clinic treatment. Can DE|RIVE be combined with other procedures? DE|RIVE can be combined with other in-clinic treatments and hair supplements, enhancing hair support. For most types of hair loss, maintenance by the patient is necessary to help achieve the best results. What does the treatment look like for your client? DE|RIVE In-Office Hair Serum: One DE|RIVE syringe is applied every 30 days in-clinic over the course of three months. Patients will take the serum home to maintain results and scalp health. Some patients are recommended a six month follow-up appointment. DE|RIVE Daily At-Home Support: Between each application in-clinic, patients should use the serum at home in the morning and evening. They will go home with a 60ml dropper bottle and one full dropper is applied twice a day. The serum can be applied after a shower as it doesn’t leave the hair feeling greasy. APPLICATION – DE|RIVE can be applied 4 ways: 1. Used in conjunction with AquaFirmeXS and the ULTRA handpiece. 2. Applied with microneedling to the scalp. 3. Combined with current hair restoration treatments in-clinic such as: PRP, nutraceuticals and lasers. 4. Applied topically as a stand-alone treatment. After the patient has received their 3 in-clinic treatment applications, spaced 30-days apart, they will continue the take home serum protocol until the foreseeable future to maintain results and scalp health. A 6-month follow up in-clinic treatment application is recommended – patient dependent. Patients will start seeing results within the first 30 days! Size and Care Info (10x DE|RIVE, 10x DAILY HAIR SUPPRT SERUM 60ML)

description: Derma-Seal Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description Reduce the risk of post-treatment infection Derma-Seal may be used to reduce the risk of post treatment infection. This is done by covering the puncture wound created by the needle or cannula. Creates an impervious barrier Derma-Seal creates a post treatment impervious barrier by creating a clear film skin covering the puncture wound created by the needle or cannula from e.g. botulinum toxin and filler treatment. Protection from the unintentional contamination of the injection points Cosmetic make-up used by your clients every day could carry bacteria increasing the risk of post treatment infection. The same can be said for the unintentional touching of injection points with your fingers through out the day after treatment. May reduce the possible contamination from environmental factors. The microscopic puncture wounds created by the needles and cannula may be a portal of entry and become infected if cosmetic make-up is applied too soon after treatment. Unfortunately, even though you advise your clients not to touch their face and apply make-up after treatment many still do too soon before the site is fully healed. Derma-Seal creates an impervious barrier protecting the injection points within minutes after a treatment and also protects the injection points from accidental contact from unintentional touching and contact with hair, make-up and other environmental contaminants. We recommend you advise your clients of the best practice to care for their skin post treatment.

description: Fillmed JuveLook 50mg Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description Juvelook is an Advanced Hybrid Dermal Biostimulator that combines the deep hydration of non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid with the collagen-restoring power of PDLLA microspheres—delivering radiant, firmer, and more youthful skin. Juvelook is a revolutionary biostimulator designed for subtle, natural-looking rejuvenation. It merges non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid for immediate hydration with Poly D,L-lactic Acid (PDLLA) microspheres to stimulate long-term collagen regeneration. This dual-action treatment improves skin tone, texture, and elasticity over time—without adding unnatural volume. With results that evolve gradually, Juvelook restores the skin’s glow, firmness, and smoothness, making it ideal for those seeking an enhanced but refined look. The updated JUVELOOK® with optimised reconstruction has been designed to support a more streamlined preparation process while maintaining the product’s performance and treatment characteristics. Reconstitution & Preparation Hand Mixing Method Add 6ml bacteriostatic saline to the JUVELOOK® vial. Withdraw the mixture into a syringe and express it back into the vial. Repeat this process 5 times. Hand mix by vigorous side-to-side shaking for 2 minutes. Inspect the product. If any powder or lumps remain, repeat the mixing process. Once fully dissolved, the product is ready for use. Vortex Mixing Method For clinics using a vortex mixer, the preparation process follows the existing vortex protocol, replacing the manual mixing stage with 5 minutes of vortex mixing before final inspection and use. Practitioners can choose between: Manual preparation using the recommended hand-mixing protocol. Vortex-assisted preparation using existing vortex devices and protocols. This flexibility allows clinics to select the preparation method that best suits their workflow and preferences. Key Benefits: Instant Hydration & Glow – HA plumps and moisturizes the skin right away Dual action: HA for immediate hydration + PDLLA for long-term collagen stimulation Results visible in 2–6 weeks; lasts up to 18–24 months Low particle size (20–40μm) = smoother injection, minimal clogging or trauma Approved by CE, FDA, KFDA; fully biodegradable into CO₂ and H₂O Ideal for delicate areas and superficial indications Can be micro needled How It Works: 1. Immediate Effect – HA hydrates and smooths skin instantly 2. Gradual Regeneration – PDLLA acts as a scaffold for collagen renewal 3. Lasting Transformation – Visible improvements develop over weeks and last 12–18 months Ideal For: Adults aged 25+ noticing signs of early aging Patients seeking subtle, progressive results Individuals avoiding volumizing fillers Recommended Treatment Areas Crow’s feet, forehead lines, perioral wrinkles Neck and décolletage Acne scars and enlarged pores Hands Technical Specs: Microsphere Size: 20–40 µm Injection Depth: Superficial to mid-dermis Duration: 12–24 months Reversible: Yes – HA with hyaluronidase; PDLLA can be reversed with RF/ultrasound energy Why Choose JUVELOOK? For patients who want natural, gradual skin enhancement without adding volume, Juvelook offers a science-backed solution that hydrates instantly and rejuvenates over time. Its unique formulation ensures subtle, radiant results with minimal downtime and maximum skin harmony. Gentle. Gradual. Glowing. Rejuvenate from Within. Ingredients (INCI) Water (Aqua), Sodium Hyaluronate, Poly D,L-lactic Acid, Sodium Chloride, Polysorbate 80, Tromethamine, Hydrochloric Acid

description: Fillmed Lenisna 200mg/vial Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Description LENISNA: Dual-Action Biostimulator for Structural Facial Rejuvenation. LENISNA is an advanced injectable that combines PDLLA and crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid for immediate lift, long-term collagen stimulation, and deep dermal rejuvenation—without surgery. LENISNA is an innovative injectable biostimulator that merges Poly D,L-lactic Acid (PDLLA) with crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid (HA) to deliver both immediate volumizing and long-term skin regeneration. Designed to restore facial structure, elasticity, and definition, LENISNA offers a minimally invasive alternative to surgery with results that can last up to 24 months. The updated LENISNA® with optimised reconstruction to provide a smoother and more efficient reconstitution process, offering greater convenience in clinical practice while maintaining the same collagen-stimulating benefits and treatment outcomes practitioners expect from LENISNA®. Reconstitution & Preparation Hand Mixing Method Add 6ml bacteriostatic saline to the LENISNA® vial. Hand mix by vigorous side-to-side shaking for 3 minutes. Withdraw the mixture into a 10ml or 20ml syringe. Attach a Baxter connector. In a second syringe, add either: 4ml bacteriostatic saline to achieve a total volume of 10ml, or 10ml bacteriostatic saline to achieve a total volume of 16ml. Mix between the two syringes 20 times. Inspect the product. If any powder or lumps remain, repeat the mixing process. Once fully dissolved, the product is ready for use. When applied to the skin, it helps reduce redness, swelling and itching and contributes to wound healing. description: HArmonyCa with Lidocaine 2 x 1.25 ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description HArmonyCa Achieve immediate volumizing results that improve over time with the new hybrid injectable dermal filler/collagen biostimulator, HArmonyCA, by Allergan. What is HArmonyCa? HArmonyCA is a new revolutionary injectable treatment with dual effects – designed to restore facial volume and also promotes the sustained generation of natural collagen formation, giving long lasting lifting and volumizing results. This latest product by Allergan provides immediate volumizing effects and contains cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (HA), much like their other popular dermal filler range – Juvederm – but has a unique selling point in that the product also contains embedded Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA) microspheres, which stimulates the body’s own production of collagen and elastin – improving the skin’s elasticity over time, even when the HA component has broken down. The Hyaluronic Acid element of this new collagen biostimulator product is naturally found in the body and elevates skin hydration and moisture, which is key to keep the skin looking plump and healthy and provides an immediate volumising effect. Calcium Hydroxyapatite generates a stable, inseparable gel that keeps the microspheres in the desired location, which minimises the risk of product migration and ensures a smooth appearance. CaHA is a biodegradable, biostimulatory soft tissue filler suitable for deeper folds and wrinkles, and encourages an increased natural formation of collagen and elastin within the skin to provide a sustained lifting effect. HArmonyCA also contains lidocaine to ensure a comfortable experience during the procedure. Size and Care Info 2 x 1.25ml

description: Heliocare 360 oral Capsules x30 Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Heliocare 360˚ Oral Capsules are a powerful anti-oxidant supplement that’s clinically proven to help defend against the free radicals that can age your skin beyond your years. Free radicals damage key skin cells and tissues which, over time, speeds up the visible ageing of the skin, causes uneven areas of pigmentation and can damage skin health. Exposure to daylight and the sun is the main cause of free radicals within the skin. Even the highest-level broad-spectrum topical protection is not enough to protect skin against these free radicals – this is especially the case during extended periods of time spent outdoors, or holidays. # Heliocare360 Capsules are clinically proven to reduce PLE – a red blotchy skin reaction to the sun. PLE is often confused with prickly heat which is a differen t kind of rash caused by blocked sweat glands. Sometimes it can be difficult to tell the difference between the two. The fantastic Fernblock anti-oxidant activity is also clinically proven to reduce the appearance of PLE; an unsightly red, blotchy rash that affects 10%-15% of the population! description: Novuma The Next-Generation CaHA Biostimulation 1.5ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Novuma® is an injectable biostimulating gel developed using Advanced BioSphere Technology. It contains highly purified Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA) microspheres at a high concentration (55–60% w/w) suspended in a Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC) gel carrier. The microspheres are designed to be perfectly smooth and round, providing strong collagen stimulation while helping limit inflammation. Novuma® is CE marked since 2020 and received MDR 2017/745 EU certification in 2025. It has been launched in more than 50 countries, with over 20,000 syringes injected worldwide since its introduction. The formulation was developed by experts in biomaterials. Novuma® responds to an increasing demand for treatments that offer more than filling lines. After the age of 45, loss of skin firmness becomes the primary aesthetic concern for women. Patients are looking for solutions that restore dermal density, rebuild facial structure and improve overall skin quality with natural and long-lasting results. Novuma® helps aesthetic practitioners address this need by providing sustained regeneration and visible clinical outcomes. Immediately after injection, Novuma® fills and lifts the treated area, providing a smoothing and plumping effect. The CaHA microspheres act as a scaffold within the tissue, activating fibroblasts and stimulating the production of new collagen. As the microspheres gradually degrade and are absorbed by the body, they leave behind a newly formed collagen network, restoring density and firmness to the skin. This regenerative process supports long-term results lasting up to 18 months, depending on treatment area and individual conditions. Novuma® is particularly suitable for addressing areas where ageing is most visible, including the face oval and cheeks, to redefine contours and improve skin density and smoothness. Key benefits include immediate lifting, progressive collagen stimulation, visible tightening, improvement of skin structure, firmer texture and long-lasting results. The product features low extrusion force and a homogeneous ceramic composition, making injection comfortable and controlled. It is supplied ready-to-use. Full application instructions are provided in the Instructions for Use. The composition of Novuma® consists of 55–60% Calcium Hydroxyapatite (solid bioceramic phase) and 40–45% Carboxymethyl Cellulose (viscoelastic carrier phase). Novuma® is designed to promote safe regeneration of tissue. Thanks to the Advanced BioSphere Technology, the CaHA particles support effective fibroblast activation while helping to control inflammation. Novuma® is intended for use by healthcare professionals only. Please refer to the Instructions for Use prior to application. Size and Care Info 1 x 1.5ml pre-filled syringe with sterile connector for dilution

description: Nucleofill Medium 1.5ml (previously 20) Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Nucleofill Medium Nucleofill Medium is the new line of natural polynucleotide based biostimulating gels, with a high viscosity, for protecting and rejuvenating skin. The unique features of Nucleofill: Moisturizing effect: The strong moisturizing ability is mainly due to the water retention capabilities of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the single nucleotides. description: Restylane Classyc Lido 1ml Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Restylane is intended to be used for facial tissue augmentation. It is recommended to be used for the correction of wrinkles and for lip enhancement. Specifically designed for the correction of moderate facial wrinkles and for lip enchancement, Restylane has an intermediate gel particle size. It should be injected into the middle part of the dermis layer or in the submucosal layer of the lip. For facial areas with limited soft tissue support and soft tissue cover, e.g. the periorbital region, injection into the subcutaneous fatty tissue or supraperiostal administration are recommended. The addition of lidocaine provides a pain relieving effect during treatment Composition:- Stabilised hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL Lidocaine hydrochloride 3mg/ml Phosphate buffered saline q.s. Indication: Cheeks. Disposable sterile 29G TW (thin-walled) needles are provided. In case a replacement needle is required a needle within the range of 29-30G should be used. Alternatively, a sterile blunt cannula 27-28G can be used. The size and the length of the cannula will affect the force needed to extrude the gel. If a thinner cannula is used the resistance during injection may be too high resulting in an increased risk for leakage or separation of the cannula and syringe. The same considerations are applicable for needles. Size and Care Info 1ml

Just like with STYLAGE ® Hydro, it can be used as a complementary treatment with other STYLAGE ® products, and a treatment plan can be established with your practitioner to ensure the best results possible over several appointments. STYLAGE ® S was created to rehydrate the face, especially around the mouth area (for example, Smoker’s Lines), but also to treat light wrinkles that start to appear on the skin but have not become too deep. A veritable rejuvenating effect, this product helps gently smooth the skin for a refreshed look. Other indications that can be treated by STYLAGE ® S include the forehead and crow’s feet (smile lines around the eyes). On average, results are visible straight after injection and can last up to 12 months 2 . For more comfort during treatment, STYLAGE ® S is available with an anaesthetic* to numb the area being injected. Considered to be one of the most versatile products in the STYLAGE ® product range, STYLAGE ® M was created to fill regular skin depressions in the face for an authentic glow-up. It can be used to treat a number of indications in both men and women of any age and skin type. As well as filling wrinkles, this product also helps smooth the skin, with results being visible immediately after treatment. STYLAGE ® M is also available with an anaesthetic* to lightly numb the area during injection and help make the patient’s experience more pleasant. If not treated right away, wrinkles will continue to mark the skin over time and a more volumizing product is needed to fill them as they become less superficial on the skin's surface. As well as being used to treat indications in the face, such as the nasolabial folds (smile lines around the mouth) and even the nose to hide a bump or lift the tip, STYLAGE ® L can also be used to bring back or add volume to the back of the hands. STYLAGE ® L is available with or without an anaesthetic* that quickly takes effect from the moment of injection, it consequently numbs the area and helps make the aesthetic treatment more comfortable for the patient. Created uniquely for the delicate and very sensitive area of the lips, STYLAGE ® Special Lips was the first product in VIVACY's product range 100% dedicated to the mouth and lip area. It is a gel that helps bring soft and subtle volume to the lips, whether they be a woman or a man. Other indications in the lips that can be treated with STYLAGE ® Special Lips include more definition around the edges of the lips (contours), fine lines around the mouth (Smoker’s Lines), and of course, increased hydration to the area. An anaesthetic* is also available with this product as the lip area can be sensitive when injected. Following the treatment, results can last up to 12 months 2 . The newest product in the STYLAGE ® range, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus goes above and beyond to bring back or create volume in the delicate lip area. Though the product is more volumizing in nature than the STYLAGE ® Special Lips, after injection, the gel still feels soft and adapts perfectly to this area of the face. It can also be injected into the vermilion border (border of the red lip) in order to better contour and outline the mouth, leaving you with the perfect pout. While some other products in the STYLAGE ® range are available without anaesthetic*, STYLAGE ® Lips Plus is only available with a numbing aide for maximum comfort during and for some time after injection. The first product in VIVACY’s volumizing range is STYLAGE ® XL. Though it is slightly less viscous than the STYLAGE ® XXL, it still provides strong, long-lasting results to reduce the visible signs of ageing in the face. When it comes to facial ageing, it is not only wrinkles that betray our age. Over time, the face and the body go through both anatomical and functional changes, causing loss of volume, and consequently, facial sagging. STYLAGE ® XL is ideal for volume restoration, it can also provide light volume creation in patients of all ages. Some indications of this product include temples, cheekbones, jawline, and chin. description: TSK STERiGLIDE Cannula 25G 38mm x 4 Create an account or log in to view the price of this item Log In Description Size and Care Info Description Dome shape tip design The patented dome-shaped tip of the STERiGLIDE™ cannula is specifically engineered to create less resistance during insertion compared to traditional cannula tips. By reducing the force required to introduce the cannula, this innovative design minimizes tissue trauma and lowers the risk of bruising, swelling, or patient discomfort. The smooth, rounded tip glides effortlessly beneath the skin, allowing practitioners to navigate delicate areas with precision and confidence. This feature ensures safer, more efficient treatments while enhancing the overall patient experience. Proprietary surface treatment STERiGLIDE™ cannulas are crafted from the highest quality surgical-grade steel and feature a proprietary surface treatment that significantly reduces friction between the cannula and skin tissue. This low-friction surface allows for smoother, more comfortable insertions, minimizing pain and irritation for the patient. In addition, the surface treatment improves cannula handling for practitioners, enhancing tactile feedback and control during procedures. The combination of high-quality material and specialized surface treatment makes STERiGLIDE™ cannulas exceptionally reliable for precision injections. Nearest to tip filler delivery One of the key advantages of STERiGLIDE™ cannulas is that practitioners can see and feel the very end of the cannula tip. This allows for delivery of filler as close to the tip as possible, providing a highly accurate sense of placement and control. By delivering product precisely at the tip, practitioners can reduce waste, avoid overfilling, and achieve optimal results. The ability to sense the tip location also improves safety when injecting near sensitive areas, making treatments more predictable and precise. Clear side-port marking STERiGLIDE™ cannulas are designed with clear side-port markings and custom fittings for Juvederm syringes, allowing practitioners to monitor flow and maintain precise control throughout the injection. These markings help minimize product leakage, prevent hub pop-offs, and ensure an ideal flow rate for smooth, controlled delivery. By combining enhanced visibility, secure connections, and precise flow, STERiGLIDE™ cannulas enable seamless procedures and superior treatment outcomes, giving both practitioners and patients greater confidence in every injection. Size and Care Info 4 PACK

Mode of Action: Botulinum toxin type A is a muscle relaxant that temporarily weakens muscle activity. After injection of Alluzience, the botulinum toxin type A works by blocking the transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre. The action results in stopping the contraction of the targeted muscles. Clinisept+ Skin 100ml Clinisept+ Skin applies the latest proprietary hypochlorous technology to ensure high levels of cleansing. Its antimicrobial properties deliver optimal hygiene and protection without stinging or irritation. Due to its oxidising method of action, Clinisept+ Skin is not susceptible to antimicrobial resistance and is also an effective deodoriser. Key Features Powerful antimicrobial cleansing removes 99.9% of germs. Advanced hypochlorous technology. Free from harsh chemicals. Provides the optimum environment for natural healing. Vegan friendly & cruelty free. Indications Clinisept+ Skin is recommended for use before, during and after all cosmetic and aesthetic procedures to ensure highly effective microbial control and protection against complications. It is ideal for after care use following procedures such as Injectables, Microneedling, Microblading, Micropigmentation, Laser Treatments, Peels, Electrocautery, Depilatory etc. Directions for Use Clinisept+ Skin is a ready to use aqueous solution. It should be decanted into a gallipot and then carefully wiped on to the skin using a gauze or pad. The skin should be thoroughly wetted. It can be used throughout a procedure to keep the skin clean and soothed. Once the procedure is complete, a wetted gauze can be left to soak on the treated area to calm and cool. Clinisept+ Skin is non-sensitising to the respiratory system and doesn’t irritate the eyes. Out of Stock Epipen 300mcg Auto-Injector P/F What is an EpiPen? It is designed for easy use by the lay person and has to be considered as first aid. EpiPen® auto-injector delivers a single dose 0.3 ml injection equal to 0.3 mg adrenaline when activated. The usual adrenaline adult dose for allergic emergencies is 0.3 mg. An initial dose should be administered as soon as symptoms of anaphylaxis are recognised. In the absence of clinical improvement or if deterioration occurs after the initial treatment, a second injection with an additional EpiPen® auto-injector may be administered 5 – 15 minutes after the first injection. It is recommended that patients are prescribed two EpiPen® auto-injectors which they should carry at all times. EpiPen® auto-injectors are automatic injection devices containing adrenaline for allergic emergencies. Responsible Selling The symptoms of a severe allergic reaction (also known as anaphylaxis) can including: Feeling lightheaded or faint Breathing difficulties – such as fast, shallow breathing Wheezing A fast heartbeat Clammy skin Confusion and anxiety Collapsing or losing consciousness EpiPen administers a dose of adrenaline, also known as epinephrine, to control symptoms of anaphylaxis and get the reaction under control. Adrenaline is considered the first-line drug of choice for allergic emergencies. If used, seek immediate medical assistance. In the absence of clinical improvement or if deterioration occurs after the initial treatment, a second injection with an additional EpiPen® auto-injector may be administered 5 – 15 minutes after the first injection. It is recommended that patients are prescribed two EpiPen® auto-injectors which they should carry at all times. EpiPen® auto-injectors are automatic injection devices containing adrenaline for allergic emergencies. Responsible Selling The symptoms of a severe allergic reaction (also known as anaphylaxis) can including: Feeling lightheaded or faint Breathing difficulties – such as fast, shallow breathing Wheezing A fast heartbeat Clammy skin Confusion and anxiety Collapsing or losing consciousness EpiPen administers a dose of adrenaline, also known as epinephrine, to control symptoms of anaphylaxis and get the reaction under control. Adrenaline is considered the first-line drug of choice for allergic emergencies. If used, seek immediate medical assistance. Hydroxocobalamin 1000mcg/1ml Inj 1 Amp Hydroxocobalamin is used in the treatment and prevention of Vitamin B12 deficiency . For adults, the daily recommended intake of Vitamin B12 is 1.5 micrograms per day and this amount is present in most balanced diets. However, Vitamin B12 only occurs in animal products, not in vegetables, and therefore strict vegetarian or vegan diets that exclude dairy products may result in an inadequate amount, although a deficiency may not be apparent for many years. Distribution: Transcobalamin II appears to be involved in the rapid transport of the cobalamin to tissues. Hydroxocobalamin is extensively bound to specific plasma proteins (transcobalamin). Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to Hydroxocobalamin or to any of the excipients. Special warnings and precautions for use: It is advisable to confirm the diagnosis of Vitamin B12 deficiency before giving hydroxocobalamin; regular monitoring of the blood is recommended. Cardiac arrhythmias secondary to hypokalaemia during initial therapy have been reported. Plasma potassium should therefore be monitored during this period. Iopidine Eye Drops Solution 5mg / ml Iopidine (Apraclonidine) 0.5% eye drops pack of 5ml. Iopidine is a prescription only medication indicated for short-term adjunctive therapy of chronic glaucoma in patients on maximally tolerated medical therapy who require additional intraocular pressure reduction to delay laser treatment or glaucoma surgery. Keep the container in the outer carton. 1 ml of solution contains Apraclonidine 5 mg (as hydrochloride) Mechanism of action Iopidine is a relatively selective alpha-2-adrenergic agonist which does not possess significant membrane stabilising (local anaesthetic) activity. When instilled into the eye, Iopidine has the action of reducing intraocular pressure. Aqueous fluorophotometry studies suggest that the mechanism of the ocular hypotensive action of Iopidine is related to a reduction in aqueous formation. Contraindications: – In patients with a history of severe or unstable and uncontrolled cardiovascular disease including severe uncontrolled arterial hypertension. – In patients with hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation or to systemic clonidine. – In patients receiving monoamine oxidase inhibitors, systemic sympathomimetics or tricyclic antidepressants. Special warnings and precautions for use: – Iopidine is not recommended during pregnancy. – Breast-feeding should be discontinued during treatment with Iopidine. See EMC link below for the complete list of special warnings and precautions for use. Kenalog 40mg/ml inj (1) Kenalog is a prescription only medicine which contains the active ingredient Triamcinolone Acetonide. Kenalog is administered via intra-articular/intramuscular injection and is used to treat various allergic disorders including asthma, blood disorders, hormone problems, rheumatic fever, and problems associated with the digestive system. Kenalog is also used for the treatment of joint pain, swelling and stiffness in inflammatory disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis. Practitioners please note: In line with our clinical governance process and in the interests of patient safety, we supply Kenalog only to those practitioners who are registered healthcare professionals . Prescribers please note: Prescribing unlicensed medicines or medicines which are being used outside the recommendations of their marketing authorisation (off-label) alters the prescriber’s professional responsibility and potential liability. The prescriber should be able to justify and feel competent in using such medicines, and also inform the patient that the prescribed medicine is being used off-label or is unlicensed. Mode of action: Triamcinolone acetonide is a synthetic glucocorticoid with marked anti-inflammatory and anti-allergic actions. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients. Systemic infections unless specific anti-infective therapy is employed. Administration by intravenous, intrathecal, epidural, or intraocular injection. Warning: Cases of serious anaphylactic reactions and anaphylactic shock, including death, have been reported in individuals receiving triamcinolone acetonide injection, regardless of the route of administration. Letybo 50 Units Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe vertical lines between the eyebrows in adults <75 years old seen at maximum frown (glabellar lines) when the severity of the facial lines has an important psychological impact. Mode of Action: Clostridium botulinum neurotoxin type A blocks the peripheral release of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine at presynaptic cholinergic nerve terminals of neuromuscular junctions by cleaving SNAP-25, a protein integral to the successful docking and release of acetylcholine from vesicles situated within the nerve endings, thereby leading to denervation of the muscle and a flaccid paralysis. Contraindications of Letybo: -Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. -Generalised disorders of muscle activity such as myasthenia gravis, Lambert-Eaton syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis -Presence of acute infection or inflammation at the proposed injection sites. Who Is the Ideal Patient For Letybo? Ideal patients for Letybo would be adults under the age of 75 with concerns of deep to severe glabellar lines. However, practitioners should always do a full consultation with clients to determine whether the treatment is both suitable and beneficial for the patient. Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding should not use Letybo. However, practitioners should always do a full consultation with clients to determine whether the treatment is both suitable and beneficial for the patient.Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding should not use Letybo.

main_text: Letybo 50 Units Botulinum Toxin Type A Letybo is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe vertical lines between the eyebrows in adults <75 years old seen at maximum frown (glabellar lines) when the severity of the facial lines has an important psychological impact. Mode of Action: Clostridium botulinum neurotoxin type A blocks the peripheral release of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine at presynaptic cholinergic nerve terminals of neuromuscular junctions by cleaving SNAP-25, a protein integral to the successful docking and release of acetylcholine from vesicles situated within the nerve endings, thereby leading to denervation of the muscle and a flaccid paralysis. Contraindications of Letybo: -Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. -Generalised disorders of muscle activity such as myasthenia gravis, Lambert-Eaton syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis -Presence of acute infection or inflammation at the proposed injection sites. Who Is the Ideal Patient For Letybo? Ideal patients for Letybo would be adults under the age of 75 with concerns of deep to severe glabellar lines. However, practitioners should always do a full consultation with clients to determine whether the treatment is both suitable and beneficial for the patient. Patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding should not use Letybo. Out of Stock LMX4 4% Cream 30g Product Description: LMX4 Lidocaine 4% W/W Cream is a powerful topical anaesthetic cream designed to provide effective pain relief for various medical procedures. With its fast-acting and long-lasting formula, LMX4 Lidocaine Cream has become a trusted choice among qualified practitioners to enhance patient comfort and overall experience during minor surgical procedures, injections, and other medical interventions. Benefits: This cream contains 4% lidocaine, a potent local anaesthetic, which quickly numbs the skin upon application. This fast-acting solution allows for more efficient procedures and reduces patient anxiety and discomfort. With its long-lasting effects, LMX4 Lidocaine Cream ensures that patients experience minimal pain during and after the aesthetic procedure, enhancing their overall satisfaction and compliance. How To Use LMX4 Lidocaine 4% W/W Cream: Before applying the cream, thoroughly clean the intended area to ensure optimal absorption. Then, apply a thin layer of LMX4 Lidocaine Cream to the targeted skin surface. Cover the treated area with an occlusive dressing to facilitate penetration and enhance its efficacy. The cream should be left in place for the recommended duration, as indicated in the product instructions, to ensure the desired numbing effect. Advise patients on the appropriate amount of cream to use and the duration of application based on the specific procedure. Side Effects of LMX4 Lidocaine 4% W/W Cream: Commonly reported side effects include mild skin reactions at the application site, such as redness, itching, or burning. These effects are usually transient and resolve on their own. Severe allergic reactions are rare but possible. Educate patients on what to watch for and instruct them to discontinue use and seek medical attention immediately if they experience any signs of an allergic reaction. Other Uses of LMX4 Lidocaine 4% W/W Cream: It can be utilised for pain relief during venipuncture, blood sampling, tattoo applications or catheter insertion, significantly improving patient comfort. Additionally, LMX4 Lidocaine Cream is suitable for use prior to laser hair removal or other cosmetic treatments, reducing discomfort and making the experience more pleasant for patients. Out of Stock Mounjaro 10mg Compatible with Novofine 30G 8mm needles Mounjaro 15mg/0.6ml is a prescription only medicine indicated for: - the treatment of adults with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise as monotherapy or in addition to other medicinal products. - weight management, including weight loss and weight maintenance, as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity in adults with an initial Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≥ 30 kg/ m2 (obesity) or ≥ 27 kg/m2 to < 30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus). Mechanism of action: Tirzepatide is a long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Both receptors are present on the pancreatic α and β endocrine cells, heart, vasculature, immune cells (leukocytes), gut and kidney. GIP receptors are also present on adipocytes. In addition, both GIP and GLP-1 receptors are expressed in the areas of the brain important to appetite regulation. Tirzepatide is highly selective to human GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide has high affinity to both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide lowers body weight and body fat mass. The mechanisms associated with body weight and body fat mass reduction involve decreased food intake through the regulation of appetite and modulation of fat utilisation. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. 5 needles included with every order. Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution (Normal Saline) 10ml (Box of 10) Product Description: Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution is a fundamental and essential product for qualified practitioners in the field of aesthetic medicine, specifically for those involved in mixing injections like Botox, Bocouture, and Azzalure. This sterile solution contains 0.9% sodium chloride, which makes it isotonic and compatible with the human body’s physiological environment. Product Contains: 5x 10ml Ampoules Benefits: It serves as a diluent for reconstituting various injectables like Botox, Bocouture, and Azzalure. By providing a stable and isotonic environment for these products, ensures optimal mixing and consistency, thus preserving their efficacy. The solution also facilitates accurate dosing and reduces the risk of over-dilution or concentration errors, ensuring the precise delivery of treatment to the patients. How To Use Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution: The process is straightforward and involves aseptic techniques to maintain product integrity. Typically, the practitioner would withdraw the required amount of Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution using a sterile syringe and then add it to the vial of the respective injectable. Gentle mixing or swirling allows for proper reconstitution, after which the solution is ready for administration. Side Effects of Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution: Allergic reactions are rare, but if any signs of irritation or hypersensitivity occur, immediate discontinuation of use is recommended. Other Uses of Sodium Chloride 0.9% Solution: It is commonly used for intravenous fluid administration, wound irrigation, and as a rehydrating agent in dehydrated patients. Its isotonic properties make it suitable for a wide range of medical procedures, making it an indispensable item in any qualified practitioner’s medical supplies. Wegovy Flextouch 0.25mg Wegovy (Semaglutide) 0.25mg FlexTouch solution for injection in pre-filled pen Wegovy is a prescription only medicine indicated as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity for weight management, including weight loss and weight maintenance, in adults with an initial Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≥ 30 kg/m2 (obesity), or ≥ 27 kg/m2 to <30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbidity (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus). Mechanism of action: Semaglutide is a GLP-1. Semaglutide acts as a GLP-1 receptor agonist that selectively binds to and activates the GLP-1 receptor, the target for native GLP-1. GLP-1 is a physiological regulator of appetite and calorie intake, and the GLP-1 receptor is present in several areas of the brain involved in appetite regulation. Semaglutide has direct effects on areas in the brain involved in homeostatic regulation of food intake in the hypothalamus and the brainstem, and direct and indirect effects on areas involved in hedonic regulation of food intake, including the septum, thalamus and amygdala. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. description: Description Clinisept+ Skin applies the latest proprietary hypochlorous technology to ensure high levels of cleansing. Its antimicrobial properties deliver optimal hygiene and protection without stinging or irritation. Due to its oxidising method of action, Clinisept+ is not susceptible to antimicrobial resistance and is also an effective deodoriser. The benefits Cleansing with Clinisept+ Skin provides a far more pleasant experience for your clients than traditional skin cleansers, which can themselves cause redness as well as dry the skin. Clinisept+ Skin leaves no residue or chemical burden, unlike traditional skin cleansing chemistries. Clinisept+ Skin advanced hypochlorous technology that has a unique oxidising method of action which cleanses and provides antimicrobial protection, but is also gentle on the skin: it doesn’t harm, irritate or sensitise the dermal layer. Vegan friendly and cruelty free skin care. Clinisept+ Skin offers a completely new approach to professional skin cleansing that maximises protection against complications and optimises patient outcomes. Directions for use Clinisept+ Skin is a ready to use aqueous solution. It should be decanted into a gallipot and then carefully wiped on to the skin using a gauze or pad. The skin should be thoroughly wetted. It can be used throughout a procedure to keep the skin clean and soothed. Once the procedure is complete, a wetted gauze can be left to soak on the treated area to calm and cool. Clinisept+ Skin is non-sensitising to the respiratory system and doesn’t irritate the eyes. Suitable for Clinisept+ Skin is recommended for use before, during and after all cosmetic and aesthetic procedures to ensure highly effective microbial control and protection against complications. It is suitable for use before procedures such as; Injectables Microneedling Microblading Micropigmentation Laser Treatments Peels Electrocautery Depilatory Used after a procedure, it keeps the skin clean and provides the optimum conditions for natural healing to occur.

Lumigan 0.1mg/ml eye drops
Pack Size: 1 x 3ml
Lumigan is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the of reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in chronic open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension in adults (as monotherapy or as adjunctive therapy to beta-blockers).
Mode of action:

	The mechanism of action by which Bimatoprost reduces intraocular pressure in humans is by increasing aqueous humour outflow through the trabecular meshwork and enhancing uveoscleral outflow.

Contraindications:

	Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients.
	Lumigan is contraindicated in patients who have had a suspected previous adverse reaction to benzalkonium chloride that has led to discontinuation.

Special warnings and precautions for use:

	There is a potential for hair growth to occur in areas where Lumigan solution comes repeatedly in contact with the skin surface. Thus, it is important to apply Lumigan as instructed and avoid it running onto the cheek or other skin areas.
	Lumigan should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary.

description: Cyclizine (also called cyclizine hydrochloride) is an antihistamine medication. It is often used as an anti sickness medication to help relieve nausea. Nausea can be triggered by a range of different factors. These include vertigo, travelling, inner and middle ear problems, radiotherapy treatment, or after a surgery where general anaesthetic has been used. How do I use cyclizine? You should always use cyclizine as instructed by your doctor. Cyclizine should only be used as and when required to treat symptoms of nausea and vomiting Cyclizine is available in a 50mg strength oral tablet that can be taken up to three times a day to help with symptoms of nausea and vomiting. Cyclizine 50mg dosage The recommended dose of Cyclizine tablet for adults is one tablet taken by mouth up to three times a day. Cyclizine can be used in adults and children over the age of 6 to treat nausea and vomiting. The recommended dose of Cyclizine tablet for children 6 to 12 years old is half a tablet up to three times a day. Do not give this medicine to children under 6 years of age.

description: Description Mounjaro 10mg/0.6ml is a prescription only medicine indicated for: the treatment of adults with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise as monotherapy or in addition to other medicinal products. weight management, including weight loss and weight maintenance, as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity in adults with an initial Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≥ 30 kg/ m2 (obesity) or ≥ 27 kg/m2 to < 30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus). Mechanism of action: Tirzepatide is a long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Both receptors are present on the pancreatic α and β endocrine cells, heart, vasculature, immune cells (leukocytes), gut and kidney. GIP receptors are also present on adipocytes. In addition, both GIP and GLP-1 receptors are expressed in the areas of the brain important to appetite regulation. Tirzepatide is highly selective to human GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide has high affinity to both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide lowers body weight and body fat mass. The mechanisms associated with body weight and body fat mass reduction involve decreased food intake through the regulation of appetite and modulation of fat utilisation. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. Store in a refrigerator at 2–8°C Practitioners please note: Additional safe guides:- when prescribing Mounjaro adults should have a BMI over 30, or those with a BMI of 27+ with at least one weight-related condition. BMI must be stated on the prescription and only x1 pen per patient per prescription. Please note, as per recently published GPhC guidelines all weight loss prescription orders must come through a registered prescriber only, after a two way consultation with the client/patient directly to the patients address. description: Loperamide is a medication that is used for the relief of acute diarrhea and the management of chronic diarrhea in patients with inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis). The effectiveness of loperamide is comparable to another anti-diarrheal, diphenoxylate (Lomotil). Loperamide was approved by the FDA in 1976. In adults and children 12 years of age and older, the usual dose is 4 mg (2 capsules) as a first dose, followed by 2 mg (1 capsule) after each unformed stool. The maximum dose is 16 mg/day. The dose for children is: age 9 to 11 years, 2 mg three times the first day; age 6 to 8 years, 2 mg twice the first day; age 2 to 5 years, 1 mg times three times the first day. After the first day, children less than 12 years of age usually receive a dose of 0.1 mg/kg after an unformed stool. description: Omeprazole reduces the amount of acid your stomach makes. It’s a widely used treatment for indigestion and heartburn and acid reflux. It’s also taken to prevent and treat stomach ulcers. Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach. The drug is often prescribed for acid reflux and is available in 20mg capsules to be taken once per day. Omeprazole works by reducing the amount of acid that your stomach produces reducing acid reflux. Omeprazole belongs to a group of medicines called ‘proton pump inhibitors’. They work by reducing the amount of acid that your stomach produces. Omeprazole is used to treat the following conditions: In adults: ‘Gastro-esophageal reflux disease’ (GERD). This is where acid from the stomach escapes into the gullet (the tube which connects your throat to your stomach) causing pain, inflammation and heartburn. Ulcers in the upper part of the intestines (duodenal ulcer) or stomach (gastric ulcer). To stop ulcers in the upper part of the intestines (duodenal ulcer) or stomach (gastric ulcer) from coming back. Ulcers which are also infected with a bacteria called ‘Helicobacter pylori’. If you have this condition, your doctor may also prescribe antibiotics to treat the infection and allow the ulcer to heal. Ulcers caused by medicines called NSAIDs (non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs). Omeprazole can also be used to stop ulcers from forming if you are taking NSAIDs. Too much acid in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas (Zollinger-Ellison syndrome). Omeprazole is used to treat certain stomach and esophagus problems (such as acid reflux, ulcers)

If you have any further questions, you can follow the link below https://www.pharmacyregulation.org/pharmacies/registration-and-renewal/providing-services-online EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/13802 Patient Information Leaflet: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/files/pil.13799.pdf Description Wegovy (Semaglutide) 1.7mg FlexTouch solution for injection in pre-filled pen Wegovy is a prescription only medicine indicated as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity for weight management, including weight loss and weight maintenance, in adults with an initial Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≥ 30 kg/m2 (obesity), or ≥ 27 kg/m2 to <30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbidity (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus). Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. Store in a refrigerator at 2–8°C

description: Description KEY BENEFITS OF BAC-STAT (30ML) Antimicrobial protection – Formulated with benzyl alcohol to inhibit bacterial growth between uses, maintaining sterility across multiple withdrawals. Multi-dose safe – Enables repeated access to the same vial with reduced risk of contamination, supporting cost effective and sustainable practice. Minimises product waste – Maximises vial usage in comparison to single use saline, reducing unnecessary waste and associated expenses. Wide medication compatibility – Suitable for reconstituting vaccines, peptides, hormone therapies, and biologics across a range of medical and lab applications. Reliable sterility in extended use – Preservative based protection provides a safety margin when handling sensitive substances over time. Efficiency in healthcare settings – Improves workflow by reducing the frequency of vial changes and saline preparation. USES Vaccinations – Maintains sterility in multi-dose vaccine vials, particularly in high volume immunisation settings. Hormone therapy – Facilitates safe, repeat reconstitution for therapies like testosterone or growth hormone. Peptides & biologics – Ensures preservation and stability for sensitive injectable drugs requiring ongoing access. Research labs – Ideal for studies requiring sustained sterility and reliable sample reconstitution. PRECAUTIONS Allergy risk – Avoid in individuals with known hypersensitivity to benzyl alcohol or related compounds. Neonatal use – Not suitable for neonates due to potential toxicity risks from benzyl alcohol. Clinical assessment required – Healthcare professionals should evaluate each case individually to ensure medication compatibility and patient safety. ADMINISTERING BAC-STAT BAC-STAT is intended for intravenous (IV), intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) use as a diluent for injectable medications. It is not suitable for inhalation or oral consumption. SHOP TORBAC BACTERIOSTATIC SALINE 0.9% Please note: Healthcare providers must assess patient specific needs and medication compatibility when selecting a diluent.

description: Description Medipal Disinfectant Wipes – Pack of 50 Medipal Disinfectant Wipes use a high specification combination chemistry, effectively blending two disinfectant compounds, DDAC and Triamine, to produce a highly efficacious, broad spectrum, alcohol free disinfectant. Pack of 50 wipes Medipal wipes are made from Tritex material which is 5 layers of material melt blown together – the disinfectant wipes are strong when pulled in both directions- making them more durable and stronger than other wipes. Another benefit of the Tritex material is that it is Hydrophilic- the technology of the wipe -locks in the moisture so the solution sits in the wipe until it is agitated and dispensed on the surface – you can see this if you feel the wipe it may feel dryer but then rub it on a surface and you will see the solution release. Medipal wipes are Halal certified, alcohol and phmb free – PHMB is a carcinogen. Medipal wipes are for cleaning & disinfecting ( 2 in 1 ) 1 Minute Medipal – the Medipal disinfectant kills MRSA, MSSA, Corona Virus and all enveloped viruses in 1 minute contact time. Medipal Disinfectant Wipes are intended for cleaning and disinfecting surfaces of non-invasive medical devices within healthcare and care environments. Medipal Disinfectant wipes are proven to kill most microorganisms such as bacteria, yeasts and viruses. The wipes have been independently tested to a range of European testing standards (EN) which includes EN16615. Tritex material is made by bonding layers of spunbond and meltblown polypropylene fibres together in a high heat process before a hydrophilic coating is applied. This material is 100% synthetic. The material offers high strength in both directions – across and along the wipe. Very low linting – low risk of leaving contaminating fibres on surfaces. Excellent solution retention – ensuring even wetness throughout the wipe. Efficient solution release – active wipe ingredients are transferred to the surface rather than being trapped in the wipe material fibres.

description: Description Alluzience is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe Glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows) and Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) in adult patients under 65 years. Key Features: Relaxes the muscles to prevent contractions Blocks transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre Used in the treatment of moderate to severe wrinkles in patients Treatment Areas: Moderate to severe glabellar lines Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) Contraindications of Alluzience: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Who should not use Alluzience? Pregnant and lactating women should not use this product as not enough clinical data has been collected to suggest that it is safe. There is a risk of this product passing through the mother to her baby Any individuals that develop hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to the product should also refrain from using it. Children under 18 and adults over 65 should also not use this product Anyone with an infection on the skin surface at the proposed injection site should wait for the infection to completely disappear first There is a probable muscle weakness(myasthenia gravis) already present then do not use Azzalure either. The following diseases and conditions should also rule out the use of this medicine: Eaton Lambert syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (degenerative nerve muscle disorder) Storage: Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C Additional Information: EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/6584

description: Description Azzalure is a prescription-only medicine indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe Glabellar lines (vertical lines between the eyebrows) and Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) in adult patients under 65 years. Key Features: Relaxes the muscles to prevent contractions Blocks transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction, located between the nerve end and the muscle fibre Used in the treatment of moderate to severe wrinkles in patients Treatment Areas: Moderate to severe glabellar lines Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet lines) Contraindications of Azzalure: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis Who should not use Azzalure? Pregnant and lactating women should not use this product as not enough clinical data has been collected to suggest that it is safe. There is a risk of this product passing through the mother to her baby Any individuals that develop hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to the product should also refrain from using it. Children under 18 and adults over 65 should also not use this product Anyone with an infection on the skin surface at the proposed injection site should wait for the infection to completely disappear first There is a probable muscle weakness(myasthenia gravis) already present then do not use Azzalure either. The following diseases and conditions should also rule out the use of this medicine: Eaton Lambert syndrome and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (degenerative nerve muscle disorder) Storage: Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C Additional Information: EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/6584

This occlusive dressing allows the active ingredients soak into the skin. description: Description What are Dulcolax Tablets and what are they used for? Dulcolax Tablets offer fast-acting relief from short-term, occasional constipation. Each tablet contains 5mg of the clinically-tested active ingredient Bisacodyl. Bisacodyl is known as a stimulant laxative, helping to get your sluggish bowels moving again quickly, giving you relief from the uncomfortable symptoms of constipation within an hour. Dulcolax suppositories are manufactured by SANOFI and are specially designed to treat constipation in adults for a maximum of 5 days. What is constipation? Constipation is a common problem that can affect people of all ages causing reduced bowel movements and leading to dry, hard and lumpy stools that are sometimes large and hard to pass. Constipation can be incredibly uncomfortable causing sufferers to feel bloated, and nauseous and can even cause pain when trying to pass stool. Constipation can have many different causes, but some of the most common causes include: A lack of fibre in your diet Not drinking enough water Not getting enough exercise Ignoring the need to go to the toilet Side effects of medication How do Dulcolax Tablets work? Dulcolax tablets contain the active ingredient bisacodyl. Bisacodyl is a stimulant laxative that helps relieve constipation by stimulating the muscles in your bowels, helping to temporarily speed up your bowel activity to help keep you regular, making hard, lumpy or large stools easier and more comfortable to pass.

description: Description Mounjaro 7.5mg/0.6ml Lilly 2.4ml is a prescription only medicine indicated for: the treatment of adults with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus as an adjunct to diet and exercise as monotherapy or in addition to other medicinal products. weight management, including weight loss and weight maintenance, as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity in adults with an initial Body Mass Index (BMI) of ≥ 30 kg/ m2 (obesity) or ≥ 27 kg/m2 to < 30 kg/m2 (overweight) in the presence of at least one weight-related comorbid condition (e.g., hypertension, dyslipidaemia, obstructive sleep apnoea, cardiovascular disease, prediabetes, or type 2 diabetes mellitus). Mechanism of action: Tirzepatide is a long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Both receptors are present on the pancreatic α and β endocrine cells, heart, vasculature, immune cells (leukocytes), gut and kidney. GIP receptors are also present on adipocytes. In addition, both GIP and GLP-1 receptors are expressed in the areas of the brain important to appetite regulation. Tirzepatide is highly selective to human GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide has high affinity to both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide lowers body weight and body fat mass. The mechanisms associated with body weight and body fat mass reduction involve decreased food intake through the regulation of appetite and modulation of fat utilisation. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. Store in a refrigerator at 2–8°C Practitioners please note: Additional safe guides:- when prescribing Mounjaro adults should have a BMI over 30, or those with a BMI of 27+ with at least one weight-related condition.BMI must be stated on the prescription and only x1 pen per patient per prescription. Please note, as per recently published GPhC guidelines all weight loss prescription orders must come through a registered prescriber only, after a two way consultation with the client/patient directly to the patients address. If you have any further questions, you can follow the link below https://www.pharmacyregulation.org/pharmacies/registration-and-renewal/providing-services-online In order to improve the traceability of biological medicinal products, the name and the batch number of the administered product should be clearly recorded. This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring. Healthcare professionals are asked to report any suspected adverse reactions using the Yellow Card Scheme: www.mhra.gov.uk/yellowcard EMC: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/15481/smpc#about-medicine Patient Information Leaflet: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/files/pil.15481.pdf User manual: https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/files/usermanual.15481.pdf

description: Description PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA is indicated for facial treatment and for restoring adipose tissue. Stabilized Hybrid Cooperative Complexes (HCC) of high and low molecular weight Ultrapure Hyaluronic Acid in high concentration, produced with a unique and innovative thermal production process patented by IBSA, the NAHYCO ® Technology. Aging manifests as a result of the interplay of changes in the facial skeleton, ligaments, muscles, adipose tissue, and skin. The characteristic signs of aging in facial skin are, in part, associated with age-related alterations in the subcutaneous adipose tissue of the face. The movement of fat within compartments, due to gravity, can result in an inferomedial displacement of the overlying skin envelope. This repositioning or shift of fat often leads to increased hollows in the cheeks and to a flattening of facial angles. Consequently, there is a loss of fat volume in the middle and lateral cheek compartments. PROFHILO ® STRUCTURA provides a lipolifting effect by restoring adipose tissue and leading to deep firmness.

description: Description How does Jalupro HMW work? Jalupro HMW Skin Booster is an injectable solution that has been formulated using a clever combination of amino acids. Technically labelled as a dermal biorevitalizer, it eradicates skin depressions caused by ageing wrinkles and scars. The science behind Jalupro works by feeding the connective tissue under the skin layers, otherwise known as fibroblasts. Fibroblasts produce collagen and repair skin to ensure it always has elasticity and great looking texture. As skin ages, the fibroblasts function reduces in activity; this can be caused by many factors, including spending too much time in the sun, intense smoking and other reasons. Consequently, wrinkles appear. The amino acids in Jalupro HMW join forces with the existing fibroblasts to help them continue their pre-ageing function. The more abundant the amino acids, the more healthier the skin cells are, resulting in younger appearance. This natural phenomenon is an effective way for skin to look younger again without surgery. What’s in the Jalupro HMW box? 1 x glass syringe (disposable), pyrogen (sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate) 1 x glass bottle sterile solution based on Amino Acids. No needles. What are the benefits of Jalupro HMW? Jalupro HMW Skin Booster can be used to fade out scars and improve skin appearance by eliminating depressions specifically in the face, neck, decollete, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen area and knees. When can Jalupro HMW be used? Jalupro HMW can be used as soon as the face area begins to show signs of ageing and photo-ageing. It can be used to correct dry and dehydrated skin. educe stretch marks and is especially ideal before or after any surgery is to take place. How long does Jalupro HMW Last for? Whilst results become more evident over time, the average effects can last for 6 months. Can be used prior to sunbathing and works well in mature aged skin.

Mechanism of action: Tirzepatide is a long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Both receptors are present on the pancreatic α and β endocrine cells, heart, vasculature, immune cells (leukocytes), gut and kidney. GIP receptors are also present on adipocytes. The mechanisms associated with body weight and body fat mass reduction involve decreased food intake through the regulation of appetite and modulation of fat utilisation. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients.
