Mechanism of action: Tirzepatide is a long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Both receptors are present on the pancreatic α and β endocrine cells, heart, vasculature, immune cells (leukocytes), gut and kidney. GIP receptors are also present on adipocytes. In addition, both GIP and GLP-1 receptors are expressed in the areas of the brain important to appetite regulation. Tirzepatide is highly selective to human GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide has high affinity to both the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Tirzepatide lowers body weight and body fat mass. The mechanisms associated with body weight and body fat mass reduction involve decreased food intake through the regulation of appetite and modulation of fat utilisation. Contraindications: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients. Store in a refrigerator at 2–8°C Practitioners please note: Additional safe guides:- when prescribing Mounjaro adults should have a BMI over 30, or those with a BMI of 27+ with at least one weight-related condition. BMI must be stated on the prescription and only x1 pen per patient per prescription. Please note, as per recently published GPhC guidelines all weight loss prescription orders must come through a registered prescriber only, after a two way consultation with the client/patient directly to the patients address. description: Botox 100 units SKU: DAL20395 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Botox 100 Units is a trusted, FDA-approved injectable product designed to temporarily reduce the appearance of facial wrinkles and fine lines. Widely used by qualified aesthetic practitioners globally, Botox provides effective results for various cosmetic and medical purposes, including smoothing dynamic wrinkles, such as crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead lines. Product Description Botox 100U Vial is a trusted product in the field of aesthetic medicine, providing qualified practitioners with a highly sought-after and powerful tool to address various cosmetic and medical concerns. This vial contains botulinum toxin type A, derived from Clostridium botulinum bacteria. Box Contents Each box of Botox 100 Units contains: - 1 vial of Botox (100 Units) for injection. - Detailed instructions for use. - Prescribing information and safety guidelines. Benefits Botox is a safe and effective solution for clinics to administer to their patients. The vial temporarily inhibits muscle activity, making it ideal for reducing the appearance of dynamic wrinkles, such as crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead creases. This allows for a younger-looking appearance and with it, more confidence and self-esteem. Contraindications of Botox - Botox should not be used in the following cases: - Individuals with hypersensitivity to any of the components in the product. - Patients with infections at the proposed injection site(s). - Individuals with neuromuscular disorders such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). - Pregnant or breastfeeding women, unless advised otherwise by a healthcare provider. - Those with a known history of allergic reactions to botulinum toxin or any of the product's ingredients. How to Use This Product Preparation and Dosage: Reconstitute the vial with 0.9% sterile, non-preserved saline. Use an appropriate-sized syringe for reconstitution and injection. Botox 100 Units is intended for intramuscular injection by a qualified healthcare professional. Injection Technique: - Identify the target muscles based on the desired aesthetic or therapeutic outcome. - Inject directly into the specific muscles to reduce muscle activity responsible for wrinkles or other medical conditions. - Avoid injecting near the eyes or in areas where muscles control critical functions unless specifically trained for such procedures. Post-Injection Care: - Avoid rubbing or massaging the treated area for at least 24 hours post-injection. - Refrain from lying down for 4 hours after the injection to prevent the spread of the toxin to unintended areas. - Follow the healthcare provider’s advice on aftercare and possible side effects. Side Effects of Botox 100U Patients may experience a range of different side effects. Some of these side effects are mild bruising, swelling, or redness at the injection sites, which do not remain visible for very long. In rare cases, patients may report headaches or flu-like symptoms. FAQs Q: How long do the effects of Botox 100 Units last? The effects of Botox typically last between 3 to 6 months, depending on individual factors such as the area treated, dosage, and the patient’s metabolic rate. Q: Is Botox safe? Yes, Botox is considered safe when administered by a qualified aesthetic practitioner. It has been widely used for cosmetic and medical purposes for over two decades. However, there are contraindications (see above) and potential side effects, so it is essential to consult a healthcare provider before use. Q: How soon will I see results after my Botox treatment? Typically within 3 to 7 days after treatment, with maximum effect visible in about 2 weeks. Q: What should I avoid after receiving Botox injections? Avoid strenuous exercise, lying down for 4 hours, and exposure to excessive heat (like saunas or hot tubs) for at least 24 hours after treatment. Also, avoid rubbing or massaging the treated area to prevent the spread of the toxin. Q: Can Botox be used for medical purposes? Yes, including chronic migraines, excessive sweating (hyperhidrosis), muscle spasms, and more. Your healthcare provider can advise on its suitability. Q: How much does a Botox 100 Units vial typically cost? The cost can vary depending on the healthcare provider, geographic location, and the extent of treatment. Achieve smoother, more youthful-looking skin with Botox 100 Units. Consult your healthcare provider today to see if Botox is right for you. description: Chloramphenicol Eye Ointment 1% SKU: DAL20761 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Chloramphenicol belongs to a group of medicines called antibiotics. Antibiotics are used for infections caused by bacteria. Chloramphenicol eye ointment is for simple eye infections called “acute bacterial conjunctivitis”. This is sometimes known as “red eye” because the white part of the affected eye(s) will be red and/or the eyelid(s) will be red or swollen. There may also be a sticky discharge which can make the eye difficult to open in the morning, and the eye may feel ‘gritty’ or ‘irritated’. Chloramphenicol eye ointment is not suitable for treating eye infections that have spread to the deeper layers of the eye coverings or into the fluid within the eyeball. Antibiotic tablets or injections are needed to treat these deeper and more serious infections. Chloramphenicol 1.0% w/w Eye ointment is recommended for Children over 2 years , adults and the elderly . It is recommended that any child below the age of two years with an eye infection should be seen by a doctor.

The product also stimulates collagen production, which can help improve the overall texture and quality of the skin. What are the benefits? description: Juvederm Volite (2 x 1ml) SKU: DAL20115 Log In to View Price Description Additional Information Juvederm Volite (2 x 1ml) is an innovative treatment is designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, & smoothness, leaving you with a more youthful and healthy-looking complexion. Juvederm Volite has numerous benefits, making it a popular choice for individuals looking to improve the quality of their skin. Some of the key benefits of Juvederm Volite include improved skin hydration, improved skin texture and elasticity, and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. It can also be used to treat sun-damaged skin, dry skin, and other skin concerns. What is Juvederm Volite (2 x 1ml)? Juvederm Volite is a HA-based treatment designed to improve skin quality by hydrating and revitalizing the skin from within. It is administered via a series of treatments into the skin, and the treatment typically takes about 30 minutes to complete. Juvederm Volite helps to replace lost volume and stimulate the production of collagen, which can help to improve the overall quality and texture of your skin. How does it work? Juvederm Volite works by adding HA into the skin. HA is a naturally occurring substance in your body that is responsible for keeping your skin hydrated and plump. As we age, our bodies produce less HA, which can lead to dry and thinning skin. By adding HA back into the skin, we can help to restore hydration and improve skin texture and elasticity. What to expect during and after treatment? Juvederm Volite is a non-invasive treatment that typically takes about 30 minutes to complete. After the treatment, you may experience mild swelling or bruising at the treatment site, but this should resolve within a few days. Results from Juvederm Volite can be seen immediately, with full results typically visible after about two weeks, and can last for up to nine months. Juvederm Volite (2 x 1ml) is a popular and effective treatment for improving the quality of your skin. By adding HA into the skin, Juvederm Volite can help to restore hydration & improve skin texture and elasticity, leaving you with a more youthful and healthy-looking complexion. If you’re interested in trying Juvederm Volite, be sure to consult with a licensed and experienced aesthetic practitioner to determine if it’s right for you.

This product can be used for moderate to deep wrinkle treatment of the following areas: Forehead wrinkles, nasolabial folds, perioral wrinkles and marionette lines. Various factors, such as the patient's age, skin type and sporting activity, can influence the effect achieved by Prostrolane Natural B. When injected into the skin, Rejuran I works by repairing damaged skin cells and stimulating collagen synthesis. Reduces Fine Lines and Wrinkles : By promoting collagen and skin regeneration, Rejuran I can soften the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, particularly around the eyes, mouth, and forehead. Non-Invasive : Unlike surgical facelifts or other more invasive procedures, Rejuran I is a non-surgical treatment that requires minimal downtime. It can be a great option for people who want to rejuvenate their skin without the need for recovery time. Safe and Biocompatible : Since Rejuran I is made from natural salmon DNA, it’s biocompatible with human skin, which minimizes the risk of adverse reactions.

description: Restylane® Eyelight Dermal Filler 1 × 0.5 mL Restylane® Eyelight with Lidocaine is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device developed by Galderma for the treatment of infraorbital hollowing and tear trough deformities . Specifically formulated for the delicate under-eye area, Restylane Eyelight is designed to provide subtle volume restoration while maintaining smooth tissue integration. The inclusion of lidocaine improves patient comfort during injection. The gel is engineered for precise placement in the infraorbital region , offering controlled correction in thin skin areas prone to shadowing and contour irregularities. Unlike volumising fillers used in cheeks or jawline, Restylane Eyelight filler is tailored for refined under-eye correction rather than large-scale structural enhancement. What Restylane® Eyelight Is Similar To Restylane Eyelight can be regarded alongside other tear trough–specific hyaluronic acid fillers designed for infraorbital hollow correction. Within the Restylane portfolio, it is positioned for delicate periorbital treatment requiring precision and smooth integration. Compared with standard volumising fillers, Restylane Eyelight with lidocaine offers a formulation adapted to thin periorbital tissue. It is not intended for high-lift midface contouring or lip augmentation. For example, Restylane Eyelight for lips would not be considered appropriate due to its targeted design for the under-eye area. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Restylane Eyelight is indicated for the correction of infraorbital hollowing (tear trough area). Treatment areas include: Tear trough • Infraorbital region • Under-eye hollows Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Supraperiosteal or deep subcutaneous placement in the infraorbital region. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle or cannula specification: Supplied with sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions with advanced knowledge of periorbital anatomy. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) Lidocaine hydrochloride Physiological buffer solution Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 0.5 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 9–12 months , depending on patient factors and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin in the periorbital area until resolved. Extreme caution is required in the infraorbital region due to vascular structures; intravascular injection must be avoided. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or authorised distributor. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Restylane® Eyelight? Restylane Eyelight is a hyaluronic acid dermal filler specifically formulated for the correction of tear trough deformities and infraorbital hollowing. 2. Does Restylane Eyelight contain lidocaine? Yes. Restylane Eyelight with lidocaine includes lidocaine to improve comfort during treatment. 3. How long do Restylane Eyelight results last? Results are commonly reported to last between 9 and 12 months , depending on individual patient metabolism and technique. 4. Can Restylane Eyelight be used for lips? No. Restylane Eyelight for lips is not indicated, as the formulation is specifically designed for the delicate under-eye area. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Treatment of the tear trough requires advanced anatomical knowledge and precise injection technique to minimise risks, particularly vascular complications.

short_description: Plenhyage XL Medium is a professional polynucleotide skin-booster designed to improve skin quality in moderately aged or photo-damaged areas. Clinicians use it to enhance skin elasticity, hydration and surface texture while promoting tissue repair and collagen support. Supplied as a 2 ml prefilled syringe for single-patient use, it is intended for administration by qualified healthcare professionals. Plenhyage XL Medium is selected where subtle structural and dermal quality gains are required — for example in periorbital maintenance, cheeks, neck and décolletage — without creating bulk or volumetric lift.
description: Plenhyage XL Medium 1 × 2 ml Clinical description Plenhyage XL Medium is a CE-marked, Class-III injectable biorevitaliser from Bioformula s.r.l. formulated from high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN, salmon-derived DNA) at 2.0% (≈20 mg/ml) . The product is indicated to support tissue regeneration by stimulating fibroblast activity, encouraging extracellular-matrix repair and improving dermal hydration and elasticity. It is intended for clinical use where skin quality improvement is required—reducing fine lines, improving texture and supporting recovery of photodamaged or atrophic skin—rather than for volumetric correction. The formulation is sterile, biocompatible and resorbable; manufacturer documentation emphasises its role in improving skin density, tone and turgor through regenerative (biostimulatory) mechanisms. What Plenhyage XL Medium is similar to Plenhyage XL Medium sits in the polynucleotide (PDRN) biostimulator / polynucleotide category alongside other PN products and combination formulations (e.g., certain Jalupro® variants which combine amino acids with DNA fragments). Mechanistically, Plenhyage XL Medium acts via polynucleotide-driven fibroblast stimulation and extracellular matrix support; this contrasts with hyaluronic-acid (HA) fillers (e.g., Juvederm®/Restylane®) that primarily provide immediate volumetric augmentation via hydrophilic gels. Compared with lighter Plenhyage XL “Thin” or more concentrated “Strong” formulas in the same product family, the Medium formulation (2.0%) is positioned for moderate skin-quality concerns — stronger than Thin for structural support but less concentrated than Strong for advanced regenerative indications. For orientation, Profhilo® (an ultra-pure HA bioremodeling product) also targets skin quality rather than volume, but uses HA rather than PDRN; clinical choice depends on desired mechanism (biostimulation vs HA-mediated hydration). This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment areas / indications Manufacturer-stated suggested treatment areas: face, neck and décolletage . Manufacturer product page also notes applicability to other body zones requiring regenerative support (e.g., hands, areas of mild atrophy) depending on clinical assessment. If a specific area is required, verify on the product pack/IFU. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Note: the following items reproduce only parameters that are present in the manufacturer’s public product documentation. Where the IFU or manufacturer page does not specify a parameter, this is stated explicitly. Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer. Manufacturer packaging statement: syringe supplied with 2 disposable needles (pack contents), but needle gauge is not specified on the publicly available product page. Frequency / number of sessions: Manufacturer states “multiple sessions are usually required; the aesthetic doctor will develop a personalised treatment plan.” No precise session count/interval is given in the public IFU. Professional-use disclaimer: Intended for professional medical use only ; to be administered by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Non-IFU professional practice note (not part of the official IFU): some clinicians report common practice of a course of 2–4 sessions with 2- to 4-week intervals and maintenance treatments thereafter; this protocol is reported by distributors and practitioner forums, but is not specified in the manufacturer IFU and should be used only where clinically justified. Ingredient list Active: Polynucleotides (PDRN) — high molecular weight, 2.0% (approx. 20 mg/ml). Excipients: sterile water and buffering components as per manufacturer formulation (detailed excipient list in full IFU/fact sheet available to registered professionals). Lidocaine: not provided by manufacturer. (Manufacturer product page does not list lidocaine content.) Hyaluronic acid: some supplier pages reference PN-HA combination products, but for Plenhyage XL Medium the manufacturer declares polynucleotides (2.0%) as the key active; HA is not presented as a primary active on the official product page. If HA content is critical for clinical choice, verify on the IFU/pack. Presentation & longevity Presentation / pack: 1 glass syringe of 2 ml supplied with 2 disposable needles (single-patient sterile pack). Shelf life / storage: not provided by manufacturer on the public product page; consult the product carton/IFU for shelf-life and storage temperature. Duration of effect: Manufacturer: “duration varies depending on individual needs; multiple sessions usually required.” Distributor/clinic reports commonly cite modest improvements that can be sustained with maintenance treatments (numerous sellers report typical effect windows in the order of months), but manufacturer does not provide a fixed longevity figure. Safety notes / contraindications (Manufacturer-aligned summary; always refer to full IFU before treatment) Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component. Do not inject into or adjacent to areas of active skin infection, inflammation or open wounds. Caution or avoid use in pregnancy and breastfeeding unless local regulations and clinician judgement allow (manufacturer documentation advises professional assessment). Administer only by trained healthcare professionals; improper injection technique may increase risk of adverse events. Regulatory status CE-marked : Class III medical device, CE 0373 (manufacturer documentation). UKCA / FDA: UKCA marking and FDA clearance are not specified on the public manufacturer page; verify regulatory status on the product carton, local distributor records or via regulatory databases before use in non-EU/UK markets. FAQ Q1 — How does Plenhyage XL Medium work? A1 — Plenhyage XL Medium delivers purified polynucleotides (PDRN) into the dermis where they act as biostimulatory molecules: studies and manufacturer data indicate PDRN can promote fibroblast activity, support collagen and extracellular matrix repair, and improve dermal hydration and tissue resilience. These mechanisms lead to gradual improvement in skin texture and elasticity rather than immediate volumetric filling. Q2 — Is treatment safe and what side effects occur? A2 — According to the manufacturer, Plenhyage XL Medium is well tolerated when used by trained clinicians; common transient reactions include redness, swelling, mild bruising or local sensitivity at injection sites. Serious adverse events are rare when used according to professional standards. Proper screening and aseptic technique reduce risks. Refer to the full IFU for detailed safety information. Q3 — What is the recommended treatment schedule? A3 — The manufacturer specifies that multiple sessions are usually required and that clinicians should personalise the protocol. The public IFU does not give a fixed session count or interval; therefore clinicians often plan an initial series (clinically reported at 2–4 sessions in some practices) with individualised maintenance. Always follow the official IFU and local clinical guidance. Q4 — How long do results last? A4 — Manufacturer guidance states that duration varies by individual and treated area ; no fixed longevity is published on the public product page. Clinical reports from distributor sources commonly indicate improvements lasting months with maintenance—actual duration depends on skin condition, patient factors and treatment plan. Q5 — Can Plenhyage XL Medium replace hyaluronic-acid fillers? A5 — No direct interchange: Plenhyage XL Medium is a PDRN biostimulator intended to improve skin quality and promote tissue regeneration, whereas HA fillers primarily provide immediate volume and structural support. Choice should be indication-led: use PN products for dermal quality and HA for volumetric restoration or contouring. In many protocols both modalities are complementary.

description: Clinical Description Nucleofill 25, commonly marketed as Nucleofill Strong , is a high-concentration polynucleotide-based injectable medical device developed by Promoitalia Medical Aesthetics. Nucleofill Strong is generally indicated for mature skin, significant skin laxity, photoaged skin, and areas requiring enhanced regenerative support. It is frequently selected by practitioners seeking a more intensive polynucleotide treatment compared with lower-concentration formulations such as Nucleofill Medium. description: Lumi Eyes 1x1ml – Polynucleotide Injectable for Periorbital Skin Regeneration Lumi Eyes is an injectable polynucleotide (PN/PDRN)-based medical aesthetic device specifically developed for periorbital skin rejuvenation . The product is designed to improve under-eye skin quality by targeting dermal thinning, dehydration, fine lines, dark circles, and fatigue-related changes without adding volume. The formulation contains high-purity polynucleotides derived from DNA fragments , which act as biostimulatory agents within the dermis. When administered intradermally, Lumi Eyes supports fibroblast activation, extracellular matrix repair, improved microcirculation, and tissue hydration , making it suitable for patients presenting with fragile, crepey, or photo-aged under-eye skin. Lumi Eyes is non-volumising and intended for regenerative skin improvement rather than contour correction or filling of the tear trough. What Lumi Eyes Is Similar To Lumi Eyes can be considered alongside other regenerative eye-area injectables such as Rejuran® i , Nucleofill® Eyes , or Sunekos® Performa , which aim to improve skin quality and biological function rather than volumisation. Rejuran® i uses polynucleotides with a focus on dermal repair and anti-inflammatory activity. Sunekos® combines amino acids and HA to stimulate collagen and elastin synthesis. Lumi Eyes relies specifically on polynucleotide-driven tissue regeneration , hydration, and microvascular support. Unlike traditional HA dermal fillers (e.g. Juvederm® or Restylane®), Lumi Eyes does not provide structural lift or bulk and should not be used as a tear-trough filler substitute. This comparison is for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. How does Lumi Eyes treatment work? Lumi Eyes treatment works by delivering polynucleotides into the dermis of the under-eye area. These biologically active DNA fragments stimulate fibroblast activity, improve extracellular matrix repair, support hydration, and enhance microcirculation, resulting in improved skin texture, elasticity, and brightness. 2. Is Lumi Eyes the same as a dermal filler? No. Lumi Eyes is not a volumising filler . Unlike cross-linked HA fillers designed to lift or fill, Lumi Eyes focuses on regenerative skin improvement and is unsuitable for tear-trough volumisation. 3. How many sessions are required and how long do results last? A standard protocol includes three sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart . Practitioners should avoid deep injections and monitor for swelling or bruising post-treatment.

Developed with RHA® technology, it supports natural facial expressions while providing subtle correction. The inclusion of lidocaine contributes to improved patient comfort during treatment. description: Teoxane Teosyal® RHA 2 Teoxane Teosyal® RHA 2 is a resorbable hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler developed using Teoxane’s proprietary Resilient Hyaluronic Acid (RHA®) technology. This manufacturing process is designed to preserve the natural HA chain length while introducing controlled cross-linking, allowing the gel to adapt to dynamic facial movements while maintaining tissue support . Teosyal® RHA 2 is intended for the correction of superficial to moderate facial wrinkles and fine lines, particularly in areas subject to frequent expression. The formulation consists of non-animal stabilised hyaluronic acid and includes lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance patient comfort during injection . Compared with higher-viscosity fillers in the RHA range, RHA 2 exhibits a softer rheological profile, supporting smooth tissue integration and flexibility. The product is supplied sterile in prefilled syringes and is intended exclusively for use by qualified medical professionals in accordance with the manufacturer’s Instructions for Use (IFU). What Teosyal® RHA 2 Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA 2 belongs to the category of soft, dynamic hyaluronic acid dermal fillers designed for superficial wrinkle correction. Within the Teosyal RHA portfolio, it is positioned below RHA 3 and RHA 4 , offering lower gel firmness and greater flexibility for areas with high mobility. For clinical orientation, RHA 2 may be compared with products such as Restylane® Refyne or Belotero® Balance , which are also formulated to integrate smoothly into superficial dermal layers while accommodating facial movement. Differences exist in HA concentration, cross-linking technology, and rheological behaviour, which influence durability and tissue response. RHA® technology focuses on resilience during repeated expression rather than lift or volumisation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to publicly available manufacturer information: Correction of superficial to moderate facial wrinkles and fine lines Specific anatomical treatment areas are not explicitly detailed in the publicly available IFU and are therefore described as: treatment areas not provided by manufacturer. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) All administration parameters must strictly follow the official Teoxane IFU. Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer Volume per injection point / site: not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer Professional-use disclaimer: Teosyal® RHA 2 is intended to be administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions and in accordance with the official IFU. Some practitioners apply specific techniques based on clinical experience; these are not included in the manufacturer’s official IFU . Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) Lidocaine hydrochloride – present (exact concentration not provided by manufacturer) Phosphate buffer system Water for injections HA concentration: not provided by manufacturer Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 2 × 1.0 mL prefilled syringes Sterility: sterile, single-use medical device Shelf life: not provided by manufacturer Treatment longevity: not provided by manufacturer Clinical durability may vary depending on patient-specific and procedural factors; no fixed duration is stated in the IFU. Safety Notes / Contraindications Based on manufacturer documentation and standard medical-device guidance: Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any formulation component Contraindicated in areas with active skin infection, inflammation, or disease Not intended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding patients as a precaution Use only in accordance with professional training and anatomical knowledge Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device (dermal filler, Class III) UKCA status: verify via authorised distributor or product packaging Regulatory classification not fully specified in public documentation; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ What type of filler is Teosyal® RHA 2? Teosyal® RHA 2 is a resorbable hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed using RHA® technology. It is designed to correct fine to moderate wrinkles while adapting to facial movement. The formulation includes lidocaine to improve patient comfort during injection. How does RHA® technology affect filler performance? RHA® technology preserves longer HA chains during cross-linking, supporting elasticity and resilience under dynamic facial stress. This helps the filler move with facial expressions rather than resisting them, which is particularly relevant in superficial and mobile areas . Does Teosyal® RHA 2 contain lidocaine? Yes. Teosyal® RHA 2 contains lidocaine hydrochloride to reduce discomfort during injection. The manufacturer does not publicly specify the exact percentage in available documentation . How long do results last? The manufacturer does not specify a fixed longevity range in the IFU. Duration of effect varies based on individual metabolism, treatment area, and technique, and should be evaluated within a clinical consultation. Is Teosyal® RHA 2 suitable for lip treatments? The IFU does not explicitly list lips as a treatment area. Any use in specific anatomical regions must follow professional judgement and official manufacturer guidance. Products should not be considered interchangeable without appropriate training.

short_description: PROFHILO® H+L is designed for professional injectable use, providing a high concentration of non-cross-linked HA to deliver skin bioremodelling and deep hydration rather than volumetric filling. It offers clinicians a tool to treat areas of skin laxity with fewer injection points and sessions. Suitable for trained aesthetic practitioners, this device focuses on improving skin quality, texture and tissue tone, making it a valuable component in aesthetic practice.
description: Profhilo H+L Facial Treatment for Hydration and Facial Lifting PROFHILO® H+L is a class of injectable medical-device gel comprising ultra-pure hyaluronic acid (HA) sodium salt in a high-concentration “hybrid cooperative complex” format combining high-molecular-weight (H-HA) and low-molecular-weight (L-HA) chains via the patented NAHYCO® technology. The product is indicated primarily for the treatment of facial skin laxity – for example the malar-zygomatic and sub-malar regions – and for the re-definition of contours and remodelling of lax tissue. The gel is non–chemically cross-linked (i.e., no BDDE) and designed to diffuse within the dermal and sub-cutaneous layers to support hydration, restructure the extracellular matrix, and promote a corrective effect in photo- and chrono-aged skin. What PROFHILO® H+L Is Similar To PROFHILO® H+L can be regarded alongside other skin-booster or bioremodelling injectables such as Sunekos® or Rejuran®, in that all aim to improve skin architecture rather than provide significant volumetric augmentation. For example, Sunekos® uses amino-acid and peptide complexes to stimulate collagen and elastin, while PROFHILO uses HA hybrid complexes for hydration and matrix stimulation. However, unlike many traditional dermal fillers (e.g., HA volumisers such as Juvederm® or Restylane®) which are designed to restore volume or fill wrinkles, PROFHILO® H+L emphasises tissue remodelling and hydration over lifting or bulk augmentation. Its longevity is also distinct: after a primary two-session protocol it is reported to last around six months in many cases , whereas volumising HA fillers may last 9–18 months depending on cross-linking and location. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, PROFHILO® is indicated for the face and body for contour re-definition and laxity remodelling; in particular the malar-zygomatic, sub-malar, brachial (arm) and abdominal areas. Treatment areas: Face (malar & sub-malar) • Body (arms, abdomen, brachial) → For PROFHILO® H+L specifically, the IFU emphasises treatment of facial skin laxity (malar-zygomatic and sub-malar regions) and states use on the body where indicated. Usage / Administration Injection depth : Deep dermal/sub-cutaneous bolus. Volume per point / injection site : 0.2 mL per injection site. Needle gauge : 29 G × ½” (0.33 × 12 mm) is supplied with syringe. Frequency / number of sessions : Initial cycle of two treatment sessions at 30-day (approximately) intervals; maintenance treatments every 2 months if necessary. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid sodium salt: 32 mg high-molecular-weight HA (H-HA) + 32 mg low-molecular-weight HA (L-HA) per 2 mL syringe. Sodium chloride Sodium phosphate Water for injection Lidocaine: Not provided by manufacturer. Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation : 1 × 2 mL pre-filled sterile syringe, supplied with 2 × 29 G × ½” needles (0.33 × 12 mm) Longevity (treatment duration) : The effects are typically reported to last about six months after the initial two-session protocol, although individual results may vary depending on patient age, anatomy and injection technique. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid in patients with active skin infections or inflammation at the injection site (e.g., cysts, pimples, rashes) until condition is resolved. Do not inject intravenously, into muscles, tendons or for mammary (breast) augmentation. Single use only; do not reuse syringe; ensure packaging intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device (CE 0197) in Europe. UKCA status: verify via IFU or distributor. Regulatory classification not fully specified in public documentation for all jurisdictions; verify on the product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. How does PROFHILO® H+L work in the skin? PROFHILO® H+L uses a hybrid complex of low- and high-molecular-weight HA which, once injected into the deep dermal/sub-cutaneous layer, spreads via the BAP (Bio Aesthetic Points) technique and diffuses across the tissue. Its mechanism is described as “bioremodelling” the low-MW HA contributes immediate hydration, while the high-MW HA supports dermal scaffold integrity and stimulates fibroblasts to synthesize new collagen and elastin. 2. Is PROFHILO® H+L the same as a traditional dermal filler? No. Unlike volumising HA fillers that are designed to fill wrinkles or restore volume (via thicker gels, higher cross-linking), PROFHILO® H+L is formulated for tissue remodelling and skin quality improvement rather than structural augmentation. It uses non-cross-linked HA in a spreadable form and fewer injection sites, focusing on hydration, laxity and skin tone. 3. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do the results last? The standard protocol involves two sessions spaced approximately 30 days apart; after the initial cycle, maintenance treatments may be administered every two months if required. Clinical reports suggest the effect lasts around six months, though this varies with patient factors and injection technique. 4. Can PROFHILO® H+L be used on areas beyond the face? Yes manufacturer documentation includes body areas such as brachial (arms) and abdomen for contour re-definition and skin laxity remodelling. However, practitioners should verify local regulatory indications and patient suitability for off-label uses. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? As with all injectable devices, strict aseptic technique, knowledge of anatomy and patient medical history are essential. Because the product diffuses widely, care must be taken to avoid off-target injection or intravascular placement. Contraindications include active skin infection, severe allergies, bleeding disorders. Post-treatment, patients should avoid strong UV exposure and protect treated areas with sun-block for a few days.

description: Teoxane Teosyal RHA Kiss (2×0,7ml) Teosyal® RHA Kiss is a CE‑marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler designed for professional aesthetic use in lip augmentation, contour refinement, and correction of fine perioral lines . Utilising patented RHA® (Resilient Hyaluronic Acid) technology , the gel comprises 23 mg/mL cross‑linked HA of non‑animal origin and 0.3 % lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance comfort during injection. RHA technology is engineered to preserve longer HA polymer chains with resilience and elasticity, making it suited for dynamic mobile regions like the lips, where natural movement is important. The viscoelastic properties support soft volume enhancement and improved lip definition while accommodating facial motion. RHA Kiss is indicated for adding subtle dynamic volume and smoothing perioral wrinkles such as “barcode” lines. Its effects are typically observed immediately with ongoing hydration, and clinical data suggest durations of approximately 6–8 months depending on individual metabolism, injection technique, and anatomical considerations. What Teosyal® RHA Kiss Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA Kiss is comparable to other lip‑oriented HA dermal fillers such as Restylane® Kysse and Juvederm® Volbella XC , which are designed to add subtle volume and refine lip contours while addressing perioral fine lines. Like these products, RHA Kiss uses cross‑linked hyaluronic acid to attract and retain water in tissues, enhancing hydration and structure. The distinguishing feature of RHA Kiss is its resilient HA network , intended to maintain elasticity in dynamic regions like lips and perioral zones. Both Restylane Kysse and Juvederm Volbella also balance volume with flexibility, but differences in HA concentration, particle size, cross‑linking, and rheologic behaviour can influence lift capacity and integration under motion. Longevity for these lip fillers is generally in the 6–9 month range , subject to metabolic and anatomical factors. description: Teoxane Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 (1×3 mL) Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 1 is a non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) skin booster medical device developed by Teoxane Laboratories to improve skin hydration, redensification, and early signs of aging across the face, neck, and décolletage. Its formula combines 15 mg/mL of free high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid with a patented dermo-restructuring complex of amino acids, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamin B6 — plus 0.3 % lidocaine to enhance patient comfort during injection. The nutrient-enriched gel is injected into the superficial to mid dermis to support tissue hydration, firmness, and prevention of fine lines and wrinkles. Teosyal Redensity 1 is intended for use by trained healthcare professionals experienced in aesthetic injectable treatments. Teosyal Redensity 1 is distinct from traditional volumising dermal fillers; rather than restoring volume, it focuses on skin texture improvement, enhanced hydration and redensification of aged or dehydrated skin, helping to support a fresher and more resilient appearance. What Teosyal Redensity 1 Is Similar To Teosyal Redensity 1 belongs to the Teosyal® PureSense line of skin boosters and can be regarded alongside other nutrient-enriched HA treatments that target skin quality rather than volumetric augmentation . Like Profhilo® or other HA-based hydration boosters, Redensity 1 uses unmodified free HA to attract and retain water in tissues, thereby enhancing hydration and general skin health. However, in addition to HA, Redensity 1 incorporates a dermo-restructuring complex of amino acids, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamin B6 designed to support cellular activity and dermal integrity. In contrast to thicker cross-linked HA fillers (e.g., Juvederm® or Restylane® volumisers), which are designed for deep wrinkle correction and volume restoration, Teosyal Redensity 1 emphasises subtle improvement in skin texture, tonicity, and hydration . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Teosyal PureSense Redensity 1 is indicated for: Skin redensification and hydration of the face, neck, and décolletage. Prevention and reduction of fine lines and early signs of aging . Improvement of skin texture, firmness, and overall luminosity . Treatment areas and injection depth should be determined by a qualified medical professional based on individual assessment and aesthetic goals. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid dermis, depending on treatment area. Volume per injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Typically supplied with 30 G × ½″ needles . Frequency / number of sessions: Treatment protocols often involve multiple sessions spaced approximately 3 weeks apart , with maintenance sessions recommended periodically; official guidance may vary. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified healthcare professionals experienced in dermal injections under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted from official IFU or product documentation, it is recorded as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (HA): 15 mg/mL of non-cross-linked HA. Lidocaine hydrochloride: 0.3 % (w/w) to enhance injection comfort. Dermo-restructuring complex: 8 amino acids (e.g., glycine, lysine, threonine, proline, isoleucine, leucine, valine, arginine) 3 antioxidants (e.g., glutathione, N-acetyl-L-cysteine, alpha-lipoic acid) 2 minerals (zinc, copper) Vitamin B6 All excipients and supplemental buffering agents are included per IFU and ensure compatibility with HA. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 3 mL pre-filled sterile syringe (traceability labelling included). Shelf life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to product packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): According to manufacturer guidance for PureSense products, Teosyal Redensity 1 has an estimated in-vivo lifetime of at least 3 months following treatment. Individual duration may vary with skin condition, injection technique, and lifestyle factors. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component of the formulation. Avoid injection into areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Strict aseptic technique and detailed anatomical knowledge are essential to minimise risks. Refer to the official Instructions for Use for complete warnings, precautions, and post-treatment care. Regulatory Status Teosyal PureSense Redensity 1 is a CE-marked medical device authorised for aesthetic use in Europe. Users should verify region-specific regulatory details (e.g., UKCA) via product packaging or formal IFU documentation. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal Redensity 1? Teosyal Redensity 1 is a nutrient-enriched skin booster based on non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with antioxidants, amino acids, minerals, and vitamin B6 to hydrate, redensify and improve skin quality . It includes 0.3 % lidocaine to enhance injection comfort and is used in superficial dermal layers. 2. How long does Teosyal Redensity 1 last? According to manufacturer guidance for Teosyal PureSense products, the estimated in-vivo lifetime of Redensity 1 is at least 3 months after treatment. Effects can vary based on skin characteristics, treatment protocol, and injection technique. 3. What areas can Teosyal Redensity 1 be used on? Teosyal Redensity 1 is typically injected into the face, neck, and décolletage to improve hydration, skin texture, and reduce early signs of aging. 4. Is Teosyal Redensity 1 a traditional volumising filler? No — Redensity 1 is a skin booster , not a structural volume filler. Its primary purpose is skin redensification and hydration , rather than restoring deep volume like thicker cross-linked HA fillers. 5. Can Teosyal Redensity 1 be combined with other aesthetic treatments? Treatment protocols may include combining Redensity 1 with other aesthetic procedures, but this should be determined by a qualified clinician. Official IFU instructions do not prescribe combination therapies and such decisions remain at the practitioner’s discretion.

short_description: Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2 is a professional-grade dermal filler designed to improve the appearance of tear troughs, under-eye hollows, and fine periorbital lines . Its unique formulation blends hyaluronic acid with a targeted nutrient complex and lidocaine for comfortable, precise treatment of sensitive areas. Suitable for trained medical professionals experienced in periocular injections, Redensity 2 supports natural-looking rejuvenation with long-lasting hydration and tissue support . This product is intended for clinicians seeking reliable correction for specific signs of ageing and volume loss in the thin skin around the eyes.
description: Teoxane Teosyal PureSense Redensity 2 (2x1ml) Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2 is a CE-marked, injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler specifically formulated for use in delicate facial regions such as the periorbital area and tear troughs . Developed by Teoxane Laboratories (Switzerland) , Redensity 2 combines cross-linked and non-cross-linked HA at 15 mg/ml with an advanced nutrient complex of 8 amino acids, 3 antioxidants, 2 minerals, and vitamin B6 to support tissue health and dermal function. All formulations contain lidocaine 0.3 % to enhance patient comfort during injection. Redensity 2’s viscoelastic gel is tailored for superficial to deep dermal placement where fine lines, under-eye hollows, and mild periorbital dark circles persist, delivering temporary structural support and hydration that typically lasts up to 9–12 months . What Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2 Is Similar To In clinical category and mechanism, Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2 is similar to tear trough-specific hyaluronic acid fillers like Restylane® Differences and Belotero® Balance / Soft . All of these products provide temporary dermal volumisation and hydration by integrating HA into tissue planes with tailored viscoelastic properties for fine-line and contour correction. Redensity 2’s unique nutrient complex is designed for delicate zones and may offer supplementary antioxidative and amino-acid support not present in simple HA gels. As with most under-eye fillers, the depth of injection and product choice should align with anatomical requirements to minimise the risk of oedema or Tyndall effect. Duration of effect for these products generally ranges from 6–12 months , depending on filler cross-linking, gel characteristics, and individual patient factors. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. What is Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2? Teosyal® PureSense Redensity 2 is a professional hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed for treating under-eye hollows, fine lines, and mild dark circles. It combines HA with an advanced nutrient complex to support tissue hydration and structure in delicate periorbital areas. It includes lidocaine to reduce injection discomfort during procedures performed by trained professionals. 2. How does it work? This filler works by physically restoring volume and hydrating the dermis via HA, which binds water within tissues. The added amino acids, antioxidants, minerals, and vitamin B6 contribute to microenvironment support but do not alter the mechanical volume-restoring function of HA. 3. How long do results last? Clinical data from distributors and product literature indicate effects usually persist up to 9–12 months , though this varies with metabolism, technique, and patient lifestyle factors. 4. Is it safe? When administered by trained clinicians following aseptic technique, Redensity 2 is generally safe. Common, usually transient events include swelling, bruising, redness, or tenderness at the injection site. Contraindications include active infection or hypersensitivity to any component. 5. How does it compare to other under-eye fillers? Like other under-eye fillers (e.g., Restylane®) it provides temporary volume support. Its nutrient complex aims to support delicate tissue environments, but injection depth and practitioner expertise remain key determinants of outcomes. This is not medical advice; injector consultation is essential.

description: Clinical Description RRS® Hyalift 75 is a CE-marked injectable dermal implant and skin biorevitalisation product designed for the treatment of skin photoageing, dermal atrophy, dehydration, and age-related deterioration in skin quality. The formulation contains non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) at a concentration of 15 mg/mL (75 mg per 5 mL vial), suspended within a protective solution containing amino acids and antioxidant components intended to support dermal hydration and extracellular matrix maintenance. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, RRS® Hyalift 75 is primarily intended to improve skin hydration, elasticity, texture, and overall skin quality rather than create structural volume. The product is commonly used in professional aesthetic medicine protocols targeting facial and body areas affected by photoageing and tissue laxity. According to manufacturer information, treatment indications include skin photoageing and its consequences, dermal atrophy, and hydration support for ageing skin. What RRS® Hyalift 75 Is Similar To RRS® Hyalift 75 belongs to the category of injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisation products. It is most comparable to products such as Profhilo® and Jalupro® , although important differences exist. Like Profhilo®, RRS® Hyalift 75 uses hyaluronic acid to improve hydration and skin quality. However, Profhilo® contains hybrid cooperative complexes of high- and low-molecular-weight HA, whereas RRS® Hyalift 75 uses non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with amino acids and antioxidant compounds. Compared with Jalupro®, RRS® Hyalift 75 shares the inclusion of amino-acid support ingredients intended to assist extracellular matrix maintenance. However, the specific formulation, concentration profile, and manufacturer protocols differ. RRS® Hyalift 75 is generally positioned as a hydration-focused biorevitalisation product for skin quality enhancement rather than a volumising filler or collagen-stimulating implant. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer information, commonly treated areas include: Face Neck Décolletage (cleavage) Back of hands Inner arms Inner thighs Peri-umbilical area Abdomen, including stretch-mark-prone areas Primary indications include: Skin photoageing Dermal atrophy Dehydrated skin Fine superficial wrinkles Reduced skin elasticity Age-related skin quality deterioration Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) Treatment frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer in publicly available documentation. Professional-use statement: RRS® Hyalift 75 is intended to be administered only by legally qualified healthcare professionals in authorised clinical settings under appropriate aseptic conditions. Important: Some practitioners describe intradermal mesotherapy protocols using fine-gauge needles. However, these approaches are not included in the manufacturer’s publicly available official IFU referenced for this description . short_description: Revolax Fine precisely diminishes fine lines and wrinkles. Its high-viscosity hyaluronic acid gel, possessing viscoelastic properties, ensures a pliable consistency that distributes evenly for a natural look. This clear, biodegradable, cross-linked dermal filler uses non-animal, high-purity hyaluronic acid, optimized to synchronize with human skin tissue.
description: Revolax Fine with Lido offers an exceptional solution for fine lines and wrinkles, including glabellar lines, neck wrinkles, and crow’s feet. This lightweight, high-viscosity dermal filler, made from high-purity hyaluronic acid, blends seamlessly with human skin tissue. Consequently, it provides a natural and smooth finish while quickly penetrating the skin to deliver instant and enduring results. Treatment Areas Crow’s Feet : Reduces fine lines around the eyes. Glabellar Lines : Smooths vertical lines between the eyebrows. Neck Wrinkles : Minimizes lines and wrinkles on the neck. Usage Administer Revolax Fine with Lido through precise injections into the targeted superficial areas. The high-viscosity gel allows for excellent molding and adjustment during application. Thus, it ensures tailored and long-lasting results. Additionally, the inclusion of lido provides a more comfortable injection experience by minimizing discomfort. Ingredient List Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid : 24 mg/ml – Provides high-density, long-lasting volume and support. Lido HCI : 3 mg/ml – An anesthetic agent included to reduce injection pain. Phosphate Buffered Saline Solution, pH 7.0 : q.s. – Ensures the stability and biocompatibility of the filler. Product Dimensions/Size Volume : 1.1 ml per syringe Needles : Includes 2 sterile 30G needles Packaging : Available in single 1.1 ml syringe packs Product Duration Revolax Fine with Lido offers long-lasting results, typically between 12-18 months. However, this duration may vary depending on the individual’s skin type and treatment area. Manufacturer Across, a renowned company in the field of aesthetic medicine known for its innovative and high-quality dermal fillers, manufactures Revolax Fine with Lido. Features High Viscoelasticity : Provides long-lasting volume and support. Low Phase Angle : Ensures the filler stays closer to the injection site for longer, reducing migration risks. Patented Particle Technology : Achieves uniform particle size for easier injections and enhanced treatment effects. High Quality & Density : Offers one of the densest HA fillers available, achieving a particle weight of 2,500,000 Da for added volume. Biodegradable : Natural absorption ensures safety and efficacy. Recommendations Revolax Fine with Lido suits individuals seeking to diminish fine lines and wrinkles, particularly in the crow’s feet, glabellar lines, and neck wrinkles. However, consider the following precautions: Pregnant or lactating women should not use it. Individuals with allergies to hyaluronic acid or lido should avoid it. It is not recommended for children under 18 or adults over 65. Do not use on skin with infections at the injection site. Avoid if there is a history of muscle weakness conditions (e.g., myasthenia gravis). Patients with coagulation disorders or those on anticoagulants or platelet aggregation inhibitors should not use it. Patients should avoid makeup for 12 hours post-injection and minimize exposure to sunlight, UV light, and extreme temperatures for two weeks after the injection. Precautions Revolax Fine with Lido is for single use only; do not re-sterilize. Avoid mixing with other products before implantation. Hyaluronic acid products are incompatible with quaternary ammonium salts like benzalkonium chloride. If the needle gets stuck, stop the injection, replace the needle, and continue. Summary Revolax Fine with Lido stands out as an effective, high-quality dermal filler designed for treating superficial lines and wrinkles. With its high-purity hyaluronic acid and added lido for comfort, it ensures a natural, youthful appearance with long-lasting results.

short_description: PRX Post-Dry for Dry Facial Skin is a nourishing moisturising cream formulated to support skin hydration and comfort after professional aesthetic treatments. Developed by WiQo®, the formula combines humectants, emollients, antioxidants, and botanical ingredients to help maintain skin balance and reinforce the skin barrier. Designed specifically for dry and dehydrated skin types, the cream may be used both as part of a PRX-Therapy homecare programme and as a daily moisturiser. Its rich texture helps improve skin comfort while supporting hydration retention and protecting the skin from environmental stressors. For clinics and skincare professionals, PRX Post-Dry represents an important component of comprehensive post-treatment care and ongoing skin maintenance.
description: Clinical Description PRX Post-Dry / Dry Facial Skin is a professional moisturising and skin-conditioning cream developed by WiQo® as part of the PRX-Therapy homecare range. The formulation is intended for dry, dehydrated, and lipid-deficient skin requiring enhanced hydration and barrier support following aesthetic procedures or during routine skincare maintenance. The cream combines hydrating, emollient, antioxidant, and skin-conditioning ingredients designed to help restore the hydrolipidic barrier and reduce transepidermal water loss. Publicly available product information identifies key ingredients including hyaluronic acid, shea butter, jojoba oil, wheat germ oil, grape seed oil, vitamin E, retinyl palmitate, and botanical extracts. PRX Post-Dry is commonly recommended as part of post-procedure skincare protocols following PRX-T33® treatments and other aesthetic procedures where skin hydration and epidermal comfort are important. The formulation is suitable for daily use and may assist in maintaining skin softness, elasticity, and overall barrier function. What PRX Post-Dry / Dry Facial Skin Is Similar To PRX Post-Dry belongs to the category of professional post-procedure skincare products designed to support hydration and skin-barrier recovery. It may be compared with other medical-aesthetic moisturising creams frequently recommended following chemical peels, biorevitalisation treatments, laser procedures, and skin resurfacing therapies. Unlike injectable skin boosters such as Profhilo® or Sunekos®, PRX Post-Dry is a topical product and does not deliver active ingredients through intradermal injection. Instead, it supports skin hydration and barrier function at the epidermal level through topical application. Compared with the PRX Post-Dry Normal Facial Skin formulation, the Dry Facial Skin version provides a richer and more nourishing composition intended for patients experiencing increased dryness, dehydration, or impaired barrier function. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to publicly available manufacturer and distributor information, PRX Post-Dry may be applied to: Face Neck Décolleté Dry or dehydrated skin requiring hydration support Skin undergoing post-procedure recovery following aesthetic treatments Usage / Administration Application Instructions Apply to cleansed skin. Massage gently until fully absorbed. May be applied morning and evening. Use according to practitioner recommendations when incorporated into professional skincare protocols. Professional Disclaimer The product should be used according to manufacturer instructions and any guidance provided by qualified skincare or medical professionals. Ingredient List Publicly available ingredient disclosures include: Hyaluronic Acid Echinacea Angustifolia Extract Shea Butter (Butyrospermum Parkii) Jojoba Oil (Simmondsia Chinensis) Wheat Germ Oil (Triticum Vulgare) Grape Seed Oil (Vitis Vinifera) Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E) Retinyl Palmitate Sunflower Seed Oil Propylene Glycol Glyceryl Stearate Hydrogenated Polydecene Sodium Gluconate Aqua (Water) Presentation & Longevity Packaging 1 × 50 ml cream jar Treatment Duration PRX Post-Dry is intended for continuous skincare maintenance and post-treatment support. Duration of use varies according to individual skincare requirements and practitioner recommendations. Safety Notes / Contraindications Publicly available documentation indicates the following precautions: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. Do not apply to damaged or infected skin unless directed by a healthcare professional. Discontinue use if significant irritation or hypersensitivity develops. Where specific contraindications are not publicly detailed: Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component or with active skin infections at the application site. Regulatory Status PRX Post-Dry is marketed as part of the WiQo® professional skincare and PRX-Therapy homecare range. Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer documentation prior to professional use. FAQ What is PRX Post-Dry for Dry Facial Skin? PRX Post-Dry is a professional moisturising cream designed to support hydration and barrier recovery in dry and dehydrated skin. It is frequently used as part of PRX-Therapy homecare protocols and may also serve as a standalone daily moisturiser. Is PRX Post-Dry suitable after aesthetic treatments? Yes. The product is commonly recommended following professional skin-renewal procedures where additional hydration and barrier support may be beneficial. Its formulation is designed to help maintain skin comfort during the recovery period. Does PRX Post-Dry contain hyaluronic acid? Yes. Public ingredient disclosures identify hyaluronic acid as a component of the formulation. However, the manufacturer does not publicly specify the concentration of hyaluronic acid contained within the product. How often should PRX Post-Dry be applied? Manufacturer guidance indicates that the cream may be applied to cleansed skin in the morning and evening. Individual usage may vary according to practitioner recommendations and patient skincare requirements. How does PRX Post-Dry differ from injectable skin boosters? Injectable skin boosters deliver active ingredients directly into the dermis through injection procedures performed by trained professionals. PRX Post-Dry is a topical skincare formulation that works at the skin surface to support hydration, nourishment, and barrier function rather than providing injectable tissue stimulation.

short_description: Profhilo Structura is a professional hyaluronic acid injectable developed for structural facial rejuvenation. The formulation integrates high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid to support superficial adipose tissue and facial contour definition. It targets age related volume loss and reduced firmness while supporting hydration and tissue quality. Profhilo Structura is administered by qualified medical professionals as part of an aesthetic treatment plan focused on facial structure and tissue support.
description: Profhilo Structura with cannula 2x1ml Profhilo Structura is an injectable hyaluronic acid product indicated for patients with age related loss of facial adipose tissue and reduced structural support. It uses patented NAHYCO technology, combining high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid into hybrid cooperative complexes. This composition supports superficial fat compartments, improves facial contour, and enhances deep tissue hydration. Unlike traditional dermal fillers this gel product contains no chemical cross linking agents and is not designed for focal volumisation. Its mechanism focuses on biological interaction with subcutaneous tissue to support firmness and structural integrity. Profhilo Structura is used in professional aesthetic practice for midface volume loss, contour refinement, and age associated changes linked to adipose tissue reduction. What Profhilo Structura Is Similar To Profhilo Structura belongs to the category of hyaluronic acid injectables designed for tissue remodelling rather than traditional wrinkle filling. It shares a related technological platform with Profhilo, as both products use hybrid complexes of high and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid. Standard Profhilo focuses on skin hydration, elasticity, and dermal bio remodelling, with primary effects in the dermis. Profhilo Structura differs by targeting superficial adipose tissue and structural support, with indications centred on contour refinement and volume support in areas affected by age related fat loss. Structura also contains a higher total hyaluronic acid content per syringe. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications • Facial adipose tissue restoration • Midface volume loss • Facial contour refinement including cheek and jawline support If additional treatment areas exist, they are not provided by manufacturer. Usage / Administration • Injection depth: intradermal or subcutaneous • Volume per point or injection site: not provided by manufacturer • Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer • Frequency or number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer • Professional use only. Ingredient List • High molecular weight hyaluronic acid, 45 mg per syringe • Low molecular weight hyaluronic acid, 45 mg per syringe • Sodium hyaluronate • Sodium phosphate buffer Presentation & Longevity Profhilo Structura is supplied as one 2 mL prefilled syringe intended for single patient use. The total hyaluronic acid content is 90 mg per syringe. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation. Do not inject into areas with active infection or inflammation. Treatment should follow strict aseptic technique and standard medical precautions. Regulatory Status CE marked medical device in accordance with European medical device regulations. Regulatory classification beyond CE marking is not specified in publicly available documentation. FAQ What is Profhilo Structura designed to do Profhilo Structura is designed to support facial structure by interacting with superficial adipose tissue. The hyaluronic acid complexes bind water and integrate with tissue, supporting firmness, hydration, and contour in areas affected by age related fat loss. Is Profhilo Structura a dermal filler Profhilo Structura is not a conventional dermal filler. Traditional fillers create defined volume in specific areas. Profhilo Structura focuses on tissue support and contour through adipose interaction rather than focal volumisation. How long do results last The manufacturer does not publish a defined duration of effect. Clinical outcomes vary between individuals and develop gradually following treatment as the hyaluronic acid integrates with tissue. Is Profhilo Structura safe Hyaluronic acid injectables show a well established safety profile when used by trained professionals. Common reactions include temporary swelling or redness at injection sites. Full safety guidance is available in the IFU. How does Profhilo Structura differ from Profhilo Both products use hybrid hyaluronic acid complexes. Profhilo targets dermal hydration and skin quality. Profhilo Structura targets superficial adipose tissue and facial contour support. They serve different clinical indications and are not interchangeable.

short_description: Plenhyage XL Thin offers a refined solution for clinicians seeking to revitalise delicate or early-aging skin without adding bulk. With its polynucleotide-based formula, it supports tissue regeneration, improves skin resilience and enhances hydration in sensitive zones such as the periorbital area, neck or décolletage. Utilised by trained professionals, this device is designed for subtle skin quality transformation rather than deep volumetric correction.
description: Plenhyage XL Thin 1 × 2 ml – In stock Clinical Description Plenhyage XL Thin is a Class III injectable medical-device from Bioformula s.r.l. (Italy) based on high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN) for professional use. Its core mechanism entails the stimulation of fibroblasts, support of collagen and extracellular-matrix regeneration, and hydration via polymerised DNA fragments derived from salmon sperm DNA, fully biocompatible and resorbable. Indicated for improving skin quality in delicate, thin, fragile or photo-aged zones (rather than for volumetric filling), Plenhyage XL Thin acts as a biorevitaliser/skin-booster to restore tone, elasticity and structure of the skin. What Plenhyage XL Thin Is Similar To Plenhyage XL Thin occupies the category of polynucleotide-based biostimulation injectables, akin to products such as Jalupro (which combine amino acids + PDRN) and the broader range of Plenhyage XL (Medium and Strong). For example, Jalupro offers skin-quality improvement by stimulating fibroblasts and ECM repair; similarly Plenhyage XL Thin focuses on cellular renewal using PDRN. The main difference lies in indication and concentration: while Jalupro may include peptides and amino acids, Plenhyage XL Thin is a dedicated high-molecular polynucleotide gel with very delicate skin indication [2]. Compared to its sibling formulations such as Plenhyage XL Medium (≈2 %) or Strong (≈2.5 %) [3], Thin employs a lower concentration better suited to fragile zones. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to marketing/manufacturer information: Face: delicate zones (thin skin) Periorbital area (around the eyes) Neck and décolletage Sensitive or fragile skin zones & post-treatment support (laser/peel) If strictly following the manufacturer IFU, the full list of indicated areas is: “face, neck and décolleté”. Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Injection depth: not provided by manufacturer for this specific “Thin” variant . Volume per point/injection site: not provided by manufacturer . Needle gauge: not provided by manufacturer . Frequency / number of sessions: Manufacturer states “multiple sessions are usually required; doctor to develop a personalised treatment plan.” Some professional sources note a recommended course of 2-4 sessions at 14-21 day intervals , followed by a maintenance session every 3-6 months. (This is not part of the official manufacturer IFU). Professional-use disclaimer: “Intended for professional medical use only” and “administered by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions”. Ingredient List Polynucleotides (PDRN), high molecular weight ~0.75 % for Thin variant. Sterile Water. Buffering Solution.Lidocaine: not provided by manufacturer . HA concentration: not applicable / not provided by manufacturer , as this is a polynucleotide-based product, not a hyaluronic acid filler. Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 pre-filled glass syringe of 2 mL with 2 disposable needles. Shelf life/storage: not provided by manufacturer in publicly accessible sources . Longevity/duration of effect: While the manufacturer states “duration varies depending on individual needs” some distributor information cites up to 4-6 months for Thin variant. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the device. Contraindicated at injection sites with active skin infection or inflammation. Use is not indicated for pregnant or breastfeeding women as per some sources. Use is for professional medical use only — improper use may increase risk of adverse events. Note: Since the manufacturer did not provide a full public IFU on injection depth or techniques, practitioners must adhere to local regulatory and best-practice guidelines for polynucleotide injections. Regulatory Status CE marked: Class III medical device, CE 0373. UKCA: not explicitly stated in the publicly available documentation; verify on product pack or with distributor . FDA: No US FDA 510(k) or PMA cleared status found in the publicly available documentation — verify with manufacturer or regulatory database. FAQ How does Plenhyage XL Thin work? Plenhyage XL Thin uses high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN), which stimulate fibroblast activity and extracellular-matrix regeneration, support hydration by binding water, and improve skin elasticity and texture [1]. The device thereby enhances the skin’s structural environment rather than volumising it. Is the treatment safe? Yes — as a Class III CE-marked device for professional use only, Plenhyage XL Thin has a documented safety profile for its intended use. Transient injection-site reactions (redness, swelling, bruising) may occur, as with any injectable device [1]. Proper patient selection (excluding active infection, hypersensitivity, pregnant/breastfeeding women) and aseptic technique are essential. What is the recommended treatment schedule? The manufacturer states that multiple sessions are required and a personalised plan should be developed by the clinician [1]. Some professional sources (not in the official IFU) indicate 2-4 sessions at 14-21 day intervals with maintenance at 3-6 months [4]. How long do results typically last? The official manufacturer information states that duration varies depending on skin condition and treatment area [1]. Distributor-listed information for Thin suggests results typically last 4-6 months [5]. Individual outcomes may differ. How does Plenhyage XL Thin compare to hyaluronic-acid fillers? Unlike traditional hyaluronic-acid dermal fillers, which primarily provide volume and structure, Plenhyage XL Thin is designed for skin-quality improvement via biostimulation rather than volumisation [2]. It is especially suited for thin, delicate skin zones where adding volume is not desirable. It should be selected based on indication rather than being considered a direct substitute for HA fillers.

description: Clinical Description Plenhyage XL Strong is a Class III CE-marked injectable medical device produced by Bioformula s.r.l. (Italy), formulated with 2.5% high-molecular-weight polynucleotides (PDRN) derived from salmon DNA. The mechanism centres on fibroblast activation, extracellular-matrix regeneration and enhanced dermal hydration via polynucleotide-mediated tissue renewal. The formulation is designed for treating more advanced signs of skin aging, photo-damage or fibrotic tissue changes, rather than volumetric augmentation. Suggested indications include skin laxity, loss of elasticity, fine lines and sun-damaged skin over face, neck, décolletage and body regions. What Plenhyage XL Strong Is Similar To Plenhyage XL Strong falls within the higher-concentration polynucleotide (PN) biostimulator category and can be compared with products like Jalupro Advanced (which combines amino acids + PDRN) and other PN-based skin boosters. While Jalupro offers a combined amino-acid/PDRN modality targeting moderate skin degradation, Plenhyage XL Strong provides a higher single-active PDRN concentration (2.5%) for more intensive regenerative support. Compared to its sister formulations — Plenhyage XL Medium (~2.0%) and Plenhyage XL Thin (~0.75%) — the Strong variant is suited to more pronounced skin aging or body applications. Short Marketing Description Nucleofill Strong Plus offers a professional-grade solution for aesthetic practitioners seeking to deeply regenerate, hydrate, and lift mature or aging skin. By delivering concentrated polynucleotides directly into the dermis, it supports long-term skin rejuvenation: improved elasticity, smoother texture, reduction in fine lines, and enhanced overall skin quality. Its biostimulatory action makes it ideal for clients who prefer subtle, natural-looking results over volumizing fillers. What Nucleofill Strong Plus Is Similar To Nucleofill Strong Plus can be compared with other polynucleotide-based or bio-stimulating skin boosters rather than traditional volume fillers. As always, treatment should be determined by a qualified aesthetic professional following patient assessment. Q5: Who is eligible to administer Nucleofill Strong Plus — and is it safe for self-use? A5: Nucleofill Strong Plus is intended for administration by licensed medical professionals experienced in injectable aesthetic treatments. It is not designed for self-injection or home use. The supplied documentation emphasizes that use is restricted to trained practitioners.
