description: Clinical Description Neauvia Organic Intense (1 x 1ml) is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed for deep tissue volumisation, contour restoration, and correction of moderate-to-severe facial wrinkles. The product is manufactured using PEG-crosslinked hyaluronic acid technology, which differs from traditional BDDE-crosslinked formulations and is intended to support high biocompatibility and gel stability. The formulation contains a high concentration of hyaluronic acid suspended in a hydrogel matrix intended for deep dermal or subcutaneous implantation by qualified medical professionals. Neauvia Organic Intense is commonly used for structural facial enhancement in areas requiring volumisation or contour support, including nasolabial folds, cheeks, jawline, chin, and facial depressions. The product belongs to the Neauvia® Organic range of injectable fillers and includes lidocaine to support injection comfort during aesthetic procedures. Its rheological profile is designed to provide projection, lift capacity, and tissue integration while maintaining flexibility within dynamic facial regions. What Neauvia Organic Intense Is Similar To Neauvia Organic Intense is comparable to other high-density hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for deep volumisation and contour support, including products such as Juvederm® Voluma and Restylane® Lyft. These fillers are all designed to restore facial structure and improve moderate-to-severe volume loss using stabilised hyaluronic acid technology. Compared with Juvederm® Voluma, which uses Vycross® cross-linking technology, Neauvia Organic Intense utilises PEG polymer cross-linking. PEG-crosslinking is promoted by the manufacturer as a highly biocompatible alternative to traditional chemical cross-linkers. Restylane® Lyft similarly targets facial contour restoration but differs in rheological behaviour and gel cohesivity due to its NASHA™ stabilisation process. Neauvia Organic Intense is generally positioned as a high-projection filler with strong lifting capacity suitable for deeper implantation techniques. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Neauvia Organic Intense is a hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed for deep facial volumisation, contour enhancement, and correction of moderate-to-severe wrinkles or folds. The filler uses PEG-crosslinked hyaluronic acid technology to create a stabilised gel intended for deep tissue implantation. Hyaluronic acid binds water molecules within the tissue while the gel structure provides mechanical support and volumisation. The formulation also contains lidocaine to support injection comfort during treatment procedures. Is Neauvia Organic Intense different from standard HA fillers? Yes. How does Neauvia Organic Intense compare with Juvederm® or Restylane® fillers? Neauvia Organic Intense is similar to high-density volumising fillers such as Juvederm® Voluma and Restylane® Lyft because all are intended for contour restoration and structural augmentation. The primary distinction is the PEG-crosslinking technology used in Neauvia products, which differs from Vycross® and NASHA™ stabilisation methods used by other brands.

description: The Luminescens Kit 2 Vials 1 Cream is an exceptional solution designed specifically to combat pigmentation issues and reduce the appearance of blemishes. It combines cutting-edge mesotherapy technology with advanced aftercare to target uneven skin tone and hyperpigmentation effectively. This product is for the specialized treatment of melasma and pigmentation. The two mesotherapy vials are infused with a potent blend of biomimetic peptides, tranexamic acid, hyaluronic acid, and antioxidants that work synergistically to regulate melanin production, lighten dark spots, and restore the skin’s natural radiance. By targeting pigmentation at its source, the vials provide a visible reduction in discoloration while improving overall skin texture and tone. The accompanying professional-grade cream further enhances these effects by delivering nourishing hydration and soothing properties post-treatment. Enriched with vitamins and antioxidants, the cream helps maintain the results of the mesotherapy treatment, while preventing new pigmentation issues by shielding the skin from environmental stressors. This all-in-one kit is ideal for aesthetic clinics looking to offer their clients an effective treatment for pigmentation concerns. It not only addresses existing issues but also promotes long-term skin clarity and evenness, ensuring visible and lasting results. Treatment Areas: Face Neck Décolleté Hands Usage: Mesotherapy Vials: Apply the contents of each vial using microneedling, mesotherapy devices . Recommended for professional use only. Follow specific clinic protocols for application. Aftercare Cream: Use post-treatment to soothe and hydrate the skin. Apply a thin layer twice daily for optimal results. Ingredient List: Mesotherapy Vials: Biomimetic Peptides: Stimulate collagen production and skin regeneration. Hyaluronic Acid: Provides intense hydration and elasticity. Antioxidants: Neutralize free radicals and protect skin cells. Aftercare Cream: Vitamins: Aid in skin repair and nourishment. Antioxidants: Protect against environmental damage. Soothing Agents: Reduce redness and irritation post-treatment. The cream provides ongoing hydration and pigmentation control and support between treatments.

description: Lumi‑Pro Lips – Lip Booster – 1 x 1.1ml Lumi‑Pro Lips – Lip Booster – 1 x 1.1ml is an innovative injectable lip skin booster formulated with pure non‑cross‑linked hyaluronic acid to promote intense hydration, smoothness, and a subtly fuller appearance in the lip tissue. Unlike traditional volumising fillers, Lumi‑Pro Lips enhances lip texture and hydration while delivering natural‑looking shape improvement. Its gentle formulation integrates into the delicate lip tissue to support moisture retention and soft enhancement. What Lumi‑Pro Lips Is Similar To Lumi‑Pro Lips can be regarded alongside other lip skin boosters or hydration‑focused injectable treatments that improve lip quality without significant volumisation. While traditional dermal fillers add structural volume through cross‑linked hyaluronic acid gels, lip boosters such as Lumi‑Pro Lips use non‑cross‑linked HA to elevate hydration and smoothness while providing a soft plumping effect. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability with volumising fillers. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Lumi‑Pro Lips is indicated for: Treatment areas: Lips (vermilion body and borders) Perioral texture and superficial lip creases → Lumi‑Pro Lips is designed to improve lip hydration, smoothness, and subtle contour definition in clients seeking refreshed, natural‑looking lips without bulky volume. Usage / Administration (IFU‑only) Injection depth: Superficial to mid‑dermal layer of the lip mucosa and borders. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer; practitioners use small aliquots via micro‑droplet or linear threading techniques based on clinical assessment. Needle gauge: Directed by practitioner preference and anatomy; typically fine‑gauge needles for delicate lip tissue. Frequency / number of sessions: Initial course may consist of 1–2 sessions spaced 2–4 weeks apart; maintenance intervals can be determined clinically. Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals only under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List (Lumi Pro Lips Ingredients) Hyaluronic acid (non‑cross‑linked): ~22 mg per 1.1 ml syringe — hydrophilic HA provides moisture binding and soft tissue smoothness. Other excipients: Saline buffer and stabilisers consistent with IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1.1 ml pre‑filled sterile syringe designed for lip skin boosting. Shelf‑life: Refer to individual packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Clinical experience suggests results may be visible immediately with improved hydration and texture, with effects often lasting several months depending on patient metabolism, technique, and aftercare; multiple sessions can enhance longevity. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or formulation excipients. Avoid injection into areas of active infection, inflammation, or compromised lip tissue until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly. Single‑use syringe; do not reuse. Strict aseptic technique and deep anatomical knowledge are essential to minimise complications. Regulatory Status Lumi‑Pro Lips is CE‑marked as a medical device or injectable skin booster in applicable regions. Regulatory classification and approved indications may vary by country; practitioners should verify local compliance and IFU details via official documentation before use. FAQ 1. How does Lumi‑Pro Lips work in the lip tissue? Lumi‑Pro Lips uses non‑cross‑linked hyaluronic acid that integrates within the superficial to mid‑dermal layer of the lips, drawing water to the tissue to improve hydration, smoothness, and subtle plumping without significant volumisation. 2. Is Lumi‑Pro Lips the same as a traditional lip filler? No. Lumi‑Pro Lips functions as a lip booster with non‑cross‑linked HA that enhances hydration and soft shape, whereas traditional lip fillers use cross‑linked HA to provide deep structural volume and augmentation. 3. What is the typical treatment protocol and how long do the results last? Treatment may involve 1–2 sessions spaced 2–4 weeks apart. Results such as improved hydration and subtle fullness are often visible immediately, with effects commonly lasting several months depending on individual factors and aftercare. 4. Can Lumi‑Pro Lips be combined with other fillers? Yes. Lumi‑Pro Lips can be incorporated into comprehensive lip enhancement protocols and is compatible with other dermal filler brands for patients seeking combined hydration and volumising results. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Practitioners should strictly adhere to aseptic technique, assess patient medical history, and avoid areas with active infection. Detailed anatomical knowledge of lip vasculature is essential to minimise risk.

short_description: LUMI-PN EYES is a high-purity PDRN eye booster designed for delicate under-eye rejuvenation. With 30 mg of ultra-pure polynucleotides in a 1.5 ml syringe, it aims to revitalise periocular skin, improve texture, enhance radiance, and support collagen synthesis. Ideal for clinics seeking a gentle yet effective regenerative solution for under-eye dark circles, fine lines, puffiness, or skin dullness offering a subtle, non-volumising approach for clients seeking refreshed, healthier-looking eyes.
description: LUMI-PN EYES is a polynucleotide (PDRN) based skin booster formulated for periocular (under-eye and eye-area) use. Its active component is ultra-pure PDRN at approximately 20 mg/ml, delivering a total of 30 mg PDRN per 1.5 ml syringe, aimed at supporting tissue regeneration in delicate skin zones.¹²³ Rather than functioning as a volumising dermal filler, LUMI-PN EYES works via a regenerative mechanism: PDRN fragments are proposed to stimulate dermal repair, support fibroblast activity, and promote extracellular matrix remodelling potentially improving skin tone, elasticity, hydration, and reducing signs of fatigue or dark circles around the eyes.¹²⁴ What LUMI-PN EYES Is Similar To LUMI-PN EYES belongs to the class of polynucleotide-based skin boosters rather than traditional hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers. As such, it more closely resembles treatments aimed at skin quality improvement — similar in intent to products like Profhilo (skin-hydrating HA booster) or other PDRN/PN skin-boosters used for skin rejuvenation and texture improvement rather than volumising. Compared to HA fillers — which provide structural volume, contouring, and tissue expansion — LUMI-PN EYES targets tissue regeneration, hydration, and barrier repair without significant volume addition. Its effect profile is oriented toward skin restorative benefits. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Under-eye and periocular region (delicate eye skin)¹²⁵ According to some distributors, treatment may be restricted to under-eye / eye area; broader face/neck use is not specified for this product.¹²³ Usage / Administration (IFU-only section) Injection / application method: According to several UK-supplier descriptions, LUMI-PN EYES is designated for “microneedling / mesotherapy / skin booster” use — not standard deep-injection filler placement.³⁴ Injection depth: As per one training document for PDRN boosters, mesotherapy injections are typically delivered at ~4 mm depth.⁵ Needle gauge, volume per point, session frequency: Not provided by manufacturer in any publicly accessible documentation. Professional-use disclaimer: Intended for use by qualified aesthetic practitioners. Several retailers explicitly state use is restricted to trained professionals.¹²⁴ Some clinics or practitioners may opt for very superficial serial puncture or microneedling-assisted delivery for periocular boosters; this is not part of the verified public IFU for LUMI-PN EYES. Ingredient List Polynucleotide (PDRN) 20 mg/ml (total 30 mg per 1.5 ml)¹²³ Water (Aqua) solvent / base (implicit in skin booster solutions)⁴ Buffer salts / supporting excipients (e.g. sodium salts, stabilisers) — not specified by manufacturer No hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or cross-linked gel matrix is declared in publicly available composition data.¹²³ Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1.5 ml sterile syringe.¹²³ Shelf life / expiry: Not provided by manufacturer in any public listing. Expected duration of effect: As a regenerative skin booster, LUMI-PN EYES does not provide a fixed volumising effect; the duration depends on the skin’s regeneration response and individual factors. No explicit longevity claim is provided in documentation. Safety Notes / Contraindications Publicly available product pages do not present a complete IFU-based list of contraindications or warnings for LUMI-PN EYES. Based on standard clinical caution for skin-booster or mesotherapy treatments: Should be administered only by qualified professionals under aseptic conditions.¹²⁴ Use is contraindicated in patients with active skin infections, inflammation, open wounds, or compromised skin integrity at the treatment site. Hypersensitivity or allergy to any ingredient (e.g. PDRN, excipients) may contraindicate use. Injection or microneedling in periocular area carries theoretical risks; practitioners must ensure knowledge of local vascular and anatomical structures. Regulatory Status Public UK distributor pages for LUMI-PN EYES do not clearly state CE-marking or UKCA certification.¹²³⁴ Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on the product pack or official IFU before use or marketing. FAQ Q1: What is PDRN and how does LUMI-PN EYES work? A1: PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) comprises purified DNA fragments (often from salmon-derived sources) that, when delivered into skin tissue, may stimulate cell repair, promote fibroblast activity, and enhance extracellular matrix remodelling potentially improving collagen synthesis, skin elasticity, hydration and overall skin quality.⁵ LUMI-PN EYES delivers 30 mg of ultra-pure PDRN in a 1.5 ml syringe, aiming to rejuvenate the delicate under-eye skin rather than add volume.¹²³ Q2: Does LUMI-PN EYES act like a traditional dermal filler and add volume? A2: No — LUMI-PN EYES is not a volumising HA filler. It lacks cross-linked hyaluronic acid or gel carriers; its base is a PDRN aqueous solution, designed for tissue regeneration and skin quality improvement, not structural volume augmentation.¹²³ Therefore, it should not be used where volume or contour correction is desired. Q3: For which areas is LUMI-PN EYES indicated? A3: According to supplier documentation, LUMI-PN EYES is intended for the under-eye and periocular region.¹²³ There is no public indication for its use on other facial zones such as cheeks, cheeks, lips, or chin. Use outside the recommended area is not supported by available information. Q4: What is the recommended method of administration for LUMI-PN EYES? A4: Public listings describe LUMI-PN EYES as a skin-booster for microneedling or mesotherapy rather than a classical injectable filler.³⁴ One training source suggests mesotherapy injections at ~4 mm depth.⁵ However, no detailed IFU is publicly available specifying needle gauge, injection points, volume per site, or session frequency. Therefore, practitioners must rely on official IFU or distributor instructions before using the product. Q5: Are the effects and safety of LUMI-PN EYES verified by clinical studies? A5: As of publicly available information, I found no peer-reviewed clinical studies specifically referencing LUMI-PN EYES. The theoretical mechanism (PDRN-mediated regeneration) draws from general literature on polynucleotides or skin-booster therapies, but evidence for efficacy and long-term safety of this exact product is lacking in the accessible scientific literature. Clinicians should inform patients accordingly and monitor outcomes.

description: Clinical Description LUMI-PN FACE is a polynucleotide (PDRN) skin-booster product, formulated with ultra-pure polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) at a concentration of 20 mg/ml, delivering a total of 50 mg per 2.5 ml syringe. Rather than acting as a volumising filler, its mechanism is regenerative: PDRN fragments are claimed to support skin tissue repair, stimulate fibroblast activity, promote extracellular matrix remodelling, and improve skin hydration, tone, elasticity and overall skin quality. The formulation targets skin rejuvenation rather than structural volume augmentation, making it suitable for skin that is dull, dehydrated, thin, or showing early signs of ageing. What LUMI-PN FACE Is Similar To LUMI-PN FACE belongs to the class of regenerative skin boosters (like polynucleotide or PDRN boosters) rather than traditional hyaluronic acid (HA) fillers. For orientation, it is similar in purpose to treatments such as Profhilo — which aim to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and quality rather than volumising — although Profhilo uses high-concentration HA rather than PDRN. Unlike HA fillers (which add volume and define contours), LUMI-PN FACE focuses on skin regeneration, collagen/elastin support and improving skin texture and tone. Compared with simpler mesotherapy or superficial boosters (vitamins, low-dose HA), LUMI-PN FACE provides a higher polynucleotide load per treatment, targeting deeper regenerative effects. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. A1: PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) are fragments of DNA derived from purified sources; when applied to the skin (via injection or mesotherapy), they are believed to support cellular repair, stimulate fibroblast activity, and encourage extracellular matrix regeneration. description: Lanluma X 1x40ml – High-Volume PLLA Biostimulator of 630 mg of PLLA mgLanluma X 1x40ml is a professional injectable poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulator suspension designed to address moderate to advanced volume loss, tissue laxity, and age-related structural deficiency across large treatment areas such as the face and body. The product consists of a 40 ml sterile vial of PLLA powder that must be reconstituted prior to administration. Consequently, once injected, Lanluma X stimulates collagen production and dermal renewal, providing gradual and natural-looking volume restoration with extended durability. This product contains 630mg of PLLA built for deep subcutaneous injection in large body areas. Lanluma X differs from traditional hyaluronic acid fillers, which provide immediate volume through gel implantation. Instead, it promotes neocollagenesis and tissue remodelling , leading to sustained improvements in skin structure and volume over a series of treatments — a critical distinction for practitioners planning long-term aesthetic outcomes. What Lanluma X Is Similar To Lanluma X belongs to the family of biostimulatory injectables focused on inducing collagen synthesis. It is clinically comparable to PLLA biostimulators such as Sculptra® in its mechanism of action, which does not rely on gel deposition but on stimulating the body’s own fibroblasts to regenerate collagen. While HA volumisers address fine lines and superficial volume loss, Lanluma X targets deeper structural rejuvenation and volumetric deficiency . This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer and distributor documentation, Lanluma X 1x40ml with 630mg of PLLA is indicated for: Treatment areas: Body areas with significant volume depletion (e.g., arms, abdomen, buttocks) Structural enhancement in age-related soft tissue descent → Lanluma X is ideal for patients with moderate to severe volume loss or those seeking long-lasting collagen stimulation and tissue support beyond what conventional fillers can achieve. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subcutaneous, depending on anatomy and target volume. Product preparation: Reconstitution with sterile water for injection according to official protocol; adequate mixing and hydration are essential for optimal distribution. Injection technique: Administered via cannula or needle in fanned, cross-hatching patterns to cover broad areas of deficit. Frequency / number of sessions: Treatment typically involves multiple sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart , with practitioner assessment guiding the number of treatments. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by trained and qualified medical or aesthetic professionals with expertise in collagen biostimulation and large-volume injections. The product does not contain lidocaine. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 40 ml vial requiring reconstitution. Shelf-life: Refer to product packaging and IFU for expiry details. Longevity (treatment duration): Results develop progressively over weeks as collagen synthesis occurs. Clinical outcomes may last 18–24 months or longer , depending on patient variables, injection technique, and treatment plan. Lanluma X price varies by region, supplier, and clinic pricing strategy; practitioners should consult authorised distributors for current pricing. Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to PLLA or any excipient. Avoid use in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised tissue. Do not inject intravascularly. Single-use product; do not reuse. Strict aseptic technique and advanced anatomical understanding are required for large-volume biostimulatory injections. Regulatory Status Lanluma X is CE-marked as a medical device where applicable. Regulatory classification, approved indications, and usage protocols may vary by jurisdiction; practitioners should verify local compliance via the official IFU or authorised distributor documentation. FAQ 1. What is Lanluma? Lanluma refers to a class of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulators designed to stimulate the body’s own collagen production for gradual volumisation and tissue support. Lanluma products differ from traditional fillers because they induce neocollagenesis rather than depositing gel to add immediate volume. 2. How does Lanluma X work in the skin? Lanluma X is reconstituted and injected into deep dermal or subcutaneous tissue, where the PLLA particles act as a scaffold that promotes fibroblast activation and new collagen formation over time. This leads to progressive improvement in volume, firmness, and skin architecture . 3. Is Lanluma X the same as a dermal filler? No. While dermal fillers such as HA gels provide immediate volume, Lanluma X works through biostimulation , leading to gradual, long-lasting structural improvements rather than instant physical augmentation. 4. Results emerge gradually over several weeks to months and are often reported to last 18–24 months or longer. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Practitioners must use strict aseptic technique , detailed anatomical understanding, careful reconstitution, and appropriate injection patterns. Avoid areas of active infection or compromised tissue and monitor for typical post-treatment responses (e.g., mild swelling, tenderness).

description: Saypha Filler Without Lidocaine – Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Volume and Contour Correction Saypha® Filler Without Lidocaine is a sterile, injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler manufactured by Croma Pharma , designed for the correction of moderate to deep facial wrinkles, folds, and for soft-tissue augmentation. The product contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid of non-animal origin and is supplied without lidocaine , making it suitable for patients with sensitivities to local anaesthetics or for practitioners who prefer separate anaesthesia protocols. description: Clinical Description PhilArt Eye (also marketed in some regions as PolyPhil Eye) is a polynucleotide-based injectable medical-aesthetic treatment specifically developed for the delicate periorbital area. Manufactured by Croma Pharma, the product belongs to the PhilArt regenerative medicine range and is designed to support tissue quality, hydration, and skin revitalisation around the eyes through the biological activity of highly purified polynucleotides (PN). Polynucleotides are purified DNA-derived molecules that have demonstrated hydrating and tissue-supportive properties within regenerative aesthetic medicine. Their mechanism is associated with water-binding capacity, extracellular matrix support, and the promotion of a favourable environment for tissue repair processes. PhilArt Eye is intended for professional use in patients presenting with signs of periocular ageing, reduced skin elasticity, skin quality concerns, and age-related changes affecting the eye contour area. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, PhilArt Eye is primarily classified as a regenerative biostimulator focused on tissue quality improvement rather than volume augmentation. What PhilArt Eye Is Similar To PhilArt Eye belongs to the expanding category of regenerative polynucleotide injectables designed for delicate facial areas. It is frequently compared with products such as Nucleofill Eyes (Nucleofill Soft Plus) and Plinest Eye because all utilise purified polynucleotide technology for tissue support and skin-quality improvement. Like Nucleofill Eyes, PhilArt Eye is intended to address skin quality concerns around the eyes through regenerative mechanisms rather than volume replacement. Both products are commonly used within aesthetic protocols focused on improving periocular tissue quality and hydration. Compared with hyaluronic acid dermal fillers used for tear trough correction, PhilArt Eye serves a different clinical purpose. Whereas HA fillers primarily provide structural support and volume, PhilArt Eye focuses on tissue revitalisation and regenerative support. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: Belotero Lip Contour with Lidocaine Lip Filler 1×0.6 mL Belotero® Lip Contour with Lidocaine is an injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) lip filler medical device developed by Merz Aesthetics for the definition, refinement, and contouring of the lips . description: Belotero Balance with Lidocaine Dermal Filler for Moderate Wrinkle Correction Belotero Balance with Lidocaine is a resorbable hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler formulated for the correction of moderate facial wrinkles and folds. It is composed of non-animal, cross-linked hyaluronic acid combined with lidocaine hydrochloride to enhance patient comfort during injection. The filler is manufactured using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology, which supports smooth integration within the superficial to mid-dermal layers while maintaining tissue elasticity and natural facial movement. The product is indicated for the treatment of moderate facial wrinkles where balanced correction, flexibility, and uniform tissue distribution are required. Its rheological profile is designed to provide effective wrinkle smoothing while minimising palpability or irregular texture. Belotero Balance with Lidocaine is biodegradable and gradually resorbed through physiological metabolic processes. It is intended exclusively for professional aesthetic use by trained medical practitioners under aseptic conditions. What Belotero Balance with Lidocaine Is Similar To Belotero Balance with Lidocaine can be compared to other hyaluronic acid dermal fillers intended for moderate wrinkle correction, such as Juvederm® Ultra or Restylane® Refyne . These products are designed to address deeper lines than superficial fillers while preserving natural facial expression. Within the Belotero range, Belotero Soft is positioned for very superficial fine lines, whereas Belotero Balance is formulated for more pronounced wrinkles requiring additional structural support. Juvederm® Ultra and Restylane® Refyne use alternative cross-linking technologies, resulting in different gel cohesivity and elasticity profiles. Compared with these, Belotero Balance prioritises homogeneous dermal integration and adaptability to dynamic facial areas. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Belotero Balance with Lidocaine is indicated for the correction of moderate facial wrinkles and folds. While it provides structural support for moderate lines and folds, it is not intended for deep contouring or facial volume restoration. 3. Longevity may vary depending on patient metabolism, treatment area, injection depth, and individual skin characteristics. 4. Can Belotero Balance with Lidocaine be used for superficial fine lines? description: Lip Filler Belotero® Lips Shape with Lidocaine 1×0.6 mL Belotero Lips Shape with Lidocaine is a hyaluronic acid (HA) lip filler developed by Merz Aesthetics for lip enhancement, shape definition, and contour improvement . Formulated using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology , this filler integrates smoothly into lip tissue, allowing precise shaping while maintaining softness and natural movement. This product is specifically designed for patients seeking enhanced lip shape and projection , rather than simple volume alone. The inclusion of lidocaine (0.3%) helps improve treatment comfort during injection, making it a popular choice among practitioners for aesthetic lip procedures. Belotero Lips Shape is intended for use by trained medical professionals only. What Belotero Lips Shape Is Used For Belotero Lips Shape is indicated for: Defining lip shape and borders Enhancing lip projection Improving lip symmetry Refining the cupid’s bow Supporting lip contour without over-volumisation It is commonly combined with Belotero Lips Contour in full lip treatments, where Shape enhances structure and projection while contour products refine borders. This complementary approach is often referred to clinically as Belotero lips shape and contour . How Belotero Lips Shape Works Thanks to CPM® technology, Belotero Lips Shape distributes evenly within the lip tissue, reducing the risk of lumpiness while providing controlled shaping. The gel’s elasticity allows lips to remain soft and flexible, supporting natural facial expressions. This makes Belotero a preferred lip filler option for patients who want definition and refinement rather than a heavy or rigid appearance. Treatment Areas / Indications Upper and lower lips Cupid’s bow Vermilion body Lip projection zones Lip shape refinement Injection technique and treatment planning should always be tailored to the patient’s anatomy and aesthetic goals by a qualified practitioner. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Mucosal or submucosal layer of the lips Needle: Supplied sterile needle suitable for lip injection Volume: 0.6 mL pre-filled syringe Anaesthetic: Lidocaine 0.3% Professional use: For trained medical practitioners only If specific parameters are not listed in official IFU documentation, they are noted as not provided by manufacturer . Ingredient List Cross-linked hyaluronic acid Lidocaine hydrochloride 0.3% Physiological buffer solution Belotero fillers are produced using non-animal-derived hyaluronic acid . Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 0.6 mL sterile pre-filled syringe Packaging: Single-use syringe with traceability labels Longevity: Results are visible immediately and typically last up to 6–9 months , depending on injection technique, metabolism, and lifestyle factors Safety Notes / Contraindications Do not use in patients with hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or lidocaine Avoid treatment in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised tissue Intravascular injection must be avoided Only to be administered by trained and qualified medical professionals Always consult the official Instructions for Use for full safety information. Regulatory Status Belotero Lips Shape with Lidocaine is a CE-marked medical device approved for aesthetic use within the European Union. Regulatory status may vary by region. FAQ 1. What is Belotero Lips Shape? Belotero Lips Shape is a hyaluronic acid lip filler designed to enhance lip shape, projection, and definition while maintaining softness and natural movement. 2. Is Belotero a good lip filler? Yes. Belotero is widely used in aesthetic medicine and is known for its smooth integration, natural results, and flexibility in dynamic areas like the lips. 3. Does Belotero Lips Shape contain lidocaine? Yes. This version contains 0.3% lidocaine to improve comfort during treatment. 4. How long do Belotero lip filler results last? Results typically last 6–9 months , though individual outcomes vary depending on metabolism and treatment technique. 5. Can Belotero Lips Shape be combined with other fillers? Yes. It is often combined with Belotero Lips Contour for comprehensive lip shape and border definition.

short_description: Bellast Prime Hard with Lidocaine is a premium-grade, high-density HA filler engineered for structural facial enhancement. Its viscous HA gel delivers reliable volumising and shaping ideal for deeper folds, cheeks, chin, or jawline while 0.3% lidocaine helps improve patient comfort during injection. With immediate visible results and excellent volume retention, this CE-marked filler offers professional practitioners a cost-effective solution for effective facial contouring and deeper wrinkle correction.
description: Bellast Prime Hard is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler from the Bellast Prime range by Fox Pharma. It is formulated with a high-density cross-linked HA (24 mg/ml) and 0.3% lidocaine, creating a viscous gel with uniform particles designed for deep dermal injection. The high viscoelasticity and gel density of Bellast Prime Hard provide structural support and volumising effect, restoring lost facial volume and contour. The filler is bio-absorbable, gradually metabolised by endogenous hyaluronidases over time. Indications include correction of deeper wrinkles/folds and facial contouring in areas requiring significant volume or definition (e.g., nasolabial folds, cheeks, chin, jaw). What Bellast Prime Hard Is Similar To Bellast Prime Hard can be compared to other high-density HA fillers used for deep dermal or subdermal augmentation, such as Restylane® (or other thicker HA fillers designed for cheeks, chin, or nasolabial folds). Like Restylane and similar fillers, Bellast Prime Hard uses cross-linked HA to provide structural support, volume restoration, and skin contouring. The 24 mg/ml HA concentration and robust viscoelastic gel of Bellast Prime Hard offer volume retention and support comparable to well-established deep fillers. However, differences may arise in gel rheology, particle size, and clinical handling — potentially affecting gel integration, mouldability, and longevity. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Nasolabial folds Cheeks (malar area) Chin Jaw / jawline contouring Usage / Administration (IFU-based) Delivery form: 1 × 1 ml prefilled syringe. Needles included: 25G and 27G sterile needles. Injection depth: as per manufacturer, “deep dermis” for Bellast Prime Hard. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer. Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Note: If a practitioner uses different techniques (e.g., cannula, layering, micro-bolus), these are not part of the official manufacturer’s IFU. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid, cross-linked — 24 mg/mL Lidocaine — 0.3% Excipients / buffer / carrier gel: not specified in public documentation Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1.0 ml prefilled syringe (ergonomic design) with 1 × 25G needle and 1 × 27G needle included Shelf-life or expiry: not provided by manufacturer (publicly available). Expected duration of clinical effect: between 6 and 12 months after injection. Safety Notes / Contraindications According to the manufacturer: Do not use in patients with bleeding disorders or those on medication affecting platelet function. Not to be resterilised or mixed with other products before injection. Not recommended for patients prone to keloid formation or with active inflammation / infection at the injection site. Contraindicated in individuals with known lidocaine allergy. Not advised in pregnancy or breastfeeding. Standard caution (if not otherwise specified): Additional contraindications may include active skin infections, autoimmune or immunosuppressive conditions, and recent dental/dermal procedures; full medical history and consultation required prior to treatment. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device. UKCA status not explicitly stated — verify via IFU or distributor at time of purchase. FAQ Q1: What makes Bellast Prime Hard different from other HA fillers? A1: Bellast Prime Hard combines a high concentration of cross-linked HA (24 mg/ml) with a viscous, high-density gel formulation — resulting in increased viscoelasticity and structural support. This makes it especially suitable for deep dermal injection to restore volume, contour cheeks/chin/jaw, and correct deep folds. Q2: How long will the results of Bellast Prime Hard last? A2: According to the manufacturer, visible aesthetic results can last between 6 and 12 months. However, longevity can vary depending on factors such as injection technique, patient metabolism, lifestyle, and treatment area. Q3: Is the injection of Bellast Prime Hard painful? A3: The filler contains 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, which helps reduce discomfort during injection.As with all dermal filler procedures, patients may still experience some mild stinging or pressure, but overall pain is generally minimised. Q4: Can Bellast Prime Hard filler be reversed when needed? A4: Since Bellast Prime Hard is HA-based, like other HA dermal fillers, it is biocompatible and bio-absorbable. In most clinical practice, HA fillers can be dissolved using hyaluronidase if required (though the manufacturer’s IFU should be consulted for compatibility). Q5: What are the main risks or complications associated with HA fillers like Bellast Prime Hard? A5: Common mild adverse effects include swelling, bruising, redness, tenderness, or lumps immediately after injection.In rare cases, more serious complications such as vascular occlusion (which may lead to skin necrosis or, very rarely, vision loss) have been reported especially in high-risk injection zones or with improper technique. It is critical that injections are performed by trained medical professionals with full knowledge of facial anatomy and safety protocols.

page_title: Bellast Prime Soft with Lidocaine (1 x 1ml)
short_description: Bellast Prime Soft with Lidocaine offers practitioners a soft, easy-to-handle filler that restores gentle volume and smoothness, especially in delicate facial regions. With 24 mg/mL HA and integrated 0.3% lidocaine, it provides comfortable injections and immediate, natural-looking results. Its lightweight gel consistency makes it ideal for treating fine lines and superficial wrinkles while maintaining skin softness and elasticity.
description: Bellast Prime Soft with Lidocaine is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler belonging to the Bellast Prime range from Fox Pharma. It is formulated with 24 mg/mL high-density HA and 0.3% lidocaine, yielding a lightweight, low-viscosity gel.The filler is designed for superficial injection into the upper dermis, making it suitable for fine lines, superficial wrinkles, and delicate facial areas where subtle volume restoration and smoothing are required. What Bellast Prime Soft Is Similar To Bellast Prime Soft resembles other light or fine-texture HA fillers used for fine lines and surface-level correction — for example, the well-known Profhilo (though Profhilo is more of a skin-bio-remodelling product rather than a volumising filler) or softer variants of classical HA fillers. Like those, Bellast Prime Soft works via HA’s hydrophilic and volumising properties to draw in water and plump the dermal tissue. However, while Profhilo focuses on skin hydration and biorevitalisation, Bellast Prime Soft is formulated for superficial wrinkle smoothing and subtle volume restoration. Compared to thicker fillers used for deep folds or structural contouring (e.g., mid to deep-dermal fillers), Bellast Prime Soft is more delicate, easier to layer, and designed for minimal invasiveness. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Periorbital area (e.g., around eyes) Superficial lines and fine facial wrinkles Tear-trough area (only when injected by fully trained and insured practitioners) Usage / Administration (IFU-based) Injection depth: Upper dermis / superficial dermis. Needle gauge & contents: Syringe plus 2 sterile 30G needles included in the box. Volume per syringe: 1 × 1 ml. Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: To be administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. (Implicit in product being sold to clinics / practitioners only.) Note: No further injection-pattern, layering, or frequency guidance is provided in publicly available manufacturer data. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid — 24 mg/mL (high-density, cross-linked) Lidocaine — 0.3% (local anesthetic incorporated for injection comfort) Other excipients / stabilisers / buffers — not provided by manufacturer Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1 ml pre-filled syringe, supplied with 2 sterile 30G needles. Longevity / duration of effect: manufacturer indicates results typically last 6–12 months . Shelf life / storage instructions: not provided by manufacturer in public listing Safety Notes / Contraindications According to the manufacturer: Should not be used in patients with bleeding disorders. Not to be re-sterilised. Do not mix with other products before injection. Not recommended for patients prone to keloid formation. Contraindicated where there is inflammation, infection, or any active skin disease at or near the injection site. Not for use in patients with known lidocaine allergy. Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. If manufacturer IFU is unavailable or does not detail other contraindications: standard caution applies — avoid in patients with hypersensitivity to components, active skin infections, or systemic conditions affecting wound healing. FAQ Q1: How does Bellast Prime Soft improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles? A1: Bellast Prime Soft uses high-density hyaluronic acid (24 mg/mL) which, when injected into the superficial dermis, attracts and binds water molecules. This increases dermal volume and provides structural support beneath fine lines and superficial wrinkles, thereby smoothing the skin surface and reducing wrinkle depth. The gel also adds immediate physical support and hydration to the tissue. Q2: Is the injection painful for patients? A2: The filler includes 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, to reduce discomfort during injection. This helps make the procedure more comfortable compared to filler without anaesthetic. Q3: How long do results from Bellast Prime Soft typically last? A3: According to the manufacturer, visible effects generally persist between 6 to 12 months post-treatment, depending on individual patient factors such as skin type, lifestyle, and treatment area. Q4: Can Bellast Prime Soft be used in the tear-trough (under-eye) area? A4: Yes — the manufacturer lists “tear trough” among the possible treatment areas. However, it is specified that injections in this delicate area must only be carried out by fully trained and insured practitioners. Q5: Is Bellast Prime Soft interchangeable with thicker fillers for deeper folds or volume restoration? A5: No — Bellast Prime Soft is formulated as a lightweight, low-viscosity filler for superficial dermal injection, fine lines, and delicate areas. Thicker fillers with higher viscosity and deeper injection depth (e.g., those designed for mid- to deep-dermis or subcutaneous tissue) are better suited for significant volume restoration, deep folds, or structural facial contouring. Therefore, Bellast Prime Soft should not be used interchangeably with heavier fillers for deep volumisation.

description: Alidya 5×10 is a CE-marked injectable medical device developed by Marllor Biomedical for the prevention and treatment of gynoid lipodystrophy, commonly known as cellulite. Unlike traditional fat-dissolving products, Alidya is designed to address several physiological factors associated with cellulite, including extracellular matrix imbalance, tissue oxygenation, microcirculation dysfunction, and oxidative stress. The formulation consists of a polyamino acid complex supplied as a powder for reconstitution with a dedicated solvent. According to manufacturer and distributor information, Alidya aims to restore normal adipocyte homeostasis and improve the appearance of cellulite-related skin irregularities such as orange-peel texture and tissue dimpling. It is commonly used as part of mesotherapy-based cellulite management protocols for areas including the thighs, buttocks, abdomen, hips, and knees. Clinical protocols generally focus on improving skin texture and tissue quality rather than producing significant fat reduction. What Alidya 5×10 Is Similar To Alidya belongs to the category of injectable anti-cellulite and mesotherapy treatments. It is often compared with products such as Celluform®, Sunekos Cell®, and other mesotherapy formulations used for cellulite management and skin quality improvement. Unlike deoxycholic acid-based fat dissolvers that primarily target adipocyte destruction, Alidya focuses on restoring extracellular tissue balance and supporting microcirculation. This distinction makes it more suitable for cellulite treatment rather than localized fat reduction. Compared with regenerative mesotherapy products that primarily stimulate collagen production, Alidya specifically targets factors associated with cellulite development, including tissue oxygenation, extracellular matrix alterations, and adipose tissue homeostasis. Treatment goals are therefore generally focused on improving skin smoothness and reducing visible cellulite irregularities rather than body contouring alone. description: Radiesse® with Lidocaine – Lifting & Volume 1 × 1.5 mL Radiesse® with Lidocaine is an injectable dermal filler medical device composed of calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres suspended in an aqueous gel carrier , developed for facial volume restoration, contour enhancement, and structural support . Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers, Radiesse filler works through both immediate volumisation and longer-term collagen stimulation. The inclusion of lidocaine improves patient comfort during injection. The CaHA microspheres provide an immediate lifting effect while gradually stimulating the body’s own collagen production as the gel carrier is resorbed. Radiesse Lifting & Volume 1 × 1.5 mL is indicated for treatment of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds, as well as contouring in areas requiring firm structural support. What Radiesse® Is Similar To Radiesse can be regarded alongside other biostimulatory dermal fillers that provide both volumising and collagen-stimulating effects. Unlike traditional hyaluronic acid fillers that rely solely on gel volume, Radiesse combines mechanical lift with neocollagenesis over time. Compared with HA fillers used for softer contouring, Radiesse with Lido offers firmer structural support and may be selected for areas requiring stronger projection and durability. However, due to its different composition and mechanism of action, it is not directly interchangeable with hyaluronic acid fillers. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Radiesse treatment is indicated for correction of moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds and for restoration of facial volume. Treatment areas may include: Nasolabial folds • Marionette lines • Cheeks • Chin • Jawline • Facial contours • Hands → Radiesse is typically selected for areas requiring structural support rather than superficial fine-line correction. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subdermal or supraperiosteal plane, depending on indication. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Supplied with sterile needles as per packaging. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is marked as “not provided by manufacturer.” Ingredient List Calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres Aqueous gel carrier (including sterile water and glycerin components) Lidocaine hydrochloride Other excipients as per IFU; additional trace components not disclosed. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 1.5 mL pre-filled sterile syringe Shelf-life: Not specified in public documentation; refer to packaging for expiry date. Longevity (treatment duration): Results are typically reported to last approximately 12–18 months , depending on treatment area, injection depth, and individual patient metabolism. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the product. Avoid use in patients with active skin infection or inflammation at the injection site until resolved. Do not inject intravascularly. Radiesse should not be used in areas where soft, highly flexible fillers are indicated, such as superficial lip augmentation. Single use only; do not reuse the syringe; ensure packaging is intact and within expiry. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in Europe. FDA-approved for specific indications in the United States. UKCA status: verify via IFU or authorised distributor. Regulatory classification may vary by jurisdiction; verify on the product packaging or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Radiesse® with Lidocaine? Radiesse with Lido is a calcium hydroxylapatite-based dermal filler designed for facial lifting and volume restoration, offering both immediate support and collagen stimulation. 2. How is Radiesse different from hyaluronic acid fillers? Unlike HA fillers, Radiesse filler contains CaHA microspheres that stimulate collagen production in addition to providing immediate volumisation. 3. How long does Radiesse last? Results are commonly reported to last between 12 and 18 months , depending on individual factors and treated area. 4. Is Radiesse suitable for lips? Radiesse is generally not indicated for superficial lip augmentation due to its firm structural properties. 5. What safety considerations should practitioners keep in mind? Advanced anatomical knowledge, correct depth placement, and strict aseptic technique are essential when performing Radiesse treatment , particularly in vascular areas.

short_description: Seventy Hyal 2000 is a next-generation skin booster formulated to enhance skin hydration, stimulate collagen and elastin production, and improve overall skin quality. With one of the highest molecular weight hyaluronic acid (HA) formulations available (>2000 kDa), it provides intense hydration, gentle volume, and a natural glow. Designed for long-term skin rejuvenation or as a pre-event treatment, Seventy Hyal 2000 restores HA levels within the dermis, improving texture and laxity. The product comes in a pack of 3 x 2ml syringes , suitable for use across the face, neck, décolletage, hands, and lips.
description: Seventy Hyal 2000 is a highly advanced skin booster designed to address the physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid within the skin. As an injectable skincare solution, it integrates deep into the dermis to deliver intense hydration, improve skin elasticity, and stimulate the natural production of collagen and elastin. With an impressive HA concentration of 90mg per 6ml , this formulation ensures optimal moisture retention, skin plumpness, and overall rejuvenation. One of the key advantages of Seventy Hyal 2000 is its use of high molecular weight HA (>2000 kDa), which offers long-lasting hydration and structural support to the skin. Unlike traditional dermal fillers, this skin booster does not add excessive volume but instead imparts a natural glow and smooths out fine lines. Its biocompatible, CE-marked, and vegan-friendly composition ensures safety and effectiveness for all skin types, making it an ideal choice for aesthetic practitioners seeking high-performance skin rejuvenation treatments. Seventy Hyal 2000 is suitable for treating the face, tear troughs, neck, décolletage, hands, and lips , offering a comprehensive approach to non-surgical facial revitalization. The results of this treatment are visible almost immediately due to the high molecular weight HA, with continued improvements over time. The recommended treatment protocol varies depending on the patient’s skin quality and individual needs, with optimal outcomes seen after a series of sessions. Treatment Areas: Face (including tear troughs) Neck Décolletage Hands Lips Usage: Administered via injection by trained medical professionals. Can be used as a standalone skin booster or combined with other aesthetic treatments. Recommended treatment plan varies per individual; initial results are visible almost immediately, with continued improvement over time. The longevity of results varies based on individual skin type and lifestyle factors. Manufactured By: Seventy Hyal Popular Questions & Answers: 1. What is Seventy Hyal 2000 used for? Seventy Hyal 2000 is a next-generation injectable skin booster designed to restore hydration, stimulate collagen and elastin production, and improve skin texture and elasticity. It is commonly used for facial, neck, décolletage, hand, and lip rejuvenation. 2. How long does Seventy Hyal 2000 last? The longevity of results varies depending on the individual’s skin quality and lifestyle factors. Typically, results are visible almost immediately and improve over time with a recommended treatment plan. 3. How does Seventy Hyal 2000 differ from traditional dermal fillers? description: DesoBody® is a professional injectable fat-dissolving treatment developed for non-surgical body contouring and reduction of localised fat deposits. DesoBody is widely used by aesthetic practitioners as part of body sculpting protocols for patients seeking targeted fat reduction without invasive surgery. Through the action of fat-dissolving ingredients, treated adipocytes are gradually broken down and naturally eliminated through the body’s metabolic processes over time. Clinical outcomes vary depending on treatment area, patient characteristics, lifestyle factors, and practitioner technique. DesoBody is frequently incorporated into professional body contouring programmes targeting areas such as the abdomen, flanks, thighs, hips, upper arms, and other regions where localised fat deposits are present. description: Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft 2x1ml – Dermal Filler for Wrinkles and Lip Enhancement Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft 2x1ml is a cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed by Vivacy Laboratories, designed for the correction of moderate to deep wrinkles, restoration of facial volume, and lip enhancement. The formulation contains lidocaine to improve patient comfort during injection and incorporates Vivacy’s Bi-Soft® injection technology for enhanced precision, control, and ergonomic handling. Stylage M offers a balanced viscoelastic profile, allowing smooth tissue integration while maintaining sufficient structural support, making it suitable for facial rejuvenation procedures where natural-looking volume, wrinkle smoothing, and lip definition are required. What Stylage M Is Similar To Stylage M can be regarded alongside other medium-density hyaluronic acid fillers such as Juvederm Ultra 3, Restylane Refyne, and Teosyal Global Action. These products are designed for moderate wrinkle correction and lip treatments, focusing on flexibility, smooth integration, and natural facial movement. Unlike higher-density fillers intended for deep structural contouring, Stylage M Bi-Soft is formulated for versatility, making it suitable for both wrinkle correction and Stylage M lip filler applications. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft is indicated for the treatment of nasolabial folds, marionette lines, moderate facial wrinkles, and lips for volume enhancement, contour definition, and hydration. Stylage M for lips is frequently selected due to its smooth extrusion force, even product distribution, and ability to preserve natural lip movement. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth is mid to deep dermis or lip mucosa depending on the treatment area and indication. The volume per injection site is determined by wrinkle depth, lip anatomy, and practitioner assessment. Stylage M is supplied in the Bi-Soft® ergonomic syringe system to improve injection control and precision. Treatment is typically completed in a single session, with optional touch-ups after 2–4 weeks if required. Stylage M must be administered only by qualified medical or aesthetic professionals under strict aseptic conditions. If any parameter is omitted in the official IFU, it is considered not provided by the manufacturer. Ingredient List (Stylage M Ingredients) Stylage M contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid sodium salt for wrinkle correction and volume support, lidocaine hydrochloride to improve injection comfort, mannitol as an antioxidant to reduce hyaluronic acid degradation, and phosphate buffer with water for injection. Presentation & Longevity Stylage M with Lido Bi-Soft is supplied as 2 × 1ml pre-filled sterile syringes with needles. Shelf life should be verified on the product packaging. Clinical results typically last between 9 and 12 months, depending on treatment area, patient metabolism, and injection technique. Stylage M price may vary depending on distributor and region. Safety Notes / Contraindications Stylage M is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any formulation components. description: Lanluma V 1x15ml – Injectable PLLA Biostimulator Lanluma V 1x15ml is a professional injectable poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) biostimulatory treatment designed to restore volume, improve skin firmness, and stimulate long-term collagen production. Supplied as a sterile powder vial containing 210 mg PLLA , Lanluma V is reconstituted prior to injection and is intended for deep dermal and subcutaneous use in face and body treatments. Unlike hyaluronic acid fillers that provide immediate volume through gel implantation, Lanluma V works by stimulating the body’s natural collagen synthesis , delivering progressive, natural-looking volume restoration and skin quality improvement over time. What Lanluma V Is Similar To Lanluma V belongs to the category of collagen-stimulating injectables and is clinically comparable to other PLLA-based biostimulators such as Sculptra® . These products focus on bioremodeling and volumization through neocollagenesis , rather than direct filling. This comparison is provided for professional reference only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Lanluma V 1x15ml is indicated for: Treatment areas: Face (cheeks, temples, jawline) Mid-face volume loss Body contouring (buttocks, hips, thighs) Skin laxity and collagen depletion Volume restoration following aging or weight loss → Lanluma V is particularly suited for patients seeking long-lasting volume correction and structural support with gradual, natural results. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Deep dermal to subcutaneous plane Product preparation: Requires reconstitution with sterile water for injection (volume as per IFU) Injection technique: Cannula or needle using fanning or cross-hatching techniques Treatment protocol: Typically 1–3 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart Longevity: Results develop gradually over weeks and can last up to 24 months Professional-use disclaimer: For use only by trained and qualified medical or aesthetic practitioners If any parameter is not explicitly stated in the official IFU, it is considered not provided by the manufacturer . Ingredient List (Lanluma V Ingredients) Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA): 210 mg Sodium carboxymethylcellulose Mannitol Lanluma V does not contain lidocaine . Reconstitution and dilution must follow official manufacturer instructions. Presentation & Longevity Presentation: 1 × 15 ml vial (powder form) Reconstitution: Required prior to use Shelf life: Refer to packaging for expiry date Treatment longevity: Progressive collagen stimulation with results lasting up to 18–24 months , depending on patient factors and protocol Safety Notes / Contraindications Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to PLLA or any excipients Do not inject into areas with active infection or inflammation Not suitable for intravascular injection Strict aseptic technique required Practitioner must have advanced anatomical knowledge and biostimulator training Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device in applicable regions. Regulatory classification, approved indications, and usage protocols may vary by country. Practitioners should always consult the official IFU and comply with local regulations. FAQ 1. What is Lanluma V used for? Lanluma V is used for collagen stimulation, volume restoration, and skin firmness improvement in both facial and body treatments. 2. How does Lanluma V work? Lanluma V contains PLLA, which stimulates fibroblasts to produce new collagen over time. This leads to gradual volumization and improved skin structure rather than immediate filling. 3. Is Lanluma V the same as a dermal filler? No. Lanluma V is a biostimulator , not a traditional filler. It works progressively by inducing collagen production rather than instantly adding volume. 4. How long do Lanluma V results last? Results typically last 18 to 24 months , depending on patient metabolism, treatment area, and number of sessions. 5. What training is required to use Lanluma V? Advanced injector training is strongly recommended. Proper education in PLLA reconstitution, injection technique, and anatomy is essential for safe and effective outcomes.

description: Clinical Description Ejal 40 is a bio-revitalising injectable medical device developed by Medixa Srl for improving skin quality, hydration, and dermal support in patients showing signs of intrinsic and extrinsic skin ageing. Classified as a skin booster and biorevitalisation treatment, Ejal 40 contains high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid at a concentration of 40 mg per 2 ml syringe, formulated to support extracellular matrix integrity and promote a more hydrated, elastic, and refreshed appearance. Unlike volumising dermal fillers, Ejal 40 is designed primarily to improve skin quality rather than create structural volume. The product is frequently used in protocols intended to address skin laxity, dehydration, and early age-related dermal changes affecting the face, neck, décolletage, and hands. Through the hydrophilic properties of hyaluronic acid, Ejal 40 supports water retention within the dermis and contributes to improved tissue hydration and skin texture. What Ejal 40 Is Similar To Ejal 40 belongs to the same category of injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisation products as Profhilo®, Sunekos®, and other hyaluronic acid-based regenerative aesthetic treatments. Compared with Profhilo®, which combines high- and low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid using a thermal stabilisation process, Ejal 40 uses high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid designed to support skin hydration and dermal quality through bio-revitalisation protocols. Compared with Sunekos®, which combines hyaluronic acid with amino acids to support extracellular matrix activity, Ejal 40 focuses primarily on high-concentration hyaluronic acid as its principal active ingredient. All of these products are intended to improve skin quality rather than provide significant volumisation. Treatment schedules, clinical outcomes, and longevity may differ depending on patient characteristics and practitioner protocols. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to manufacturer documentation, Ejal 40 may be used in areas showing signs of skin ageing and reduced dermal quality, including: Face Neck Décolletage Hands Clinical objectives include: Improvement of skin hydration Enhancement of skin elasticity Support of dermal revitalisation Management of age-related skin changes Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Intradermal injection. Frequency / number of sessions: Publicly available manufacturer documentation describes treatment cycles; however, exact frequency parameters are not consistently specified in accessible IFU documentation. Therefore: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Ejal 40 should be administered exclusively by qualified medical professionals trained in aesthetic injection procedures and under appropriate aseptic conditions. Some practitioners utilise the well-known 4-point BioRevitalization Technique (4PBT®) with Ejal 40; however, specific practitioner protocols may vary and should not be considered a substitute for the manufacturer’s official IFU. Ingredient List Active Ingredients Hyaluronic Acid (High Molecular Weight): 40 mg / 2 ml Excipients Physiological buffered solution Sodium chloride Water for injection Lidocaine: No. Presentation & Longevity Packaging 1 × 2 ml sterile prefilled syringe Single-use medical device Treatment Duration / Longevity Longevity is not explicitly guaranteed by the manufacturer and may vary according to patient characteristics, treatment area, lifestyle factors, and practitioner protocol. Publicly available clinical and distributor information suggests treatment programmes commonly involve multiple sessions, but exact duration is not provided by manufacturer. Safety Notes / Contraindications According to manufacturer guidance and standard injectable medical-device precautions, Ejal 40 should not be used in: Patients with known hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any formulation component. Patients with active skin infections or inflammatory conditions at the intended treatment site. Patients with severe autoimmune disorders where treatment is considered unsuitable by the treating physician. Pregnant or breastfeeding patients unless specifically assessed by an appropriately qualified healthcare professional. Additional precautions include: Avoid intravascular injection. Use only under aseptic conditions. Do not use damaged or previously opened syringes. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device. Intended for professional medical use only. Manufactured by Medixa Srl, Italy. UKCA status: Verify via current IFU, importer documentation, or authorised UK distributor. FAQ 1. What is Ejal 40 used for? Ejal 40 is a hyaluronic acid-based bio-revitalisation treatment designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and overall dermal quality. It is commonly used in aesthetic medicine for patients presenting with skin ageing, dehydration, and reduced firmness. 2. Is Ejal 40 a dermal filler? Ejal 40 differs from traditional dermal fillers because its primary objective is skin revitalisation rather than volumisation. While it contains hyaluronic acid, the treatment focuses on improving skin quality and hydration rather than restoring facial volume or contour. 3. What areas can be treated with Ejal 40? Manufacturer information identifies the face, neck, décolletage, and hands as principal treatment areas. These regions commonly exhibit age-related changes such as dehydration, reduced elasticity, and diminished skin quality. 4. Does Ejal 40 contain lidocaine? No. Public manufacturer specifications indicate that Ejal 40 contains high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid in a physiological buffer but does not contain lidocaine. 5. How does Ejal 40 compare with other skin boosters? Ejal 40 belongs to the same broad category as Profhilo® and Sunekos®. While all aim to improve skin quality, they differ in formulation technology and ingredient composition. Ejal 40 relies primarily on high-concentration hyaluronic acid for bio-revitalisation and hydration support.

While these products share a similar mechanism of action, they differ in HA concentration, cross-linking methods, gel elasticity, and manufacturer-defined indications . short_description: aesPLLA® is a professional-use PLLA collagen stimulator designed to promote gradual tissue rejuvenation through collagen induction. Rather than functioning as a traditional filler, it supports the body’s natural regenerative processes by encouraging new collagen formation within treated areas. The product is frequently used in aesthetic medicine protocols aimed at improving facial volume deficiency, contour support, and signs of ageing associated with collagen depletion. Because results develop progressively, many practitioners consider PLLA-based treatments suitable for patients seeking natural-looking volumisation over time. aesPLLA® should be administered only by appropriately trained healthcare professionals according to the manufacturer’s instructions and applicable clinical guidelines.
description: AesPLLA Poly-L-Lactic Acid Collagen Stimulator Injectable for Facial Volume Restoration and Wrinkle Correction aesPLLA® Poly-L-Lactic Acid (PLLA) Collagen Stimulator is a biodegradable injectable collagen-stimulating device designed to support gradual facial volume restoration through neocollagenesis rather than immediate volumisation. The product contains poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), a synthetic biocompatible polymer that has been extensively studied in aesthetic medicine for its ability to stimulate fibroblast activity and promote endogenous collagen production over time. Unlike conventional hyaluronic acid fillers that primarily provide immediate space-occupying volume, aesPLLA® acts as a biostimulatory treatment. Following administration and reconstitution according to manufacturer instructions, PLLA microparticles gradually trigger a controlled tissue response that may lead to progressive collagen deposition and structural support within treated tissues. aesPLLA® is intended for use by qualified medical professionals and is commonly selected for patients seeking gradual correction of age-related volume loss and skin laxity. Treatment outcomes develop progressively over several weeks and months following treatment. What aesPLLA® Is Similar To aesPLLA® belongs to the category of collagen-stimulating injectables and is commonly compared with products such as Sculptra® and Lanluma®. All three products utilise poly-L-lactic acid as their primary active component and are intended to stimulate endogenous collagen production rather than provide immediate volumisation through hyaluronic acid implantation. Compared with traditional HA fillers such as Juvederm® Voluma or Restylane® Lyft, PLLA-based products typically deliver gradual improvements over multiple treatment sessions. Results often emerge progressively as collagen remodelling occurs following administration. Product selection depends on treatment goals, patient anatomy, desired correction pattern, practitioner preference, and treatment planning considerations. short_description: Bellast Prime Mild with Lidocaine provides practitioners with a versatile, mid-viscosity dermal filler that delivers immediate, natural-looking volume restoration in lips, cheeks and perioral regions. Its 24 mg/mL HA formulation ensures effective structural support and soft tissue integration, while 0.3% lidocaine provides enhanced comfort during injection.
