description: Bellast Prime Mild with Lidocaine is a CE-marked hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler from the Bellast Prime range by Fox Pharma. It contains 24 mg/mL high-density HA with 0.3% lidocaine, formulated as a viscoelastic gel with uniform particle distribution. The filler is designed for mid-dermal injection, offering moderate volumising and correction — especially suitable for perioral lines, cheeks, and lip augmentation. What Bellast Prime Mild Is Similar To Bellast Prime Mild occupies a role similar to mid-viscosity HA fillers used for lip enhancement, cheek volumising, and perioral rejuvenation. For example, compared with lighter fillers aimed at superficial fine lines (akin to a “soft” filler), Bellast Prime Mild offers greater viscoelasticity and deeper dermal support — making it more comparable to standard volumising HA fillers in the mid-dermis. Like other HA fillers, it works through the hydrophilic nature of HA: after injection the gel attracts and retains water, thereby restoring volume, providing structure, and smoothing skin surface. While lighter fillers may primarily address superficial wrinkles, and heavier fillers focus on deep volume or structural contouring, Bellast Prime Mild offers a balance — suitable for moderate volume restoration without overfilling. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to the manufacturer’s product page, Bellast Prime Mild is indicated for: Lips Cheeks Perioral lines If other areas are considered, verify manufacturer guidance before use. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: Mid dermis. Syringe & needle gauge: Supplied in a 1 × 1 ml ergonomically designed syringe, with 2 × 27G needles included. Volume per syringe: 1 ml. Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer. Professional-use disclaimer: Must be administered by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. (Implicit: product sold to clinics/practitioners only.) Note: No detailed injection pattern, layering, or retreatment interval is provided in publicly available manufacturer documentation. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid — 24 mg/mL (high-density, cross-linked HA) Lidocaine — 0.3% (local anaesthetic for injection comfort) Other excipients / stabilisers / buffers — not provided by manufacturer. Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1 ml pre-filled syringe, supplied with 2 × 27G needles. Longevity / duration of effect: Manufacturer indicates a typical duration of 6–12 months for visible results. Shelf life / storage instructions: not provided on publicly available page — verify on product pack or IFU. Safety Notes / Contraindications Manufacturer notes for Bellast Prime Mild with Lidocaine include the following contraindications / precautions: Not to be used in patients with bleeding disorders or on medications affecting platelet function. Should not be re-sterilised, or mixed with other products before injection. Contraindicated in patients with known allergy to lidocaine. Not recommended for patients with susceptibility to keloid formation. Avoid injection at sites with inflammation, infection, or any active skin disease. Not advised for patients who are pregnant or breastfeeding. If patient has known hypersensitivity to any component (e.g., HA or lidocaine), or active skin infection at the injection site — use is contraindicated. Regulatory Status Bellast Prime Mild is CE-marked, confirming conformity with European health, safety, and environmental standards. No public documentation of UKCA marking, FDA approval, or other regulatory registrations — verify on product pack or official IFU/distributor. FAQ (5 Evidence-Based Q&As) Q1: How does Bellast Prime Mild with Lidocaine restore facial volume and improve appearance? A1: Bellast Prime Mild uses cross-linked hyaluronic acid (24 mg/mL), which when injected into the mid dermis attracts and holds water molecules, thus increasing dermal volume and filling soft-tissue deficits. This provides structural support beneath lips, cheeks, or perioral lines — smoothing wrinkles and restoring a more youthful contour. The viscoelastic gel also integrates into surrounding tissue, leading to natural-looking results. Q2: Is the injection with Bellast Prime Mild painful? A2: The filler includes 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, which helps minimise discomfort during injection. This tends to make the procedure more comfortable compared with fillers lacking anaesthetic. Q3: How long do results from Bellast Prime Mild typically last? A3: According to the manufacturer, visible improvements from a single treatment session generally last between 6 to 12 months. Duration may vary depending on patient skin condition, metabolism, treatment area, and lifestyle. Q4: What areas of the face can safely be treated with Bellast Prime Mild? A4: As per manufacturer information, Bellast Prime Mild is intended for lips, cheeks and perioral lines — offering volume restoration and correction in those zones. Use in other areas should only proceed after verifying suitability and practitioner training. Q5: Is Bellast Prime Mild interchangeable with lighter or heavier fillers in the Bellast Prime range? A5: Not exactly — Bellast Prime Mild occupies an intermediate role: compared to lighter fillers (designed for fine lines or superficial wrinkles), Mild offers deeper volume support and stronger viscoelasticity; compared to heavier fillers (designed for deep folds, structural contouring), Mild is less robust. Therefore, choosing between Soft, Mild, Hard, or Ultra formulations depends on treatment goals, anatomical area, and required volume.

description: Fillmed NCTF 135HA is a CE-marked , injectable biorevitalising medical device designed for skin quality enhancement. It combines 5 mg/mL non crosslinked sodium hyaluronate with a rich “polyrevitalising” formula containing vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals, and co-enzymes. This cocktail supports fibroblast activity, promoting collagen and elastin synthesis, hydration, and dermal renewal. The mechanism of action is not volumetric filling, but biological stimulation of the dermis, helping to improve skin radiance, elasticity, and density. What It’s Similar To In terms of function and category, NCTF 135HA can be compared to other skin boosters such as Sunekos® or Profhilo® . Like Sunekos, it uses a multi-component formula (not just hyaluronic acid) to stimulate skin renewal; unlike cross-linked volumising fillers, it doesn’t add structure or volume, similar to Profhilo, but its action is more focused on skin revitalisation rather than deep hydration or bi-restructuring. The key difference lies in the ingredient profile: NCTF includes a broad mix of vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals and co-enzymes alongside HA, giving it a richer “biological” stimulation. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to the manufacturer and distributor information, NCTF 135HA is indicated for: Face (including periorbital area) Neck Décolleté Hands Arms (some sources mention inner arms) Usage / Administration (IFU-Only) Injection depth: Superficial dermis (intradermal). Needle gauge: According to clinical use, 32 G × 4 mm classic needle has been used. Frequency / number of sessions: The standard recommended protocol is 3 sessions spaced 15 days apart , followed by 2 sessions spaced one month apart . Volume per injection / point: The IFU does not publicly specify a fixed “volume per point / papule” for each injection site. (The public IFU / SSCP does not provide a detailed per-point dosage.) Professional-use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals, under aseptic conditions. Ingredient List Non–crosslinked sodium hyaluronate (5 mg/mL) 12 vitamins (A, B-complex including B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B8, B9, B12; C; E) 24 amino acids (e.g., glycine, proline, leucine, etc.) 5 nucleic acids (deoxyadenosine, deoxycytidine, etc.) 6 minerals (e.g., calcium, potassium, magnesium) 6 co-enzymes (e.g., NAD, FAD, CoA) Other excipients: glutathione, polysorbate 80, glucuronic acid / lactone, glucosamine, dextrose (anhydrous) Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 5 × 3 mL sterile vials. Shelf life: Not publicly specified in the manufacturer SSCP. Treatment duration / longevity: According to clinical evidence, skin improvements (wrinkles, radiance, density) were still measurable at 120 days (4 months) after the third injection in studies. Maintenance protocols typically follow every 3–6 months as used in practice. Safety Notes / Contraindications From publicly available prescribing and distributor information: Hypersensitivity : Contraindicated in patients with known allergy or hypersensitivity to any component (e.g., hyaluronic acid). Active infection : Avoid in areas with active skin infection, inflammation, or wounds. Autoimmune or clotting disorders : Use cautiously (or avoid) in patients with autoimmune disease, bleeding/clotting disorders. Pregnancy / Breastfeeding : Not recommended during pregnancy or in breastfeeding mothers (precaution due to lack of safety data). Regulatory Status CE-marked (European Conformity) medical device. Regulatory classification: injectable medical device for professional use (as stated by Fillmed). FAQ Q1: How does NCTF 135HA actually improve skin quality? A: NCTF 135HA works by delivering a synergistic blend of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid and vital “polyrevitalising” nutrients (vitamins, amino acids, nucleic acids, minerals, co-enzymes) into the dermis. This stimulates fibroblasts, which in turn produce more collagen and elastin, improving elasticity, hydration, and skin tone over time. Q2: Is NCTF 135HA safe for use, and what side-effects are common? A: Clinical evidence and safety performance reports show that most adverse reactions are mild: bruising (~36%) and redness (~23%) are common but generally light in intensity, with nearly half resolving within 48 hours. It should not be used in patients with hypersensitivity, active infection, or certain systemic conditions. Q3: How often should treatments be performed? A: According to Fillmed’s recommended protocol, you would typically administer 3 sessions spaced 15 days apart, followed by 2 further sessions with one-month intervals.Some practitioners then use maintenance treatments every 3–6 months. Q4: How long do the effects last? A: In clinical studies, improvements in skin density, radiance, and the appearance of fine lines were still measurable at 120 days after the treatment course. Maintenance treatments can help sustain results. Q5: How does NCTF 135HA compare with other skin boosters like Profhilo or Sunekos? A: Unlike volumising fillers, NCTF 135HA doesn’t add structure—its strength lies in “biological revitalisation.” Compared to Sunekos, which also uses amino acids, NCTF provides a more complex mix, including nucleic acids and co-enzymes. Compared to Profhilo, which focuses on very high-purity hyaluronic acid and bi-restructuring, NCTF is more nutrient-rich and stimulatory. This comparison is for clinical orientation and does not imply interchangeability.

description: Gouri – Liquid PCL (Polycaprolactone) 1 × 1 mL Gouri®, also referred to as Liquid PCL , is an injectable polycaprolactone (PCL) biostimulator medical device formulated to support natural collagen regeneration (collagenesis) in the skin through a fully solubilised liquid PCL solution. The product is typically administered across multiple sites with fine needles and may be used for broad facial rejuvenation rather than focal volumetric correction. The liquid PCL formulation makes Gouri adaptable for more uniform tissue distribution compared with particulate PCL or suspended fillers, which can require shaping after injection. However, unlike particulate PCL or PLLA products that encapsulate solid particles requiring reconstitution and carry a higher risk of nodule formation, Gouri’s liquid formulation is fully solubilised, allowing smoother injection and broader tissue distribution. Compared with HA-based skin boosters (e.g., Profhilo®), which primarily hydrate and improve matrix quality, Gouri emphasises longer-term collagenogenesis and tissue firmness due to PCL’s polymer structure and sustained biostimulatory effect. short_description: Bellast Prime Ultra with Lidocaine is a high-viscosity HA filler engineered for advanced facial sculpting and volumising. Its dense gel structure delivers strong lift and structural support — ideal for reshaping the chin, cheeks, jawline, or nose. The integrated 0.3% lidocaine enhances patient comfort during injection. description: Bellast Prime Ultra with Lidocaine is a CE-marked dermal filler from the Bellast Prime range by Fox Pharma. It is formulated with 24 mg/mL cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) and includes 0.3% lidocaine to improve injection comfort. The product is designed for deep structural augmentation, with the filler intended for injection into the subcutaneous tissue (beneath the dermis) to provide lift, volume restoration, and define facial contours. Indications typically include facial contouring (chin, cheeks, jawline), nasal augmentation, and volumising in areas requiring substantial structural support. What Bellast Prime Ultra Is Similar To Bellast Prime Ultra performs similarly to other high-viscosity, deep-placement HA fillers used for facial contouring and non-surgical rhinoplasty. For example, compared with lighter HA fillers (designed for superficial wrinkles or hydration), Bellast Prime Ultra resembles the performance profile of dense fillers used for chin, jaw, or nose augmentation. It differs from lighter fillers (e.g., those for fine lines or periorbital areas) by offering greater structural support and lift. Compared with a filler such as Profhilo (which primarily hydrates and improves skin quality), Bellast Prime Ultra focuses on volume and contour rather than superficial skin texture. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to the manufacturer’s product page, Bellast Prime Ultra is intended for: Nose (nasal augmentation) Chin Cheeks Jaw / jawline If additional treatment areas are required (e.g., mid-face, cheeks, other zones), they are not specified in the publicly available documentation. Usage / Administration (IFU-only) Injection depth: subcutaneous tissue (below dermis) Needle gauge (included): 25G needle and 27G needle supplied in the kit. Volume per point / injection site: not provided by manufacturer . Frequency / number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer . Professional-use disclaimer: To be administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. (As standard for CE-marked dermal fillers.) Some practitioners may use cannula or layering techniques for deep-tissue fillers; this is not included in the official manufacturer instructions for Bellast Prime Ultra. Ingredient List Hyaluronic acid (cross-linked) — 24 mg/mL Lidocaine — 0.3% Excipients / gel matrix / buffer — not specified in publicly available documentation Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 1 × 1.0 ml prefilled syringe, supplied with 1 × 25G needle and 1 × 27G needle. Shelf life / expiry: not provided by manufacturer in publicly accessible sources. Expected duration of effect: 6–12 months. Safety Notes / Contraindications According to the manufacturer: Not to be used in patients with bleeding disorders or those on medications affecting platelet function. Not to be resterilised or mixed with other products before injection. Contraindicated in patients with known lidocaine allergy. Not to be used in areas with active inflammation, infection, or other active dermal disease. Not recommended for patients prone to keloid formation. Not advised for use in pregnant or breastfeeding patients. Standard precautionary statement (if not otherwise specified): Use is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component or with active skin infections at the injection site. Treatments should only be performed by certified medical professionals. Regulatory Status CE-marked medical device. UKCA status: not explicitly stated — practitioners should verify relevant regulatory labeling on the product packaging or IFU at time of purchase. FAQ Q1: What is the mechanism of action of Bellast Prime Ultra? A1: Bellast Prime Ultra is a hyaluronic-acid (HA) dermal filler whose cross-linked HA gel is injected into the subcutaneous layer beneath the skin. Once placed, the gel provides volume and structural support, restoring facial contours and lift. Over time, the body gradually degrades the HA by endogenous hyaluronidases, making the filler bio-absorbable. Q2: How long do the results of Bellast Prime Ultra typically last? A2: The manufacturer states that clinical effects of Bellast Prime Ultra generally persist for 6 to 12 months . Longevity can vary depending on patient factors, injection technique, and treated area. Q3: Is the injection painful? A3: Bellast Prime Ultra includes 0.3% lidocaine, a local anaesthetic, which helps to minimise discomfort during injection. As with all injectable treatments, some patients may still experience mild stinging, pressure, or temporary discomfort during and after the procedure — but pain is generally mitigated by the lidocaine. Q4: Can Bellast Prime Ultra be used for superficial wrinkles or fine lines? A4: No — according to the manufacturer, Bellast Prime Ultra is formulated for deep structural enhancement (subcutaneous tissue), not superficial dermal correction. For fine lines or superficial wrinkles, lighter products in the same range (e.g., fillers designed for upper dermis) are more appropriate. Q5: Who should perform the injections with Bellast Prime Ultra? A5: Injection must be performed only by qualified and trained medical professionals under strictly aseptic conditions, using the supplied sterile needles (25G or 27G). The manufacturer does not provide guidance for self-administration.

description: Teoxane Teosyal® RHA 3 is a hyaluronic acid–based dermal filler developed using Teoxane’s proprietary Resilient Hyaluronic Acid (RHA®) technology. This formulation is designed to adapt to dynamic facial movements, maintaining structural integrity and elasticity in areas subject to repeated expression. RHA technology modifies the cross-linking process to preserve the natural HA chain length, supporting tissue integration and mechanical resilience under stress. Teosyal® RHA 3 is classified as a resorbable dermal filler intended for the correction of moderate to marked facial wrinkles and folds, particularly in mobile facial zones. The product contains non-animal stabilised hyaluronic acid and includes lidocaine hydrochloride to improve patient comfort during injection. Its viscoelastic profile positions it between softer RHA formulations and higher projection fillers, offering balanced volumisation while preserving natural facial dynamics. What Teosyal® RHA 3 Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA 3 belongs to the category of resilient hyaluronic acid dermal fillers formulated for dynamic facial zones. Within the Teosyal RHA range, it sits between RHA 2 and RHA 4 , offering a mid-range balance of flexibility and support. Compared with RHA 2, RHA 3 provides greater structural capacity for more pronounced folds, while remaining more adaptable than higher projection fillers. In the wider market, it may be compared for orientation purposes with fillers such as Juvéderm® Volift or Restylane® Refyne , which are also designed to accommodate facial movement. Differences exist in cross-linking technologies, HA concentration, and rheological properties, which influence tissue behaviour and longevity. Teosyal® RHA 3 emphasises resilience under dynamic stress through its RHA® manufacturing process, whereas other fillers may prioritise lift or firmness. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. RHA® technology modifies the cross-linking process to preserve longer HA chains, supporting elasticity and resilience during repeated facial movement. short_description: Teosyal® RHA 4 is a professional‑grade resilient hyaluronic acid filler tailored for deep volume restoration, facial contouring, and correction of dynamic wrinkles . Its unique RHA technology provides elasticity and resistance, supporting natural facial movement and expression while enhancing structural integrity. Containing lidocaine for injection comfort, RHA 4 is intended for experienced clinicians treating areas such as the cheeks, chin, jawline, and other extended zones requiring robust support. With its strong lift and smooth tissue integration, RHA 4 offers reliable enhancement with long‑lasting results that respect dynamic anatomy.
description: Teoxane Teosyal RHA 4 Teosyal® RHA 4 is a CE‑marked, resilient hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler developed by Teoxane Laboratories (Switzerland) for professional aesthetic use in deep volume restoration and correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds. RHA stands for Resilient Hyaluronic Acid , a patented HA formulation designed with a low degree of modification (MoD ~3.6‑4 %) that preserves longer HA chains and supports natural tissue movement while maintaining structural support. This gel combines 23 mg/mL cross‑linked HA with 0.3 % lidocaine for enhanced patient comfort during injection. Its rheological profile provides a combination of elasticity and strength suited for deep dermal to subcutaneous placement in areas with significant volume loss or dynamic expression, including the cheeks, chin, jawline, and other contour regions. RHA 4 integrates smoothly with tissue and adapts to facial motion over extended durations , commonly reported between 9–22 months depending on patient factors and treatment area. What Teosyal® RHA 4 Is Similar To Teosyal® RHA 4 is functionally comparable to other deep volume HA fillers such as Juvederm® Voluma and Restylane® Lyft in that all provide structural volume augmentation and deep fold correction via cross‑linked hyaluronic acid. Like these products, RHA 4 is designed for deep dermal or subcutaneous placement to restore midface volume and support facial contours. However, RHA technology’s lower degree of HA modification is intended to maintain longer polymer chains with improved dynamic resilience , allowing the gel to adapt to facial expressions and motion with fewer rigid constraints. In contrast, standard high‑modification HA gels may offer stronger lift at the cost of stiffness. Longevity for deep HA fillers generally ranges from 9–18+ months , with RHA 4 often cited toward the higher end depending on anatomical site and patient metabolism. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Mid‑ to lower face volume restoration (e.g., cheeks, cheekbones ) Chin and jawline contouring Correction of moderate to severe dynamic wrinkles such as nasolabial folds and marionette lines Extended dynamic facial areas where elasticity and movement are significant Usage / Administration (IFU‑only section) Publicly available IFU data for precise injection parameters is limited; the following reflects verified manufacturer/distributor information where available. Where direct IFU parameters are not publicly provided, “not provided by manufacturer” is stated. Injection depth: Deep dermis to subcutaneous plane, adapted to anatomical requirements of target area. Volume per point / injection site: Not provided by manufacturer Needle gauge: 27 G × ½″ sterile needles included. Frequency / number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer Professional‑use disclaimer: Administered only by qualified medical professionals under aseptic conditions. Some practitioners adopt multilayering techniques for midface volumisation; this is not included in the official IFU. Ingredient List Hyaluronic Acid (HA): 23 mg/mL cross‑linked hyaluronic acid of non‑animal origin Lidocaine Hydrochloride: 0.3 % for injection comfort Phosphate buffer: stabilising excipient to maintain pH compatibility Presentation & Longevity Packaging: 2 × 1.2 ml pre‑filled syringes , 2 × 27 G × ½″ needles , traceability labels, and product insert. Shelf life: Not provided by manufacturer Treatment duration / longevity: Effects commonly reported to last between 9–22 months , dependent on the anatomical site and individual metabolism. Safety Notes / Contraindications Use is contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid, lidocaine, or any component . Not for use in areas with active skin infections, inflammation, or compromised tissue integrity . Avoid treatment in pregnant or breastfeeding individuals . Should not be combined with concurrent aggressive resurfacing procedures (e.g., peels, lasers) at the same site. Regulatory Status CE‑marked Class III medical device compliant with EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR). Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on product pack or manufacturer’s IFU. FAQ 1. What is Teosyal® RHA 4? Teosyal® RHA 4 is a resilient hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed for deep volumisation and contouring of facial structures. It uses patented RHA technology with a balanced cross‑linked HA formulation to provide elasticity and strength for dynamic facial areas while supporting natural expression. It contains lidocaine for improved patient comfort during clinical injection. 2. How does the RHA technology differ from traditional HA fillers? RHA technology minimises excessive cross‑linking of HA chains, preserving longer HA polymers that are more adaptable to facial movements. This can result in a filler that integrates smoothly with tissues and maintains elasticity, compared with traditional highly cross‑linked HA gels that may prioritise lift over pliability. 3. Where can Teosyal® RHA 4 be used? It is typically used in areas requiring deep volume restoration such as cheeks, chin, jawline, and regions with moderate to severe dynamic wrinkles. Placement is generally in the deep dermis to subcutaneous plane, administered by a qualified clinician. 4. How long do results last? While individual outcomes vary, clinical and distributor information suggests visible volumising effects may persist 9–22 months after treatment, with longevity influenced by treatment area, metabolism, and lifestyle. 5. Is it safe? When used by trained professionals under aseptic technique, RHA 4 is generally well tolerated. Common, transient side effects include swelling, redness, or tenderness at injection sites. Contraindications include hypersensitivity to components and active infections.

description: Nithya Body is a state-of-the-art mesotherapy product developed by Euroresearch to promote skin rejuvenation and improve overall body aesthetics. As we age, collagen levels in the skin decrease, leading to visible signs of aging such as sagging, wrinkles, and uneven texture. Nithya Body addresses these issues by delivering a potent combination of native collagen directly into the skin’s deeper layers, where it can stimulate the body’s natural healing and regenerative processes. The standout ingredient in Nithya Body is native collagen, a highly purified form of collagen that closely resembles the body’s own natural collagen. This makes it exceptionally effective at promoting skin regeneration and elasticity. By restoring collagen levels, Nithya Body helps to improve skin tone and texture, resulting in a more youthful appearance. What sets Nithya Body apart from traditional dermal fillers and other body treatments is its focus on revitalizing and rejuvenating the skin from within rather than merely filling areas. The mesotherapy treatment involves a series of micro-injections into targeted areas, allowing for precise delivery of the active ingredients. This method not only helps to tighten and firm the skin but also improves hydration levels, providing patients with a smoother and more even skin surface. Nithya Body is suitable for various treatment areas, making it a versatile addition to any aesthetic practitioner’s offerings. It can be effectively used on: Abdomen: To tighten loose skin after weight loss or childbirth. Thighs: Reducing the appearance of cellulite and improving skin texture. Arms: Tightening sagging skin and enhancing firmness. Back: Addressing uneven skin tone and texture. Patients can expect to see noticeable improvements in skin firmness and hydration following their treatments. The results typically last for up to 6 months, depending on individual skin conditions and post-treatment care. For optimal outcomes, a series of 3 to 4 treatments is recommended, spaced 2 to 4 weeks apart. Maintenance sessions can be performed every 6 months to prolong the benefits of the treatment. One of the key benefits of Nithya Body is its safety and minimal downtime. Patients may experience slight redness or swelling at the injection sites, which generally resolves within a few hours to a day. This makes it an ideal option for those looking for effective skin rejuvenation without the need for invasive procedures or extended recovery times. For aesthetic clinics, offering Nithya Body enhances the treatment portfolio, providing clients with a high-quality solution for non-surgical body contouring and rejuvenation. Its natural approach to restoring collagen and improving skin quality appeals to patients who are increasingly seeking non-invasive treatments for body aesthetics. In summary, Nithya Body offers a revolutionary approach to mesotherapy, delivering native collagen directly into the skin to improve texture, firmness, and hydration. With its broad range of applications and minimal side effects, it is a preferred choice for practitioners looking to meet the evolving demands of their clients. description: Ellansé® M 2 × 1 mL Dermal Filler Ellansé® M is an injectable polycaprolactone (PCL)-based dermal filler medical device developed for the correction of facial wrinkles, folds, and contour deficiencies , while also providing long-term collagen stimulation. description: RRS® Silisorg is a professional mesotherapy and biorevitalisation solution developed by Skin Tech Pharma Group for the management of skin ageing, loss of firmness, and connective tissue deterioration. The product combines organic silicon with a carefully selected blend of amino acids, vitamins, antioxidants, trace elements, and coenzymes intended to support dermal metabolism and extracellular matrix function. Unlike hyaluronic acid-based skin boosters that primarily focus on hydration, RRS® Silisorg is formulated to target connective tissue support and skin revitalisation through a multi-ingredient approach. Organic silicon is widely recognised for its role in collagen and elastin metabolism, while the complementary ingredients are designed to contribute to overall skin quality maintenance. The product is supplied in sterile 5ml vials and is intended exclusively for professional administration within aesthetic medical settings. RRS® Silisorg is commonly incorporated into facial and body rejuvenation protocols addressing visible signs of ageing, skin laxity, and reduced tissue quality. What RRS® Silisorg Is Similar To RRS® Silisorg belongs to the category of mesotherapy and biorevitalisation solutions. It shares certain characteristics with products such as NCTF® 135 HA and Jalupro® , although important differences exist. Like NCTF® 135 HA, RRS® Silisorg contains a broad spectrum of revitalising ingredients including vitamins, amino acids, minerals, and antioxidants designed to support skin quality. However, NCTF® includes hyaluronic acid as a central component, whereas RRS® Silisorg focuses primarily on organic silicon-based revitalisation. Compared with Jalupro®, both products utilise amino acid complexes to support dermal metabolism. However, Jalupro® is specifically centred around amino acid and hyaluronic acid combinations, while RRS® Silisorg incorporates organic silicon together with a broader nutritional complex. RRS® Silisorg is generally positioned as a connective tissue-supporting mesotherapy solution rather than a volumising filler or hydration-focused skin booster. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. description: BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is a prescription-only medicine containing botulinum toxin type A , supplied as a white powder for solution for injection. Each vial contains 200 Allergan Units of botulinum toxin type A derived from Clostridium botulinum . The active neurotoxin acts at peripheral cholinergic nerve terminals by inhibiting acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction. This temporarily reduces neuromuscular transmission and produces a reversible reduction in targeted muscle activity. The UK-authorised BOTOX formulation has multiple therapeutic indications. In aesthetic medicine, it is authorised for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet), forehead lines. BOTOX should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with expertise in the relevant indication and the required equipment. Treatment Areas / Indications For aesthetic use, the current UK SmPC identifies: Glabellar lines between the eyebrows at maximum frown. Lateral canthal lines (crow’s feet) at maximum smile. Forehead lines at maximum eyebrow elevation. Platysma prominence at maximum contraction. These aesthetic indications apply to adults where the severity has an important psychological impact. Administration Parameters Professional administration: BOTOX should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with expertise in the relevant indication and required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines. Treatment frequency: The aesthetic indications should not be treated more frequently than every 3 months . Single use: BOTOX is intended for treatment of one patient during a single session , with unused product discarded according to the product information. Ingredient List Active ingredient: Botulinum toxin type A — 200 Allergan Units per vial . BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is supplied as a powder for solution for injection and requires reconstitution before administration. Presentation & Longevity BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is supplied in a clear glass vial containing 200 Allergan Units of botulinum toxin type A. The standard pack comprises one 200-unit vial and package leaflet ; packs containing multiple cartons may also be authorised, although not all pack sizes may be marketed. The unopened product has a 3-year shelf life . The UK SmPC specifies storage in a refrigerator at 2–8°C. For aesthetic treatment, the documented duration varies by indication. Glabellar-line improvement has been demonstrated for up to 4 months , while crow’s feet and forehead-line studies report effects lasting approximately 4 months on average , with some clinical data showing reduction in line severity for longer periods in selected studies. Safety Notes / Contraindications BOTOX is contraindicated in patients with: Known hypersensitivity to botulinum toxin type A or any listed excipient. Infection at the proposed injection site. Important precautions include the potential for distant spread of toxin effect , which can result in excessive muscle weakness and serious swallowing, speech or respiratory difficulties. For aesthetic indications, BOTOX is not recommended for individuals under 18 years . The product is also not recommended during pregnancy, and use during breastfeeding cannot be recommended because sufficient information is unavailable. The MHRA has issued updated warnings concerning rare cases of iatrogenic botulism following therapeutic or cosmetic use of botulinum toxin products. The MHRA also highlights the risks associated with unlicensed and counterfeit botulinum toxin products. Regulatory Status BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is a UK-authorised Prescription-Only Medicine (POM) . It is not a dermal filler and is not classified as a CE/UKCA medical device. The current UK SmPC lists AbbVie Ltd as the marketing authorisation holder and gives UK marketing authorisation PL 41042/0058 . The manufacturer name for the specific manufacturing site is not provided in the current public UK SmPC ; therefore, the product page should not infer a manufacturing entity from third-party retail listings. BOTOX potency is expressed in Allergan units, which are product-specific and not interchangeable with units used for other botulinum toxin preparations . FAQ 1. What is BOTOX 200 Allergan Units? BOTOX 200 Allergan Units is a prescription-only medicine containing 200 Allergan Units of botulinum toxin type A in a single vial. The neurotoxin temporarily inhibits acetylcholine release at peripheral cholinergic nerve terminals, reducing neuromuscular transmission and targeted muscle activity. In the UK, BOTOX has several authorised indications spanning aesthetic, neurological, bladder and dermatological conditions. The product should only be administered by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner with relevant expertise in the indication being treated. 2. What is BOTOX 200 units used for? The UK-authorised aesthetic indications include temporary improvement in moderate to severe glabellar lines, lateral canthal lines, forehead lines and platysma prominence in adults where severity has an important psychological impact. The same 200-unit presentation is also authorised for medical indications, including certain forms of focal spasticity, chronic migraine, bladder disorders and severe primary axillary hyperhidrosis. The authorised dose, injection pattern and treatment interval vary substantially according to the indication. 3. Is BOTOX 200 Allergan Units equivalent to 200 units of Bocouture or Azzalure? No. BOTOX uses Allergan Units , while Bocouture and Azzalure use their own product-specific potency units. Although all three contain botulinum toxin type A, their formulations, potency assays, authorised indications and dosing instructions differ. The BOTOX UK SmPC explicitly states that its units are not interchangeable with other botulinum toxin preparations. Therefore, a 200-Allergan-Unit BOTOX vial should not be treated as equivalent to 200 units of another botulinum toxin product.

description: Clinical Description Azzalure 125IU (2 Vials) is a prescription-only injectable medicine containing botulinum toxin type A in the form of a powder for solution for injection. Each vial contains 125 Speywood units of botulinum toxin type A haemagglutinin complex. Azzalure is specifically indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines in adults under 65 years of age when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact. Botulinum toxin type A acts as a local muscle relaxant. Following intramuscular administration, it inhibits the transport of the neurotransmitter acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction. This reduces contraction of the targeted muscles and temporarily decreases their activity, producing a reduction in the appearance of dynamic facial lines. Importantly, Azzalure Speywood units are specific to this preparation and are not interchangeable with units from other botulinum toxin products . What Azzalure 125IU (2 Vials) Is Similar To Azzalure belongs to the same broad therapeutic class as other botulinum toxin type A medicines used in aesthetic medicine, including BOTOX and BOCOUTURE . These products all act at the neuromuscular junction to temporarily reduce muscle activity, but their formulations, potency units, authorised indications and dosing recommendations differ. For example, the UK SmPC for BOCOUTURE describes botulinum toxin type A for facial lines including glabellar and lateral periorbital lines. However, BOCOUTURE uses its own units and its recommended doses are not directly interchangeable with Azzalure Speywood units. BOTOX likewise has product-specific Allergan Units and separate dosing guidance. Azzalure’s UK indication is specifically for moderate to severe glabellar and lateral canthal lines in adults under 65 who meet the stated indication criteria. Its clinical effect is temporary, with clinical studies demonstrating improvement for up to approximately four months for glabellar lines. Lateral canthal lines — commonly referred to as crow’s feet, assessed at maximum smile. The indication applies to adults under 65 years of age where the severity of the lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. Other facial areas, including forehead lines, nasal lines or perioral lines, are not provided as authorised indications for Azzalure in the current UK SmPC . Injection location: Intramuscularly into five sites — two injections into each corrugator muscle and one into the procerus muscle. Injection direction: At right angles to the skin for the specified glabellar injection sites. Needle gauge: The SmPC states that a sterile suitable-gauge needle should be used; specific gauge not provided by manufacturer . Lateral Canthal Lines Recommended dose per side: 30 Speywood units. Total recommended dose: 60 Speywood units for both sides. Injection sites: 3 sites per side. Dose per site: 10 Speywood units. Injection depth: Intramuscular and described as very superficial. Injection angle: Approximately 20–30° to the skin. Injection location: External portion of the orbicularis oculi muscle, sufficiently distant from the orbital rim, approximately 1–2 cm. Needle gauge: Specific gauge not provided by manufacturer . Treatment interval: Not more frequently than every three months. Reconstitution must be performed with 0.9% sodium chloride solution for injection under appropriate aseptic conditions. Once reconstituted, Azzalure is intended for treatment of a single patient during a single session. Individual duration can vary and should not be represented as a guaranteed treatment duration. Myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Additional precautions include careful consideration of pre-existing neuromuscular disorders, facial anatomy, muscle weakness or atrophy, inflammation at the injection site and prolonged bleeding time. Azzalure should not be used during pregnancy, and use during breastfeeding cannot be recommended because sufficient clinical information is not available. Immediate medical assessment is required if serious symptoms occur. Azzalure 125IU is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines in adults under 65 years of age when the severity of the lines has an important psychological impact. It works by temporarily reducing activity in targeted muscles through inhibition of acetylcholine transmission at the neuromuscular junction. Its authorised UK aesthetic indications do not include all facial wrinkle areas, so use should follow the current UK prescribing information. 2. How does Azzalure work? Azzalure contains botulinum toxin type A, a peripherally acting muscle relaxant. After intramuscular administration, it interferes with the transport of acetylcholine across the neuromuscular junction. This interrupts communication between the nerve ending and the muscle fibre, temporarily reducing contraction of the treated muscle. Muscle activity gradually returns as the neuromuscular junction recovers. The effect is therefore temporary rather than permanent. 3. How is Azzalure administered according to the UK SmPC? Azzalure must be reconstituted before administration and given by an appropriately qualified healthcare practitioner. For glabellar lines, the recommended total dose is 50 Speywood units divided between five intramuscular injection sites. For lateral canthal lines, the recommended dose is 30 units per side across three sites per side. A sterile suitable-gauge needle is specified, but a particular needle gauge is not stated in the SmPC. Treatment should not be repeated more frequently than every three months. 4. How long does Azzalure last? The duration of Azzalure’s effect is temporary and varies between individuals. In clinical studies, the optimal effect for glabellar lines was demonstrated for up to four months, with some patients still responding at five months. For lateral canthal lines, clinical benefit was demonstrated through several follow-up assessments, including 16 weeks. The actual duration should not be presented as guaranteed because response can differ according to patient characteristics and the treated indication. 5. Is Azzalure the same as Botox or Bocouture? Azzalure, BOTOX and BOCOUTURE are all botulinum toxin type A medicines, but they are not identical products. Each uses its own formulation, potency units and prescribing information. Azzalure is measured in Speywood units , which the UK SmPC specifically states are not interchangeable with units from other botulinum toxin preparations. Consequently, dosing should always be based on the product-specific prescribing information rather than direct unit-for-unit substitution.

Bocouture contains purified botulinum toxin type A, which acts at cholinergic nerve terminals at the neuromuscular junction. Maximum effect is described around day 30 for each indication. 5. Is Bocouture equivalent to Botox or Azzalure? Bocouture, BOTOX and Azzalure are botulinum toxin type A medicines, but their formulations, potency assays and licensed dosing instructions differ. Bocouture contains purified 150 kD neurotoxin without complexing proteins, while Azzalure contains a haemagglutinin complex. BOTOX and Bocouture use different unit systems. UK product information specifically states that botulinum toxin units are not interchangeable, so one product should not be substituted using an assumed unit-for-unit conversion.

description: Emla Cream 30g (Lido Cream) is a trusted topical anaesthetic formulated to provide effective dermal numbing before aesthetic procedures such as injectable treatments, microneedling, mesotherapy, or laser therapy. It contains a eutectic mixture of 2.5% Lidocaine and 2.5% Prilocaine , offering rapid onset and reliable skin analgesia. Suitable for use on intact skin, Emla is ideal for practitioners seeking to reduce procedural discomfort and anxiety in clients, ultimately improving treatment outcomes. Emla Cream 30g (Lido Cream) is a pharmaceutical-grade, dual-action topical anaesthetic developed for temporary numbing of the skin prior to non-invasive aesthetic procedures. A favourite among aesthetic professionals, it combines 2.5% Lidocaine and 2.5% Prilocaine —both amide-type local anaesthetics known for their rapid and reliable nerve-blocking effects. Designed for use on intact skin , Emla is commonly applied before procedures that cause mild to moderate pain or discomfort. Its formulation creates a temporary numbing effect by inhibiting sodium ion influx in neuronal membranes, effectively blocking pain signal transmission. Emla Cream Clinical Utility in Aesthetic Practice From a B2B medical aesthetic perspective, Emla Cream provides several benefits for clinics aiming to optimise client care and procedural comfort. This product is particularly useful in: High-throughput clinics where treatment efficiency is key. Procedures requiring precise injection techniques, where reducing client flinching is essential. Managing needle-phobia or procedural anxiety in sensitive clients. The onset of action is between 30–60 minutes , with an analgesic window of up to two hours depending on the duration and area of application. The cream is non-greasy , fragrance-free , and dermatologically tested, making it suitable even for patients with sensitive skin types. Advantages for Aesthetic Clinics Dual-active formula: Lidocaine and Prilocaine for enhanced dermal penetration . Safe for use on sensitive facial regions . Ideal for pre-injection and pre-laser procedures. Widely available and recognised by healthcare professionals. Supports clinic efficiency by allowing clients to relax pre-treatment. The 30g tube format provides excellent value for high-volume clinics, allowing for approximately 20–25 applications depending on treatment area size. This helps reduce wastage while keeping supply costs efficient for clinics offering daily injectable treatments. Treatment Areas for Emla Cream: Emla Cream is used to numb: Lips (lip fillers) Cheeks, chin, and nasolabial folds Forehead and glabella (Botulinum toxin) Tear troughs and periorbital region Jawline and masseter Scalp (for PRP) Neck and décolletage Back of hands Microneedling and mesotherapy zones Usage Instructions & Ingredient List: Apply a thick, even layer (approx. 1–2g per 10cm²) to clean skin. Cover with an occlusive dressing (cling film) where necessary. Leave on for 30–60 minutes depending on procedure. Remove cream completely before treatment. Lidocaine 2.5% (25mg/g): Amide anaesthetic that inhibits voltage-gated sodium channels. Prilocaine 2.5% (25mg/g): Complementary amide anaesthetic enhancing local numbing. Polyethylene glycol, Carbopol, Water, Sodium hydroxide – for emulsification and skin compatibility. Product Dimensions / Size: Tube Size: 30g Formulation: Topical cream Packaging: Tube with tamper-proof cap, box with usage guide 5 Popular FAQs 1. How long should Emla Cream be left on before treatment? Emla Cream should be applied for at least 30–60 minutes before the procedure. The exact duration depends on the treatment area and client sensitivity. 2. Can Emla Cream be used on the face? Yes, Emla is safe for use on the face, including sensitive areas like lips and under the eyes. Occlusion is recommended for optimal effect. 3. How many applications are in a 30g tube? A 30g tube typically offers 20–25 applications, depending on the treatment area size and quantity used. 4. Is Emla suitable for all skin types? Emla Cream is dermatologically tested and suitable for most skin types, including sensitive skin. A patch test is recommended for new clients. 5. Can Emla Cream be used before Botox or fillers? Yes, Emla is ideal for use before Botulinum toxin and dermal filler treatments, helping reduce injection discomfort and client anxiety.

description: Saypha Dermal Filler Volume without Lido – HA Dermal Filler without Lidocaine Saypha® Filler Volume without Lido is a class of injectable hyaluronic acid (HA) dermal filler medical device formulated with a high concentration of cross-linked HA sodium salt designed to restore lost facial volume and smooth moderate to deep wrinkles and folds. description: solution developed by Love Cosmedical for the reduction of localized adipose tissue in the facial and submental regions. The product belongs to the category of injectable lipolytic treatments and is formulated to target stubborn fat deposits that may persist despite diet and exercise efforts. The primary active ingredient is sodium deoxycholate 0.5% , a bile acid derivative that disrupts adipocyte cell membranes, promoting the breakdown of localized fat cells. The formulation also contains caffeine and equisetum (horsetail extract), which are included to support lipid metabolism and tissue drainage processes. DesoFace is intended for aesthetic contouring of facial areas affected by localized fat accumulation, particularly the cheeks, jowls, neck, and submental region (double chin). It is designed as a non-surgical alternative for facial contour refinement and localized fat reduction when administered by appropriately qualified healthcare professionals. What DesoFace 5 x 10 ml Is Similar To DesoFace belongs to the same category of lipolytic injectables as Kybella® , Aqualyx® , and DesoBody® , although each product differs in concentration, treatment indications, and treatment areas. Like Kybella®, DesoFace uses a deoxycholate-based mechanism to disrupt adipocyte membranes and reduce localized fat deposits. However, Kybella is specifically approved for submental fat reduction in certain markets and follows different treatment protocols. Compared with DesoBody, DesoFace contains a lower sodium deoxycholate concentration (0.5%), making it specifically intended for smaller and more delicate facial treatment areas. DesoBody contains a higher concentration and is generally positioned for larger body areas. Aqualyx is also used for localized fat reduction but differs in formulation and manufacturer guidance. Selection between products should always be based on practitioner assessment, treatment goals, and product-specific instructions. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications According to publicly available manufacturer-aligned information, DesoFace may be used for the treatment of: Double chin (submental fat) Cheeks Jowls Neck fat Facial contouring areas with localized adiposity Some distributors also reference use around the lower facial contour and selected facial regions where localized fat deposits are present. Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) Injection depth: Not provided by manufacturer in publicly accessible documentation. Volume per injection point: Not provided by manufacturer. Needle gauge: Not provided by manufacturer. Dosage per treatment area: Manufacturer-aligned sources indicate approximately ½ vial (5 ml) per 5 × 5 cm area of localized adiposity. Treatment frequency: Typically every 5–6 weeks according to manufacturer-aligned guidance. Number of sessions: Not provided by manufacturer. Publicly available sources indicate visible results may occur after the first or second treatment, but the total number of sessions should be determined by the treating professional. Professional-use statement: DesoFace should only be administered by qualified medical professionals using appropriate aseptic techniques and according to local regulations and manufacturer instructions. Ingredient List Active Ingredients Sodium Deoxycholate – 0.5% Caffeine Equisetum (Horsetail Extract) Excipients Not fully disclosed in publicly available manufacturer documentation. Hyaluronic Acid Not applicable. Lidocaine No lidocaine reported in publicly available product information. Presentation & Longevity Packaging 5 × 10 ml vials per pack. Storage Store between 2°C and 25°C. Longevity Manufacturer-aligned sources state that destroyed adipocytes do not regenerate; therefore, results may be long-lasting when body weight remains stable. However, the manufacturer does not provide a specific clinical longevity range. Longevity: not provided by manufacturer. Shelf Life Not provided by manufacturer in publicly available documentation. Safety Notes / Contraindications Users should always consult the latest manufacturer instructions before treatment. Important precautions include: Contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of the formulation. Do not use in areas with active infection, inflammation, or compromised skin integrity. Administration into non-target tissues may increase the risk of adverse reactions. Temporary swelling, tenderness, bruising, redness, and localized discomfort may occur following treatment. It is important to note that desoface swelling is commonly reported as a temporary post-treatment response and should be assessed and managed by the treating practitioner according to clinical protocols. Regulatory Status Manufacturer: Love Cosmedical SRL (Italy). CE Marked medical-aesthetic product according to distributor and manufacturer-aligned documentation. Professional-use product. UKCA status: Verify via current manufacturer IFU, distributor documentation, or product packaging. FDA status: No publicly accessible FDA approval information identified for DesoFace. Frequently Asked Questions 1. How does DesoFace work? DesoFace contains sodium deoxycholate, which disrupts adipocyte cell membranes. Once fat cells are broken down, their contents are gradually processed and removed through the body’s natural metabolic pathways. The formulation also includes caffeine and horsetail extract, which are commonly incorporated into lipolytic formulations. 2. What areas can be treated with DesoFace? Publicly available manufacturer-aligned information identifies the cheeks, double chin, jowls, and neck as primary treatment areas. These regions are often selected when localized adiposity affects facial definition and contour. Treatment suitability should always be determined by a qualified healthcare professional. 3. Is swelling normal after treatment? Yes. Temporary desoface swelling , redness, tenderness, and bruising are commonly reported local reactions following lipolytic treatments. The degree and duration vary according to treatment area, patient characteristics, and treatment volume. Patients should follow all aftercare instructions provided by their practitioner. 4. How many treatment sessions are usually required? The manufacturer does not specify a fixed number of sessions in publicly available documentation. Manufacturer-aligned sources indicate treatments are commonly spaced every 5–6 weeks, and visible improvement may occur after the first or second treatment session. 5. How does DesoFace compare with DesoBody? Both products belong to the Love Cosmedical lipolytic range and use sodium deoxycholate as their primary active ingredient. DesoFace contains 0.5% sodium deoxycholate and is intended for facial areas, whereas DesoBody contains a higher concentration and is intended for larger body areas. Product selection should be based on the treatment area and practitioner assessment.

short_description: The FMS Fine Micro Syringe 32G 0.3 ml offers aesthetic practitioners a precision-engineered tool for controlled delivery of injectable products such as skin boosters, polynucleotides, and mesotherapy cocktails . Its ultra-fine 32G needle enables smooth insertion and reduces patient discomfort, making it ideal for delicate treatment zones including the periorbital and perioral areas. description: Clinical Description FMS Fine Micro Syringe 32G 0.3 ml is a sterile, single-use medical device designed for high-precision intradermal and subcutaneous injections commonly used in aesthetic medicine, mesotherapy, and micro-injection protocols . Each syringe features an ultra-thin 32-gauge needle (8 mm length) attached to a 0.3 ml low-dead-space barrel , ensuring consistent dose control and minimal product waste. The device is CE-marked and manufactured under ISO 13485-certified quality standards. Its smooth plunger and tight-fit design allow practitioners to perform precise micro-bolus or linear-thread injections with reduced extrusion force. Intended exclusively for use by qualified healthcare professionals, the syringe is latex-free, non-toxic, and pyrogen-free . What FMS Fine Micro Syringe 32G 0.3 ml Is Similar To Clinically, FMS Fine Micro Syringe shares comparable performance characteristics with TSK Syringes and Terumo insulin syringes used in aesthetic and medical settings. All are designed for precision injections, but FMS syringes are optimised for low-dead-space design , minimising product loss during mesotherapy or filler delivery. While TSK and Terumo may offer slightly different plunger resistance and barrel materials, injection accuracy, sterility assurance, and safety standards remain equivalent under CE-certified conditions. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications As per the manufacturer’s IFU, this syringe may be used for intradermal and subcutaneous delivery of injectable solutions under medical supervision. Typical aesthetic treatment areas include: Face and neck (mesotherapy) Periorbital and perioral zones Décolletage and hands Scalp (trichology applications) Specific treatment areas may vary depending on the injectable used. Always follow the product’s official IFU. Some practitioners apply this syringe for mesotherapy and skin-booster delivery; this technique is not part of the manufacturer’s official IFU. Ingredient List As a medical-grade disposable device, FMS Fine Micro Syringe does not contain pharmacologically active ingredients. Components: Medical-grade polypropylene barrel and plunger Stainless-steel 32G (0.23 mm × 8 mm) needle Synthetic rubber gasket (latex-free) Silicone-coated needle for smooth penetration Sterilised by ethylene oxide gas Presentation & Longevity Packaging: Box of 100 individually sterile blister-packed syringes Volume: 0.3 ml per syringe Needle: 32G × 8 mm, pre-attached Shelf life: typically 5 years from manufacture date (not provided by manufacturer) Longevity: single use only; discard after one procedure Safety Notes / Contraindications Use of the FMS Fine Micro Syringe is contraindicated in: Patients with known hypersensitivity to stainless steel or synthetic rubber components Presence of active skin infection or inflammation at injection site Re-use of device or compromised sterility (seal damaged / expired) Always dispose of used syringes in approved sharps containers in accordance with local clinical waste regulations. Regulatory Status Classification: Sterile Class IIa medical device (under MDD 93/42/EEC or MDR 2017/745) Marking: CE mark indicating compliance with European safety standards Quality System: ISO 13485-certified manufacturing process Manufacturer: FMS Co., Ltd (Korea) / distributed via UK registered medical suppliers Regulatory classification not specified in public documentation; verify on product packaging or the manufacturer’s IFU. It offers exceptional needle sharpness, low dead space, and minimal injection resistance , allowing efficient product delivery with less waste. Yes, FMS Fine Micro Syringe is CE-certified as a sterile Class IIa medical device and complies with EU and UK medical device standards .

description: Prostrolane Blanc B is an injectable skin booster / dermal filler developed by Caregen Co., Ltd., formulated to support skin revitalisation and tone improvement. Prostrolane Blanc B is primarily positioned for professional aesthetic use where concerns include uneven skin tone, dull appearance, and early signs of photoaging. Provides moisture to help counteract dryness associated with traditional retinoid-based products. If you are pregnant, breast feeding or planning to become pregnant, consult a doctor before use.

description: 8% NeoGlucosamine, 0.1% Retinol, Antioxidant Complex, UVA/UVB Filters. A day cream targeting the skin’s hydrating matrix to firm the skin’s appearance and repair the look of fine lines and wrinkles. Visibly improves skin texture and uneven skin tone. This multi-purpose anti-wrinkle day cream acts as the ultimate anti-ageing arsenal for mature skin. Matrix Support improves skin texture and uneven tone while helping skin look firmer and healthier. It features ultimate anti-ageing ingredients (Retinol and NeoGlucosamine) with broad-spectrum SPF 30 sun protection for prevention and protection. This luxurious, medium-weight day cream is designed to target skin’s hydrating matrix, this cream addresses advanced visible wrinkles and lack of firmness, while providing clarity of discolourations and renewing texture.NeoGlucosamine: A non-acid amino sugar that alleviates discolouration for a more even skin tone while diminishing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for dry, normal and oily skin types.

input_title: Skin Active Triple Firming Neck Cream With MicroDiPeptide229®
page_title: Skin Active Triple Firming Neck Cream With MicroDiPeptide229®
description: A supercharged, triple-action neck cream formulated with breakthrough MicroDiPeptide 229® to reduce visible signs of ageing on the neck and decolletage for a visibly firmer, smoother, more even toned appearance.

jsonld.name: Skin Active Triple Firming Neck Cream With MicroDiPeptide229®
jsonld.description:
A supercharged, triple-action neck cream formulated with breakthrough MicroDiPeptide229® to reduce visible signs of ageing on the neck and decolletage for a visibly firmer, smoother, more even toned appearance.
An award-winning neck cream that just got even better. Target neck lines and creases in just 2 weeks* with this all-new formula now featuring breakthrough MicroDiPeptide229@  – NEOSTRATA’s patented lifting and firming peptide technology, 2.5x times smaller than other leading cosmetic peptides allowing for optimised delivery into skin’s surface – plus a next-level combination of NeoGlucosamine, Bakuchiol (a plant-derived Retinol alternative) NeoCitriate® and Vitamin E.
 
More than just a moisturiser, this fast-absorbing neck cream is specially formulated to target delicate skin on the neck and decolletage area. This neck cream targets lack of firmness, crepey skin texture, lines, wrinkles, sagging skin and surface discolouration for an overall firmer, smoother appearance with a visibly lifted, more sculpted look. Don't neglect your neck, it is often the first area to show signs of ageing and tech-neck wrinkles (the horizontal lines and wrinkles caused from staring down at your smart device.)
Ideal for anyone seeking a more even-toned, firmer, lifted appearance for the delicate neck area. This potent anti-ageing neck cream is ideal for dry, normal and oily skin types.
Fragrance-free • Absorbs quickly • Non-irritating • Non-greasy • Non-sticky • Gentle on skin • Doesn’t transfer onto clothes • Does not rub off or ‘ball’
 
Key Ingredients:


0.1% MicroDiPeptide229® - Unique lifting and firming peptide that penetrates skin’s surface and targets 5 key components of skin’s matrix, including Collagen, Hyaluronic Acid, and Elastin, to visibly lift and sculpt.

8% NeoGlucosamine - Gently exfoliates to promote skin’s natural turnover process, while fading the appearance of discolouration

4% NeoCitriate - Targets skin’s collagen to visibly firm skin

0.5% Bakuchiol - A natural retinol alternative, visibly brightens skin’s surface and smooths the look of lines and wrinkles

0.5% Vitamin E - Provides nourishing antioxidant protection from drying environmental aggressors

description: A high-strength gel that combines active brighteners, Butyl Resorcinol, Kojic Acid and Vitamin C, to help reduce the appearance of existing pigmentation and discourage new spots from forming. An AHA/PHA blend helps exfoliate skin and spots, while Liquorice Extract enhances brightness. 10% AHA/PHA Blend, Butyl Resorcinol, Kojic Acid, Vitamin C Spot-on correction! Get even with this targeted treatment gel, formulated to address dark spots with a 10% Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA)/Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) exfoliating blend, and powerful antioxidant chelators to help trap the metals that can cause uneven skin tone. Plus, a blend of Vitamin C, Kojic Acid and Liquorice Root Extract to help promote brightness and a more even complexion. This is not for use on the entire face and should be applied directly to noticeable dark spots on the skin. Glycolic Acid: Known to be the workhorse of the AHA family for those looking to really retexture and refine their skin’s surface! Citric Acid: Found naturally in citrus fruits and is a powerful Alpha/Beta Hydroxy Acid that has antioxidant and corrective antiaging effects, helping to minimise the visible signs of photodamage. This AHA/BHA gives the added benefit of being a powerful antioxidant to help protect skin against the visible signs of oxidative stress and make skin appear more youthful. Gluconolactone: Found naturally in the skin and provides antiageing and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. Gluconolactone strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits. Lactobionic Acid: Part of the PHA family and is also non-irritating. This ingredient is known as a "Bionic Acid" and is derived from natural sugars. The Bionics are potent antioxidants that have been shown to target naturally-occurring skin degrading enzymes to help maintain a youthful look. 1% Kojic Acid, Ascorbic Acid (Pure Vitamin C) & Licorice Root Extract: Powerful skin brightening antioxidants that help promote brightness and a more even complexion. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Oil-free. Fragrance-free. Non-Hydroquinone.

description: A high strength AHA cleanser featuring Glycolic Acid, known to visibly even skin tone. Designed to exfoliate and cleanse congested pores. Not suitable for sensitive skin Foams up and glows all the way! Discover more than just a cleanser, but a solution designed for skin renewal and preparation in one simple step. This award-winning maximum strength foam cleanser features Glycolic Acid, known to visibly even skin tone, and is formulated to retexture the skin’s surface helping to cleanse clogged pores and lightly exfoliate skin’s surface, preparing the skin for optimal benefits of the regimen that follows. It features a smart delivery system to provide the benefits of Glycolic Acid and L-bionic Acid while minimising the potential for irritation. Get ready to get glowing with Glycolic Acid! Glycolic Acid: A natural component of sugar cane, known to visibly even skin tone. Glycolic Acid is also known to be the workhorse of the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family for those looking to really retexture and refine their skin’s surface. 2% Lactobionic Acid: Part of the Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) family and derived from natural sugars. Lactobionic Acid helps to reduce the appearance of lines and wrinkles, discoloration, enlarged pores and roughness through gentle exfoliation, while also attracting moisture for added hydration and comfort. For those seeking to boost their regimen with a high strength exfoliating cleanser, Foaming Glycolic Wash is a sure way to step up your Glycolic Regimen. If you are new to NEOSTRATA®, try our NEOSTRATA® SKIN ACTIVE Exfoliating Wash as our starter foaming wash and move to Foaming Glycolic Wash as your tolerance increases. Suitable for dry, normal and oily skin types.

A favourite amongst long-time NEOSTRATA customers, this highly potent, silky cream is formulated to reduce the appearance of uneven skin tone and help regenerate and revitalise skin damaged from cumulative UV exposure while helping to prevent future damage. Repeated use will leave your skin smoothly textured and healthier-looking. 18% Glycolic Acid: known to help even skin tone, is a natural component of sugar cane that normalises the skin’s exfoliation process, refining the appearance of pore size and smoothing the look of fine lines and wrinkles as it retexturises skin. Lactobionic Acid: part of the Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) family and is derived from natural sugars. Vitamin E: Antioxidant protection helps fight future damage. High Potency Cream is our step-up AHA exfoliator and hydrator in one. This high strength treatment is ideal for anyone who is already an experienced Glycolic Acid user, looking to take their AHA regimen to the next level. If you are brand new to Glycolic Acid, we recommend Resurface Glycolic Renewal Serum as the perfect starter AHA treatment. Once Glycolic Renewal Serum is well tolerated, consider graduating your evening regimen up to High Potency Cream. Appropriate for dry, normal and oily skin types. (Not recommended for sensitive skin types!)

description: Our soap-free, fragrance-free formulation gently yet effectively cleanses and exfoliates without drying or stripping the skin. Suitable for all skin types, this product is especially beneficial in conjunction with therapeutic skin regimens, for patients with sensitive skin or those who have recently undergone an in-office procedure such as microdermabrasion, a chemical peel or a non-ablative laser procedure. Soap-free, fragrance-free. Hypoallergenic. 4% Gluconolactone, Pro-Vitamin B5 Gentle cleanser. Powerful results. Start your skincare routine strong with this soap-free, non-foaming gel facial cleanser, clinically shown to help reduce the look of blotchiness and increase brightness*. Ideal for all skin types including sensitive and reactive skin, this gentle cleanser is formulated with Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA), to gently exfoliate while it cleanses without irritation. This cleanser has been shown to be well tolerated, even by those with sensitive or reactive skin. 4% Gluconolactone (PHA): Found naturally in the skin and provides anti-ageing and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. Sensitive skin types, as well as those who have had recent superficial cosmetic procedures, will find comfort in this molecule’s gentle nature. Gluconolactone strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits. Gluconolactone is a welcome choice for sensitive skin types or following recent superficial cosmetic procedures where the skin can be more sensitive. *The Restore Regimen: twice daily use of PHA Facial Cleanser and Redness Neutralising Serum with PHA Day Cream with SPF and Ultra Moisturising Face Cream daily. PHA Facial Cleanser is perfect for those seeking an anti-ageing facial cleanser that is also gentle enough for dry, sensitive and reactive skin. This non-foaming gel formulation effectively removes makeup and impurities without irritation.

description: A skin-fortifying moisturiser for face and body designed to soothe dry, reactive skin. Lightweight feel, high strength action! This mild, non-irritating lotion is designed to soothe dry, reactive skin for face and body. Formulated with a powerful 15% Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) blend which acts as a humectant, attracting and binding moisture to the skin. Formulated to gently exfoliate, smoothing the rough, dry skin on the face and body while providing restorative antioxidants to help protect against environmental factors. Gluconolactone: a Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) that is found naturally in the skin and provides anti-ageing and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. It is a welcome choice for sensitive skin types as it strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits. Lactobionic Acid: part of the Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) family and is derived from natural sugars. It helps to reduce the appearance of lines and wrinkles, discoloration, enlarged pores and roughness through gentle exfoliation, while also attracting moisture for added hydration and comfort. Looking for lightweight, deep hydration and gentle exfoliation for face, hands and body? You'll love Bionic Lotion. This high strength PHA formula delivers moisture to dry, sensitive skin in a light lotion format, and is a great alternative to heavier face creams for those living in hot or humid climates. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Fragrance-free.

description: A gel facial wash for oily skin. Formulated with PHA and Salicylic Acid to help clarify pores and improve skin texture. Cleanse and clarify! Suds up with this soap-free foaming gel facial cleanser, formulated with Mandelic Acid, a gentle yet effective Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) that is ideal for exfoliating oily skin. It also contains Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) and Salicylic Acid, known to help clarify pores and improve skin texture. Wash away excess oil and problematic bacteria and reveal smoother, more clarified-looking skin! Mandelic Acid: found naturally in almonds and is a lipophilic, oil-loving Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA), making it ideal for use on oily skin. Mandelic Acid also reduces the look of oily shine over time. This is the perfect AHA for oily and blemish-prone skin types. Gluconolactone: a Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) that is found naturally in the skin and provides anti-ageing and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. It is a welcome choice for sensitive skin types as it strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits. Salicylic Acid: clarifies pores, exfoliates, reduces oiliness and reduces pore appearance. If you experience oily shine and blemish-prone skin, Mandelic Clarifying Cleanser is the perfect start to your daily skincare regimen. Formulated with oil-soluble Mandelic Acid, Mandelic Clarifying Cleanser is designed to exfoliate and clarify pores, leaving skin feeling refreshed and ready to take on the day. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Soap-free. Fragrance-free. description: This clarifying solution contains Alpha Hydroxy Acid to gently exfoliate, help clear clogged pores and remove excess surface oil, sebum and other lipids present on blemish-prone skin. Use after cleansing or throughout the day to freshen skin. Fragrance-free. 8% Glycolic Acid Hit refresh! This pore minimising toner is formulated to exfoliate, clarify and help tighten pores. The hydroalcoholic solution contains 8% Glycolic Acid, an Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA), to exfoliate skin and target clogged pores and excess surface oil. This high strength AHA formula is designed to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and is ideal for oily or oily-prone skin with early signs of ageing. 8% Glycolic Acid: known to even skin tone, is a natural component of sugar cane that normalises the skin’s exfoliation process refining the appearance of pore size and smoothing the look of fine lines and wrinkles as it retexturises skin. Glycolic Acid is known to be the workhorse of the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family for those looking to really retexture and refine their skin’s surface. Clarify Oily Skin Solution is a Glycolic Acid toner for oily and blemish-prone skin types. Glycolic Acid is known to help exfoliate at the skin's surface to help keep pores clear of problematic debris that can lead to congestion and blemishes. Oily Skin Solution is not recommended for those with sensitive skin. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Non-comedogenic. Non-acnegenic. Oil-free. Fragrance-free.

description: This extra-strength formulation is ideal for experienced users of Glycolic Acid and those who prefer a light, non-greasy and fast-absorbing gel suitable for oily, blemish-prone skin or hot, humid climates. Glycolic Acid helps correct the visible signs of photo-ageing such as enlarged pores, uneven texture and pigment. As a highly effective exfoliant, this formula can also be used to help relieve ingrown hairs associated with pseudofolliculitis barbae. Fragrance-free. 15% Glycolic Acid Amplfied anti-ageing for oily skin types! Featuring 15% Glycolic Acid, this lightweight gel is designed for experienced users of Glycolic Acid. The lightweight silky gel is formulated for powerful skin-smoothing results! It helps to reduce the appearance of enlarged pores, while smoothing the appearance of rough texture and evening skin tone. Suitable for oily skin that may be prone to breakouts and ideal for use in hot, humid climates. 15% Glycolic Acid: known to even skin tone, is a natural component of sugar cane that normalises the skin’s exfoliation process refining the appearance of pore size and smoothing the look of fine lines and wrinkles as it retexturises skin. Glycolic Acid is known to be the workhorse of the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family for those looking to really retexture and refine their skin’s surface. Gel Plus is a daily treatment gel that targets oily and blemish-prone skin concerns, as well as helping visibly improve signs of skin ageing like fine lines and uneven skin tone. If you are looking for a daily exfoliator, add this Glycolic Acid treatment to your list! Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Fragrance-free. Oil-free.
