description: This concentrated daily-use serum restores skin radiance and amplifies the benefits of other anti-ageing products across all key photo ageing parameters, including fine lines, wrinkles, pore size, laxity and mottled pigmentation. Lactobionic Acid, a potent antioxidant, both builds skin’s support matrix and protects it by inhibiting MMP, the enzyme that breaks down collagen. description: Bring new life to stressed skin with our Gentle Daily Exfoliating Pads that work to shed dry, dull surface layers and reveal a radiant complexion with a youthful skin glow. Our skin-loving formula contains a blend of PHAs, which are gentle enough for all skin types, and effectively exfoliate to brighten your skin. Infused with a daily dose of antioxidants Vitamin C + E, Green Tea and Cucumber Extracts, formulated to lightly hydrate and protect your skin against daily environmental aggressors. Dye free. Formulated without parabens. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. 60 pads. These replace the SkinRise Morning Glow but they are the same formulation. Key Ingredients: Polyhydroxy Acids (PHAs): non-irritating, gentle exfoliators that are ideal for any skin type, including sensitive skin. PHAs improve skin texture, even skin tone and reduce the appearance of pores. Gluconolactone: found naturally in the skin and provides anti-ageing and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. Sensitive skin types, as well as those who have had recent superficial cosmetic procedures, will find comfort in this molecule’s gentle nature. Gluconolactone strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits. Gluconolactone is a welcome choice for sensitive skin types or following recent superficial cosmetic procedures where the skin can be more sensitive. Lactobionic Acid: part of the PHA family and are also non-irritating. These ingredients are known as "Bionic Acids" and are derived from natural sugars. They help to reduce the appearance of lines and wrinkles, discolouration, enlarged pores and roughness through gentle exfoliation. The bionics are potent antioxidants that have been shown to target naturally-occurring, skin degrading enzymes to help maintain a youthful look. The bionics are medically coveted because they are super powered chelators and humectants, protecting skin and attracting moisture to the delicate barrier for added hydration boosting and comfort. The bionics are the key choice for very dehydrated, parched and dry skin types. Cucumber Extract: Known to soothe stressed skin. Green Tea Extract & Vitamin C + E: Provide antioxidant protection. For anyone seeking a first time exfoliator, or just a gentle, daily exfoliant used twice daily to prepare your skin for the rest of your skincare routine.

description: Retinol Treatment with Nourishing Centella Asiatica0.3% Retinol, 4% Niacinamide, 2% NeoGlucosamine, Centella Asiatica, Hyaluronic AcidThis potent serum minimises the look of age spots and wrinkles while delivering hydration through a unique blend of anti-ageing, brightening and nourishing ingredients including NeoGlucosamine to synergistically target skin’s turnover and support smoother looking skin.Suitable for Normal, Dry and Oily Skin Retinol + nourishment + hydration = an all-new sensation! Retinol serum, reinvented! This next-generation formula packs all the potent benefits you love from Retinol while helping minimise irritation to reveal smoother, hydrated, more even-looking skin. It's lightweight, non-greasy formula glides on skin smoothly and melts right into skin, leaving a soft, radiant finish. This innovative serum is designed to visibly minimise age spots and wrinkles with a powerful formulation of 0.3% Pure Retinol, 4% Niacinamide and 2% NeoGlucosamine, while boosting nourishment and hydration with Centella Asiatica and Hyaluronic Acid. 0.3% Pure Retinol: A form of the powerful antioxidant Vitamin A. It’s one of dermatologists’ go-to ingredients for wrinkles, sun damage, enlarged pores and more. As a prime exfoliator, Retinol increases skin turnover, so the skin is continually sloughing off dull cells, revealing healthy, more radiant skin below. Retinol also targets collagen, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. 4% Niacinamide: Reduces appearance of age spots. 2% NeoGlucosamine: Known to visibly firm skin. Gently exfoliates to smooth the look of fine lines and wrinkles and improve the appearance of photo aged skin. Centella Asiatica (Tigergrass): Botanical antioxidant soothes and balances reactive dehydrated skin while protecting against drying environmental aggressors. Hyaluronic Acid: Acts as a potent humectant that delivers plumping hydration. Suitable for dry, normal and oily skin types. This product is ideal for those who want the powerful anti-ageing benefits of Retinol while minimising the potential for irritation that's associated with traditional Retinol formulas. Fragrance-free. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Tested on all skin tones.

jsonld.name: Exfoliating & Conditioning Foot Balm
jsonld.description:
Smooth your soles. Reveal silky-smooth feet (without unsightly peeling or flaking). This luxurious at-home treatment exfoliates rough, dry, scaly skin on feet and heels with a powerful 20% AHA/PHA blend.
Meet the No Peel Foot Peel! Get silky-smooth feet all year round with this high strength exfoliating and conditioning foot balm. It offers all the benefits of a traditional foot peel with none of the unsightly peeling or flaking. This powerful yet comforting formula features a 20% AHA/PHA blend to exfoliate dry, rough, scaly skin and Vitamin E with rich emollients to smooth and moisturise. Its luxurious, non-greasy texture melts beautifully into skin and imparts a soft, radiant finish. Treat yourself to this luxurious at-home spa experience up to twice daily or whenever needed for a quick pick-me-up. Just sit back, relax and let it reveal renewed, comforted, silky-smooth feet and heels!
Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs): 15% blend of Glycolic Acid, Lactic Acid and Mandelic Acid
• Glycolic Acid: A natural component of sugar cane, known to visibly even skin tone. Glycolic Acid is also known to be the workhorse of the Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA) family for those looking to really retexture and refine their skin’s surface.
• Mandelic Acid: Found naturally in almonds and is a lipophilic, oil-loving Alpha Hydroxy Acid (AHA), making it ideal for use on oily skin. Mandelic Acid also reduces the look of oily shine over time. This is the perfect AHA for oily and blemish-prone skin types.
Polyhydroxy Acids (PHAs): 5% blend of Gluconolactone and Maltobionic Acid
• Gluconolactone: A Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) that is found naturally in the skin and provides antiaging and gentle exfoliating benefits without sun sensitivity. It is a welcome choice for sensitive skin types as it strengthens the skin’s moisture barrier leaving it more resilient, while also providing potent antioxidant benefits.
• Maltobionic Acid: Are part of the PHA family and are also non-irritating. This ingredient is known as a "Bionic Acid" and is derived from natural sugars. They help to reduce the appearance of lines and wrinkles, discolouration, enlarged pores and roughness through gentle exfoliation. The Bionics are potent antioxidants that have been shown to target naturally-occurring, skin degrading enzymes to help maintain a youthful look. The Bionics are medically coveted because they are super powered chelators and humectants, protecting skin and attracting moisture to the delicate barrier for added hydration boosting and comfort. The Bionics are the key choice for very dehydrated, parched and dry skin types.
Vitamin E: An antioxidant with conditioning benefits.
This Exfoliating &amp; Conditioning Foot Balm is ideal for anyone with dry or scaly skin on their feet that would like to improve the appearance, while conditioning and comforting for smoother, healthier-looking skin.
Dermatology and Allergy tested. Fragrance-free.

description: Receive 5% off when you purchase 6 units or receive 10% off when you purchase 12 units. This discount will be automatically applied at checkout. A form-fitting biocellulose mask designed to provide immediate intense hydration and plumping benefits. Reveals instantly hydrated, smooth, supple and luminous skin. It's like a hug of hydration for your face. This Hyaluronic Acid mask with Caffeine floods skin with instant plumping hydration. Derived from nourishing coconut water, this form-fitting, no-budge biocellulose mask adheres to skin, allowing freedom of movement while enhancing product absorption to reveal instantly hydrated, smooth, supple and luminous skin. Recommended for all skin types, including dehydrated, sensitive skin. This is the perfect self care pick-me-up moment for anytime, anywhere. The Pick-Me-Up Plumping Mask is an excellent pre-makeup prep step to help infuse your skin with instant hydration. Apply it before your moisturiser and foundation to achieve a smooth, plump, dewy makeup look. Even take it with you on the go for a luxurious mid-flight treatment or a quick boost of hydration when you arrive to your destination. Hyaluronic Acid: A potent humectant that helps replenish skin's moisture. Caffeine: A blood vessel thinning agent which may reduce blood flow (reduce redness), increase skin brightening, and reduce puffiness under eyes. This mask is great for anyone looking to give their skin a quick boost of moisture. Approved for all skin types, including dehydrated, sensitive skin.

description: Clinisoothe+ Skin Purifier protects and purifies your skin from environmental pollutants that cause ageing, breakouts and irritation. Our formula uses advanced hypochlorous technology which soothes and calms the skin on the face and body, balancing redness and promoting rapid skin recovery, with visible results. We recognise that skin problems are unique, and for some people, they don't just affect the face. This is why our gentle formula has a skin neutral pH and can be applied anywhere on the face or body where breakouts, irritation and redness occur. Hypochlorous has an oxidising method of action which cleanses and provides purifying antimicrobial protection, but is also gentle on the skin: it doesn’t harm, irritate or sensitise the dermal layer. Clinisoothe+ has a skin neutral pH, is non-toxic, contains no alcohol and is non-cytotoxic to re-growing skin cells. It is clinically formulated and dermatologically tested to guarantee its safety on even the most sensitive skin.

description: Radiance Refining Mask exfoliates dull, dehydrated skin cells and promotes cellular rejuvenation to help improve skin texture and deliver a smoother, brighter complexion. In addition, it draws out skin impurities and detoxifies skin while calming and soothing to minimise any irritation associated with chemical exfoliation. Features a blend of 15% Alpha Hydroxy Acids that allows for optimal exfoliation while also containing ingredients that calm and soothe the skin. This mask also uniquely purifies, detoxifies and energises skin revealing a fresh, healthy glow. Can be used on normal, oily, dry or combination skin types and mature skin. Not recommended for sensitive skin. Ideal for normal to dry skin to help remove dead, dehydrated skin cell buildup and great for combination and oily skin types to help keep skin smooth and clear. Can also be used as a pre- treatment mask to prep the skin for enhanced treatment results.

description: This concentrated daily-use serum restores skin radiance and amplifies the benefits of other anti-ageing products across all key photo ageing parameters, including fine lines, wrinkles, pore size, laxity and mottled pigmentation. Lactobionic Acid, a potent antioxidant, both builds skin’s support matrix and protects it by inhibiting MMP, the enzyme that breaks down collagen. Can be applied to target areas such as eyes or around mouth, as an all-over facial treatment, used alone or layered under other products. Oil-free, fragrance-free. Hypoallergenic. Ideal for use post-procedure. 10% Lactobionic Acid, Vitamins A, C and E Revive your skin's radiance! This radiance and texture face serum is formulated to help correct the signs of photo ageing including enhanced radiance, intense moisturisation and overall clarity. Featuring 10% Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA), a potent antioxidant to help replenish skin’s moisture barrier and protect against environmental factors. This bionic serum is designed to create a protective layer to help restore skin's youthful appearance. 10% PHA (Lactobionic Acid): part of the Polyhydroxy Acid (PHA) family and derived from natural sugars. It helps to reduce the appearance of lines and wrinkles, discolouration, enlarged pores and roughness through gentle exfoliation, while also attracting moisture for added hydration and comfort. Ideal for anyone desiring an anti-ageing face treatment that's gentle enough for dry, sensitive skin. Dermatologist & Allergy tested. Fragrance-free.

description: SuneKOS® 1200 is formulated with medium–high molecular weight hyaluronic acid combined with the patented HY6AA amino acid cluster, designed to provide structural support and antioxidant protection for the extracellular matrix (ECM). By strengthening the dermal scaffold and protecting fibroblasts from oxidative stress, 1200 helps reduce inflammageing, restore density, and support skin resilience. While it contributes to overall ECM regeneration, SuneKOS 1200’s primary role is to act as a foundation for subsequent rejuvenation treatments, preparing the skin for enhanced results with SuneKOS Performa. It is clinically indicated for deeper wrinkles, skin laxity, and volume loss, helping practitioners address structural concerns while maintaining natural, long-lasting results. SuneKOS is intended for use by Registered Health Care Professionals only.

SuneKOS is intended for use by Registered Health Care Professionals only.

jsonld.description:
Advanced Anti-Ageing: Reduce Wrinkles &amp; Boost Radiance with Retinol + Vitamin C







Stimulates collagen production
Enhances skin firmness
Reduces appearance of fine lines
Boost natural glow

Priori is expanding its professional skincare range with Age Renew Glow Serum, a high-performance serum that merges RETINOL, AHA (Lactic Acid), and Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid). Developed in close collaboration with dermatological researchers and certified skincare professionals, the serum is designed to deliver visible results in a safe, skin-friendly way.
AN EFFECTIVE BOOST FOR HEALTHY SKIN
Age Renew Glow Serum combines clinically proven ingredients to counteract signs of ageing, improve skin texture, and restore a youthful glow.

RETINOL 0.15%: Stimulates collagen production, enhances skin firmness, and reduces fine lines.
AHA (Lactic Acid): Gently exfoliates, renews the skin’s surface, evens out skin tone, and boosts natural glow.
VITAMIN C (L-Ascorbic Acid) &amp; GRAPEFRUIT EXTRACT: Protects the skin against free radicals while brightening and enhancing skin radiance.

POWERFUL, YET GENTLE FORMULATION
What makes Age Renew Glow Serum unique is its gentle yet powerful combination of Vitamin C, Retinol, and AHA — some of the most sought-after ingredients in skincare, blended in a balanced formula to maximise results without compromising skin comfort. The result is firmer, smoother, and more radiant-looking skin.
Retinol warning: This product contains retinol, which may increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun. Use sunscreen and limit sun exposure while using this product. Avoid using this product if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting a healthcare professional. Discontinue use if irritation, redness, or excessive dryness occurs.

Alongside updated packaging and naming, the formulation has been refined by replacing two cyclic silicones with a non-silicone alternative in line with EU compliance requirements. Formulated with advanced DNA repair enzymes, this hydrating treatment helps support the skin’s natural recovery process from daily environmental damage. Its nourishing formula helps soothe, hydrate and protect the skin throughout the day and night for complete 24-hour care. Powered by Butterfly Bush Extract (Soliberine®) to help defend against modern environmental aggressors, alongside Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamins C & E to help hydrate, smooth and support healthier-looking skin. Delivers a soft, comfortable finish without leaving an oily residue. Suitable for use alone or as the final step in your skincare routine to lock in moisture and enhance skin comfort.

1 x vial of 50 units of Merz botulinum toxin

Bocouture is a prescription only medicine manufactured by Merz and is a non-fridge line toxin. It works by blocking the nerve impulses in all injected muscles. jsonld.description:
50 x 2.2ml ampoules

2% lidocaine with 1:80,000 epinephrine injection solution.

available on prescription only

Lignospan Special is given by injection to cause loss of feeling before and during dental procedures. It contains two active ingredients: Lignocaine hydrochloride, a local anaesthetic to prevent the pain, and adrenaline tartrate, a vasoconstrictor, which makes it, last longer (Adrenaline narrows the blood vessels at the site of injection, which keeps the anaesthetic where it’s needed for a longer time) and controls bleeding during the surgery.

jsonld.name: Aqualyx 10 x 8ml
jsonld.description:
Aqualyx® is a non-surgical solution to minimize and remove stubborn localized pockets of fat. 

This technique, known as Aqualysis™ or Aquaplasty™, consists of injecting the solution into localised fat deposits. Aqualyx® consists of phosphatidylcholine – a natural substance which, when given in higher doses, can cause the destruction of fat cells.

Destroying the fat cells is a long-term solution provided you retain a stable weight, eat healthily and continue exercise as usual. Aqualyx® leads to a permanent reduction of fatty tissue; once removed, fat cells will not reappear. 

Aqualyx® can be used on the following areas:

  • Stomach (inc. six pack definition)
  • Love handles
  • Arms
  • Chin
  • Flanks and waist
  • Inner and outer thighs
  • Underarms and armpits
  • Under-bra area

jsonld.description:
The Aesthetic Emergency Response kit has been designed specifically for use within the aesthetic setting to assist aesthetic practitioners with complications which could occur during your day to day aesthetic practice. The AER kit contains quality supplies and is adaptable to suit individual and organisations' needs.

Please note a prescription is required for the following items: 

(10x 1:1000 Adrenaline ampoules, 10 x Sodium Chloride 0.9% x 10, 1 x hyaluronidase 1500 ampoule)

Contents

10x 1:1000 Adrenaline ampoules

10 x Sodium Chloride 0.9% x 10

1 x hyaluronidase 1500 ampoule

1 box of Cetirizine & 75mg dispersable Aspirin 

1 x Large sterile dressing 7.5cm x 4.5cm 

5 x sterile saline pods topical irrigation solution 20ml

1 x Sterile eye pad dressing 

1 x sterile gallipot

1 x pair Sharp/blunt scissors

1 x Sharps bin (yellow)

1 x pocket face mask in case

1 x pair Nitrile disposable gloves medium 

5 x BD Microlance yellow 30g needles

5 x BD Microlance green 21G needles

5 x BD Microlance blue 21G needles

1 x Adhesive tape

1 x pack safety pins

 1 x Gauze swabs non-sterile 7.5cm x 7.5cm (pack of 100)

1 x Resuscitation face shield

1 x Sterile adhesive dressings 

4 x 1ml sterile luer syringes

4 x 2ml sterile luer syringes

2 x 10ml sterile luer syringes

1 x Foil Blanket 

1 x Reusable Heat/Cold pad

 

Please note a prescription is required for this item

jsonld.description:
Glutathione (GSH) is a powerful antioxidant found within every cell, protecting it from free radicals. The human body produces and stores the largest amount of GSH in the liver, where its used to detoxify harmful compounds. GSH level will decline with age and lacking of GSH will expose the body more vulnerable to damage by free radicals and will speed up its ageing process.

5 x 5ml Vials

INDICATIONS

  • Skin rejuvenation
  • Photo-aged skin
  • Melasma
  • Brown spots
  • Hyperpigmentation

jsonld.description:

  • Stretch marks

PRX-T33 is a bio-revitalising product that is unique. It is not a peel, nor is it an injectable. Low dose hydrogen peroxide “protects” the tissues and enhances the affinity for the growth factor receptors. TCA at 33% is a powerful peeling agent and without the addition of hydrogen peroxide would cause considerable frosting and peeling for several days. However, the addition of hydrogen peroxide allows the TCA to permeate beneath the epidermis to reach the dermis. At this level it stimulates both keratinocyte and fibroblast growth factor activity. The healing response begins and is accompanied  by a visible improvement immediately after the treatment – but with no pain or downtime.

jsonld.name: Black Diamond LED light therapy facial mask
jsonld.description:
The Black Diamond LED light therapy facial mask is the leading aesthetician recommended LED face mask for home use.

Used by leading aestheticians in the UK. 

Special price for registered aestheticians purchasing via the site : £350

Recommended selling price to client: £450 

Whether its brighter clearer skin, reducing fine lines or giving your face a fuller more youthful appearance the Black Diamond LED light therapy facial mask is the choice for you with visible results in 2-3 weeks.

Features.

Full face coverage and even light distribution. The wearable LED light therapy face mask is a home wearable and rechargeable photon rejuvenation beauty device manufactured from medical grade silicone.

The 186 multipoint LED lights (face 122 LEDs) are distributed evenly throughout the mask to give a close contour fitting thus avoiding deadspots and providing even results.

The adjustable buckle allows for adjustment according to different face sizes. 

Clinically proven light wavelengths.

Each LED emits at 4 clinical different wavelengths and at three different energy levels.

Blue Light – 415nm – acne. Reduces acne producing bacteria, reduces inflammation and scars. Purifies problem areas and balances oil production.

Yellow light – 590 nm - skin rejuvenation. Diminishes age spots, balances skin texture, stimulates red blood cells, reduces swelling and fine lines. Can be used as part of a morning or bedtime routine.

Red light – 660 nm – antiaging and skin rejuvenation. Promotes collagen production, skin tightening and increasing elasticity.

Near infra-red light - 850nm – anti ageing and deep repair. Improves blood circulation and increases skin hydration.

Comfort and safety.

LED treatments require 10-20 minutes. Comfortable medical grade silicone that reduces skin irritation. Additional essential features include, built-in eye protection and a default timer of 10 minutes to prevent over use.

Six different treatment modes are available to match different skin types and concerns that actually work for different skin types. Whether you are dealing with sensitive skin or switching between acne and anti-aging treatments. The Black Diamond face is the leading aesthetician recommended LED face mask for home use.

Ease of use and battery life.

 The re-chargeable controller is fully charged in 3 hours. A simple 3 button control is easy to set up and use with six modes to choose from. The user manual is simple and straight-forward to follow. It is important before using for the first time, to perform a light sensitivity test.

jsonld.name: AMI eyes 2ml
jsonld.description:
AMI eyes 2ml
AMI EYES is an advanced tissue stimulator, designed for needle mesotherapy of the eye area and the tear valley with a filling effect, without side effects in the form of lumps or lymphatic stagnation. When applied to the skin, it stimulates it to produce more collagen and elastin. As a result, the structure and appearance of the dermis is significantly improved. In addition, the product supports skin regeneration from the inside.
The secret of this rejuvenating treatment is that AMI Eyes contains Polynucleotide (PDRN) which is safe for human use and has no adverse effects. Instead, it revitalises, energises and moisturises the skin. In fact, it also has a skin lightening effect.
Polynucleotide (PDRN) is obtained by purifying the DNA of salmon family fish. PDRN is a low molecular weight complex that affects the repair of cells and damaged tissues, and homeostasis from within. The mechanism of action of the substance is based on stimulating the active synthesis of collagen, which helps to rebuild DNA chains and increase the production of its own elastin.
 
The package contains:


one pre-filled syringe with a capacity of 2 ml

Product for professional use only.By deciding to purchase, you declare that you are a doctor or cosmetologist trained in aesthetic medicine.

jsonld.description:
BELOTERO Balance - 1 x 1ml
Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Fine Lines, Wrinkle Correction & Natural Facial Rejuvenation
 
What is BELOTERO Balance?
BELOTERO Balance is a professional hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed for smoothing fine lines, correcting moderate wrinkles and enhancing facial rejuvenation treatments. The filler uses CPM® technology to create a smooth injectable gel that distributes evenly within the skin for soft and natural integration.
 
Unlike heavier dermal fillers designed for deep structural support, BELOTERO Balance is formulated specifically for delicate treatment areas and superficial wrinkle correction, making it highly suitable for precision aesthetic treatments.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, BELOTERO Balance is trusted for subtle wrinkle correction and refined facial rejuvenation while preserving natural expression.
 
Its lightweight gel formulation allows seamless integration into the skin for smooth, natural-looking results.
 
Key Benefits 

Advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler
Smooth integration into the skin
Designed for fine lines and moderate wrinkle correction
Supports natural facial movement and expression
Ideal for delicate facial treatment areas
Lightweight injectable gel formulation
Helps soften smile lines and superficial wrinkles
Suitable for subtle lip enhancement treatments
Professional-grade injectable filler
Minimal downtime treatment option
Natural-looking facial rejuvenation results


 
Treatment Areas
BELOTERO Balance is commonly used for professional aesthetic treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Nasolabial folds
Perioral lines
Lip border definition
Smile lines
Marionette lines
Tear trough area
Fine facial wrinkles
Superficial facial lines

 
Composition

Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (HA)
Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM®) technology
Sterile injectable gel formulation
Lidocaine-free formulation

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is BELOTERO Balance used for?
BELOTERO Balance is used for fine line correction, wrinkle smoothing, facial rejuvenation, and subtle contour enhancement treatments.
 
Is BELOTERO Balance good for fine lines?
Yes. BELOTERO Balance is specifically designed for superficial and moderate facial lines, making it ideal for delicate wrinkle correction treatments.
 
Does BELOTERO Balance look natural?
Yes. BELOTERO Balance is known for its smooth skin integration and natural-looking results without creating a heavy or overfilled appearance.
 
How long does BELOTERO Balance last?
Results typically last approximately 6–12 months depending on the treatment area, metabolism, and injection technique.
 
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling, bruising, or tenderness following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Clinisept+ Skin 490ml
jsonld.description:
Cleans, calms and protects your skin.
For use in clinic before, during and following an aesthetic procedure to provide optimum skin hygiene and protect against complications without causing irritation.





Clinisept+ Skin applies the latest proprietary hypochlorous technology to ensure high levels of cleansing. Its antimicrobial properties deliver optimal hygiene and protection without stinging or irritation.
Due to its oxidising method of action, Clinisept+ is not susceptible to antimicrobial resistance and is also an effective deodoriser.
The benefits
Cleansing with Clinisept+ Skin provides a far more pleasant experience for your clients than traditional skin cleansers, which can themselves cause redness as well as dry the skin.
Clinisept+ Skin leaves no residue or chemical burden, unlike traditional skin cleansing chemistries. Clinisept+ Skin advanced hypochlorous technology that has a unique oxidising method of action which cleanses and provides antimicrobial protection, but is also gentle on the skin: it doesn’t harm, irritate or sensitise the dermal layer.
Vegan friendly and cruelty free skin care.
Clinisept+ Skin offers a completely new approach to professional skin cleansing that maximises protection against complications and optimises patient outcomes.
Directions for use
Clinisept+ Skin is a ready to use aqueous solution. It should be decanted into a gallipot and then carefully wiped on to the skin using a gauze or pad.
The skin should be thoroughly wetted. It can be used throughout a procedure to keep the skin clean and soothed. Once the procedure is complete, a wetted gauze can be left to soak on the treated area to calm and cool.
Clinisept+ Skin is non-sensitising to the respiratory system and doesn’t irritate the eyes.
Suitable for
Clinisept+ Skin is recommended for use before, during and after all cosmetic and aesthetic procedures to ensure highly effective microbial control and protection against complications. 
It is suitable for use before procedures such as;

Injectables
Microneedling
Microblading
Micropigmentation
Laser Treatments
Peels
Electrocautery
Depilatory

Used after a procedure, it keeps the skin clean and provides the optimum conditions for natural healing to occur. 
Suitable for all skin types
Hypoallergenic and suitable for use on all types of skin including those prone to;

Rosacea
Eczema
Psoriasis
Dermatitis

jsonld.name: DesoFace Fat Dissolver
jsonld.description:
DESO Face is a state-of-the-art fat dissolving injectable product designed to treat those difficult localised pockets of fat. In line with similar injectable treatments like Aqualyx®, the active ingredient is Deoxycholic Acid, proven to reduce fat deposits for the right patients. The product is conveniently separated into a face and body concentration and side effects are minimal. In addition, DESO is known to result in much less swelling than Aqualyx®.
Application
The sterile product used is mixed with local anaesthetic and drawn up into a small syringe. The skin in the treatment area is cleaned then disinfected and the product is injected with a needle. Multiple injections are required per treatment area. The procedure causes minimal pain and lasts around 20-30 minutes, depending on the area(s) treated. You may notice tiny puncture marks and it is common to have localised redness. A compression garment may be recommended, depending on the treated area.

jsonld.description:
Fillmed NCTF 135 - 5 x 3ml
Advanced Polyrevitalising Skin Booster for Hydration, Skin Rejuvenation & Anti-Ageing Treatments
 
What is Fillmed NCTF?
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is an advanced injectable skin revitalisation treatment designed to improve skin hydration, radiance, elasticity and overall skin quality. Developed by Fillmed Laboratories, this professional-grade mesotherapy solution combines hyaluronic acid with a powerful complex of vitamins, amino acids, minerals, coenzymes and antioxidants to support comprehensive skin rejuvenation and anti-ageing treatments.
 
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is widely used across UK aesthetic clinics for treating dull, dehydrated, ageing and tired-looking skin while helping improve skin texture and luminosity with minimal downtime.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers designed to add volume, Fillmed NCTF 135 HA focuses on improving overall skin quality, hydration and revitalisation at the cellular level for healthier, brighter and smoother-looking skin.
 
Key Benefits

Advanced injectable skin revitalisation treatment
Deeply hydrates and revitalises the skin
Helps improve skin texture and elasticity
Supports collagen stimulation and skin regeneration
Contains hyaluronic acid plus 50+ active ingredients
Helps reduce the appearance of fine lines
Improves dull and tired-looking skin
Supports brighter and smoother skin appearance
Popular for preventative anti-ageing treatments
Professional-grade mesotherapy solution
Suitable for face, neck, décolletage and hands
Minimal downtime treatment option

 
Treatment Areas
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is commonly used for professional skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Under-eye area
Cheeks
Forehead
Jawline
Perioral area

 
Composition

Non-cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (5mg/ml)
12 Vitamins
23 Amino Acids
6 Minerals
6 Coenzymes
5 Nucleic Acid Bases
Antioxidants
Sterile injectable solution

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Fillmed NCTF 135 HA used for?
Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is used for skin rejuvenation, hydration, anti-ageing treatments and improving overall skin quality and radiance.
Is Fillmed NCTF 135 HA a skin booster?
Yes. Fillmed NCTF 135 HA is an injectable skin booster and mesotherapy treatment designed to deeply hydrate and revitalise the skin.
What areas can Fillmed NCTF 135 HA treat?
Common treatment areas include the face, neck, décolletage, hands and under-eye area.
Does Fillmed NCTF 135 HA stimulate collagen?
Yes. The hyaluronic acid and polyrevitalising ingredients help support collagen production and fibroblast activity.
How many Fillmed NCTF treatments are recommended?
Many practitioners recommend an initial course of treatments followed by maintenance sessions depending on skin condition and treatment goals.
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling, tenderness or mild bruising following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Fluid-resistant (Type IIR) surgical mask is Recommended for primary, outpatient, community and social care by setting, NHS and independent sector

Type IIR Fluid Repellent
CE Certified to EN 14683 TYPE IIR
High bacterial filtration efficiency (BFE) ≥ 98%
Masks sealed in a pack of 50 for hygiene purposes

Fluid Resistant
High filtration efficacy acc. to EN 14683, Type II R Fluid Resistant. These masks have different layer materials and thicknesses to correctly reach Type II R Mask (EN14683) certification.


Outer layer: polypropylene non-woven fabric, water-repellent effect layer.
Middle layer: High efficiency blown melt.

Melt Blown Fabric Technology
Our masks feature a once-obscure material called melt-blown fabric. It's an extremely fine mesh of synthetic polymer fibres that forms the critical inner filtration layer of a mask, allowing the wearer to breathe while reducing the inflow of possible infectious particles. There are many non-certified medical masks on other marketplaces that do not have this - they are just three layers of non-woven material.

jsonld.name: Gouri Skin Booster
jsonld.description:
GOURI is the 1st liquid type PCL injectable. GOURI rejuvenates our skin through the collagenesis on the entire face.
These features make GOURI a fundamental anti-aging product:

Spreadability: GOURI naturally spreads and regenerates collagen on the entire face.
Easy to Use: GOURI needs only 10 injection points for the entire face
Natural & Sustainable Improvements: GOURI restores the collagen synthesis rate which has decreased due to skin ageing and rejuvenates the skin, making it younger and healthier.

Unlike fillers, GOURI has no microparticles. Microparticle-free composition allows GOURI to be solubilized homogenously in the water, yielding a smoother extrusion force that is acceptable for use of 30G – 35G needles as necessary for injection.
GOURI is injected uniformly into dermal or subdermal layer. GOURI, as a biodegradable polymer, degrades naturally due to hydrolysis. Compared to hyaluronic acid, it has a longer cosmetic performance.
For the best results, three sessions are recommended at 4 week intervals. After the 3 sessions, apply additional 1~2 treatments at 3-6 month interval, depending on patient’s condition.

jsonld.name: Jalupro Classic
jsonld.description:
Jalupro is a sterile re-absorbable injectable solution which acts – as dermal biorevitaliser which can be used for improving skin texture and minimizing evidence of skin wrinkles of the face; – as adjuvant in the physical or chemicals treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, dermabrasion, radiofrequency, dermal filler, botulinum toxin, etc.
Benefits of Jalupro:

Can fix scars
Areas: Face, neck, décolleté, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen, knee region

How long does the result last for?
Results are instant from the first treatment. In general, results last up to 6 months.
 
 
Jalupro® is a professional mesotherapy product for bio revitalisation. Using a combination of sodium hyaluronate (a salt of hyaluronic acid) of inorganic origin and a rich complex of important amino acids, it gradually reduces the appearance of wrinkles, hydrates the skin, and improves its smoothness and appearance in general.
JALUPRO is composed of two small bottles each one containing lyophilised Amino Acids and two vials, each one including Sodium Hyaluronate which must be mixed together with Amino Acids.
This is a sterile, resorbable, injectable solution that acts as a dermal bio revitaliser. It can be used for improving skin texture and minimising evidence of skin wrinkles in the face. Jalupro Amino Acid can be used as an additional step in physical or chemical treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, dermabrasion, radiofrequency and dermal filler. Use Jalupro for photo-aging and anti-aging of the face and body (light and medium degree), stretch marks, preparation, improvement, and prolongation of results for different aesthetic procedures and for pre and post-surgery.

Unlike more volumising dermal fillers, Juvederm Ultra Smile is specifically formulated for delicate lip enhancement and refined contour definition.

Advanced hyaluronic acid lip filler

Lip asymmetry correction

Juvederm Ultra Smile is used for lip enhancement, lip contouring, lip hydration and correction of fine lines around the mouth.

jsonld.description:
Lumi Eyes - 1 x 1ml
Lumi Eyes is a specialised tissue stimulator designed for mesotherapy treatments around the eyes and tear trough area. This product contains polynucleotides, which support tissue regeneration and hydration, helping to improve the overall appearance of the skin.
Formulated with high-quality ingredients, Lumi Eyes works to repair damage to the dermis, offering deep hydration and rejuvenation. It is designed to improve the appearance of dark circles, fine lines, and signs of fatigue. By stimulating collagen and elastin production, this treatment can contribute to a refreshed and revitalised look.
The key ingredient in this skin booster, polynucleotide is known for its ability to support cell regeneration and hydration while promoting a smoother, more even skin texture. PDRN, or Polydeoxyribonucleotide, is a natural compound derived from DNA fragments, often from salmon sperm, known for its regenerative and anti-inflammatory properties. Lumi Eyes also contains glutathione, which provides antioxidant benefits and helps to enhance skin quality.
Lumi Eyes is designed for a gradual, natural-looking improvement. To achieve optimal results, a series of treatments is recommended at four-week intervals. Regular use can support long-term skin health and help to maintain a refreshed, well-rested appearance.
Key Benefits

Targets dark circles and signs of fatigue
Hydrates and revitalises the skin
Supports collagen and elastin production
Aims to improve skin firmness and elasticity
Designed to reduce the appearance of fine lines

Product Details


Brand: Dermaren

Product: Lumi Eyes

Pack Contains: 1 x 1ml pre-filled syringe

Needle Size: 32G x 4mm


Lumi Eyes offers an advanced approach to under-eye rejuvenation, supporting a refreshed and well-rested appearance over time. Regular treatments can help to maintain skin hydration and reduce common concerns associated with ageing and fatigue.
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Fine Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Lips, Fine Lines & Facial Rejuvenation
 
What is LUMIFIL Lite?
LUMIFIL Lite with Lidocaine is a fine hyaluronic acid dermal filler specifically formulated for treating superficial lines, delicate facial areas, and subtle lip enhancement procedures. Developed using advanced cross-linking technology, this lightweight injectable filler provides smooth integration, natural-looking results, and precise contour refinement.
 
Its low viscosity formulation makes LUMIFIL Lite particularly suitable for treating fine lines, perioral wrinkles, crow’s feet, forehead lines, and subtle lip enhancement techniques including the increasingly popular Russian Lip technique.
 
Containing 20mg/ml of purified cross-linked hyaluronic acid alongside 0.3% lidocaine, LUMIFIL Lite helps improve injection comfort while supporting soft, balanced, and natural facial rejuvenation.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners, LUMIFIL Lite is ideal for patients seeking subtle enhancement, smoother skin texture, and refined facial contouring without excessive volume.

Fine hyaluronic acid dermal filler

Ideal for superficial fine lines and wrinkles
Suitable for delicate treatment areas
Supports subtle lip enhancement procedures
Popular for Russian Lip technique treatments
Improved patient comfort with lidocaine
Lightweight injectable formulation

Professional-grade anti-ageing filler treatment

 
Treatment Areas
LUMIFIL Lite is designed for professional aesthetic treatments targeting delicate facial areas and subtle rejuvenation procedures, including:

Fine lines & wrinkles
Crow's feet
Perioral lines
Forehead lines
Lip enhancement
Russian lip technique

LUMIFIL Lite is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional fine dermal filler for subtle facial rejuvenation and delicate contouring treatments. The filler is ideal for patients seeking refreshed and balanced facial enhancement without excessive volume.

20mg/ml Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (HA)
3mg/ml Lidocaine
Phosphate-buffered saline

Microblading eyebrow tweezers are a crucial makeup prep tool that helps create stunning and natural-looking eyebrows. These tweezers are specifically designed for use during microblading procedures, where hair-like strokes are tattooed onto the skin to create fuller and well-defined eyebrows.
But these specialised tweezers aren't only limited to microblading. They're also ideal for shaping and grooming natural eyebrows, ensuring a precise and flawless finish. With their sharp and angled tips, microblading eyebrow tweezers can easily pluck even the shortest and finest hairs.
Moreover, microblading eyebrow tweezers are typically made from high-quality stainless steel, ensuring durability and hygiene. Their non-slip grip handles provide comfort and control, allowing for fewer errors and more precise movements.

In conclusion, whether you're a professional makeup artist or a beauty enthusiast, investing in a good pair of microblading eyebrow tweezers is a wise decision. They're versatile, long-lasting, and essential in achieving the perfect eyebrow look.

jsonld.description:
Profhilo H+L – 1 x 2ml
 
Advanced Hyaluronic Acid Skin Booster for Skin Remodeling, Deep Hydration & Skin Rejuvenation
 
What is Profhilo H+L?
Profhilo H+L is an advanced injectable hyaluronic acid skin booster developed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, firmness and overall skin quality. Using patented NAHYCO™ Hybrid Technology, Profhilo combines both low and high molecular weight hyaluronic acid to stimulate collagen and elastin production while deeply hydrating the skin.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers designed to add volume, Profhilo works as a bio-remodelling treatment that spreads evenly beneath the skin to improve texture, laxity and skin rejuvenation. Its unique stabilised HA formulation delivers intense hydration while supporting natural collagen stimulation for smoother, firmer and more radiant-looking skin, making Profhilo H+L an excellent complement to other aesthetic products and dermal filler procedures.
 
Containing 64mg of hyaluronic acid per 2ml syringe, Profhilo H+L is widely used by aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional skin booster treatment for ageing, dehydrated and lax skin. The treatment is commonly used on the face, neck, hands and other areas affected by reduced skin elasticity and volume loss.



Key Benefits:

Deep skin hydration and rejuvenation
Improves skin firmness and elasticity
Stimulates collagen and elastin production

Helps improve skin laxity and texture
Smooths crepey and dehydrated skin
Non-surgical skin remodelling treatment
Natural-looking anti-ageing results
Advanced NAHYCO™ Hybrid Technology
High concentration hyaluronic acid formula
Suitable for multiple treatment areas


 

Treatment Areas:

Profhilo H+L is designed for professional skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Arms
Malar region
Submalar region
Lower face
Jawline
Overall skin quality improvement

 
Why Buy Profhilo H+L?
Profhilo H+L is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a premium injectable skin booster with proven skin remodelling benefits. Its advanced HA formulation supports natural collagen stimulation while improving hydration, firmness and skin texture with subtle, natural-looking results.
 
Composition:

64mg Hyaluronic Acid per 2ml
Stabilised low molecular weight HA
Stabilised high molecular weight HA
NAHYCO™ Hybrid Technology
Sodium chloride solution

 
FAQs
What is Profhilo H+L used for?Profhilo H+L is used for professional skin booster treatments designed to improve hydration, skin laxity, elasticity and overall skin quality.
 
Is Profhilo a dermal filler?No. Profhilo is not a traditional dermal filler. It is an injectable skin booster designed to improve skin hydration and stimulate collagen production rather than add facial volume.
 
How long do Profhilo results last?Results typically last around 6 months depending on the patient’s skin condition, metabolism and treatment protocol.
 
Does Profhilo stimulate collagen?Yes. Profhilo helps stimulate collagen and elastin production to improve skin firmness, elasticity and hydration.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Its smooth injectable consistency allows practitioners to achieve refined contouring while maintaining natural facial movement and expression.
 
Containing stabilised hyaluronic acid and lidocaine for enhanced patient comfort, Regenovue Deep helps improve facial structure, soften visible lines and support overall facial rejuvenation.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners, Regenovue Deep is suitable for patients seeking subtle enhancement, wrinkle correction and long-lasting facial definition without an overfilled appearance.

Professional-grade anti-ageing filler treatment

 
Treatment Areas

Facial rejuvenation

Regenovue Deep is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional injectable dermal filler for wrinkle correction, facial contouring and natural-looking volume enhancement. Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid – 2 x 5ml vials
 
Advanced Collagen-Stimulating Injectable for Facial Volume Restoration & Long-Lasting Skin Rejuvenation
 
What is Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid?
Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid is an advanced professional collagen biostimulator developed to restore facial volume, improve skin structure and support long-term collagen regeneration. Designed specifically for professional injectable aesthetic treatments, this high-performance collagen-stimulating injectable helps address age-related volume loss, facial hollowing, skin laxity and overall facial rejuvenation.
 
Its advanced formulation contains Poly-L-Lactic Acid (PLLA), a clinically recognised collagen stimulator that works deep within the skin to gradually stimulate collagen production while supporting natural-looking volume restoration and improved facial contour definition.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners across the UK, Sculptra is suitable for professional collagen stimulation treatments targeting facial ageing, structural volume loss, skin firmness concerns and advanced facial rejuvenation protocols.
 
The sterile injectable formulation allows precise professional administration while helping support progressive collagen synthesis, improved facial support and long-lasting rejuvenation.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers, Sculptra works by stimulating the body’s natural collagen production process to gradually improve skin structure and restore youthful facial contours over time.
 
Key Benefits:

Professional collagen-stimulating injectable treatment
Helps restore lost facial volume
Supports natural collagen regeneration
Promotes gradual, natural-looking enhancement
Helps improve skin firmness and elasticity
Supports long-lasting facial rejuvenation
Helps improve facial contour definition
Professional-grade PLLA injectable
Suitable for multiple facial treatment areas


 
Treatment Areas:
Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid is designed for professional injectable collagen stimulation treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Cheeks
Temples
Jawline
Chin
Nasolabial folds
Marionette lines
Mid-face volume restoration
Facial hollowing correction
Lower face contouring
Overall facial rejuvenation


 
Composition:

150mg Poly-L-lactic acid
90mg Sodium carboxymethylcellulose
127.5mg Non-pyrogenic mannitol

 
FAQs:
What is Sculptra Poly-L-Lactic Acid used for?
Sculptra is used for professional collagen stimulation treatments designed to restore facial volume, improve skin structure and support long-term facial rejuvenation.
Is Sculptra suitable for facial rejuvenation treatments?
Yes. Sculptra is specifically formulated for professional facial rejuvenation treatments focused on collagen stimulation and volume restoration.
 
Does Sculptra help with facial volume loss?
Yes. Sculptra helps stimulate collagen production to improve visible facial hollowing, age-related volume loss and contour definition.
 
How long do Sculptra results last?
Results can last up to two years or longer depending on treatment protocol, patient response and practitioner technique.
 
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Stylage Bi Soft M
jsonld.description:
Stylage Bi Soft M - 2 x 1ml
Stylage Bi Soft M is a dermal filler designed to correct superficial lines and wrinkles while providing subtle contouring for a natural, refreshed appearance.
Stylage Bi Soft M is developed to address the appearance of fine lines, including smaller nasolabial folds, marionette lines, and sagging skin around the chin. Its formulation combines cross-linked hyaluronic acid with mannitol and 0.3% Lidocaine to deliver a smooth, even correction.
Ideal for fine line correction and subtle volume restoration, Stylage Bi Soft M can also be used for reshaping features such as the nose and ears, as well as for hand rejuvenation. Its ultra-fine formulation allows for precise application and a natural look, even during facial movement.
This injectable dermal filler is intended for use by qualified professionals. Results may vary based on individual factors such as lifestyle, age, and skin type, with effects typically lasting up to 12 months but this does depend on a number of factors.
Check out the entire Stylage collection.
Key Benefits

Treats superficial wrinkles and fine lines
Helps correct and reshape nasal and ear features
Provides subtle hand rejuvenation and volume restoration
Delivers a natural-looking, balanced correction


Product Details


Brand: Stylage

Product: Stylage Bi Soft M

Contains: 2 x 1ml pre-filled syringes

Key Ingredients: 20 mg/g cross-linked hyaluronic acid, Mannitol, 0.3% Lidocaine

For use on: Superficial wrinkles, smaller nasolabial folds, sagging chin, marionette lines, nasal hump reduction, nasal tip lift, ear reshaping, and hand rejuvenation

Needles: 4 x 30G needles included

This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Sunekos 1200 is an advanced skin booster with antioxidant and volumising properties, designed to enhance skin hydration and support the effects of Sunekos 200.

jsonld.description:
Sunekos Performa Dermal Filler - 2 x 3.5ml
Sunekos Performa is an injectable dermal filler designed to correct skin imperfections by restoring elasticity and enhancing volume in areas affected by wrinkles and scars.
Sunekos Performa is a sterile, re-absorbable injectable solution recommended for treating blemishes and depressions in the skin caused by wrinkles and scars. It supports the restoration of physiological elasticity by temporarily replacing lost volume in soft tissues.
Ideal for use in conjunction with physical or chemical treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion, Sunekos Performa is formulated to correct mild to moderate skin imperfections. By supplementing the intracellular matrix, it helps to normalize the appearance of anatomically depressed skin.
The solution is administered using a sterile syringe with a needle size selected by the practitioner based on the treatment area. This product is supplied as a pack containing two 3.5ml vials, offering a comprehensive approach to skin rejuvenation.
Key Benefits

Corrects skin imperfections and depressions
Restores physiological elasticity and supports volume restoration
Compatible with complementary treatments such as peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion
Provides a minimally invasive solution for skin rejuvenation
Designed to enhance the overall appearance of the skin

Product Details


Brand: Sunekos

Product: Sunekos Performa

Contains: 2 x 3.5ml vials

Formulation: Re-absorbable injectable filler

For use on: Areas with wrinkles, scars, and skin depressions

Application: Administered via sterile syringe; needle size as per practitioner’s discretion

Recommended use: Can be used with peeling, laser therapy, and dermabrasion

Teosyal Puresense Kiss with Lidocaine - 2 x 1ml
Teosyal Puresense Kiss is a hyaluronic acid-based filler designed to enhance lip volume and shape, with added Lidocaine for improved comfort during treatment.
Teosyal Puresense Kiss is a Swiss-manufactured premium dermal filler formulated specifically for lip augmentation. Its hyaluronic acid composition offers excellent hydration and elasticity, helping to create fuller, more defined lips. The addition of 0.3% Lidocaine aims to reduce discomfort, making the injection process more tolerable.
Thanks to the 27G needle design, the Teosyal Puresense Kiss lip filler requires less injection force, facilitating precise application. The double bevel, lubricated needle helps ensure smooth penetration, supporting accurate shaping of the lips while minimizing patient discomfort.
Results may last between 9 to 12 months, depending on factors such as age, lifestyle, and individual skin characteristics. This dermal filler can also help diminish mouth wrinkles and refine lip contours, contributing to a refreshed and youthful appearance.
Check out the entire Teosyal collection, including Teosyal Puresense and Teosyal RHA products.
Key Benefits

Enhances lip volume and contour
Contains 0.3% Lidocaine to improve comfort
27G needle requires less injection force
May reduce mouth wrinkles for a smoother look
Typically offers results lasting 9–12 months

Needle: 27G needle for precise application

For use on: Lips (volume, shape) and perioral wrinkles

Duration: Results typically last 9–12 months

jsonld.name: Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 (1 x 3ml)
jsonld.description:
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 dermal filler is the first of two Redensity formulas from Teoxane, delivering patented Teosyal hyaluronic acid to contoured parts of the face. In particular, the pair of pre-filled 1.0 ml syringes offer enough capacity to restore contours and fullness to parts of the face where the natural plumpness of hyaluronic acid may have diminished over the years. This dermal redensification helps to fill out loose or sagging skin and eliminate wrinkles whilst producing a soft, natural finish that does not appear excessively taut.
Use Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 on the cheeks and jawline to return a more naturally curved appearance to aged faces, restoring the curves and contours associated with a younger individual. This product has been specifically designed to redensify and deeply rehydrate your face, neck and neckline.
Teosyal products are made according to a Teoxane Laboratories patent, and closely mimic natural human hyaluronic acid found in the face, allowing them to produce a uniquely soft, flexible and authentic-looking finished effect.
 
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 Treatment Areas:
Teosyal Puresense Redensity 1 has been designed to moisturise the skin and correct wrinkles in the following areas:

Neckline
Neck
Face

jsonld.name: Teosyal PureSense Redensity II
jsonld.description:
Teosyal PureSense Redensity II is an advanced gel designed to treat the delicate and sensitive eye area. The product has a subtle mix of non cross-linked and cross-linked hyaluronic acid that is specifically indicated for under-eye circles and hollow eye-circles. The ingredients in Teosyal PureSense Redensity II helps to regenerate and restructure skin cells, while it protects the cells from oxidation. This improves the quality of the skin and provides a natural and long-lasting correction of tired looking eyes.
Please be aware that the product cannot be used to treat sunken under-eye circles and malar bags.


Benefits of Teosyal PureSense Redensity II:

Areas: the delicate and sensitive eye area
Treat under-eye circles and hollow eye-circles
Also designed for tear trough treatment

How long does the result last for?
In general, results can last up to 9-12 months. The duration depends on the individual's lifestyle, age and skin type.

The Teosyal formulation used mimics natural human hyaluronic acid closely, and has been created to support the skin without adding rigidity. As a result, natural facial expressions and emotions are unaffected, even when Puresense Ultra Deep is administered in large quantities to the most mobile regions of the face.
Use to restore softness and eliminate gauntness, to rejuvenate the cheeks, and to fill in deep furrows and moderate to severe wrinkles and skin folds, for an overall return to a more youthful appearance.

Create volume in targeted areas
Redefine facial outlines
Treat deep wrinkles

VOLIFIL Classic with Lidocaine - 1 x 1ml
VOLIFIL Classic is a low-viscosity hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed for fine lines, subtle lip augmentation, and natural-looking facial contouring.
VOLIFIL Classic is developed by the same manufacturer behind LUMIFIL LITE, offering a next-generation dermal filler experience. Formulated with lidocaine, this injectable aims to enhance comfort during application while addressing concerns such as crow’s feet, perioral lines, and light forehead wrinkles.
Its ultra-fine particles integrate smoothly into the skin, making VOLIFIL Classic ideal for precise lip treatments, including both standard and Russian Lip techniques. Containing 20mg/ml of hyaluronic acid, this filler helps achieve refined volume and shape while maintaining a natural finish.
Results may last around 9 to 12 months, depending on individual factors. VOLIFIL Classic can also be used for mild facial contouring, providing a versatile solution for those seeking a gentle yet effective approach to facial rejuvenation.

What is Juvederm Ultra 2?
Juvederm Ultra 2 is an advanced professional hyaluronic acid dermal filler developed to smooth fine facial lines, enhance subtle lip volume and improve overall skin hydration. Designed specifically for professional injectable aesthetic treatments, this high-performance dermal filler helps deliver refined correction for early signs of ageing and delicate contour enhancement.
 
Its advanced cross-linked hyaluronic acid formulation is designed to provide smooth integration within the skin while delivering subtle volumisation and natural-looking rejuvenation.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Juvederm Ultra 2 is suitable for professional dermal filler treatments targeting superficial wrinkle correction, lip refinement and delicate contour enhancement protocols.
 
The smooth sterile injectable gel allows precise professional administration while helping support soft, balanced and natural-looking results.
 
Unlike heavier facial fillers, Juvederm Ultra 2 is specifically formulated for lighter correction and subtle aesthetic enhancement.
 
Juvederm Ultra 2 has become a trusted choice within aesthetic medicine due to its smooth consistency and suitability for treating delicate facial areas.

Professional hyaluronic acid dermal filler
Helps smooth fine facial lines
Supports subtle lip enhancement
Improves skin hydration
Smooth gel formulation for precise placement
Helps refine facial contours
Supports natural-looking facial rejuvenation
Professional-grade injectable filler
Suitable for delicate treatment areas


 
Treatment Areas
Juvederm Ultra 2 is designed for professional injectable aesthetic treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Lips
Lip border definition
Fine perioral lines
Superficial facial lines
Smile lines
Marionette line refinement
Delicate wrinkle correction
Facial contour refinement
Lip hydration enhancement
Overall facial rejuvenation

jsonld.name: Restylane Defyne - 1 x 1ml
jsonld.description:
Restylane Defyne - 1 x 1ml
Advanced Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Filler for Deep Wrinkle Correction, Facial Contouring & Natural Facial Movement
 
What is Restylane Defyne?
Restylane Defyne is an advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed to correct deep facial wrinkles, restore lost facial volume and enhance natural facial contours while maintaining dynamic facial movement. Developed using Restylane’s proprietary XpresHAn Technology™, Restylane Defyne delivers flexible support and smooth tissue integration for natural-looking facial rejuvenation results.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Restylane Defyne is a trusted injectable treatment for addressing moderate to severe facial folds while preserving natural facial expression.
 
Its advanced gel formulation allows the filler to adapt naturally to facial movement while providing structural support and long-lasting contour enhancement.
 
Unlike more rigid dermal fillers, Restylane Defyne is specifically designed for expressive facial areas requiring both flexibility and support.
 
Key Benefits:

Advanced hyaluronic acid dermal filler
Designed for moderate to severe facial wrinkles and folds
XpresHAn Technology™ supports natural facial movement
Helps restore facial structure and contour
Ideal for nasolabial folds and marionette lines
Supports natural-looking facial rejuvenation
Smooth gel integration into facial tissues
Flexible filler designed for expressive facial areas
Contains lidocaine for improved injection comfort
Professional-grade injectable filler
Long-lasting facial contouring results
Minimal downtime treatment option
Popular for non-surgical anti-ageing treatments

 
Treatment Areas
Restylane Defyne is commonly used for professional aesthetic treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Nasolabial folds
Marionette lines
Chin
Jawline
Oral commissures
Lower-face contouring
Mid-to-deep dermal correction areas
Facial volume restoration zones

 
Composition:

Cross-linked Hyaluronic Acid (20mg/ml)
Lidocaine Hydrochloride 0.3%
Phosphate buffered saline
XpresHAn Technology™ gel formulation
Sterile injectable gel

 
Frequently Asked Questions
What is Restylane DEFYNE used for?
Restylane Defyne is used for correcting deep facial wrinkles and folds, restoring facial volume and enhancing facial contours.
Is Restylane DEFYNE good for nasolabial folds?
Yes. Restylane Defyne is particularly popular for treating deep nasolabial folds and marionette lines.
What is XpresHAn Technology™?
XpresHAn Technology™ allows the filler to move naturally with facial expressions while maintaining structural support and flexibility.
Does Restylane DEFYNE contain lidocaine?
Yes. Restylane Defyne contains 0.3% lidocaine to improve patient comfort during treatment.
What areas can Restylane DEFYNE treat?
Common treatment areas include nasolabial folds, marionette lines, chin, jawline and lower-face contouring areas.
How long does Restylane DEFYNE last?
Results typically last between 6–12 months depending on individual metabolism, lifestyle, treatment area and injection technique.
Does Restylane DEFYNE look natural?
Yes. Restylane Defyne is specifically formulated to maintain natural facial movement and expression while providing contour enhancement and wrinkle correction.
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary swelling, redness, bruising or tenderness following injection. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Nexfill Fine
jsonld.description:
Nexfill is a monophasic hyaluronic acid filler that stands out from other fillers for its deep, natural hydration. Nexfill replenishes volume loss by stimulating fibroblasts to produce their own collagen.
After rigorous testing it was found that Nexfill retains big part of its shape 24 hours after hyaluronidase injection, which shows that it has high viscoelasticity and long duration compared to other fillers. On the other hand, 48 hours after the injection, it is completely degraded, indicating that the filler has a high purity which results in minimised side effects. This is a perfect monophasic filler which is manufactured by using special grinding machine, allowing smooth injection without breaking. Accordingly, soft, uniform gel type is easier to mold to achieve natural results.
The Nexfill rejuvenating moisturising filler works very quickly to help prolong youth in any skin with outstanding benefits.
Recommended IndicationsFine linesCrows feetRussian lipsPeriorbital lineLip contour
Needles = 2 x 30G * 1/2″Storage = 2-25°CDuration = 9-12 monthsBDDE = Not Detected

Jalupro Young Eye – 1 x 1ml
 
Advanced Under-Eye Skin Booster for Hydration, Fine Lines & Eye Rejuvenation
 
What is Jalupro Young Eye?
Jalupro Young Eye is an advanced injectable skin booster specifically formulated for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments. Developed with a unique combination of hyaluronic acid and amino acids, this professional eye treatment helps improve hydration, skin texture and elasticity in the delicate periocular area.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic use, Jalupro Young Eye helps reduce the appearance of tired-looking eyes, fine lines, dark circles and puffiness while supporting natural collagen production and skin regeneration.
 
Its lightweight injectable formulation integrates smoothly into the under-eye tissue, helping restore skin firmness and improve overall eye-area brightness for a refreshed and revitalised appearance.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners across the UK, Jalupro Young Eye is suitable for professional under-eye rejuvenation and skin revitalisation treatment protocols.
 
Checkout the entire Jalupro product range.
 
Key Benefits

Professional under-eye skin booster
Helps deeply hydrate delicate eye-area skin
Supports collagen stimulation and skin regeneration
Helps reduce the appearance of fine lines
Improves skin elasticity and texture
Helps minimise dark circles and puffiness
Lightweight injectable formulation
Supports brighter and smoother-looking under-eyes
Professional-grade aesthetic treatment

Minimal downtime procedure


 
Treatment Areas

Under-eye area
Tear trough region
Crow’s feet area
Fine periocular lines
Delicate eye contour skin

 
Why Choose Jalupro Young Eye?
Jalupro Young Eye is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional injectable treatment specifically designed for under-eye rejuvenation and hydration. The treatment is ideal for patients seeking refreshed-looking eyes, improved skin quality and smoother under-eye texture through professional aesthetic protocols.
 
Composition

Hyaluronic Acid
Amino Acid Complex

 
FAQs
What is Jalupro Young Eye used for?
Jalupro Young Eye is used for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, fine lines, skin texture and tired-looking eyes.
 
Does Jalupro Young Eye stimulate collagen?
Yes. The amino acid complex helps support collagen synthesis and natural skin regeneration.
 
Is there downtime after treatment?
Patients may experience temporary redness, swelling or mild bruising following treatment. Downtime is generally minimal.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

1 treatment per month, 1-3 sessions in total

Radiesse Injectable Implant Dermal Filler - 1 x 1.5ml
Advanced Calcium Hydroxylapatite Dermal Filler for Facial Contouring, Volume Restoration and Collagen Stimulation
 
What is Radiesse?
Radiesse 1.5ml with Lidocaine is an advanced professional calcium hydroxylapatite dermal filler developed to restore facial volume, improve contour definition and stimulate natural collagen production. Designed specifically for professional injectable aesthetic treatments, this high-performance volumising filler helps address age-related volume loss, facial contour depletion and structural support concerns.
 
Its advanced calcium hydroxylapatite microsphere formulation is suspended within a smooth gel carrier designed to provide immediate volume enhancement while stimulating collagen production for longer-term structural support and skin rejuvenation.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Radiesse is suitable for professional dermal filler treatments targeting facial contour enhancement, volume restoration and advanced collagen-stimulating rejuvenation protocols.
 
The sterile injectable formulation allows precise professional placement while helping support natural-looking contour restoration and progressive skin improvement.
 
Unlike traditional hyaluronic acid fillers, Radiesse uses calcium hydroxylapatite technology to deliver immediate lift alongside long-term collagen stimulation.
 
The inclusion of lidocaine helps improve patient comfort during treatment, supporting a smoother injection experience.
 
Key Benefits

Professional calcium hydroxylapatite dermal filler
Helps restore facial volume
Supports natural collagen stimulation
Enhances facial contour definition
Provides immediate lifting support
Supports long-term structural improvement
Helps improve skin firmness
Professional-grade injectable filler
Includes lidocaine for enhanced treatment comfort


 
Treatment Areas
Radiesse is designed for professional injectable contouring treatments across multiple facial areas, including:

Cheeks
Jawline
Chin
Marionette lines
Pre-jowl sulcus
Lower face contouring
Facial volume restoration
Structural contour enhancement
Hand rejuvenation
Overall facial rejuvenation

 
Why Buy Radiesse?
Radiesse is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional collagen-stimulating filler designed to improve facial structure, contour definition and long-term rejuvenation. The treatment is ideal for patients seeking natural-looking structural enhancement through professional injectable aesthetic protocols.
 
Composition

30% Calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres
0.3% Lidocaine hydrochloride
Sodium carboxymethylcellulose gel carrier
Glycerin
Sterile water for injection

 
FAQs
What is Radiesse used for?
Radiesse is used for professional dermal filler treatments designed to restore facial volume, improve contour definition and stimulate natural collagen production.
 
Does Radiesse stimulate collagen?
Yes. Radiesse contains calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres that stimulate collagen production for progressive skin rejuvenation and structural support.
 
Is Radiesse suitable for facial contouring?
Yes. Radiesse is widely used for professional contouring treatments targeting the cheeks, jawline and chin.
 
How long do Radiesse results last?
Results may last up to 12–18 months depending on treatment protocol, patient metabolism and practitioner technique.
 
Does Radiesse contain lidocaine?
Yes. Radiesse contains lidocaine to improve patient comfort during treatment.

Bags / Bags under the eyes

Regenerate the skin in the periocular area
Bio-restructuring of deep tissues
Improvement of superficial wrinkles without the use of fillers
Pre- and post-surgical treatment (such as blepharoplasty, surgical eye lift, laser)

jsonld.name: Nucleofill Strong 2.5% 1 x 1.5ml Syringe
jsonld.description:
Nucleofill 25 (Strong) is a  bio stimulant gel based on natural polynucleotides and high viscosity for skin rejuvenation and protection. As an anti-ageing treatment. Nucleofill is designed to improve skin elasticity and tightness as well as aid in the prevention of wrinkles. Nucleofill 25 is the new line of natural polynucleotide-based bio stimulating gels, with a high viscosity, for protecting and rejuvenating the skin. It’s recommended to have 2 treatments with 2-4 weeks in between each session, in severe cases you can have up to 4 treatments with 2-4 weeks intervals.
The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical peculiarities make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orient in space a considerable amount of water molecules, which are primarily retained in the hydrophilic groups level of phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides.
The strong moisturising ability is mainly due to the water retention capabilities of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the single nucleotides. An “electrostatic sponge” able to guarantee cellular well-being by conferring deep hydration to tissues.
Free radical scavenger effect – The polymeric macromolecules are able to also play an immediate “scavenger” action against free radicals. This effect of this polynucleotide gel is possible thanks to the chemical structure capable of blocking free radicals in the nitrogenous ring. Moreover, the progressive degradation of polynucleotide molecules by enzymes present in the extracellular environment, free metabolites which, in turn, accentuate the protection activity against free radicals.
The biostimulating effect is given both by the presence of nucleoside structures capable of activating cell membrane receptors, and by metabolites that are produced by the enzymatic attack during the degradation process. A slow and continuous effect.
By promoting the metabolic activity of the fibroblastic cells, polynucleotides collaborate to reintegrate into the dermis various fundamental autologous components (glucoseaminoglycans, proteins, glycoproteins, fibrils, etc.) tending to maintain their physiological functionality. Their repeated administration over time, determines:– a protracted isosmotic hydration of the dermal matrix– an anti-radical actionBoth of these effects combine to recreate in the dermal matrix the most favourable physiological conditions for the regeneration and metabolic activity of fibroblasts, with long-lasting biorevitalising effects.
Polynucleotides activate two types of membrane receptors in fibroblasts, or rather Receptor CD39 and Receptor CD40. The activation of these receptors lead to two effects: stimulation of type I collagen production, saturation of fibroblasts in myofibroblasts
Contains:25mg/ml of polynucleotides
The synergy of 4 types of stimulation:– Skin regeneration– Cleansing effect on the cells by increasing circulation and removing  free radicals– Deep moisturising effect– Firming and contouring
Indications:– Loose skin with poor circulation– Dehydrated skin– Skin submitted to oxidative stress– Stretch marks– Scars– For those who want firming and contouring, more definition– Bio-stimulation and increase in collagen type 1.
