Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Hydration, Skin Regeneration & Early Anti-Ageing Treatments
 
What is Nucleofill 20 Medium?
Nucleofill 20 Medium is an advanced injectable polynucleotide skin booster developed to improve skin hydration, elasticity and overall skin quality while supporting natural tissue regeneration. Formulated with highly purified sodium DNA polynucleotides, Nucleofill 20 Medium is specifically designed for younger skin and early anti-ageing treatments.

This professional bio-stimulation treatment works within the dermis to support fibroblast activity, improve skin firmness and help reduce the appearance of fine lines, mild to moderate wrinkles and skin laxity. Its regenerative action helps restore healthier-looking skin while maintaining natural facial features and expression.

Unlike traditional dermal fillers that add volume, Nucleofill 20 Medium focuses on skin quality improvement, hydration and tissue regeneration. The treatment is commonly used as part of mesotherapy and skin rejuvenation protocols for patients seeking smoother, firmer and more radiant skin.

Its antioxidant properties help protect the skin against oxidative stress and free radical damage while supporting collagen production and cellular renewal.
 
Key Benefits

Advanced polynucleotide skin booster treatment
Deeply hydrates dry and dehydrated skin
Helps improve skin elasticity and firmness
Supports collagen stimulation and tissue regeneration
Helps reduce fine lines and mild to moderate wrinkles
Supports improvement of stretch marks and superficial scars
Provides antioxidant protection against free radical damage
Suitable for face and body skin rejuvenation
Professional-grade injectable bio-stimulation treatment
Compatible with mesotherapy treatment protocols
Natural-looking skin rejuvenation results
Minimal downtime treatment option

 
Treatment Areas
Nucleofill 20 Medium is designed for professional injectable skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Cheeks
Perioral area
Abdomen
Thighs
Buttocks
Stretch mark-prone areas
Mild scar correction areas
Skin laxity treatment zones

 
Why Buy Nucleofill 20 Medium?
Nucleofill 20 Medium is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional polynucleotide treatment designed to improve hydration, skin elasticity and early signs of ageing. Its sodium DNA formulation helps support natural skin regeneration while improving overall skin quality, firmness and radiance without adding volume.

FAQs
What is Nucleofill 20 Medium used for?

jsonld.name: Medisco Peelieve Skin Peel kit
jsonld.description:
Medisco Peelieve Skin Peel is an effective solution for renewing skin. Its combination of antioxidants and enhanced formula helps improve skin texture and protect against environmental damage. This powerful peel provides long-lasting results for a renewed and revitalized complexion.
1. Medium peeling

For all skin type, thin skin, sensitive skin, beginners.
Use half of powder and solution based on 1 vial (0.5 g of powder + 4 ml of solution).
Recommended to use once for 1-2 months. Use it once 2-3 months if have sensitive and thin skin.

2. Strong peeling

For all skin type, thick-skinned, large pores, experts.
Use each 1 vial of powder and solution based on 1 vial (1 g of powder + 8 ml of solution).
Recommended to use once for 2-3 months. Use it once 3-4 months if have sensitive and thin skin.

How to use Peelieve Skin Peel

Cleanse your face and lightly apply toner.
Place the Peelieve Peeling Solution in the vial containing the Peelieve Peeling Powder, cover the cap and shake it until it is sufficiently mixed. (Check proportions and recommendation for medium and strong peeling above.)
After applying the mixed solution evenly to the face, rub each cheek, chin, nose philtrum, and forehead, for 7-10 minutes. Even if you feel some pain, rub sufficiently first then press into the skin so the Spicule is properly stack in the skin. This is what makes it effective. (Do not exceed 7-10 minutes for total rubbing time).NOTE: If you rub focusing only on the one area it can create a wound. Please apply even pressure all over the face while rubbing. Also, please strictly adhere to the recommended rubbing time.Be careful to rub lightly on the thin part of the skin such as around the eyes.
If you experience dryness then spray facial mist intermittently during the peeling process. (Please only use normal hydration facial mist. Do not use facial mist that includes ingredients such as AHA, BHA, PHA, or oils.)(If it doesn't feel dry you do not need to spray facial mist.)
Apply a mask sheet pack without cleansing the face, so the particles of the Spicule properly stuck in the skin. (You can use any normal essence-type face mask pack. Avoid using mask pack with ingredients such alcohol, AHA, BHA, PHA, or oils.)
Take off the mask sheet pack after 10 minutes.
Do not use a cleanser but wash the face with lukewarm water lightly. (Spicule should be stuck in the skin for a good result.)
Apply washing plentiful Medisco Peelieve Cica Cream, after wiping off the water.
After washing your face each day, apply plenty of Medisco Peelieve Cica Cream to provide hydration and nutrition. Drink a lot of water.Make sure to apply sunscreen carefully every day when you go out.(If you are exposed to ultraviolet rays without applying sunscreen, blemishes may rise.)
According to the age, exfoliation starts approximately 7-10 days post-treatment. After the exfoliation begins do not forcefully remove dead skin.

jsonld.description:
Coenzyme Q10 occurs naturally within every cell in the human body, we cannot live without it. It is a vitamin-like substance which is found in our mitochondria (structures within cells responsible for energy production). It is also important as an antioxidant, associated with various health benefits.
Approximately three quarters of the body’s Q10 is made within the liver. You can obtain small amounts of coQ10 from food. Our Q10 levels peak between the ages of 20 and 25. As the body’s ability to create/absorb Q10 declines with age, our levels of Q10 will also decline. Dietary supplementation can help to maintain optimal levels of coenzyme Q10 within the body.

100% natural
Essential for the normal functioning of all tissues due to its role in the cellular energy production process
Gluten Free / Lactose Free / Yeast Free / Sugar Free / Estrogen Free

jsonld.description:
Plinest One - 5 x 4ml 
 
Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Skin Rejuvenation, Hydration & Skin Elasticity
 
What is Plinest One?
Plinest One is an advanced polynucleotide-based injectable treatment developed to improve skin hydration, elasticity and overall skin quality. Formulated using PN-HPT® (Polynucleotide High Purification Technology), Plinest One helps support skin regeneration while improving the appearance of skin laxity, dehydration and early visible signs of ageing.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic treatments, Plinest One works by supporting fibroblast activity and helping stimulate collagen production for healthier, firmer and more revitalised-looking skin.
 
Widely used across UK aesthetic clinics, Plinest One is suitable for patients seeking skin rejuvenation treatments targeting dull skin, reduced elasticity, crepey texture and stretch mark concerns.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers designed to add volume, Plinest One focuses on improving overall skin quality and tissue regeneration while maintaining natural-looking results.



Key Benefits:

Advanced polynucleotide injectable skin treatment
Helps improve skin hydration and elasticity
Supports collagen stimulation and skin regeneration
Helps improve skin laxity and crepey skin
Supports smoother and firmer-looking skin
Suitable for face and body rejuvenation treatments
Helps improve overall skin texture and radiance
Professional-grade regenerative skin booster
Suitable for preventative anti-ageing treatments
Minimal downtime treatment option


 

Treatment Areas:

Plinest One is designed for professional skin rejuvenation treatments across multiple areas, including:

Face
Neck
Décolletage
Hands
Arms
Abdomen
Inner thighs
Stretch mark-prone areas
Body skin laxity areas
Overall skin quality improvement

 
Why Buy Plinest One?
Plinest One is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional polynucleotide skin booster designed to improve hydration, elasticity and visible skin quality. Its advanced PN-HPT® formulation supports natural skin regeneration and collagen stimulation while helping improve skin texture and firmness with natural-looking rejuvenation results.
 
Composition:

2mg/ml PN-HPT® Polynucleotides
High Purification Technology formulation
Sterile injectable solution
5 x 4ml vials


 
Treatment Protocol:

Injection depth: Dermal
Phase I: Every 7–14 days for 4 sessions
Phase II: Every 21–30 days for an additional 4 sessions

 
FAQs
What is Plinest One used for?
Plinest One is used for professional skin rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, elasticity, skin texture and overall skin quality.
 
Is Plinest One a dermal filler?
No. Plinest One is not a traditional dermal filler. It is a polynucleotide skin booster designed to support skin regeneration and collagen stimulation rather than add facial volume.
What areas can Plinest One treat?
Common treatment areas include the face, neck, décolletage, abdomen, thighs and other areas affected by skin laxity or dehydration.
 
Does Plinest One stimulate collagen?
Yes. Plinest One helps support fibroblast activity and collagen production to improve skin firmness and elasticity.
 
Is Plinest One suitable for stretch marks?
Yes. Plinest One is commonly used in treatments targeting skin laxity and striae distensae (stretch marks).
 
How many Plinest One treatments are recommended?
An initial course of treatments is typically recommended, followed by maintenance sessions depending on skin condition and treatment goals.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.description:
Profhilo Structura – 1 x 2ml

Advanced Injectable Skin Remodeling Treatment for Facial Structure & Tissue Restoration
 
What is Profhilo Structura?
Profhilo Structura is an advanced injectable skin remodeling treatment specifically developed to address age-related facial tissue changes, superficial fat loss and reduced structural support within the skin. Using stabilised hybrid hyaluronic acid technology, Profhilo Structura helps reposition superficial facial fat compartments while improving skin firmness, contour and overall facial structure.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic practitioners, Profhilo Structura targets concerns associated with mid-face fat loss, pronounced facial hollows, reduced skin elasticity and altered facial contours caused by the ageing process. The treatment works beneath the skin to support tissue remodeling, improve facial definition and stimulate collagen and elastin production for natural-looking rejuvenation.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers that primarily add volume, Profhilo Structura focuses on restoring facial architecture and improving tissue quality through bio-remodeling technology. Its advanced injectable formulation helps lift, contour and support the face while maintaining softness and natural facial movement.
 
Containing a total of 90mg of stabilised hyaluronic acid per 2ml syringe, including both high and low molecular weight HA, Profhilo Structura delivers intensive hydration and structural support for patients experiencing facial tissue laxity and volume redistribution.

Key Benefits

Advanced injectable skin remodeling treatment
Helps reposition superficial facial fat
Supports facial lifting and contouring
Targets mid-face fat loss and facial hollows
Stimulates collagen and elastin production

Improves skin firmness and elasticity
Supports structural facial rejuvenation
Helps restore facial definition naturally
High concentration stabilised hyaluronic acid formula
Natural-looking anti-ageing enhancement

 
Treatment Areas
Profhilo Structura is designed for professional aesthetic treatments targeting structural ageing, tissue laxity and facial contour changes associated with age-related fat loss, including: 

Mid-face fat loss
Facial hollows
Jawline definition
Cheeks
Facial laxity
Facial contouring

 
Why Buy Profhilo Structura?
Profhilo Structura is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking an advanced injectable treatment for structural facial rejuvenation and skin remodeling. Its innovative hyaluronic acid formulation helps improve tissue quality, firmness and facial support while maintaining natural-looking aesthetic results.
 
Composition

45mg High Molecular Weight Hyaluronic Acid
45mg Low Molecular Weight Hyaluronic Acid
Total 90mg HA per 2ml syringe
Sodium hyaluronate
Sodium chloride
Sodium phosphate
Water for injection

 
FAQs: 
What is Profhilo Structura used for?Profhilo Structura is used for facial tissue remodeling, skin laxity improvement, collagen stimulation and structural facial rejuvenation.
 
Is Profhilo Structura a dermal filler?No. Profhilo Structura is not a traditional volumising dermal filler. It is an injectable bio-remodeling treatment designed to improve tissue quality and structural support.
 
Does Profhilo Structura stimulate collagen?Yes. Profhilo Structura supports collagen and elastin production to improve skin firmness and tissue quality.
 
Is Profhilo Structura good for skin laxity?Yes. Profhilo Structura is specifically designed to help improve skin laxity and support facial tissue restoration.
 
What does Profhilo Structura treat?Profhilo Structura is designed to treat age-related facial tissue changes including mid-face fat loss, facial hollows, skin laxity and reduced facial contour definition.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: aesPlla®
jsonld.description:
aesPlla® is a Poly-L-Lactic Acid based (PLLA) collagen stimulator. Formulated with a biocompatible and biodegradable synthetic polymer, aesPlla® stimulates collagen production to help volumise and smooth the skin. Offering gradual results, the bio-stimulatory, PLLA filler works to correct the appearance of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies and facial wrinkles. Subsequent results may be observed from four weeks post-treatment, lasting for up to 3 years.
Key Features:

Ideal for patients aged 30+
Stimulates collagen to increase skin volume
Effects of aesPlla® can be observed from 4 weeks post-injection
Gradual and natural-looking results
Results last up to 3 years
Creates a softer and more natural-looking result

Treatment Areas:

Shallow to deep facial wrinkles
Nasolabial folds
Temple
Cheeks
Deep dermal deficiencies
Marionette lines
Sagging jowls
Scarring

Box Contents:

1 vial: 365mg of powder (150mg of PLLA)

Ingredients:
150mg of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 90mg of sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125g of mannitol.
Recommended Treatment protocol:

Dissolving time: 3 hours
Add 5ml of sterile water for injection, using 18G needle
Must be injected within 72 hours of reconstitution
Recommended technique: Linear Thread Technique
Recommended consumables: 18G sterile needle + 1/3ml syringe to withdraw
26G cannula or needle to inject
Inject into the deep dermis / lower layers of dermis / layers of hypodermis
Shelf life: 21 months

Aftercare:
Massage the skin for 5 minutes, 5 times per day, for 5 days post-treatment
Storage:

Do not refrigerate - store at room temperature
Stable for 72 hours post-reconstitution – discard after this duration

This product has been clinically tested and is suitable for vegans and is manufactured to be completely cruelty free.

jsonld.description:
LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster – 1 x 1ml
 
Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Dark Circles, Fine Lines & Under-Eye Rejuvenation
 
What is LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster?
LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster is an advanced injectable polynucleotide treatment specifically developed to revitalise the delicate under-eye area. Formulated with 5mg/ml of polynucleotides (PN), this professional skin booster helps improve skin hydration, elasticity, and overall skin quality while targeting common under-eye concerns including dark circles, puffiness, fine lines and tired-looking skin.
 
Designed for professional aesthetic treatments, LUMI-PRO Eyes works by supporting cellular repair, collagen stimulation and tissue regeneration within the under-eye area. Its advanced PN formulation helps improve skin firmness and hydration while restoring a smoother, brighter and more refreshed appearance.
 
Widely used within aesthetic medicine, LUMI-PRO Eyes is suitable for patients experiencing early visible signs of ageing, dehydration, loss of elasticity and skin fatigue around the eyes.
 
Unlike traditional dermal fillers focused primarily on adding volume, this polynucleotide skin booster works to improve overall skin quality and support long-term under-eye rejuvenation.
 
Key Benefits

Advanced under-eye polynucleotide skin booster
Helps reduce dark circles and puffiness
Supports collagen stimulation and skin repair
Improves under-eye hydration and elasticity
Helps smooth fine lines and wrinkles
Supports brighter and more refreshed-looking eyes
Enhances skin texture and firmness
Natural-looking under-eye rejuvenation
Professional injectable skin revitalisation treatment
Suitable for delicate under-eye skin

 
Treatment Areas
LUMI-PRO Eyes is specifically designed for professional aesthetic treatments targeting delicate under-eye concerns and visible signs of ageing, including:

Dark under-eye circles
Under-eye puffiness
Fine line & wrinkles
Skin dehydration
Loss of elasticity
Gender under-eye rejuvenation

 
Why Buy LUMI-PRO Eyes PN Skin Booster?
LUMI-PRO Eyes is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional under-eye polynucleotide treatment for advanced skin rejuvenation and hydration support. The treatment is ideal for patients seeking healthier-looking and naturally rejuvenated under-eye skin without excessive volume enhancement.
 
Composition

Polynucleotides (PN) 5mg/ml
Deoxyribonucleic acid (250–350 kDa)
Sodium DNA
Sodium chloride
Sodium phosphate
Aqua

 
FAQs:
What is LUMI-PRO Eyes used for?LUMI-PRO Eyes is used for under-eye rejuvenation treatments targeting dark circles, puffiness, fine lines, dehydration, and reduced skin elasticity.
 
Does LUMI-PRO Eyes contain polynucleotides?Yes. LUMI-PRO Eyes contains 5mg/ml of polynucleotides (PN) to support collagen stimulation, skin repair, and tissue regeneration.
 
Is LUMI-PRO Eyes a dermal filler?No. LUMI-PRO Eyes is a polynucleotide skin booster designed to improve skin quality and hydration rather than add significant facial volume.
 
Does LUMI-PRO Eyes help stimulate collagen?Yes. Polynucleotides help support collagen production and tissue regeneration within the under-eye area.
 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

Silex’s Male Fertility Test measures your sperm concentration in the comfort of your home. The test indicates a normal or low sperm count.
Symptoms
The main sign of male infertility is the inability to conceive a child. There may be no other obvious signs or symptoms. In some cases, however, an underlying problem does have signs and symptoms. These may include
A condition that affects your testicles may cause: pain and swelling in your testicles or prominent veins in on your testicles.
A problem with your prostate gland or tube that carries sperm from your testicles may cause: blood in your semen, pain when ejaculating or trouble ejaculating when you have sex
Low hormone levels may cause: problems getting or keeping an erection, changes to your mood, tiredness, weight gain, lower sex drive (libido), growth of male breasts, or less facial hair.

The One-Step Menopause Test detects the presence of FSH to assess the function of the pituitary gland and hormone levels to predict the onset of menopause.
Symptoms
Changes to your periods – they may become irregular and eventually they will stop altogether.
Effect on your well-being: changes in mood are common including low mood, anxiety, mood swings and low self-esteem. There may also be problems with memory and concentration (sometimes called ‘brain fog’).
Physical symptoms:

Hot flushes
Difficulty sleeping
Night sweats
Headaches and migraines may be worse than usual
Muscles aches and joint pains
Changes in body shape and weight gain
Skin changes including dry and itchy skin
Reduced sex drive
Vaginal dryness and pain, itching or discomfort during sex

jsonld.name: Iron Deficiency (Ferritin) Self Test Home Kit
jsonld.description:
Iron Deficiency Test for early screening of Iron Deficiency Anaemia (IDA). The test is used to check your blood iron stores which works by testing a finger prick blood sample to check the ferritin level.
Symptoms
Iron is used to make haemoglobin which is found in red blood cells. Haemoglobin is important for carrying oxygen around the body. If you don't have enough haemoglobin then your body is not going to get the oxygen it requires to function at its best. This low level of haemoglobin/red blood cells is called anaemia.Iron is also important for the healthy growth of hair, skin and nails.
If you are iron deficient, then you can experience a wide variety of symptoms. These include:

Tiredness
Becoming fatigued quickly during exercise.
Looking pale
Memory problems
Brittle hair and nails
Poor concentration
Getting out of breath quicker than normal
Slow wound healing

Fitzpatrick 4-6.Shading Solution LUXE: The best solution for developing a lighter, more sheer color especially for shading purposes. Loose Glitter
jsonld.description:
Glitterbels Loose Glitters
These loose glitters can be used with both Gel nails and acrylic nails.
For encapsulating in gel nails over gel polish we suggest our Clear Brush on builder gel:-
Once you've applied your chosen glitter, apply our Clear Brush on builder gel over the top to seal it in, cure for 60sec, you can then file and buff as usual, then go in with your topcoat.
For use with acrylic, simply go into your clear acrylic first, and dip this into your glitter pot.
All pots are size 15g, however, due to the sizes and shapes of the glitters being different the weights may vary, however, the 15g pot will still be full.

jsonld.description:
Glitterbels Loose Glitters
These loose glitters can be used with both Gel nails and acrylic nails.
For encapsulating in gel nails over gel polish we suggest our Clear Brush on builder gel:-
Once you've applied your chosen glitter, apply our Clear Brush on builder gel over the top to seal it in, cure for 60sec, you can then file and buff as usual, then go in with your topcoat.
For use with acrylic, simply go into your clear acrylic first, and dip this into your glitter pot.
All pots are size 15g, however, due to the sizes and shapes of the glitters being different the weights may vary, however, the 15g pot will still be full.

jsonld.name: Plenhyage XL Strong (2.5%)
jsonld.description:
2.5% high molecular weight polynucleotides
Ideal for Repairs, revitalizes and regenerates tissues
Sterile disposable product that belongs to the new concept of regenerative medicine: it allows to promote cell turnover, improve skin elasticity and hydration and heal sun-damaged skin, photoaging and scars (acne).
The polynucleotide chain, in addition to attracting water molecules, has an anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals which tend to accumulate as a result of stress, cell damage, external agents such as UV rays. The moisturizing action and the anti-free radical activity help to create an optimal environment for the growth of fibroblasts, favoring the restoration of tissue elasticity.
Nucleotides, natural DNA fractions, constitute the peculiar and original ingredient of this new product as they have an antioxidant action, protection and reduction of cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars.
The product contains high molecular weight polynucleotide chains whose biochemical characteristics make it highly viscoelastic and capable of binding and orienting in space a considerable quantity of water molecules, which are mainly retained at the level of the hydrophilic groups of the phosphorylated sugars of the individual nucleotides.

jsonld.description:
Glitterbels Loose Glitters
These loose glitters can be used with both Gel nails and acrylic nails.
For encapsulating in gel nails over gel polish we suggest our Clear Brush on builder gel:-
Once you've applied your chosen glitter, apply our Clear Brush on builder gel over the top to seal it in, cure for 60sec, you can then file and buff as usual, then go in with your topcoat.
For use with acrylic, simply go into your clear acrylic first, and dip this into your glitter pot.
All pots are size 15g, however, due to the sizes and shapes of the glitters being different the weights may vary, however, the 15g pot will still be full.

Puri HiLo PN – a highly concentrated hyaluronic Acid & 25mg Polynucleotides Skin Booster in one 2.5ml syringe
AETER Puri HiLo PN is meticulously formulated to address the delicate skin on the Face, Hands and Neck area, optimizing skin health and restoring youthfulness. This specialized skin booster offers an array of benefits:
Advanced Lifting and Moisturizing
Crafted with medical-grade Polynucleotides (PN), it generates a lifting effect by enhancing density through dermal cell proliferation. Its Hyaluronic Acid (HA) content draws deep moisture into the skin, ensuring optimal hydration, rejuvenating the skin, and refining its tone and density.
Cell Renewal and Collagen Stimulation
AETER Puri HiLo boasts potent ingredients that stimulate collagen production, promoting skin elasticity and firmness. The medical-grade PN utilized in this formulation accelerates wound recovery, boosts fibroblast growth, and synthesizes collagen and elastin, fortifying the dermal structure.
Key Ingredients for Enhanced Skin Regeneration
Certified medical-grade PN containing DNA polymer, nitrogenous bases, phosphate groups, and pentose (deoxyribose) are key components. These activate cell secretion, improve dead skin cells, and ensure optimal moisture levels.
Clinical Validation and Results
Clinical studies have evidenced its efficacy in improving roughness, pore volume, pigmentation, and skin texture. Notably, patients treated with AETER Puri Eyes experienced brighter and improved skin texture, demonstrating substantial improvements in just weeks.
Specialized Treatment Procedure
Following treatment, post-care measures are crucial for optimized results, ensuring smoother skin texture, enhanced complexion, improved oil balance, and increased skin elasticity. The recommended treatment cycle includes 3 to 4 sessions in 2 to 3-week weeks to achieve maximum effectiveness.

jsonld.name: Perma Blend Luxe Vicky Martin Unstoppable Areola Pigment Set
jsonld.description:
PMU Artist, Vicky Martin brings you The Unstoppable Areola Pigment Set. These pigments are inspired by the Vicky Martin Method, a revolutionary 3D areola tattooing technique that transforms the bodies of those impacted by breast cancer. With 8 pigments in this set, you'll be able to to create beautiful blends for any client. This pigment is EU REACH compliant.
In the kit: 0.5 oz bottles of Warrior White, Power Through Peach, Courageous Coral, Unbeatable Brown, Show Up Scarlet, Resilient Red, Determined Dark Brown, Outstanding Orange
Warrior White: A white used to boost opacity, provide outstanding coverage, and color building for areola restoration.
Power Through Peach: A light, muted pink flesh tone with high opacity to give a strong foundation for a light to medium pink areola.
Courageous Coral: A dull, pink-to-dark nude flesh tone with high opacity to give a strong foundation for a medium dark pink areola.
Unbeatable Brown: A strong, yellow-based warm to neutral nude-brown shade, providing great coverage and golden foundation for those olive skin clients.
Show Up Scarlet: A warm pink shade with strong opacity for the best blending and shading for those pinker shades of areola.
Resilient Red: A rich, warm red with low opacity to give the best red tone needed to get the perfect areola shade.
Determined Dark Brown: The darkest color of the areola set with neutral mass tone and slightly cool undertone and healing. It is best for providing the dark depth of color needed for high-melanin clients.
Outstanding Orange: A bright orange color with very strong warm undertones. Best used as a modifier for color adjustments to get the shade exactly right for each client.

jsonld.name: aesPlla®
jsonld.description:
aesPlla® is a Poly-L-Lactic Acid based (PLLA) collagen stimulator. Formulated with a biocompatible and biodegradable synthetic polymer, aesPlla® stimulates collagen production to help volumise and smooth the skin. Offering gradual results, the bio-stimulatory, PLLA filler works to correct the appearance of shallow to deep nasolabial fold contour deficiencies and facial wrinkles. Subsequent results may be observed from four weeks post-treatment, lasting for up to 3 years.
Key Features:

Ideal for patients aged 30+
Stimulates collagen to increase skin volume
Effects of aesPlla® can be observed from 4 weeks post-injection
Gradual and natural-looking results
Results last up to 3 years
Creates a softer and more natural-looking result

Treatment Areas:

Shallow to deep facial wrinkles
Nasolabial folds
Temple
Cheeks
Deep dermal deficiencies
Marionette lines
Sagging jowls
Scarring

Box Contents:

1 vial: 365mg of powder (150mg of PLLA)

Ingredients:
150mg of poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 90mg of sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125g of mannitol.
Recommended Treatment protocol:

Dissolving time: 3 hours
Add 5ml of sterile water for injection, using 18G needle
Must be injected within 72 hours of reconstitution
Recommended technique: Linear Thread Technique
Recommended consumables: 18G sterile needle + 1/3ml syringe to withdraw
26G cannula or needle to inject
Inject into the deep dermis / lower layers of dermis / layers of hypodermis
Shelf life: 21 months

Aftercare:
Massage the skin for 5 minutes, 5 times per day, for 5 days post-treatment
Storage:

Do not refrigerate - store at room temperature
Stable for 72 hours post-reconstitution – discard after this duration

Widely used by aesthetic practitioners, LEMONBOTTLE Solution is designed for injectable fat reduction treatments across multiple facial and body areas where diet and exercise alone may not effectively reduce stubborn fat accumulation.
 
Unlike more invasive body contouring procedures, LEMONBOTTLE offers a non-surgical approach to fat dissolving treatments with minimal downtime and natural-looking contour enhancement. Its lightweight injectable formulation is commonly used in clinics offering advanced aesthetic body sculpting and facial contouring treatments.
 
LEMONBOTTLE has become increasingly popular within aesthetic medicine due to its rapid treatment times, smooth formulation and ability to target smaller localised fat pockets while maintaining skin quality and contour smoothness.

LEMONBOTTLESolution is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional fat dissolving injectable for advanced contouring treatments. Its lightweight formulation and targeted fat reduction properties make it suitable for both facial and body contouring procedures.

Advanced Brightening Microneedling Serum for Pigmentation, Uneven Skin Tone & Skin Radiance
 
What is LUMI-MESO BRIGHT?
LUMI-MESO BRIGHT is an advanced professional microneedling serum developed to improve skin brightness, clarity and overall skin tone. Designed specifically for microneedling and mesotherapy treatments, this high-performance brightening serum helps target pigmentation concerns, dull skin, uneven texture and visible skin discolouration.
 
Its advanced formulation combines powerful brightening ingredients, antioxidants, vitamins and skin-supporting actives to help improve skin radiance while supporting overall skin rejuvenation and clarity.

Formulated with advanced biomimetic peptides, polynucleotides, niacinamide and skin-rejuvenating active ingredients, LUMI-MESO TOX works to support collagen stimulation, skin renewal and improved skin elasticity while helping maintain a smoother and more refined complexion.

NAD+ Vitamin B3 derivative (30ml) is a Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD+) supplement for professional use, administered via intravenous infusion or subcutaneous injection. Each 30ml vial contains 1000mg of high purity NAD+.
Designed with flexibility in mind, the dosage can be tailored to each patient’s requirements.
What is NAD+?
NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is a critical coenzyme involved in:


Cellular energy production (ATP synthesis)


DNA repair and cellular defense mechanisms


Neuroprotection and cognitive function


Metabolic regulation and healthy aging


Natural NAD+ levels decline with age, which may contribute to fatigue, reduced physical and mental performance, and slower recovery. Supplementation may help restore optimal cellular function and support overall wellness.
Levels of NAD+ naturally decline over time, potentially contributing to fatigue, slower recovery, cognitive fog, and age-related decline. Supplementing NAD+ may help support optimal cellular function and promote overall vitality.
Usage
NAD+ Vitamin B3 derivative (30ml) can be administered via intravenous infusion or subcutaneous injection. Dosages can be altered at the discretion of the healthcare professional administering, taking into account the patient’s health goals and any existing health conditions and/or medications.

jsonld.name: Jalupro Glow Peel – 6 x 5ml
jsonld.description:
Jalupro Glow Peel is a gentle yet powerful chemical peel designed to address multiple skin concerns, including fine lines, wrinkles, pigmentation, acne scars and uneven tone. It supports cell renewal, refines skin texture and helps restore a fresh, radiant and more youthful-looking complexion. Developed by Professional Derma, this peel combines targeted amino acids with an advanced acid complex that works in the deeper layers of the epidermis to support long‑term improvement in skin function.
Key Benefits


Skin appears brighter and more luminous immediately after treatment.


Cell renewal is stimulated, helping to promote a smoother, more youthful appearance.


Gentle exfoliation refines the skin’s surface for a more even texture.


The appearance of acne and inflammatory skin concerns is reduced, supporting a clearer complexion.


Pigmentation is visibly softened while the skin is helped to defend against oxidative stress.


Recommended Protocol
Jalupro Glow Peel fits easily into contemporary skincare routines and is suitable for all age groups. For best results, a course of four treatments spaced 2–3 weeks apart is recommended.
After application, slight redness may appear, usually subsiding within a few hours. To protect the skin and enhance outcomes, it is important to maintain intensive hydration and apply sun protection consistently. Even sensitive skin can benefit from the peel’s gentle yet effective action. If significant irritation occurs at any point during treatment, discontinue use immediately and rinse the skin thoroughly.

VITARAN Eyes – 1 x 1ml
 
Advanced Polynucleotide Skin Booster for Under-Eye Rejuvenation, Hydration & Skin Repair
 
What is VITARAN Eyes?
VITARAN Eyes is an advanced polynucleotide skin booster specifically developed for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments. Formulated using highly purified salmon trout DNA, this regenerative injectable treatment helps improve skin quality, hydration and elasticity in the delicate periocular area.
 
Designed specifically for professional aesthetic treatments, VITARAN Eyes helps restore the skin barrier while supporting collagen and elastin production for smoother, firmer and more refreshed-looking under-eyes.
 
Its advanced PN 2% formulation contains 20mg/mL of polynucleotides (PDRN), helping support tissue repair, skin regeneration and protection against oxidative stress.
 
Widely used by aesthetic practitioners across the UK, VITARAN Eyes is suitable for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments targeting tired-looking eyes, fine lines, dehydration and skin laxity.
 
The sterile injectable formulation allows precise professional administration while helping support natural-looking skin revitalisation with minimal downtime.
 
Key Benefits

Professional polynucleotide skin booster
Specifically formulated for the under-eye area
Helps improve skin hydration and elasticity
Supports collagen and elastin production
Helps rejuvenate tired-looking eyes
Assists with skin barrier repair
Protects against free radical damage
Advanced PN 2% polynucleotide formulation
Professional-grade regenerative injectable treatment
CE marked
Minimal downtime treatment option

 
Treatment Areas

Under-eye region
Tear trough area
Periocular fine lines
Delicate eye contour area

 
Why Buy VITARAN Eyes?
VITARAN Eyes is a trusted choice for clinics and aesthetic practitioners seeking a professional polynucleotide treatment designed specifically for delicate under-eye rejuvenation. The treatment is ideal for patients seeking improved hydration, smoother skin texture and refreshed under-eye appearance through professional regenerative aesthetic protocols.
 
Composition
Polynucleotide Sodium 20mg/mL (PN 2%)
 
FAQs
What is VITARAN Eyes used for?
VITARAN Eyes is used for professional under-eye rejuvenation treatments designed to improve hydration, skin quality and overall under-eye appearance.
 
What does VITARAN Eyes contain?
VITARAN Eyes contains highly purified polynucleotides (PDRN) sourced from salmon trout DNA at a concentration of 20mg/mL.
 
Does VITARAN Eyes stimulate collagen production?
Yes. The polynucleotide formulation helps support collagen and elastin production while improving skin regeneration.
 
Contraindications

Pregnancy or breastfeeding
Fish allergies
Active skin infections
Individuals under 18 years old
Autoimmune conditions

 
This product is intended exclusively for administration by licensed healthcare or aesthetic professionals, as required by applicable local laws and professional guidelines.

jsonld.name: Vitamin B12, Liposomal Liquid Sachets.                                                 Strawberry - 14 pk
jsonld.description:
A delicious and convenient high-dose liquid vitamin B12 featuring exceptional absorbability and natural fruit extracts for a delightful taste. 


One sachet a day – perfectly portioned and ready to drink, simply rip, sip and go.

Store at room temperature – but for the best taste, keep in the fridge.

Enjoy your way – straight from the sachet, mixed into water, juice, and smoothies or drizzled over yoghurt, fruit, and oats.

A top tip from us - it tastes particularly delicious chilled.
Ingredients and info
Unlike many liquid supplements, this formula contains no artificial flavourings, sweeteners or preservatives, only carefully selected ingredients for a clean, natural taste.



Ingredients:

Purified Water - the base that carries all the other ingredients.
Phospholipids (Sunflower Oil containing Phosphatidylcholine) - support encapsulation, helping oil- and water-based ingredients blend smoothly and aiding nutrient delivery.
Glycerin (Coconut-Sourced) - a natural humectant from coconuts that helps maintain moisture and stability.
Sweetener (Xylitol) - a plant-based sweetener that adds gentle sweetness without added sugar.
Acidity Regulators (Citric Acid, Potassium Bicarbonate) - naturally occurring compounds that balance flavour and help preserve freshness.

Vanilla and Strawberry Extract (Natural Flavours) - provide a fruity strawberry profile, rounded with smooth vanilla notes.
Oleic Acid (from Olive Oil) - a naturally occurring fatty acid that supports formulation stability.
Antioxidant (D-Alpha Tocopherol) - a natural form of vitamin E that helps protect the product and supports overall health.
2500 µg Vegan Vitamin B12 (as Methylcobalamin) - a highly bioavailable, vegan-friendly form of vitamin B12 that contributes to energy production and nervous system support.

Flavourings:

Strawberry – naturally sweet and fruity, balanced with a smooth hint of vanilla.

Nutrition (per sachet):

Energy – 146 kJ / 35 kcal;
Fat – 3 g (of which saturates – 0 g);
Carbohydrates – 2 g (of which sugars – 0 g);
Protein – 0 g;
Salt – 0 g;
Vitamin B12 – 2500 µg (100,000% NRV);
Vitamin E – 5 mg (42% NRV).

jsonld.name: Seventy Hyal 2000 Single (1 x 2ml)
jsonld.description:
Seventy Hyal 2000 is a bio-stimulating, injectable skin booster intended to help the treatment of physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid (HA) within the skin. The supplementation of hyaluronic acid (HA) simultaneously stimulates the production of new collagen and elastin while delivering moisture-surging hydration for a glowing appearance. 
Seventy Hyal 2000 is the perfect skin booster treatment to improve skin texture and skin laxity whilst gently adding volume. The Next Generation Skin Booster offers one of the highest molecular weights of hyaluronic acid formulations on the market to hydrate, contour and add glow to the skin. Seventy Hyal 2000 can be used for facial enhancements, delivering long-lasting hydration and a glow like no other. Alternatively, it can be used to rejuvenate the neck area, décolleté and hands as well as on the body to reduce the appearance of scarring, sagging and skin laxity.  
 Key Features: 

Contains one of the highest molecular weight hyaluronic acid (HA) formulations on the current market (> 2000 kDa) 
Results are expected to show almost immediately with full results showing two weeks post-treatment 
Covered by leading insurance providers, Insync and Cosmetic Insure 
CE-marked 
Bio-stimulates the production of new collagen and elastin within the skin 
Rejuvenates the skin to improve skin texture, skin laxity, dehydrated skin and crepiness 
With a HA concentration of 30mg per 2ml 

Targeting:  

Skin hydration  
Sagging skin  
Ageing skin  
Scarring  
Improved skin quality  
Reduction in fine lines  
Radiance 
Subtle contour  

Treatment areas: 

Face 
Lips
Neck 
Décolleté 
Hands 
Stomach   
Elbows    
Arms   
Abdomen   
Knees   

Composition: 

High molecular weight Sodium Hyaluronate 1.5, obtained by bacterial fermentation without any chemical modification. 

Other ingredients: Sodium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate 2H₂0, Monosodium Phosphate 2H₂0 Water for Injection. 


Box contents: 

Each box contains: 1 x 2ml pre-filled syringe of Seventy Hyal 2000 (with a HA concentration of 30mg per 2ml)

Incredible results that last between 6 and 12 months

Visible results after just one treatment

jsonld.description:
Kiara is not a traditional skin booster. It’s a clinically backed bio-remodeller designed to improve skin quality by hydrating, lifting, and stimulating collagen production — for subtle, natural-looking results. It deeply hydrates and renews skin, stimulates collagen and elastin synthesis, lifts and firms, and improves elasticity, texture, and overall skin health. The treatment is perfect for patients who are looking for a refreshed and radiant look as it enhances collagen production, elasticity, and deep hydration. 
Key Features

54mg of high purity hyaluronic acid per syringe
CE Marked, meaning that the treatment has been through stringent health, safety, and environmental testing.  
Incredible bio-remodelling results that last between 6-9 months. 
Impressive results can be visible after just a single treatment.  
Progressive tissue remodelling 

Kiara Treatment Areas

Face  
Hands 
Neck  

Composition

Cross-linked HA  
Non-cross-linked HA  
DVS thermal cross-linking  

Kiara Bio Remodelling Benefits

DVS thermal cross-linking ensures incredible purity with fewer impurities  
Adds a natural lift without added volume needed 
Provides anti-inflammatory support post-injection for an enhanced recovery time  
Perfect for patients with age-related facial fat loss, sagging, and loss of elasticity  

High-quality product at an incredibly affordable and accessible price point 


Kiara Contraindications

Must not be given to anyone with an active infection  
Must not be given to women who are pregnant or breastfeeding  
Must not be given to anyone with an autoimmune disease  
Must take caution with any client on anticoagulants or anti-inflammatory medication

description: NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is a vital molecule found in every cell of our body and is involved in various cellular processes, including energy metabolism, DNA repair, and cell signalling. A NAD+ supplement is designed to boost the levels of NAD+ in the body . As we age, NAD+ levels naturally decline. This decrease is associated with various age-related health issues and the overall ageing process. NAD+ supplements, therefore, are taken with the intention of replenishing dwindling NAD+ levels, potentially offering benefits such as: Improved energy production Enhanced cognitive function Cellular repair and protection Potential anti-ageing effects NAD+ supplements can come in various forms, including oral capsules, sublingual tablets, injections, or IV drips. Some forms of supplementation are less effective than others, so please take the time to consider your options. Before considering NAD supplements, it’s crucial to consult with a healthcare professional to ensure its safety and appropriateness for individual health needs. description: Description How does Jalupro HMW work? Jalupro HMW is an injectable solution that has been formulated using a clever combination of amino acids. Technically labelled as a ‘dermal biorevitalizer’, it eradicates skin depressions caused by ageing wrinkles and scars. The science behind Jalupro works by feeding the connective tissue under the skin layers, otherwise known as fibroblasts. Fibroblasts produce collagen and repair skin to ensure it always has elasticity and great looking texture. As skin ages, the fibroblasts function reduces in activity; this can be caused by many factors, including spending too much time in the sun, intense smoking and other reasons. Consequently, wrinkles appear. The amino acids in Jalupro HMW join forces with the existing fibroblasts to help them continue their pre-ageing function. The more abundant the amino acids, the more healthier the skin cells are, resulting in younger appearance. This natural phenomenon is an effective way for skin to look younger again without surgery. What’s in the box? 1 x glass disposable syringe, pyrogen (sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate) 1 x glass bottle sterile solution based on Amino Acids. No needles. In total: (1 x 1.5 ml & 1 x 1.0 ml solutions) What are the benefits of Jalupro HMW? Jalupro HMW can be used to fade out scars and improve skin appearance by eliminating depressions specifically: in the face, neck, decollete, underarms, hands, inner thighs, abdomen area and knees When can Jalupro HMW be used? Jalupro can be used as soon as the face area begins to show signs of ageing and photo-ageing. It can be used to correct dry and dehydrated skin. educe stretch marks and is especially ideal before or after any surgery is to take place. How long will results last for? Whilst results become more evident over time, the average effects can last for 6 months. Can be used prior to sunbathing and works well in mature aged skin.

Description Seventy Hyal 2000 is a bio-stimulating, injectable skin booster intended to help treat the physiological depletion of hyaluronic acid (HA) within the skin. Seventy Hyal 2000 makes for the perfect skin rejuvenation treatment to improve skin texture and skin laxity whilst adding gentle volume. Composition: High molecular weight sodium Hyaluronate 1.5, obtained by bacterial fermentation without any chemical modification. Other ingredients: Sodium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate 2H20, Monosodium Phosphate 2H20 water for injection. description: Description INFINI Premium MESO LipoMAX INFINI Premium MESO LipoMAX 5x10ml is an innovative formula designed for aesthetic treatments to combat fatty tissue. LipoMax causes permanent dissolution of fat accumulations (lipolysis) and is currently one of the most effective and safest alternative to surgical liposuction procedures. Lipolysis is simply non-invasive body contouring, involving the injection of active substances that cause the dissolution of fat cells . An intentional and controlled mild inflammation of the fat tissue is created at the injection site. “Swollen” cells rupture and the fat released from them passes into the blood, with which it goes to the liver, where it is broken down and then excreted from the body. As a result, the excess accumulated tissue disappears and the circumference of the treatment area visibly decreases. The effects of LipoMAX treatment appear gradually over the first few weeks. Their durability depends mainly on the lifestyle and diet used. For permanent and optimal results, 3-5 treatments should be performed at intervals of 21-28 days . TREATMENT INDICATIONS: – levelling of adipose tissue – acceleration of fat cell metabolism – reduction of body circumferences – silhouette modelling – improvement of body contours and firmness INGREDIENTS: Aqua, Butylene Glycol Pentapeptide-25, Benzyl Alcohol, Sodium Hydroxide, Phosphatidylcholine, Caffeine, Carnitine, Sodium Deoxycholate, Theophylline, Polysorbate-80 5 x 10ml Sterile Vials

description: Description INFINI PREMIUM MESO BTX INFINI PREMIUM MESO BTX 5x10ml is an advanced cocktail to combat facial wrinkles and signs of skin ageing. A perfectly balanced combination of hyaluronic acid and argireline prevents the formation of new expressive wrinkles and reduces and stops the deepening of existing wrinkles, giving a spectacular smoothing effect. BTX is an effective stimulator of collagen and elastin synthesis and a stimulator of tissue restructuring. Its main action is muscle hydration of the skin, thanks to which the face regains its youthful contours and appears visibly smoother. Argireline is a hexapeptide that acts as an inhibitor of acetylcholine, which blocks the impulse in the neuromuscular junction. Its “botox-like” effect relies on relaxing the tension of the facial skin’s mimic muscles, which prevents the formation of new expression lines and reduces the depth of the existing ones. Due to the excellent rejuvenating properties of argireline, it is often used as a synthetic and non-toxic alternative to botulinum toxin treatments with clinically proven effectiveness. Recommended mainly for a strong lifting of the temple, forehead, and mouth area. TREATMENT INDICATIONS: – Soft lifting of the skin – Anti-wrinkle and anti-ageing prevention – Strong hydration of the skin – Sustaining the effects of botulinum toxin treatments HYALURONIC ACID: 50mg/10ml PEPTIDE COMPLEX: Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 5 x 10ml Sterile Vials

description: Description HArmonyCa is a hybrid injectable dermal filler treatment from Allergan. It combines hyaluronic acid (HA) with Calcium Hydroxyapatite (CaHA), which is how it gets its name. It is designed to augment, tighten, and lift the skin via injections into the deep dermal and subdermal layers. It also encourages the production of collagen. HArmonyCa may improve your skin architecture by immediately lifting the skin, and supporting your body’s production of collagen. HOW DOES HARMONYCA WORK? The cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel plumps the skin, resulting in an immediate lifting effect. The CaHA particles support the body’s production of collagen, so that new collagen develops. New collagen can be present in the body as early as one week after treatment. Collagen is a protein that is naturally produced in the body, and it can be found in connective tissue, skin, tendon, bone, and cartilage. It provides structural support to tissue. As we age, our bodies’ product less collagen, which can lead to signs of ageing such as sagging skin and wrinkles. HOW LONG DO THE RESULTS LAST FOR? The results should last for around 18 to 36 months, before you will need treatment again. Immediately after the procedure, you will see an increase in volume. Overtime, you will see continuous improvement in the overall quality and appearance of the skin as a result of the new collagen production.

Azzalure is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, also known as vertical lines between the eyebrows. Different clinical trials have validated the effectiveness of Azzalure for treating specific facial lines, involving numerous patients to ensure its efficacy and safety. In addition, frown lines, along with lateral canthal lines, are seen at maximum smile. Therefore, adult patients with visible signs of lines and wrinkles in these facial areas seeking a softening of the area of concern would be good candidates for Azzalure. What are the contraindications of Azzalure? The main contraindications for Azzalure include hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients, muscle weakness as a potential side effect, an existing infection at the injection site, and health conditions such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert Syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Individuals with an infection on the skin surface at the injection site should wait for the infection to fully resolve before undergoing treatment. IMPORTANT — PLEASE INSPECT BEFORE USE Azzalure contains a very small quantity of freeze-dried product, which may appear as a thin, barely visible film inside the vial rather than an obvious amount of powder. The rubber stopper must never be removed. Once a vial has been opened, had its stopper removed or been reconstituted, its original condition and sterility are compromised, and it may no longer be possible to return it to the laboratory for an accurate investigation. Opened or reconstituted products cannot be accepted as evidence of a manufacturing defect. Please do not use any vial if you have concerns about its condition or integrity.

description: Description Ejal 40 is a bio-revitalizing gel containing the latest generation of medium molecular weight hyaluronic acid ideal to rebuild the basic structure of the extracellular matrix. Treatments with Ejal 40 will firm sagging skin, reduce wrinkles, improve the skin tone and elasticity as well as improve the overall skin condition. A fantastic alternative to Profhilo. The formula of the product contains an optimal combination of molecular concentration and molecular weight of 40mg HA and 1200-1800 kDaltons, formulated in a phy­siological, sterile, biodegradable, and isotonic buffer. The syringe is pre-filled and contains 2,0ml of gel. Ejal 40 can be injected with several techniques, but the most effective technique is the 4-point technology (4 PBR), which allows the injection of 25ml with a 30G needle on each side of the face that minimizes the risk of edema, bruising, and pain. Treatments with Ejal 40 improves the density of the skin by stimulating fibroblasts and the formation of collagen and elastin fibers. Treatments with hyaluronic acid stimulate the production of new collagen and restore the level of natural hyaluronic acid in the skin by counteracting the breakdown process. Furthermore, the product is designed to restructure and reinforce the extracellular matrix revitalizing skin that is dehydrated and dama­ged by aging and solar exposure.

description: Description Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine contains biocompatible hyaluronic acid which is an injectable filler that provides instant results that are natural. What is Volift? Volift utilises VYCROSS™ technology; an innovative combination of low and high molecular weight HA to improve the cross-linking efficiency of HA chains. The cross-linking enables a low concentration of Hyaluronic acid to provide effective natural long-lasting results, alongside minimal swelling and bruising. What is in the box? 2 x 1ml syringes What can Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine be used for? Reduction of nasolabial folds whilst restoring your natural contours within the face. How long will effects last? A 30 minute treatment sessions can give you effects lasting for up to 15 months. Who should not use Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine? Pregnant or lactating women should not use Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine. If you are considering Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine, inform your Physician of any previous permanent products or body enhancing products you have used. You should also make them aware of any allergies, immune diseases and infections you have. Similarly if you have hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid. The treatment should not be used in conjunction with any skin treatments including laser or dear abrasion treatment. What are the associated side effects with Juvéderm® VOLIFT® with lidocaine? Common symptoms such as swelling, bruising and redness can occur at the site of gel injection. Resolution is usually within one week.

description: Description DISOLVIDASE is a Meso-Lyophilised powder diffusion solution of Hyaluronidase which is an enzyme (natural substance that activates processes in the body), that digests Hyaluronic Acid fibers. It is able to cut the Hyaluronic Acid polymer. Hyaluronidase is a treatment to accelerate the natural breakdown of Hyaluronic Acid. It increases tissue permeability and promotes the spread or dispersion of other injected fillers. DISOLVIDASE only used to decrease some overcorrections (bumps) created by Dermal Filling with Hyaluronic Acid. PURPOSE AND INDICATIONS: Hyaluronidase enzymes degrade Hyaluronic Acid, additionally, it increases the permeability of active substances, increases the rate of diffusion and has a marked permeability effect. DISOLVIDASE is to be used only as a cosmetic agent and not as a drug. DESCRIPTION/ PHARMACEUTICAL FORM: DISOLVIDASE is a white, sterile freeze-dried powder for solution for injection, containing 1.500 international units of the active ingredient Hyaluronidase. Indicated to remove the effects of Hyaluronic Acid fillers (with which an individual is not happy or satisfied). PRESENTATION: Each box contains of 5 sterilized vials x 1.500 I.U Each vial is intended for single patient use. THE ACTIVE INGREDIENT/COMPOSITION: Each 10 ml vial contains: HYALURONIDASE 1.500 I.U. POWDER FOR SOLUTION. DESIGNED FOR: Dissolving Hyaluronic acid fillers. Diffusion of uncomplicated nodules and overcorrection, inflamed nodules, or tissue ischemia associated with HA filler injection. Hydrolipodystrophy grade III & IV. Transport of cosmetic agents DISCLAIMER: DISOLVIDASE must only be used by or under the supervision of a medical aesthetic specialist or Dermatologist. It is essential that the medical professional keeps a record of details relating to the treatment and the patient (personal details and batch number of the product applied). Consultation is required before treatment. METHOD OF ADMINISTRATION / USER INDICATION (BEAUTY THERAPIST): Topical application. Needle-free Mesotherapy. Derma Roller. Electroporation. Iontophoresis.

description: Description JUVÉDERM ULTRA 4 Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ contains biocompatible hyaluronic acid which is an injectable filler that provides instant results that are natural so no one will guess anything has even been done. What is Hyaluronic Acid? Hyaluronic acid (HA) is a natural substance found inside the human body. It's key properties are to keep the skin hydrated whilst adding plumpness. HA naturally breaks down in the body during metabolism and is then replaced. However as we get older and our metabolism slows down, replacement of HA is less often which results in less hydrated skin and less volume in the skin. Medical professionals have been using HA in arthritis treatment and during eye surgery. What is in the box? 2 x 1ml syringes What can Juvederm be used for? Make cheeks and cheekbones look younger and healthier. Increasing fat content in the face following loss of weight which have made cheeks become hollow. It can also be used for correcting folds and wrinkles in the face. The gel containing lidocaine can be administered without any pain due to its smooth consistency. How long will effects last? The effects can be seen for up to 12 months. Who should not use Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ Pregnant or lactating women should not use Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ If you are considering using Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ , then you must inform your Physician of any previous permanent products or body enhancing products you have used. You should also make them aware of any allergies, immune diseases and infections you have. Similarly if you have hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid. The treatment should not be used in conjunction with any skin treatments including laser or dear abrasion treatment. Individuals seeking correction of frown lines should also not use this product. What are the associated side effects with Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ ? Common symptoms such as swelling, bruising and redness can occur at the site of gel injection. Resolution is usually within one week.

What is Hyaluronic Acid? Hyaluronic acid (HA) is a natural substance found inside the human body. It's key properties are to keep the skin hydrated whilst adding plumpness. HA naturally breaks down in the body during metabolism and is then replaced. However as we get older and our metabolism slows down, replacement of HA is less often which results in less hydrated skin and less volume in the skin. Medical professionals have been using HA in arthritis treatment and during eye surgery. What is in the box? 2 x 0.55ml syringes What can Juvederm Ultra Smile be used for? Juvederm Ultra Smile is a leading filler used for enhancing lip volume. The gel containing lidocaine can be administered without any pain due to its smooth consistency. How long will effects last? The effects can be seen for up to 12 months. Who should not use Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ SMILE Pregnant or lactating women should not use Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ SMILE If you are considering using Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ SMILE , then you must inform your Physician of any previous permanent products or body enhancing products you have used. You should also make them aware of any allergies, immune diseases and infections you have. Similarly if you have hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid. The treatment should not be used in conjunction with any skin treatments including laser or dear abrasion treatment. Individuals seeking correction of frown lines should also not use this product. What are the associated side effects with Juvéderm™ ULTRA™ SMILE? Common symptoms such as swelling, bruising and redness can occur at the site of gel injection. Resolution is usually within one week.

description: Description AMI eyes AMI eyes is a premium PN product which improves the conditions of damaged dermis with tissue regeneration material and purified DNA from salmon milt. Polydeoxyribonuclotides (PDRN) has previously been used as a skin injectable for anti-aging and hair growth treatments in Korea, and medically for skin regeneration purposes. PN is a purer and more concentrated form of PDRN and has stronger regenerative properties. Benefits of AMI eyes are: Increases skin elasticity Tightening effect of enlarged pores Increase fibroblast function Abundant moisture supply with polymer hyaluronic acid Improvement of skin tone and oil-water balance So, how to use AMI eyes ? Under eye treatment Use 30g 13mm needle or multi needle / Meso needle Point 6 ~ 10 spots under one eye Inject the same amount ( 1ml for one eye / 2ml for one session total ) *You can inject more amount on the dark circle area. Mesotherapy Use 33g needle or multi needle / Meso needle Inject the same amount ( 2ml for whole face ) * if you use AMI eyes with Collagen filler or HA booster, the effect will be better and last longer.

description: Description Jalupro HMW is composed of – one glass disposable syringe, apyrogen, containing a sterile gel of Sodium Hyaluronate; – one glass bottle containing a sterile solution based on Amino Acids. The package does not contain needles. WHEN TO USE JALUPRO – Photo-aging and Anti-aging of a face and a body (moderate and severe degree) – Dry and dehydrated skin – Procedures during summer time – The beginning of the course of revitalization (possible to combine with Jalupro) – Preparation, improvement and prolongation of results for different aesthetic – procedures WHERE Face, Neck, Decollete, Underarms, Hands, Inner thighs, Abdomen, Knee region INJECTION TECHNIQUES Micropapules, Linear, Fan shape, Grid shaped, mixed. A local anaesthetic can be associated – 0,5-1 ml of 2% procaine – in order to reduce the burning sensation which follows the injection. The needle has to be inserted along the wrinkle and then gradually retracted, by releasing the product. After injection, if necessary, proceed with a light massage in order to model the treated zone. For the correction of thin wrinkles, the more recommended site of injection is typically reticular dermis. FEEDING THE FIBROBLASTS WITH AMINO ACIDS The cells of the subcutaneous connective tissue in our skin are called fibroblasts. Fibroblasts act by forming collagen and repairing fragile and worn out skin, ensuring skin tone and elasticity.Fibroblasts activity reduces over time because of aging or other reasons (eating habits, diets, smoking, intense physical activity, long exposure to the sun). Therefore, skin gets old, loses tone, elasticity, brightness, volume, and subsequently wrinkles and furrows appear. Fibroblasts produce collagen by using a nutritional support: Amino Acids (Glicine, L-Proline, L-Lysine) which are essential to compensate the reduced fibroblasts activity. More is high the Amino Acids quantity available in the interested areas, more cells vitality and their number increase. Therefore, skin appearance gets better greatly. THE RESULTS A RAPID AND SAFE RECOVERY OF THE WRINKLE Jalupro’s use means to reduce skin wrinkleness significantly. Especially the product has shown to have an excellent biorevitalizing efficacy and to improve the main skin aging and photoaging signs. This efficacy grows over time and lasts 6 months. Jalupro’s tolerance was very good in all treated subjects and the treatment is ideal before sunbathing too.

Fibroblasts produce collagen by using a nutritional support: Amino Acids (Glicine, L-Proline, L-Lysine) which are essential to compensate the reduced fibroblasts activity. More is high the Amino Acids quantity available in the interested areas, more cells vitality and their number increase. Therefore, skin appearance gets better greatly.

description: Description A new concept has been added to the range – Revitalize Essence is the future of mesotherapy. It has an optimised potential to hydrate the tissues with added cross-link technology to give much longer lasting results, this new serum is set to revolutionise the mesotherapy industry. Cross-linking increases the resistance of hyaluronic acid molecules to the body’s degradation rate therefore allowing them to remain in-situ for an extended time and giving patients an improved result for longer. Revitalize Essence has been developed by the My Med experts in response to the need for a long-lasting bio-revitalization product. It has both high & low-density molecules perfectly balanced to give optimum hydration coupled with a robust viscosity for added support within the dermis. This combination makes it a ‘hybrid’ offering clients the rejuvenating properties of a top-quality mesotherapy serum whilst physically smoothing wrinkles & skin imperfections in the same way that dermal fillers work within the tissues. Product for topical use, not suitable for injection. Packaging: 2 vials, 5 ml each. Indication: For all skin types requiring hydration & regeneration. Restores elasticity to the skin & promotes longer lasting collagen production. Application: Face, neck, hands, décolletage, arms, tummy, thighs & any area that requires rejuvenation. Administration: all mesotherapy techniques including microneedling, electroporation, ultrasound, iontophoresis and nappage. Using Revitalize Pen considerably speed up the results. Can be mixed with the other Revitalize serums to enhance performance (except Revitalize Booster).

description: Description WHAT IS LETYBO? Letybo is a new Botulinum Toxin Type A, now available and approved for use in the UK, from aesthetic manufacturer Croma-Pharmacy. Letybo can be used to treat the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, (wrinkles and lines between the eyebrows and forehead) in adults. One vial contains 50 units of botulinum toxin type A produced by Clostridium botulinum. The recommended dose is a total of 20 units, divided into 5 injections of 4 units each. You can purchase. WHAT ARE THE SIDE EFFECTS? The side effects are minimal, but you may experience reactions at the injection site, such as swelling, which should fade within 48 hours. You may also experience a headache, dropping of the eyelids, twitching eyelids, head discomfort, and bruising, which should fade within 1 to 2 weeks. WHO SHOULD NOT USE LETYBO? You should not use Letybo if you are pregnant or breast-feeding. You should consult a doctor before any treatment, and they will be able to help you decide the type of treatment needed. description: Description Box Contents Each box contains x2 Azzalure 125UI Vials Prescription-only medication Indicated for use on moderate to severe Glabellar lines and Lateral canthal lines Storage Keep refrigerated at 2-8°C https://www.galderma.com/azzalure Who is a good candidate for Azzalure? Azzalure is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines, also known as vertical lines between the eyebrows. Different clinical trials have validated the effectiveness of Azzalure for treating specific facial lines, involving numerous patients to ensure its efficacy and safety. In addition, frown lines, along with lateral canthal lines, are seen at maximum smile. Therefore, adult patients with visible signs of lines and wrinkles in these facial areas seeking a softening of the area of concern would be good candidates for Azzalure. Patients must be under 65 years old and not have any contraindications that would make them unsuitable for Azzalure treatment. How long does azzalure take to work? Clients should begin to notice a softening of the lines and wrinkles 2 to 3 days after treatment. After two weeks, the client should see the optimal level of results. What are the contraindications of Azzalure? The main contraindications for Azzalure include hypersensitivity to any of the ingredients, muscle weakness as a potential side effect, an existing infection at the injection site, and health conditions such as myasthenia gravis, Eaton-Lambert Syndrome, or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Individuals with an infection on the skin surface at the injection site should wait for the infection to fully resolve before undergoing treatment. IMPORTANT — PLEASE INSPECT BEFORE USE Azzalure contains a very small quantity of freeze-dried product, which may appear as a thin, barely visible film inside the vial rather than an obvious amount of powder. Please inspect every vial carefully before removing the flip-off cap, piercing the rubber stopper or injecting saline. If you believe a vial is empty, damaged or defective, do not open, reconstitute or otherwise tamper with it. Take clear photographs of the sealed vial and contact us immediately with the batch number and expiry date. Saline must be injected through the intact rubber stopper using a sterile needle. The rubber stopper must never be removed. Once a vial has been opened, had its stopper removed or been reconstituted, its original condition and sterility are compromised, and it may no longer be possible to return it to the laboratory for an accurate investigation. Opened or reconstituted products cannot be accepted as evidence of a manufacturing defect. Please do not use any vial if you have concerns about its condition or integrity.

description: Description The operation is very simple and the effect is particularly obvious. Brightens the skin: Promotes local tissue microcirculation, allowing for stronger cell regeneration and tissue repair, plumps up the skin, brightens the overall complexion and improves pigmentation.Collagen regeneration: Pdo cog is not a smooth thread, it is like the stem of a rose, with many small thorns that hook the skin, lift, fix and prevent sagging effect on the skin.Support and plumping: The pdo threads create a three-dimensional network to support collapsed subcutaneous tissue as a whole, while promoting subcutaneous blood circulation for rosy, radiant skin. Please use immediately after opening the package and keep out of direct sunlight during handling. This product is a disposable device, please do not reuse or resterilized it. The bleeding point is less likely to be bruised and less likely to be swollen after surgery. Non-Toxic, Non-Pyrogenic, sterilized by E.O.Gas.

description: Description AfterMed Lips is an innovative and market-first premium aftercare product, uniquely formulated to reduce the common side effects of having a lip filler procedure, such as swelling, bruising, and discomfort. It is ideal to use straight after any lip treatment, such as dermal filler, lip blush and filler dissolving, and can be used as an in-clinic after-care product or sold to the patient to take home with them for repeated use. AfterMed Lips contains Arnica for its soothing and bruise-healing properties, Kahai Oil for hydration and firmness, and Colloidal oats which include avenanthramides; these work like an anti-inflammatory, to reduce redness and itchiness when the skin is irritated. Recommended protocol: Apply post lip filler, every 2 hours & before bed to help with swelling. Use for up to 14 days. Key Features: Premium and safe alternative to petroleum jelly which is made from leftover material from oil and gas production. The product has a low molecular weight to cross the dermal barrier. Ingredients contain anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial and antibacterial properties – meaning it is safe to use on the lip after procedures. Contains lipids, such as Omega 6, to retain moisture. Active cooling agents included. Vegan. Formulated, developed and manufactured in the UK. Product shelf-life 3 years unopened, 12 months once opened. 75 treatments/pumps per bottle. Treatment Areas: Designed for the lips. Can also be used on the face after injectable procedures. Ingredients: Arnica Kahai Oil Colloidal Oats Ingredients contain anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial and antibacterial properties – meaning it is safe to use on the lip after procedures. Box Contents: One 15ml pump bottle.

description: Description PLENHYAGE XL Medium is a disposable sterile product that belongs to the new concept of regenerative medicine. The product contains 2% high molecular weight polynucleotides that are ideal for repairing, revitalising, and regenerating facial tissues. Plenhyage is renowned for its anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals. These radicals, often generated by external agents like UV rays and stress, can wreak havoc on skin cells, leading to cell damage, dehydration, and skin elasticity reduction. This treatment is designed to promote cell turnover, improve skin elasticity and hydration, and heal sun-damaged skin, photoaging, and scars (acne). PLENHYAGE XL Medium is also an excellent option for preparing facial skin for other aesthetic medicine treatments. The polynucleotide chain in PLENHYAGE XL Medium has an anti-free radical action, acting as a scavenger of OH hydroxyl radicals that tend to accumulate because of stress, cell damage, and external agents such as UV rays. The moisturising action and anti-free radical activity help to create an optimal environment for the growth of fibroblasts, helping to restore the elasticity of the tissues. PLENHYAGE XL Medium contains natural DNA fractions called nucleotides, which are the peculiar and original ingredients of this new product. The antioxidant action of these nucleotides protects against and reduces cell damage caused by UV radiation or scars.

description: Description Vitaran I (or "Vitaran Eyes") is a specialized polynucleotide injectable skin booster designed to rejuvenate the delicate under-eye area. It comes in a 1 x 1ml syringe and is used by qualified aesthetic practitioners to improve skin quality, firmness, and hydration. Key features Active ingredient: The injectable is made from highly purified and sterilized fragments of salmon DNA. This ingredient works at a cellular level as a bio-stimulator. Mechanism of action: Polynucleotides promote the natural repair and regeneration of skin cells. It stimulates the production of collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid to improve the skin's structure and elasticity. It also has anti-inflammatory properties that help combat free radical damage. Target area: Vitaran I is specifically formulated for the thin, sensitive skin in the periorbital (under-eye) area. This makes it a targeted solution for concerns that may be challenging to treat with traditional fillers. Box contents: The product is sold as a 1 x 1ml syringe, with some boxes containing needles (typically 33G or 34G) appropriate for the treatment.

This single syringe of high-performance injectable solution is expertly formulated to combat all major signs of ageing and environmental damage across the face, working at a deep cellular level to repair and renew. Treatment Versatility: The 1 x 2.5ml format offers flexibility for comprehensive facial coverage or targeted application in areas of concern. Lumi-PN is suitable for a wide range of clients seeking a visible and natural improvement in skin quality without invasive procedures. Recommended protocols typically involve a course of 2–3 initial sessions, spaced a few weeks apart, followed by maintenance treatments for long-lasting results.

description: Description Dermaheal HL: The Professional Solution for Hair Recovery Dermaheal HL (Hair Loss) is a sophisticated mesotherapy treatment engineered to prevent hair loss and encourage robust regrowth. The Science of Stronger Hair At the core of Dermaheal HL is a potent blend of 56 active ingredients.
