Nucleic Acids & Minerals: Support cellular repair and maintain the scalp’s moisture balance, creating the optimal environment for growth. Indications for Treatment Dermaheal HL is a versatile solution suitable for a wide range of hair and scalp concerns: Alopecia: Effective for both focal and diffuse alopecia in men and women. Hormonal Thinning: Addresses hair loss related to menopause or hormonal imbalances. Environmental & Lifestyle Damage: Repairs hair weakened by stress, pollution, or poor diet. Scalp Health: Treats dry, exhausted scalps and damaged hair structures like split ends. Key Benefits Stimulates Regrowth: Actively encourages follicles to enter the growth phase. Enhances Volume: Significantly improves hair fullness and thickness for a denser appearance. Boosts Circulation: Increases blood flow to the scalp, delivering oxygen and nutrients to the roots. Restores Scalp Vitality: Deeply moisturises and eliminates dryness, reducing irritation and flaking. Strengthens Hair Structure: Results in hair that is less prone to breakage and environmental damage. Empower your clients to regain their confidence by stocking Dermaheal HL.

description: Description Description Ares HB Hair Booster by Cmed Aesthetics is a revolutionary mesotherapy treatment that addresses hair thinning and loss. Developed with years of research and expertise, this product harnesses the power of advanced ingredients to stimulate hair follicles, strengthen the scalp, and promote hair growth. The unique blend of ingredients in Ares HB includes potent peptides, vitamins, and minerals that work together to revitalize the scalp and support healthy hair growth. By targeting the root cause of hair loss, Ares HB provides a comprehensive solution for both men and women seeking to restore their hair’s natural thickness and vitality. What makes this product different than the rest is the patented sterilisation process that is not done with heat allowing for all the raw ingredients of the product within Ares Hair booster stay wholly intact. Ares HB Treatment Areas: Ares HB Hair booster is specifically formulated for use on the scalp. It can be effectively applied to areas experiencing hair thinning or loss, including the crown, temples, and frontal hairline and even eyebrows. The precise administration of this mesotherapy treatment ensures targeted delivery to the hair follicles, maximizing its efficacy. Usage: Ares HB is administered through micro-injections into the scalp, performed by trained aesthetic doctors or skin therapists. The treatment protocol may vary depending on the severity of the hair loss and the individual’s needs. Multiple sessions are typically recommended for optimal results, with intervals of 2 to 4 weeks between treatments. Ingredient List: Peptides: These powerful amino acid chains promote hair follicle stimulation and strengthen the scalp. Vitamins: Ares HB contains a blend of essential vitamins, including Biotin and Panthenol, which nourish the hair follicles and support healthy hair growth. Minerals: Key minerals such as Zinc and Copper are included to maintain scalp health and improve the overall condition of the hair. Hyaluronic Acid: Known for its hydrating properties, Hyaluronic Acid helps to improve scalp moisture and promote a healthy environment for hair growth. Product Dimensions/Size: Ares HB comes in a pack of four vials, each containing 4ml of the solution. This generous size ensures an ample supply for repeated treatments and allows for comprehensive coverage of the treatment areas. Product Duration: The duration of Ares HB’s effects varies depending on individual factors such as hair growth cycle, lifestyle, and overall hair health. Generally, patients can expect visible improvements within a few weeks of starting the treatment. For long-lasting results, maintenance sessions are recommended every 3 to 6 months.

description: Description Vitamin D3 Streuli is a vitamin supplement used to help maintain healthy bones, teeth, and muscle function. Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) plays an essential role in regulating calcium and phosphate levels in the body, which are vital for strong skeletal health. It is commonly recommended for individuals who have low sun exposure, dietary deficiencies, or increased needs due to age, lifestyle, or medical conditions. Supplementing with Vitamin D3 can also support normal immune system function. Vitamin D3 Streuli is available in convenient oral drops or tablets (depending on the preparation) and is suitable for both treatment and prevention of vitamin D deficiency, as prescribed by your healthcare professional. Regular use as directed helps restore optimal vitamin D levels and reduces the risk of deficiency-related problems such as rickets or osteomalacia.

Hydration: Nourishing the skin barrier to improve natural immunity and moisture retention.

description: Description Juvelook is an advanced hybrid filler that blends HA with Polylactic Acid (PLA). HA delivers deep hydration for an instant plumping effect, while PLA works beneath the surface to stimulate natural collagen production, providing long-lasting wrinkle reduction and skin renewal. Juvelook is CE marked. The result: Smoother, firmer, and more youthful looking skin. Juvelook contains KFDA-approved Poly DL-Kactide, a form of PLA that is known to stimulate the production of collagen in the skin. When injected, the PLA particles work to replace lost collagen and reinforce the skin’s structure. Over time, the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles will decrease as the skin’s collagen levels rise. HA helps to provide an immediate plumping effect, drawing moisture into the skin. When the effects of the HA wear off, the PLA continues to boost collagen synthesis. This means that the skin will gradually become smoother and look younger after the injection, with the results lasting up to 2 years. Main benefits: Long lasting anti aging affection Visible anti wrinkle effects Safe, non toxic, biodegradable Juvelook comes in powder form and needs to be diluted with distilled water and a numbing agent before use. Store at room temperature, avoiding excessive temperatures. Box contains 1 x 50ml

description: Description The Dr Pen A10 microneedling cartridges offer a safe and effective way to rejuvenate the skin, refine pores, and restore youthful radiance. Each cartridge is made of surgical-grade stainless steel, sterilised using EO gas, and individually packaged to ensure hygiene and reliability. Available in multiple pin configurations, these cartridges are suitable for both small and large treatment areas: 12 & 24 Pin: Ideal for fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, melasma, and rosacea. 36 & 42 Pin: Perfect for larger zones, helping to reduce stretch marks, large pores, and improve skin hydration. Nano: Gentle epidermal treatment for BB Glow, serum penetration, and brow regrowth. Microneedling creates tiny micro-channels in the skin, triggering the body’s natural repair mechanisms to increase collagen and elastin production. The treatment also boosts the absorption of active skincare products for enhanced results. Key Benefits: Stimulates collagen and elastin growth Refines skin texture and tone Enhances effectiveness of serums and treatments Safe, single-use design for professional or home use Pin options tailored to treatment area and goal Aftercare Advice: Prepare skin by cleansing and drying thoroughly. Apply SPF and avoid excessive sun or swimming for 24 hours. Adjust depth and speed according to skin sensitivity and treatment area, and seek professional guidance if unsure.

description: Description Stylage® Hydromax is an effective skin booster designed to improve hydration and overall skin appearance. It contains cross-linked hyaluronic acid to retain moisture and sorbitol to help protect the skin from damage caused by environmental factors. The treatment works by gently stimulating collagen and improving skin elasticity, helping the skin look smoother, firmer, and more refreshed. It is especially helpful for dry skin, fine lines, and dull or tired-looking complexions. Stylage® Hydromax can be used on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands, and is delivered through small microinjections into the skin. Most patients require 2–3 sessions for best results, with effects lasting around 6–9 months. This treatment is a great option for anyone looking for natural skin improvement and long-lasting hydration without changing facial volume.

description: Description Alyval Med Intimate Care An innovative formula that deeply moisturises and soothes delicate skin, helping to improve intimate comfort. Ideal as an adjunct treatment to help relieve redness, itching, burning, and irritation in the intimate area. Alyval Med Intimate Cream has undergone gynecological testing and is specifically designed to influence metabolic-sensory modulation, providing enduring relief to sensitive intimate regions. It hydrates, calms, and aids in restoring equilibrium, thereby enhancing comfort and promoting vaginal health. Alyval Med Intimate Care is specifically designed for the delicate intimate region, offering gentle yet effective support to alleviate symptoms associated with vulvodynia, dyspareunia, and allergic contact eczema, such as redness, itching, burning, and irritation. Alyval Med Intimate Care helps to: Support the adjunct treatment of vulvodynia (vestibulodynia) Reduce itching, burning and discomfort during sexual intercourse (dyspareunia). Provides relief in cases of allergic contact eczema (which may be triggered by underwear, latex, tampons etc) Soothes red or irritated skin, ideal for post-depilation care Suitable for daily use and sensitive skin At the core of this innovation lies Alyval’s patented pealiquitech™ technology, which incorporates PEA (palmitoylethanolamide). PEA is a naturally occurring molecule synthesized by the body, recognized for its anti-inflammatory, soothing, antimicrobial, and neuroprotective characteristics. Nevertheless, because of its low solubility, PEA is generally challenging for the skin to absorb. Through a distinctive solubilization method, pealiquitech™ guarantees that PEA stays stable, active, and bioavailable at elevated concentrations, facilitating a gradual release for optimal effectiveness. Other added ingredients include Hyaluronic Acid, Argireline and Vitamin B12. Size : 50ml Directions: Suitable for all ages, it helps relieve symptoms of vulvodynia, dyspareunia, and allergic contact eczema, including redness, itching, burning and irritation in the intimate area. After cleansing the intimate area with Alyval Vital Cleanser, apply a small amount of Alyval Med Intimate Cream directly to the area and gently massage. Use daily or as needed.

description: Description Alyval Regenera Intimate Care A targeted treatment that helps repair and regenerate delicate tissues through its moisturising and soothing action on stressed and atrophic skin. Alyval Regenera Intimate Cream has undergone gynecological testing and is specifically designed to repair and rejuvenate sensitive intimate tissues. It is especially effective for atrophied tissue, vaginal dryness, skin that has been stressed due to surgical or pharmaceutical interventions, and for the treatment of lichen sclerosus. Alyval Regenera Intimate Cream provides deep soothing, hydration, and comfort to the sensitive intimate region, facilitating the restoration of elasticity, tone, and overall tissue resilience for enduring relief and enhanced intimate health. At the core of this innovation lies Alyval’s patented pealiquitech™ technology, which incorporates PEA (palmitoylethanolamide) — a naturally occurring molecule known for its anti-inflammatory, soothing, antimicrobial, and neuroprotective properties. However, through a distinctive solubilisation process, pealiquitech™ guarantees that PEA stays stable, active, and bioavailable at elevated concentrations, allowing for a gradual release that maximizes efficacy. Vitamin E (Tocotrienols) provides antioxidant defense and aids in the restoration of sensitive intimate skin. Moreover, it includes Biosaccharide Gum-2, a natural polysaccharide that functions as a biological barrier, safeguarding the skin against external irritants and assisting in the regulation of inflammatory reactions. description: Description 4T Medical Wound Spray 75ml | Product Description The 4T Medical Wound Spray is a CE-marked (CE0481) solution intended for cleansing and irrigation of wounds in professional healthcare settings. Formulated with sodium hypochlorite and hypochlorous acid (HOCl), it provides a ready-to-use option for wound cleaning procedures without the addition of harsh agents. HOCl is a substance naturally found in the body’s immune response, and in this context, it is incorporated into a stable formulation suitable for external application. This spray is designed to assist clinicians and carers in maintaining a clean wound environment during routine dressing changes or wound care protocols. It can be applied directly to the wound area to aid the mechanical removal of visible debris and residues prior to dressing application. By supporting routine cleansing practices, it helps prepare the wound bed for the next stage of care as directed by local guidelines. The 4T Medical Wound Spray is supplied in a convenient spray bottle for direct application, enabling controlled and hygienic delivery of the solution to the required site. It is suitable for use in hospitals, clinics, and other professional healthcare environments and is compatible with most standard dressing materials. Each bottle is clearly labelled with usage instructions, CE marking, and safety information to support correct handling by healthcare professionals. It is intended for external use only and for single-patient application according to clinical protocol.

description: Description RRS® HA Long Lasting is a sterile, resorbable dermal implant designed for skin revitalisation, long-lasting hydration, and improvement of early signs of skin ageing. Developed by Skin Tech Pharma Group, the product combines BDDE cross-linked hyaluronic acid with a protective amino acid buffer intended to support hydration, antioxidant protection, and dermal regeneration. RRS® HA Long Lasting is positioned within the category of hybrid skin boosters and biorevitalising injectables. It is commonly used to improve skin elasticity, superficial to moderate wrinkles, dermal atrophy, and photoaged skin. The formulation contains 21 mg/3 ml cross-linked hyaluronic acid together with 15 amino acids that help stabilise the HA while supporting tissue quality and hydration. The product is frequently selected for patients presenting with dull, dehydrated, lax, or prematurely aged skin, particularly in facial areas such as the cheeks, jawline, nasolabial folds, and marionette lines. Results may remain visible for approximately 9–12 months depending on patient-specific factors and treatment protocol. What RRS® HA Long Lasting Is Similar To RRS® HA Long Lasting is often compared with injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisers such as Profhilo and Jalupro Super Hydro due to its focus on hydration, skin quality improvement, and collagen-supportive activity. Like Profhilo®, RRS® HA Long Lasting uses hyaluronic acid to improve hydration and skin elasticity. However, RRS® HA Long Lasting incorporates an amino acid protective buffer and cross-linked HA structure intended to prolong hydration effects and support antioxidant activity. Compared with Jalupro Super Hydro, RRS® HA Long Lasting also combines HA with amino acids, but it is generally positioned more toward long-lasting hydration and dermal support rather than intensive collagen biostimulation alone. The product is additionally described by some distributors as a hybrid between a skin booster and a soft dermal filler due to its cross-linked HA composition. This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability. Treatment Areas / Indications Manufacturer and distributor information indicates use for: Face Jawline Cheeks Chin Nasolabial folds Marionette lines Décolletage Hands Areas affected by photoaging and dermal atrophy Primary indications include: Skin hydration BioRevitalisation Improvement of skin elasticity Reduction of superficial and moderate wrinkles Support for photoaged skin Improvement of tired or dull skin appearance Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section) According to publicly available manufacturer and distributor guidance: Recommended injection depth: deep dermis Suggested needle size: 30G needle Proposed maintenance schedule: 1–3 booster sessions may be performed depending on clinical outcome Injection volume per point: not provided by manufacturer Number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer The product should only be administered by qualified medical professionals under appropriate aseptic conditions. Some practitioners apply a “7-point technique”; however, this is not clearly established within the official manufacturer IFU guidance and may vary according to practitioner preference.

jsonld.name: RRS HA Long Lasting (1x3ml)
jsonld.description:
RRS® HA Long Lasting is a sterile, resorbable dermal implant designed for skin revitalisation, long-lasting hydration, and improvement of early signs of skin ageing. Developed by Skin Tech Pharma Group, the product combines BDDE cross-linked hyaluronic acid with a protective amino acid buffer intended to support hydration, antioxidant protection, and dermal regeneration.

RRS® HA Long Lasting is positioned within the category of hybrid skin boosters and biorevitalising injectables. It is commonly used to improve skin elasticity, superficial to moderate wrinkles, dermal atrophy, and photoaged skin. The formulation contains 21 mg/3 ml cross-linked hyaluronic acid together with 15 amino acids that help stabilise the HA while supporting tissue quality and hydration.

The product is frequently selected for patients presenting with dull, dehydrated, lax, or prematurely aged skin, particularly in facial areas such as the cheeks, jawline, nasolabial folds, and marionette lines. Results may remain visible for approximately 9–12 months depending on patient-specific factors and treatment protocol.

What RRS® HA Long Lasting Is Similar To
RRS® HA Long Lasting is often compared with injectable skin boosters and biorevitalisers such as Profhilo and Jalupro Super Hydro due to its focus on hydration, skin quality improvement, and collagen-supportive activity.

Like Profhilo®, RRS® HA Long Lasting uses hyaluronic acid to improve hydration and skin elasticity. However, RRS® HA Long Lasting incorporates an amino acid protective buffer and cross-linked HA structure intended to prolong hydration effects and support antioxidant activity.

Compared with Jalupro Super Hydro, RRS® HA Long Lasting also combines HA with amino acids, but it is generally positioned more toward long-lasting hydration and dermal support rather than intensive collagen biostimulation alone. The product is additionally described by some distributors as a hybrid between a skin booster and a soft dermal filler due to its cross-linked HA composition.

This comparison is provided for clinical orientation only and does not imply interchangeability.

Treatment Areas / Indications
Manufacturer and distributor information indicates use for:

Face
Jawline
Cheeks
Chin
Nasolabial folds
Marionette lines
Décolletage
Hands
Areas affected by photoaging and dermal atrophy
Primary indications include:

Skin hydration
BioRevitalisation
Improvement of skin elasticity
Reduction of superficial and moderate wrinkles
Support for photoaged skin
Improvement of tired or dull skin appearance
Usage / Administration (IFU-Only Section)
According to publicly available manufacturer and distributor guidance:

Recommended injection depth: deep dermis
Suggested needle size: 30G needle
Proposed maintenance schedule: 1–3 booster sessions may be performed depending on clinical outcome
Injection volume per point: not provided by manufacturer
Number of sessions: not provided by manufacturer
The product should only be administered by qualified medical professionals under appropriate aseptic conditions.
Some practitioners apply a “7-point technique”; however, this is not clearly established within the official manufacturer IFU guidance and may vary according to practitioner preference.

description: Description Hyalmass Aqua Exosome An innovative exosome-based hydrating product designed to achieve resilient and radiant skin, giving it an aqua-infused glow. It provides immediate hydration with hyaluronic acid, while PDRN and exosome ingredients support skin regeneration, enhancing the overall skin environment. What makes Hyalmass Aqua Exosome different from traditional hydration products? Hyaluronic acid + PDRN + Exosomes are added as key ingredients. Provides moisture replenishment to the skin in the short term. Helps with skin elasticity and regeneration in the long term Main Ingredients Hyaluronic Acid is a substance that exists in the human body, inducing cell differentiation and growth, providing and maintaining moisture in the skin. It can hold up to 1,000 times its weight in water, making it widely used in products aimed at maintaining skin elasticity and smooth texture Exosomes Exosomes are nano-sized vesicles produced and secreted by cells, generated in trace amounts during the process of culturing stem cells. They contain bioactive molecules such as genetic material and proteins. In the skin, exosomes stimulate fibroblasts to promote collagen production, exhibiting excellent anti-ageing and regenerative effects. Polydeoxyribonucleotide PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a DNA fragment extracted from salmon semen, which has a composition most similar to human DNA. It helps in tissue regeneration by enabling continuous production of growth factors within the body. Activating the skin’s regeneration ability at the cellular level improves the skin environment and restores the skin structure, resulting in firmer and healthier skin. Method of Use Hyalmass Exosome can be used as a Topical product, with Microneedling and as a Mesotherapy (injection) product How to use: (Topical and Microneedling use) 1. Thoroughly clean and disinfect the application area before use. 2. Evenly apply the product to the treatment area. 3. To enhance absorption into the skin, you may use a derma roller or derma pen. (Microneedling) 4. Gently massage the area after application, taking care not to apply excessive pressure. Usage Protocol Topical use | Recommended to use 1 ml in the morning and 1 ml at night. Microneedling | Recommended to use 1 syringe with intervals of 3 weeks Mesotherapy | Recommended to use 3 times at intervals of 3-5 weeks Application Area | Suitable for all facial areas except around the eyes. If any adverse reactions occur during use, consult a specialist immediately.

description: Description PN Eyes is a polynucleotide eye booster designed specifically for the delicate under-eye area. Powered by medical-grade PN (Polynucleotides) derived from salmon DNA, this skin regeneration treatment supports collagen production, improves elasticity, and revitalises tired under-eye skin. Formulated with DNA-based regenerative ingredients, brightening actives, peptides, and hydration boosters, PN Eyes helps restore skin quality, reduce dark circles, smooth fine lines, and strengthen the fragile periorbital skin structure. Unlike traditional eye treatments that target only one concern, Lapiena PN Eyes delivers comprehensive under-eye rejuvenation, combining skin repair, brightening, hydration, and wrinkle improvement in one powerful PN skin booster solution. What is PN (Polynucleotide) Skin Booster? PN (Polynucleotides) are highly purified DNA fragments derived from salmon germ cells, sharing over 95% similarity with human DNA. Polynucleotides are MFDS-approved for wound healing and tissue repair after skin transplantation, making them a trusted ingredient for skin regeneration treatments. Stimulate fibroblast activity Boost collagen and elastin production Improve dermal density and skin thickness Support cellular repair and skin regeneration Reduce micro-inflammation How PN Eyes Improves the Skin’s Regenerative Environment PN Eyes enhances the skin’s regenerative micro-environment, creating optimal conditions for cellular repair and tissue recovery. Because the eye area has thin, fragile skin, PN provides a strong structural foundation for regeneration, helping restore healthy skin structure and improve overall skin quality. Key regenerative actions include Enhancing the skin’s natural repair process Supporting recovery of damaged skin tissue Improving skin elasticity and firmness Reducing micro-inflammation Strengthening delicate under-eye skin

Mounjaro (tirzepatide) solution for injection in pre-filled pen Pharmacology: Long-acting dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist. Enhances glucose-dependent insulin secretion, lowers glucagon, delays gastric emptying and reduces appetite and energy intake. Licensed indication:
Weight management (weight loss and maintenance) in adults, as an adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity, with initial BMI ≥30 kg/m², or ≥27 to <30 kg/m² with at least one weight-related comorbidity Administration: subcutaneous injection into abdomen or thigh, or upper arm (if a carer injects), rotating sites. Any time of day, with or without food. Missed dose: give within 4 days, otherwise skip. Day may be changed if doses are ≥3 days apart. Warnings and precautions: Acute pancreatitis (stop if suspected; do not restart if confirmed). GI adverse effects and dehydration (risk to renal function). Hypoglycaemia with sulfonylurea or insulin (consider dose reduction). Diabetic retinopathy. Pulmonary aspiration risk under general anaesthesia or deep sedation. Report adverse reactions via the MHRA Yellow Card scheme.
Store unopened pens in a refrigerator (2–8 °C). Do not freeze. After first use, may be kept unrefrigerated at no more than 30°C for up to 30 days. Do not use if the solution is cloudy, discoloured or contains particles.

jsonld.description:

Relfydess™▼ is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate-to-severe glabellar lines at maximum frown and moderate-to-severe lateral canthal lines at maximum smile alone or in combination, in adult patients under 65 years, when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. Relfydess SmPC

 

Relfydess™ ▼ (RelabotulinumtoxinA) is the first and only ready-to-use liquid neuromodulator created with PEARL™ Technology, developed and manufactured by Galderma. Relfydess SmPC

 
Relfydess™▼ 100 units/mL solution for injection - Prescribing Information:
Relfydess▼ 100 units/mL solution for injection - Prescribing Information (Ireland) – alternative version
 
▼This medicinal product is subject to additional monitoring. This will allow quick identification of new safety information. Healthcare professionals are asked to report any suspected adverse reactions. See ‘Undesirable Effects’ for how to report adverse reactions.
 
Presentation: Each vial contains 150 units of botulinum toxin type A 100 units/mL manufactured from Clostridium botulinum in 1.5 mL of solution.
Indications: Relfydess is indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of: 
·       Moderate to severe glabellar lines at maximum frown
·       Moderate to severe lateral canthal lines seen at maximum smile 
alone or in combination, in adult patients under 65 years, when the severity of these lines has an important psychological impact on the patient. 
Dosage: The treatment interval should be no more frequently than every twelve weeks. The efficacy and safety of the repeated administration of this product has not been studied for more than 52 weeks. Consideration of the cumulative dose is necessary if other botulinum toxin products are being or have been used to treat other indications for those products. The potency units are specific to Relfydess and are not interchangeable with other preparations of botulinum toxin. Relfydess is ready-to-use with a concentration of 10 units per 0.1 mL and no reconstitution is required.
Dosing Instructions for Relfydess





Treatment(s)


Total Recommended Dose


Dose per injection




Glabellar Lines (GL)


50 units (0.5 mL) 


5 injections of 10 units (0.1 mL):
2 injections on each side at the corrugator muscle and 1 injection at the procerus muscle near the nasofrontal angle




Lateral Canthal Lines (LCL)


60 units (0.6 mL)


6 injections of 10 units (0.1 mL):
3 injections on each side at the orbicularis oculi muscle 




Combined treatment of Glabellar Lines and Lateral Canthal Lines


110 units (1.1 mL) 


11 injections total of 10 units (0.1 mL) for combined GL and LCL





General information
In the event of treatment failure or diminished effect following repeat injections, alternative treatment methods should be employed. In case of treatment failure after the first treatment session, the following approaches may be considered:
·       Analysis of the causes of failure, e.g. incorrect muscles injected, inappropriate injection technique, and formation of toxin-neutralising antibodies.
·       Re-evaluation of the relevance of treatment with botulinum toxin A.
Paediatric population: The safety and efficacy of Relfydess in children aged up to 18 years have not been established. The use of Relfydess is not recommended in patients under 18 years. 
Elderly population: There is limited phase 3 clinical data with Relfydess in patients 65 years and older.
Method of administration: Relfydess should only be administered by health care professionals with appropriate qualifications and expertise in this treatment and having the required equipment, in accordance with national guidelines and legislation. Intramuscular use. Dosing and treatment intervals depend on assessment of the individual patient’s response, but dosing should not exceed maximum doses allowed and the treatment interval should be at least 12 weeks. Each vial should be used for a single patient during a single treatment session only. Any residual product after the treatment should be discarded. Use aseptic technique and standard practice to prevent cross-infections. The median time to onset is 2 to 3 days, with some patients reporting an effect within 1 day. Treatment effect has been demonstrated for 6 months, with up to 75% of patients not returning to baseline. Glabellar lines: The recommended dose for the treatment of glabellar lines in adults is a total of 50 units/0.5 mL administered by intramuscular injection divided equally (10 units/0.1 mL per injection) into each of the 5 intramuscular injection sites: 2 injections on each side at the corrugator muscle and 1 injection at the procerus muscle near the nasofrontal angle. The anatomical landmarks can be more readily identified if palpated and observed at patient maximum frown. Before and during the injection, place the thumb or index finger firmly below the orbital rim in order to prevent extravasation below the orbital rim. The needle bevel should be pointed upward and medially during the injection. In order to reduce the risk of eyelid ptosis, the following steps should be taken:
·       Avoid injections near the levator palpebrae superioris muscle, particularly in patients with larger brow-depressor complexes.
·       Lateral corrugator injections should be placed at least 1 centimetre above the bony supraorbital ridge.
·       Ensure the injected dose (volume) is accurate. 
·       Avoid injecting closer than 1 centimetre above the central eyebrow.
Lateral canthal lines: The recommended dose for the treatment of lateral canthal lines in adults is a total of 60 units/0.6 mL administered by intramuscular injection divided equally into 10 units/0.1 mL into each of the 6 intramuscular injection sites: 3 injections (30 units/0.3 mL) on each side at the orbicularis oculi muscle. Injections should be given with the needle bevel-up and oriented away from the eye in the lateral orbicularis oculi muscle. When lines in the lateral canthal region appear both above and below the lateral canthus, inject above and below lateral canthus. In case lines in the lateral canthal region are mainly below the lateral canthus, inject per below lateral canthus. Lateral canthal line anatomical landmarks can be more readily identified if observed and palpated at maximal smile. Care must be taken to avoid injecting the zygomaticus major/minor muscles to avoid lateral mouth drop and asymmetrical smile. Glabellar lines/lateral canthal lines combined treatment: For combination treatment of glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines, the respective individual dosing and administration should be followed for a total dose of 110 units/1.1 mL of Relfydess. The recommended dose for the treatment of glabellar lines is 50 units/0.5 mL (10 units/0.1 mL per injection) into each of 5 intramuscular injection sites and for lateral canthal lines is 60 units/0.6 mL (10 units/0.1 mL in each of 6 intramuscular injection sites).
Contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin products or to any of the excipients. Presence of infection at the proposed injection sites. Presence of myasthenia gravis, Eaton Lambert Syndrome or amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. 
Precautions and Warnings: General: Relfydess should not be injected into a blood vessel. As with all intramuscular injections, use of Relfydess is not recommended in patients who have a prolonged bleeding time. Patients treated with the recommended dose may experience exaggerated muscle weakness. Each vial of Relfydess must be used for a single patient treatment during a single session. Any excess of unused product must be disposed of and specific precautions must be taken for the inactivation and disposal of any unused solution. Hypersensitivity reactions: Serious and/or immediate hypersensitivity reactions have been reported for botulinum toxin products and anaphylactic reactions can occur very rarely (see ‘Undesirable Effects’). These reactions include anaphylaxis, serum sickness, urticaria, soft tissue oedema, and dyspnoea. Equipment and medications (including adrenaline) needed to treat anaphylaxis should therefore be readily available. If such a reaction occurs, further injection of Relfydess should be discontinued, and appropriate medical therapy immediately instituted. Spread of Toxin effect: Post-marketing safety data from other approved botulinum toxin products suggest that botulinum toxin effects (such as diplopia, blurred vision and ptosis) may be observed beyond the site of local injection (see section 4.8). In addition, adverse reactions possibly related to the spread of toxin effect distant from the site of injection have been reported very rarely with botulinum toxin and may include asthenia, generalised muscle weakness, dysphagia, dysphonia, dysarthria, urinary incontinence, and breathing difficulties. These symptoms are consistent with the mechanism of action of botulinum toxins and have been reported hours to weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death related to spread of toxin effects. Patients with pre-existing swallowing or breathing difficulties may be more susceptible to these complications. More specifically, following treatment with botulinum toxin, very rare cases of death have been reported in the context of patients who have dysphagia, pneumopathy, or significant asthenia. Therefore, Relfydess is not recommended in such patients. Patients or caregivers should be advised to seek immediate medical care if swallowing, speech or respiratory disorders arise. Pre-existing neuromuscular disorders: Relfydess should be used with caution in patients with a risk of, or clinical evidence of, marked defective neuro-muscular transmission. These patients may have an increased sensitivity to agents such as botulinum toxin, and excessive muscle weakness (including systemic effects of severe dysphagia and respiratory compromise) may follow treatment. In some of these cases, dysphagia has lasted several months and required placement of a gastric feeding tube. Pre-existing conditions at the injection site: Caution should be taken when Relfydess is used in the presence of inflammation at the proposed injection site(s) or when excessive weakness or atrophy is present in the targeted muscle(s). Caution should be used when Relfydess treatment is used in patients who have marked facial asymmetry, ptosis, excessive skin laxity (such as dermatochalasis), deep dermal scarring, or thick sebaceous skin. Ophthalmic adverse reactions: Dry eye, reduced tear production, reduced blinking, and corneal disorders may occur with the use of botulinum toxins. If symptoms of dry eye (e.g., eye irritation, photophobia, or visual changes) persist, consider referring the patient to an ophthalmologist. Increased lacrimation may occur with the use of botulinum toxins. Muscle atrophy: Muscle atrophy is expected after repeated botulinum treatment secondary to the flaccid paralysis of the treated muscles. Antibody formation: Injections at more frequent intervals or at higher doses may increase the risk of neutralising antibody formation to botulinum toxin. Clinically, the formation of neutralising antibodies may reduce the effectiveness of subsequent treatment. Traceability: In order to improve the traceability of biological medicinal products, the name and the batch number of the administered product should be clearly recorded. Potassium and Sodium content: This medicine contains potassium, less than 1 mmol (39 mg) per 150 units vial, i.e. essentially ‘potassium-free’. This medicine contains less than 1 mmol sodium (23 mg) per 150 units vial, i.e. essentially ‘sodium-free’. Polysorbate 80 content: This medicine contains 1.6 mg of polysorbate 80 per 150 units vial which is equivalent to 1.1 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions.
Interactions: No drug interaction studies have been conducted. Concomitant treatment with Relfydess and aminoglycosides or other agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission (e.g. curare-like agents or other botulinum toxin products in other locations) should only be used with caution since the effect of botulinum toxin may be potentiated. 
Pregnancy, Breastfeeding and Fertility: Pregnancy: There are no adequate data from the use of botulinum toxin type A in pregnant women. Animal studies do not indicate direct or indirect harmful effects with respect to reproductive toxicity other than at high doses causing maternal toxicity. The potential risk for humans is unknown. Relfydess should not be used during pregnancy and in women of childbearing potential not using contraception. Breastfeeding: It is unknown if Relfydess is excreted in human milk. The excretion of Relfydess in milk has not been studied in animals.  Relfydess should not be used during breast-feeding. Fertility: There are no clinical data examining the effect of Relfydess on fertility.  There is no evidence of direct effect of botulinum toxin A on fertility in animal studies. 
Effects on ability to drive and use machines: Other botulinum toxin products have been reported to have a minor or moderate influence on the ability to drive and/or use machines. There is a potential risk of localised muscle weakness or visual disturbances linked with the use of Relfydess which may temporarily impair the ability to drive or operate machinery.
Undesirable Effects: The majority of adverse reactions reported after one treatment with Relfydess in subjects receiving ≥ 50 units in all placebo-controlled studies in the development program were of mild to moderate intensity. The most frequently reported adverse reactions were injection site reactions and headache occurring in approximately 7% and 5% of subjects, respectively. In general, treatment/injection technique-related reactions occurred within the first month following injection and were transient. When glabellar lines and lateral canthal lines were treated in combination, the nature and frequency of adverse reactions were comparable to what was observed when patients were treated for the individual indications. The following adverse reactions were observed in patients that were administered Relfydess for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe glabellar lines: Common (≥ 1/100 to < 1/10): Headache, eyelid ptosis, injection site reactions (e.g. bruising, swelling, pruritus, pain, discomfort,  haematoma, hypersensitivity and warmth), uncommon (≥ 1/1,000 to <1/100): Hypersensitivity, visual impairment, dry eye, asthenopia, brow ptosis, urticaria, muscular weakness, muscle spasm. The following adverse reactions were observed in patients that were administered Relfydess for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate to severe lateral canthal lines: Common (≥ 1/100 to < 1/10): Headache, injection site reactions (e.g. erythema, pain, and bruising), uncommon (≥ 1/1,000 to <1/100): Hypersensitivity, dry eye, asthenopia, swelling of eyelid, muscular weakness.
 
Prescribers should consult the summary of product characteristics for further details.

STYLAGE® Hydro is one of the most hydrating products in the STYLAGE® range. Its main role is to bring moisture and hydration back to the skin through superficial injections on the skin’s surface and can be used to treat the full face. It can also be applied to the neck and décolleté, as it is not only the face that is prone to ageing or sun-damage.The non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid gel is extremely fluid to help it absorb more quickly and easily into the skin’s surface. It is recommended to establish several injection appointments with STYLAGE® Hydro to obtain optimal results and better skin quality!Key Benefits
Deep hydration: Replenishes skin’s moisture for a fresh, dewy appearance.
Improved skin elasticity: Promotes firmness and smoothness by stimulating collagen production.
Enhanced radiance: Revitalises dull, tired-looking skin for a brighter complexion.
Antioxidant protection: Mannitol reduces free radical damage and prolongs the effects of treatment.
Long-lasting results: Provides lasting hydration and skin quality improvements for several months.

jsonld.description: TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is a sterile, transparent, non-pyrogenic, viscoelastic gel made of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid (HA) of non-animal origin (from HA mean molecular weight higher than 1 million Dalton), and contains 0.3% by mass of lidocaine hydrochloride, for its anesthetic properties. Each box contains one or two pre-filled syringes of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1. For each syringe, the box contains two sterile 30G1/2’’ needles and two traceability labels (one to be given to the patient, and one to be kept by the doctor in the patient medical records). The volume of gel in each syringe is indicated on the cardboard box as well on each syringe.Hyaluronic acid is a major constituent of the ground substance of the dermal extracellular matrix. A genuine molecular sponge, its helicoidal structure enables it to trap up to a thousand times its weight in water. It is widely distributed in cutaneous tissue and hydrates the skin, though its content diminishes with age. As the skin becomes thinner and fragile, initial skin fracture lines appear. Thanks to its marked fluidity and its viscoelastic properties, TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is evenly distributed. This characteristic ensures that an optimal level of dermal hydration is maintained and leads to a lasting improvement in the skin's texture and elasticity.TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is a biodegradable implant that is progressively resorbed over time. The estimated lifetime of TEOSYAL® PureSense REDENSITY 1 is at least 3 months. The duration of the treatment depends on several factors including skin type, the severity of the wrinkle to be treated, the injection area, the volume injected, the patient’s physiology and lifestyle.In their aesthetic indications, TEOSYAL® products do not have an intended medical purpose. Therefore, the non-medical benefit of TEOSYAL® devices is understood as clinical performance. Overall, 70 to 100% of patients experienced an aesthetic improvement of the treated area following the injection, based on data collected throughout clinical studies program.

About ALLSKIN | MED Exfoliating Cleanser The ALLSKIN | MED Exfoliating Cleanser is a daily, medical-grade, gentle dual-action exfoliating cleanser developed for normal to oily and combination skin, designed to cleanse effectively while addressing excess sebum, congestion and surface build-up. Formulated as a gel-based cleanser combining chemical and physical exfoliation, with purifying and moisturising active ingredients, it provides gentle yet effective exfoliation to support the removal of impurities and dead skin cells while helping to maintain skin comfort and tolerance. Key Ingredients Cleansing Complex: Mild, skin-tolerant surfactants remove impurities, excess oil and surface debris by reducing water’s surface tension, supporting effective daily cleansing for normal, oily and combination skin while maintaining comfort. Physical Exfoliant: Natural, biodegradable microcrystalline cellulose provides controlled mechanical exfoliation to remove dead skin cells, excess sebum and surface impurities, supporting pore decongestion and refined skin texture. Chemical Exfoliation: Salicylic acid (BHA) delivers targeted, oil-soluble exfoliation within pores, helping dissolve dead skin cells to support pore decongestion, improved clarity and smoother texture. Moisturising Complex: Glycerin and sodium PCA attract and retain water to support hydration during and after cleansing, helping reduce post-cleansing tightness and maintain comfort. Comfort Complex: Panthenol and niacinamide provide soothing and skin-conditioning support, helping calm the skin and maintain balance with regular use. About ALLSKIN | MED Renewal Pads ALLSKIN | MED Renewal Pads are a gentle triple action exfoliant designed to prepare, refine and revitalise the skin. Combining three complementary modes of exfoliation – chemical, physical and enzymatic – they are designed to prep the skin ahead of professional treatments, whilst continuing cellular renewal to enhance results at home. Although suitable for all skin types, the Renewal Pads help oily and acne prone skin have long lasting clarity and balance by reducing excess sebum production, which prevents skin inflammation, clogged pores, acne, and blackheads. By regulating oil levels, the pads restore the skins natural pH, refine pores, brighten tone and boost hydration. By harnessing its triple action approach, the renewal pads work to remove dead skin cells and impurities, leaving the complexion smoother, brighter and renewed. Pre-Procedure: Used at home prior to treatment, they prepare the skin to enable treatments to penetrate more evenly and deeply. This not only enhances the performance of in-clinic procedures but also supports a smoother recovery process and more radiant, longer-lasting outcomes. At-Home: Consistent use of the Renewal Pads will regulate the oiliness of the skin and reduce any inflammation, helping to support the absorption of daily skincare products. By keeping the skin refined and balanced between treatments, it prolongs the visible benefits achieved in-clinic. Key Ingredients AHA & BHA complex: A progressive-release complex of glycolic, lactic, salicylic and citric acids works together to exfoliate and renew the skin, refine texture and tone, stimulate antioxidant activity, and enhance overall radiance. Modified Fruit Enzyme: Papaya, Pineapple, and Pomegranate, offer a mild, surface-level exfoliation. They enhance skin smoothness and radiance while supporting hydration, barrier repair, and sebum control. Panthenol & Pentylene Glycol: Helps calm irritation and provides moisture​. Antioxidant complex: Helps calm irritation and protect against oxidative stress. About ALLSKIN | MED Renewal Scrub By harnessing its triple-action approach, the Renewal Scrub works on multiple levels to gently resurface the skin. The physical exfoliants lift away surface debris, while the chemical and enzymatic components help to dissolve impurities and encourage cellular renewal. The result is a visibly smoother texture, refined pores, and balanced surface oils, leaving the skin refreshed, radiant and perfectly primed for in-clinic procedures. description: ALLSKIN | MED Retinoid Pigment Control Emulsions RETINDUO® Dual Retinoid Technology: Pure retinol in microsponges + AOX Tech–encapsulated retinal, enhanced with a bioavailability booster to maximise efficacy with optimised tolerance. Multi-Pathway Pigment Correction System: Clinically proven formula combining RETINDUO® with Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, and N-Acetyl Glucosamine to target the key drivers of hyperpigmentation. Barrier Support & Treatment Flexibility: Reoxderm® antioxidant technology protects against oxidative stress while a moisturising repair system and multiple medical-grade strengths enable personalised treatment protocols. 50ml SRP £110.00 / £125.00 / £132.00 Available in potency levels 1, 2, 3 Login To Order Tell Me More Existing customers can buy the product now via the Professional Shop. Otherwise, you can enquire about this product and learn how to stock it. About ALLSKIN | MED Retinoid Pigment Control Emulsions An innovative medical-grade approach for patients presenting with photodamage and hyperpigmentation, to reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots, unify skin tone, and increase skin firmness and elasticity. Powered by RETINDUO® Technology, at three medical-grade potency levels: 1, 2, 3 and expertly formulated with a clinically proven pigment correction system combining Tranexamic Acid and Niacinamide, to accelerate pigment reduction and support the skin’s biological processes that help reduce melanin production. Reoxderm® patented antioxidant barrier technology, and a moisturising repair system to hydrate and protect the skin barrier, helping to reduce inflammation and enhance the skin’s tolerance to the retinoid activity . Clinically evaluated outcomes after only 27 days of use 1 : 90% reported more radiant and luminous skin 90% reported firmer and rejuvenated skin 95% reported improved skin elasticity High levels of skin comfort and tolerability Recommended by experts “Effective pigmentation management requires more than surface correction. It demands a strategic, multi-pathway approach to regulate melanogenesis while preserving the skin barrier. By combining ALLKSIN | MED’s advanced retinoid technology with tranexamic acid and niacinamide, this formulation addresses both existing pigment and the underlying drivers of hyperpigmentation, without compromising skin integrity.” Key Ingredients RETINDUO® Technology: Combining retinol and retinal with a bioavailability booster, RETINDUO® accelerates cellular turnover, supporting the dispersion of established pigment and restoration of luminosity without compromising skin integrity. Reoxderm® Technology: A patented antioxidant and immunomodulating technology that protects the skin barrier and regulates oxidative stress, helping to reduce inflammation, support repair and enhance skin tolerance. Tranexamic Acid: A key ingredient in prescriptive pigmentation protocols, tranexamic acid is clinically proven to influence keratinocytes and melanocytes, helping regulate and reduce melanin production and inflammation. Niacinamide: Inhibits melanin transfer from melanocytes to keratinocytes, helping reduce visible pigmentation and improve overall skin tone and clarity. Targets reactivity by strengthening the skin barrier. Acetyl Glucosamine: Reduces pigmentation by inhibiting melanin production and improves skin quality. Moisturising Repair System: Working alongside the pigment correction system, the moisturising repair system supports skin hydration and barrier function, with ingredients including camelina oil to restore the lipid barrier, calendula extract to soothe and calm the skin and anti-inflammatory Bisabolol. description: ALLSKIN | MED Retinoid Texture Repair Emulsion RETINDUO® Dual Retinoid Technology: Pure retinol in microsponges + AOX Tech–encapsulated retinal, supported by a bioavailability booster to optimise activity, stability, and treatment efficacy. Advanced Retexturising & Skin Balancing System: Combines RETINDUO® with Reoxderm® to normalise cell turnover, regulate sebum, decongest pores, and support the microbiome, barrier function, and inflammation control. Supports Skin Comfort & Daily Use : Moisturising and peptide repair system helps maintain hydration, reinforce the skin barrier and support comfort during retinoid use, while the lightweight, non-greasy texture is ideal for combination to oily, acne-prone skin and consistent daily application. 50ml SRP £130.00 Potency level 2 Login To Order Tell Me More Existing customers can buy the product now via the Professional Shop. Otherwise, you can enquire about this product and learn how to stock it. About ALLSKIN | MED Retinoid Texture Repair Emulsion An advanced lightweight medical-grade formulation particularly suitable for combination, oily and acne-prone skin. Powered by RETINDUO® technology at retinoid potency level 2, designed to improve skin texture and refine pores, regulate sebum and promote a smoother, more balanced complexion, while also helping to improve signs of ageing. Reoxderm® patented antioxidant barrier technology, alongside an advanced moisturising and tri-peptide repair complex, protects and hydrates the skin barrier and helps balance the skin microbiome, helping reduce inflammation and enhance the skin’s tolerance to the retinoid activity. Clinically evaluated outcomes after only 27 days of use 1 : 95% reported improved skin texture and tone 90% reported smoother skin 90% reported reduced appearance of fine lines High levels of skin comfort and tolerability Recommended by experts “My go-to for textural irregularities, enlarged pores and acne-prone skin. They all share a common underlying driver: dysfunctional keratinisation. Retinoids remain the gold standard, normalising cellular turnover, decongesting follicular pathways and regulating sebum production, but only when tolerance is maintained. ALLSKIN | MED’s Texture Repair Emulsion is designed for sustained daily use, progressively refining skin texture and supporting collagen remodelling without compromising the skin barrier, delivering a measurable and lasting improvement in skin clarity and uniformity.” Key Ingredients RETINDUO® Technology: Combining retinol and retinal with a bioavailability booster, RETINDUO® accelerates cellular turnover to improve skin texture, refine pores and support the normalisation of sebum production. Reoxderm® Technology: A patented antioxidant and immunomodulating technology (including curcumin, tocopherol, lycopene and ascorbic acid) that protects the skin barrier, regulates oxidative stress, helps reduce inflammation, supports repair and balances the skin microbiome. Moisturising & Peptide Repair System: : A complex of soothing and hydrating ingredients, including Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract, Bisabolol and Glycerin, designed to support hydration, reinforce barrier function, and improve comfort during retinoid use. Anti-Ageing & Antioxidant Complex: Combines Palmitoyl Tripeptide-5, Beta-Glucan and Buddleja Davidii Extract to help protect against oxidative stress, support collagen production, and strengthen the skin barrier. Helps defend the skin from environmental damage. This system helps reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Promotes smoother-looking skin while improving overall texture and tone, helping to minimise the look of imperfections.
